Formerly Battlefield Info.

The small Battlefield Map, turned into the map you actually play with.

Waymark builds on the game's own Battlefield Map (Shift-M): the small map you can keep open while you play. It's an exploration aid in the classic spirit: it shows you the world and leaves the route to you.

• Rares and treasures (with RareScanner), gathering nodes (with GatherMate2)
• Dungeons and caves: dungeon entrances on the world, a dungeon's own map while you're inside, and cave maps either art or minimap detail when youre inside.
• Exploration: show unexpored in different styles you want
• Your group: party and raid members in class colours, a line to your target (friendlies only).
The map itself
• Resize it, move it, zoom it in and out, and switch to a large mode.
• Close-up detail when you zoom in near. (or at any zoom if you choose)
• Zoom out for continent view, seamless.
• Header and border styles to choose from: classic plate, parchment, leather, stone, gold, wood and more.
• Every layer has its own switch, opacity and size, and a row of toggle buttons on the map that you pick and order yourself.
• Context profiles: different layers in combat, battlegrounds, dungeons, towns or while gathering, or hide the map there.
• Saved setups: keep several complete setups and switch between them; each character can use its own.
• Key bindings also!

DropTheCheapestThingv2026.5 (2026-09-20)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Add profile support
AceDBOptions gives the database's profiles a tab in the options. The default
profile is still DEFAULT, so an existing install opens on the settings it
already had, and a character that wants its own lists picks its own profile.
Two places held on to a profile table instead of reading it through db, and a
switch left them pointing at the profile the player just left: the merchant
module's file-local db, and the minimap settings LibDBIcon keeps a reference
to. Both are refreshed from the parent database's OnProfile callbacks.
• Show junk icon in blizzard bags as well
• Move the "mark junk in bags" toggle to the General section
It doesn't have anything to do with "what to drop", after all.
Follow-up-to: 1513f9d9215377c586e5f95924081f9d14277589
• An option to stop marking junk in the bag addons (#2)
The switch is read inside the two callbacks rather than around the
registration. Bagnon and Baganator are told about the plugin once, when they
load, and neither offers a way to withdraw it, so a flag checked at
registration would only take effect after a reload -- and an option that needs
a reload is one people report as broken.
Defaults to on, which is what everyone has today, and the toggle greys itself
out when neither bag addon is loaded, the way the appearance toggle does
without transmog.
• API: drop with sell\_if\_available could be confused by unsellable items
If at a merchant, and the cheapest item was something unsellable, if
sell\_if\_available was set we'd call drop\_bagslot with drop\_only based
on the function-level sell\_if\_available, not the item-level sell\_only
which actually took whether it was sellable into account.
This wouldn't be terrible, but it would stall selling items via the API
because it'd claim it was selling it, print the message, then error "the
merchant doesn't want this item"... and just get stuck.
• Bindings: also offer bindings for drop/sell/sell-or-drop
• Bindings: add a binding for never consider as well
• Bindings: move to a dedicated category
Blizzard stopped header displaying anything back in 2022, and doesn't
plan to change that (see: Stanzilla/WoWUIBugs#305). This makes a binding
like "Toggle the item under the mouse" extremely hard to interpret when
mixed with other addon bindings.
Refs #34
Follow-up-to: 513e44fa7d48122ebaf6528a92b59e8ec34faba5
• Don't load Bindings.xml in the TOC
It's magic, Blizzard loads it if it's present. It being the TOC causes
an error because blizzard
Refs #34
Follow-up-to: 513e44fa7d48122ebaf6528a92b59e8ec34faba5
• Auction values were used for the sale total chat summary
• API.Drop ignored sell\_if\_available
• A key that toggles the item under the mouse in Always Consider (#30)
Built over the snippet in the issue, with the Lua moved out of the XML into
config.lua -- the file that already holds db and already owns the two lists --
and the message going through DEFAULT\_CHAT\_FRAME like the rest of the addon.
No default key. The binding sits under its own header in the keybinding UI,
so it is bindable to a controller button as well, which is free with Blizzard
bindings and is what makes the addon usable without a mouse.
.luacheckrc gains the two BINDING\_ globals; without them luacheck fails the
build with "setting non-standard global variable", which I checked by running
your lint both ways on a scratch runner.
• Never consider the greys that buy the Baubleworm pets (#14)
Nine grey items are the currency for the three Baubleworm pets. They look
exactly like junk, and selling one costs the pet, so they go in the same
hardcoded list as the Haunted Memento. Item ids are the ones in #14.
• Slash commands for drop and sell (#4)
/dtct drop and /dtct sell do what the minimap button's clicks do, through the
API that api.lua already exposes; /dtct sell all sells the list, capped at the
buyback limit. Anything else opens the config, so /dtct on its own behaves as
it always has.…

addons.description:
(screen)-shotta, mate. Automatically take screenshots of your best moments in
Azeroth so you can keep them forever.
Shotta Discord
Join the Shotta Discord server to share your
best screenshots, suggest features, or just chat.
Features
Shotta takes screenshots for you automatically, so the moments worth keeping
are saved without you thinking about it. Each event can be toggled on its own:
• levelling up, quest completions and reputation/renown gains
• achievements, loot rolls and hearthstone binds
• boss kills, including first kills and raid encounters
• entering a new zone or area
• ready checks, trade windows and group formation
• emotes, mailboxes, auction houses and chat channels
• death
• on a timer: every 5, 10 or 30 minutes

Screenshots include the interface by default. You can also take one on demand
from the minimap button: click it for a screenshot without the UI, or
control-click it to include the UI.

Every library is embedded, so there is nothing else to install. New events are
added regularly and suggestions are very welcome via GitHub issues or Discord.

Shotta supports Retail, Forever, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Classic Era, and
Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary.

Screenshots are saved to the Screenshots folder inside the game installation
for the client you are playing:

| Client | Folder |
| --- | --- |
| Retail | retail/Screenshots |
| Forever | camelot/Screenshots |
| Mists of Pandaria Classic | classic/Screenshots |
| Classic Era | _classic_era_/Screenshots |
| Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary | anniversary/Screenshots |

On Windows these live under C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft\, and on
macOS under /Applications/World of Warcraft/.

4.2
On World of Warcraft: Forever, a party member set as a custom target now takes. Until now chat said it was set, but it was not.

On World of Warcraft: Forever, Dispel is now two actions. A Dispel action now shows as Dispel: Curse, Disease, and Dispel: Magic, Poison is new. Both work on a Druid, Priest, Shaman or Paladin; a Mage has only Dispel: Curse, Disease. Where a class has two spells for one dispel, the higher-level one is cast once you know it.

A key where no action runs can go back to WoW, if you want it to. Set When no action runs under Keys Given Back in Debind's settings to Key is given back, and the key then does what WoW or another addon has on it, as it did before 4.0. It starts on Press does nothing, which is what every key has done since 4.0.

Keys given back can follow a change sooner. A key that is given back, or runs a WoW Binding, only in some situations can still do what it did before a change for up to 0.2 seconds after it. This can happen with When no action runs set to Key is given back, or on a key with a Give Key Back or WoW Binding action. Lowering State Driver Interval, under Miscellaneous in Debind's settings, shortens that delay, down to one frame at 0. The value belongs to Blizzard's state driver, which other addons use too, so a lower value makes theirs update more often as well and costs more CPU. With no such key, the slider changes nothing.

Hover Cast has no Off, and a press while you point at a unit follows the order on screen. It tries a key's actions in the order the Overview tab shows. An action that was on Off is now on Cast on the usual target, so one standing above an action set to Cast on the unit you point at now takes that press; set it to Skip this action to pass it on. One that was on Off with Normal Cast unticked is now on Skip this action. As set it never runs, so it is marked Needs checking.

Mouse buttons other than left and right click run on unit frames. An action on one of them now runs when you click a unit frame with that button, and goes where its Hover Cast row sends it. To leave that click to the frame as before, set it to Skip this action.

During a pet battle, an Action Button action does what WoW's own keybinding for that button does. Action Button 1 to 5 press the battle's buttons, and 6 to 12 do nothing. Until now it pressed that slot of your main action bar.

An Action Button action whose slot holds a flyout opens it at the cursor, as a Flyout action does. It used to open on that slot's button on WoW's action bar, so with a bar addon that hides WoW's bars it showed nothing and left that addon's button raising an error.

Two new actions: Give Key Back and WoW Binding. Give Key Back, in the Special tab of Add an action, gives the key back when it runs. WoW Binding, in the WoW Bindings tab, runs one of WoW's own keybindings. A Use WoW's Own Binding or Binding Command left over from before 4.0 is now a Nothing action, which is what it has done since 4.0.

The Commands tab of Add an action is now WoW Bindings, and holds only WoW's own keybindings. Targeting, focus, the unit menu, world markers and the Action Button rows moved to the Special tab.

A share code made by 4.2 cannot be pasted into 4.1.2 or earlier, which answer that it was made by a newer version of Debind. Share codes made by earlier versions still paste into 4.2.
4.1.2
On World of Warcraft: Forever, spells you have not learned yet can be given a key now. Talking to a class trainer adds the spells that trainer can teach to an Unlearned group in the spell list. With Unavailable checked in the trainer window's filters, the spells you cannot learn yet are added as well. The group's tooltip says the same.
4.1.1
Entering an arena with Clique or another click casting addon installed no longer raises a Lua error from Debind.

addons.description:
Supports Retail and World of Warcraft: Forever.

Set a key once, for every character you have. Override it on one class, one spec, or a single alt — and only that key changes.

A key in Debind goes straight to a spell, an item, or a macro — no action bar slot involved — and the layers decide which characters it covers. Whatever you already bound in WoW's own keybinding window stays exactly where it is, and stays there if you ever remove Debind.
The problem
Roll an alt of a class you already play and you lay its bars out like the others. Some of those spells are on the bar because you want to watch the cooldown. The rest are on the bar because that's where the keybind is. 3 doesn't mean Judgment. 3 means the third button on the first bar, and Judgment happens to be standing there.

Addons have been putting spells on keys without a bar slot for years. None of them answer the next question:

Which characters is this key for?

Most of your binds are the same on every character. Some belong to one class. A few to one spec, one or two to a single character. WoW's own switch is all-or-nothing — the whole set shared, or the whole set per-character — and all-or-nothing has no way to say that. Go character-specific and every key that was the same everywhere now has to be set everywhere — the chore you were trying to avoid, times your alt count.

And "which character" isn't the only question a key has. The same key can want one thing in combat and another out of it, one thing on the frame under your mouse and another anywhere else. That part you already know — it's why you ran out of modifier keys, and why the macro got too long.

So the binds have to be layered, and one key has to be able to mean more than one thing.
What you get
• Layers, not profiles. account → class → spec → this character → that character's spec. The narrowest layer holding that key wins; the rest keep every other key. Nothing to switch by hand — the layers follow your character and spec.
• @healer and @tank that actually work. WoW has no idea what a healer is; Debind does. Pick Healer as an action's target and you're done — no macro. And where you do want one, /cast @healer,exists Innervate is one line.
• Conditions on any key. In combat, in a form, in a party or a raid, while some unit exists — re-checked as they change.
• Click casting built in. A key can go to the unit you point at, so one key heals off the raid frames and stays a normal key everywhere else. Unit frame addons work with it whether or not they support Clique, and Clique itself can run alongside.
• Flip what a key does mid-fight. Switches of your own, usable in combat, without spending a real modifier.

Debind is for the keys where the answer isn't "all of them." Put in the ones you want now — every other key goes on working exactly as it did.
Layers
| Where a key can come from | Who it applies to |
|---|---|
| Character / Specialization | this character, in this spec |
| Character / Class | this character |
| Account / Specialization | every Druid you own, while Balance |
| Account / Class | every Druid you own |
| Account / General | every character on the account |

A layer holds only the keys you put in it — never a whole keyboard. So the question is asked one key at a time: for this key, which rows have something to say?

The narrowest row that fits wins. A row whose conditions don't hold has nothing to say this time, so the key carries on to the next row that does, and if none of them do, by default it does whatever it would do without Debind. Nothing is switched off on the way: the rows below are still answering for every other key.…

4.2
On World of Warcraft: Forever, a party member set as a custom target now takes. Until now chat said it was set, but it was not.

On World of Warcraft: Forever, Dispel is now two actions. A Dispel action now shows as Dispel: Curse, Disease, and Dispel: Magic, Poison is new. Both work on a Druid, Priest, Shaman or Paladin; a Mage has only Dispel: Curse, Disease. Where a class has two spells for one dispel, the higher-level one is cast once you know it.

A key where no action runs can go back to WoW, if you want it to. Set When no action runs under Keys Given Back in Debind's settings to Key is given back, and the key then does what WoW or another addon has on it, as it did before 4.0. It starts on Press does nothing, which is what every key has done since 4.0.

Keys given back can follow a change sooner. A key that is given back, or runs a WoW Binding, only in some situations can still do what it did before a change for up to 0.2 seconds after it. This can happen with When no action runs set to Key is given back, or on a key with a Give Key Back or WoW Binding action. Lowering State Driver Interval, under Miscellaneous in Debind's settings, shortens that delay, down to one frame at 0. The value belongs to Blizzard's state driver, which other addons use too, so a lower value makes theirs update more often as well and costs more CPU. With no such key, the slider changes nothing.

Hover Cast has no Off, and a press while you point at a unit follows the order on screen. It tries a key's actions in the order the Overview tab shows. An action that was on Off is now on Cast on the usual target, so one standing above an action set to Cast on the unit you point at now takes that press; set it to Skip this action to pass it on. One that was on Off with Normal Cast unticked is now on Skip this action. As set it never runs, so it is marked Needs checking.

Mouse buttons other than left and right click run on unit frames. An action on one of them now runs when you click a unit frame with that button, and goes where its Hover Cast row sends it. To leave that click to the frame as before, set it to Skip this action.

During a pet battle, an Action Button action does what WoW's own keybinding for that button does. Action Button 1 to 5 press the battle's buttons, and 6 to 12 do nothing. Until now it pressed that slot of your main action bar.

An Action Button action whose slot holds a flyout opens it at the cursor, as a Flyout action does. It used to open on that slot's button on WoW's action bar, so with a bar addon that hides WoW's bars it showed nothing and left that addon's button raising an error.

Two new actions: Give Key Back and WoW Binding. Give Key Back, in the Special tab of Add an action, gives the key back when it runs. WoW Binding, in the WoW Bindings tab, runs one of WoW's own keybindings. A Use WoW's Own Binding or Binding Command left over from before 4.0 is now a Nothing action, which is what it has done since 4.0.

The Commands tab of Add an action is now WoW Bindings, and holds only WoW's own keybindings. Targeting, focus, the unit menu, world markers and the Action Button rows moved to the Special tab.

This version adds initial support for WoW: Forever!

Additional Changes

• Most Chat Window Settings will now only be changed if needed, instead upon every addon settings load. This is a test to try and prevent taint in Mythic+/Boss Encounters.

addons.description:
An addon for World of Warcraft!
About
This QOL addon synchronizes various Blizzard Interface Settings that are normally character specific and applies them to all of your characters on your account automatically, including brand new characters.

The addon can synchronise the following, and you can disable any that you'd rather keep character specific:
• Combat
• Action Targeting Settings
• Assisted Highlight Setting
• Auto Loot Settings
• Empowered Spell Input Setting
• Loss of Control Settings
• Mouseover Cast Setting
• Self Cast Setting
• Misc. Combat Settings
• Unit Frames & Nameplates
• Arena Frame Settings
• Nameplate Settings
• Party/Raid Frame Settings
• HUD & Interface
• Calendar Filter Settings
• Camera Settings
• Cooldown Manager Visibility Setting
• Chosen Edit Mode Layout
• Damage Meter Settings
• External Defensives Visibility Setting
• Gamepad Settings
• Minimap Settings
• Spell Overlay Settings
• Viewed Tutorial Tooltips
• Visible Action Bars
• World Map Settings
• Zone Map (Shift-M) Settings
• Misc. UI Settings
• Social
• Block Channel Invite Setting
• Block Guild Invite Setting
• Block Neighborhood Invite Setting
• Block Trade Request Setting
• Chat Window Settings
• Chat Position/Size Settings
• Custom Chat Channels
• Location Visibility Setting
• System
• Graphics Settings
• Audio Settings
• Modifier Keybinds
• Experimental (Togglable in Advanced Options)
• Bag Organisation Settings
Additional Functionality
• Profile Support - Save and switch between multiple Interface configurations
• Profile Import/Export - Share your profile as a text string with others online, or import a profile string that has been shared with you
• Graphics & Audio Settings Import/Export - Export your system settings from one WoW client and import into another
• Force Leave/Join Blizzard Chat Channels - Never see Services spam on any character again, or perhaps always make them join Trade Chat?
• Screen Resolution Specific Settings - Useful for users who sync addon settings across multiple PCs, enable in Advanced Settings
• Custom CVar Support - Enter your own additional list of CVars to synchronise across characters, enable in Advanced Settings
Compatibility
• Midnight - 12.1.5
• MoP Classic - 5.5.4
• TBC Classic - 2.5.6
• Forever - 1.60.1
• Classic Era - 1.15.9

Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog,
and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.
[Unreleased][2.3.0] - 2026-10-14
Stable release of 2.3.0-beta1: no code changes since the beta (the entries below are the release content).

Verified in game on this build: the M1 Part D regression pass (docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md) - the event reason argument, the single-frame dispatch, the target-change STOP, the WoW: Forever target registration and the Unit:Reschedule pause-resume fix - and the duplicate-dispatch two-copy test (an addon embedding MINOR 37 loaded together with this build).

Known unverified in this release: the WoW: Forever Multi-Shot / Aimed Shot no-reset (UNIT_SPELLCAST_START behavior, melee cadence across the cast) and the Rapid Fire mid-swing rescale (whether the engine rescales the in-flight swing at all, and the factor, 1.40 vs 1.41) - no in-game capture yet. Capture plan: docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md B8.
[2.3.0-beta1] - 2026-10-14
Known unverified in this build: the WoW: Forever entries below - no in-game capture yet. Multi-Shot / Aimed Shot no-reset: UNIT_SPELLCAST_START behavior, melee cadence across the cast. Rapid Fire: whether the engine rescales the in-flight swing at all, and the factor (1.40 vs 1.41). Capture plan: docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md B8. The event reason argument, the single-frame dispatch, the target-change STOP, the Forever target registration and the Unit:Reschedule helper below: no in-game pass on any client yet (luajit -bl syntax check only); the duplicate-dispatch fix wants a two-copy test (an addon embedding MINOR 37 loaded together with this build). Regression plan: docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md Part D.
Added
• reason argument on UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START / UNIT_SWING_TIMER_UPDATE and their legacy SWING_TIMER_* variants (all clients), appended after hand so existing consumers are unaffected. START: "swing" (a swing seen by the game), "reset", "clip", "attack"; UPDATE: "haste", "parry", "pause", "autoshot", "movement". On WoW: Forever this tells consumers which starts come from the game's own PLAYER_SWING ("swing") and which are the library's reconstruction.
• Rapid Fire (3045) mid-swing haste on WoW: Forever: the cast now rescales the in-flight main-hand, off-hand and ranged swings by 1.4 (Wowhead Forever lists +41%, the forever-hunter wiki +40%), through the dynamic-haste path Slice and Dice uses. ApplyDynamicHaste gains an optional ranged factor, fed from a new dynamic_ranged_haste_spells table, so the Slice and Dice rescale keeps leaving ranged alone. The rescale is not undone when the buff fades; the next swing re-anchors on its true speed, as with Slice and Dice. Classic flavors unchanged (they rescale ranged via UNIT_ATTACK_SPEED).
Changed
• Internal: every in-flight swing reschedule (parry haste, haste rescale, pause resume, Auto Shot cast window, movement delay) goes through one Unit:Reschedule helper (all clients). Behavior is unchanged except that a pause resume now cancels the hand's existing timer before arming the new one, so a swing that started during the pause can no longer leave two timers (and two STOPs) behind. Needs a regression pass on Classic Era and on a client with pause spells (Wrath, Cata, Mists: Slam).
Fixed
• Fire every event once when several addons embed different library versions (all clients): each copy created its own event frame, and after a LibStub upgrade the older copy's frame kept dispatching into the shared library, so every game event was handled twice (START / STOP / START per swing). The frame is now shared through lib.frame and taken over by a newer copy; handlers dispatch through a private table and the lib.EVENT_NAME entries are blanked, which also silences frames left behind by copies up to MINOR 37.…
addons.description:
There is no relevant WOW API to have an easily accessible state of the swing timer. This library fires custom EVENTS that can be used in other ADDONs to produce swing timer information.
WoW: Forever
The library runs on WoW: Forever (the Classic-rule-set mainline client) and fires the same events as on Classic Era:
• Swing detection uses the native PLAYER_SWING event (the client refuses the combat log there). The player's main-hand, off-hand and ranged swings are all anchored by it, including in restricted content where weapon-speed APIs return secret values.
• Cast-completion resets, instant-with-reset spells and no-reset exceptions follow the Classic Era spell tables — the client reuses classic-era spell IDs.
• Parry haste is reflected mid-swing on the player, via the defender-anchored UNIT_COMBAT event (probe-verified on the beta). Other mid-swing modifications (haste changes) are still reflected at the next swing; no addon-facing event exists for those (report filed with Blizzard).
• Target swing tracking is unsupported on WoW: Forever — no UNIT_SWING_TIMER_* event other than UNIT_SWING_TIMER_INFO_INITIALIZED fires for "target", and UnitSwingTimerInfo("target", ...) always reports a parked state (no swing in flight).
• Only UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START events with reason "swing" come from the game's own swing event. The other reasons (cast resets, clips, haste, parry, ...) are the library's reconstruction of the Classic rules; any drift is corrected at the next swing, which then arrives as UNIT_SWING_TIMER_STOP followed by UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START.
• The game's own swing timer bars (controlled by the showSwingTimer CVar) coexist with this library's events; disable the CVar if you only want addon-driven bars.
Usage example:Use in AddonUse in WeakAuras
The LibClassicSwingTimerAPI fire the events as WeakAuras custom events that can be use on Custom Triggers. The following auras export strings are examples on how to use the lib in WeakAuras.
Main hand auraOff hand auraRanged hand auraAPI EVENTSUNIT_SWING_TIMER_INFO_INITIALIZED
Fired after the initialization of swing information for the unit. The UnitSwingTimerInfo method is only usable after this event. It fires again for the player after every loading screen, and for the target on every target change: treat it as "reset everything for this unit". Swings still in flight at that moment end with UNIT_SWING_TIMER_STOP first.

| Property | Description |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| unitId | string - type of the unit ("player" or "target") |
UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START
Fired when a weapon or ranged swing starts.

| Property | Description |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| unitId | string - type of the unit ("player" or "target") |
| speed | number - weapon speed |
| expirationTime | number - end of swing relative to GetTime() |
| hand | string - the hand that start to swing ("mainhand", "offhand" or "ranged") |
| reason | string - why the swing started, see below |

| reason | Meaning |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| "swing" | A swing seen by the game: an auto attack, an Auto Shot / wand shot, or an on-next-swing ability (Heroic Strike, Raptor Strike, Maul...) |
| "reset" | A spell cast, channel end, Feign Death, Volley or weapon swap restarted the timer |
| "clip" | The swing came due during a cast and restarted; UNIT_SWING_TIMER_CLIPPED follows |
| "attack" | Auto-attack was switched on (off-hand start) |

UNIT_SWING_TIMER_UPDATE
Fired when an in-flight swing's end time changes: a weapon speed change, and also parry haste, the end of a pause, or a delayed Auto Shot. speed is the weapon speed, not the time left: expirationTime - speed is not the swing's start after an update.

Known limitation: a parry in the same frame as the player's own swing start is treated as landing before that swing and does not shorten it. The engine applied the cut in one such case and skipped it in another (Classic Era captures), so the rule stays until more samples settle the ordering; 2.1.x cut every parry.

• Park the player's swings on PLAYER_DEAD (all clients): the death reset cancelled each active hand's timer and fired UNIT_SWING_TIMER_STOP but left its expiration in the future, so UnitSwingTimerInfo kept reporting the stopped swing as in flight until that time passed. Each stopped hand now parks (expiration = lastSwing, the same convention as the login seed) before its STOP fires, so a consumer that reads the state inside its STOP handler already sees it parked. Found in the Classic Era regression pass (2026-10-02, client 1.15.9.70003, Season of Discovery realm): STOP fired at death with 0.54 s left on the main hand, while the state query still read that swing as in flight. Event-driven consumers were unaffected. Verified on the same client after the fix: one STOP at death and the main hand reads parked at once; the duplicate PLAYER_DEAD fires nothing; the first swing after resurrection starts cleanly. addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon that remembers the people you meet in the open world.

You group with a stranger for an hour in the Barrens, trade a few potions with
someone in Redridge, get killed twice by the same rogue in Hillsbrad. A week
later you meet one of them again and can't place the name. Social Diary writes
these meetings down for you: who you grouped with, traded with, whispered,
fought beside or against, who killed you, who you saw along the road, and when
you met again.

It keeps your own journey too: levels, firsts, the zones you
passed through, close calls, lucky drops, the end of long quest chains and
profession caps. All of it is written into a paper journal automatically.

Made for WoW Forever (currently in beta): classic-era content on the
retail addon API. Current version: 1.5.0.

addons.description:
Bulk mail sending made really easy. Bulk Mail also offers the unique ability to automatically send emails based on rules you configure. This is very useful and powerful if you have bank alts that for specific resources. With a few clicks you can now send all collected items to the right alt simply by opening the send mail page.

Bulk Mail is originally written by hyperactiveChipmunk. NeoTron just took over the addon with his blessing and will work on moving to Ace3 and adding support for LibDataBroker.
Bulk Mail v4.0 Beta
BulkMail v4.0 beta is now available for download. The beta is a complete move to Ace 3, LibQTip, LibDropdown and other modern version of the libraries used. Please report any issues with this version so I can fix it. Right now the Ace2 configuration will be kept around in case you decide to downgrade. Note however that Ace3 configuration will not be downgraded to the Ace2 configuration.
Version History Explained
BulkMail 2 (version 2.x) was the version during Burning Crusade. BulkMail 2 (version 3.x) was the version during Wrath of the Lich King. BulkMail 2 (version 4.x) is the new Ace3 based version. BulkMail 2 v7.x is updated for Legion.

Since it's rather confusing to have BulkMail 2 v3.0, BulkMail 3 v4.0 or similar, I simplified it to just BulkMail with a version. Typically the major version matches the current expansion (1 = vanilla, 2 = BC, 3 = WotLK, 4 = Cataclysm) although there's no guarantee for this.

• Don't queue mail to the character you're playing when names have two parts
On WoW: Forever characters have two-part names and UnitName('player') only
returns the first word, so the self-send check compared a rule for
"Firstname Surname" against "Firstname" and queued the mail to the sender.
GetUnitName('player') does return the full name there, so check that as well,
feature-detected for clients without it. UnitFullName and UnitNameUnmodified
are truncated too, which is why neither is used.
UnitName is still checked first, so single-word names are unaffected.

Wayfarer 1.0.0 — аддон, все паки голосов и «Путевые истории» прямо в этом релизе (архивы ниже). То же самое есть на CurseForge.
Как установить
• Проще всего — Wayfarer на CurseForge: приложение CurseForge поставит аддон вместе с паками голосов и будет их обновлять.
• Вручную, отсюда. Скачайте ниже:

| Архив | Что это | Нужен? |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfarer-1.0.0.zip | сам аддон: плеер, дневник путника | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Alliance-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Альянса | если играете за Альянс |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Horde-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Орды | если играете за Орду |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Shared-3.2.0.zip | голоса: общие квесты, праздники | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Narrator-3.2.0.zip | рассказчик: лор мест, книги и таблички | да |
| Wayfarer_Radio-1.0.0.zip | «Путевые истории»: радио и аудиокнига для дороги | по желанию |

Полностью закройте игру, распакуйте все папки из архивов в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns (должны получиться Wayfarer, Wayfarer_Voices_… и, если ставите истории, Wayfarer_Radio) и запустите игру заново — после /reload новые звуки игра не увидит.
• Обновляетесь с 0.7.x: замените папку Wayfarer и папки паков голосов целиком (в паках 3.2.0 — 1 201 новая реплика и исправления ударений).
Что нового по сравнению с 0.7.0Дневник путника
Книга, в которой собрано всё, что вы открыли в пути, и всё, что можно послушать ещё раз. Зачем он нужен:
• рассказчик говорит о месте один раз, при первом входе — в дневнике любую историю можно переслушать;
• видно, сколько мест каждой земли вы уже открыли и где ещё не были;
• с паком «Путевые истории» дневник становится библиотекой: сезоны «Хроник Азерота», бестиарий, лица, тайны мест, байки — слушать по порядку, как аудиокнигу.
Как открыть
• Левый клик по кнопке Wayfarer — микрофон на краю мини-карты. Правый клик — быстрое меню.
• Команда /wf journal (или /wf j).
• Клавиша «Дневник путника»: Esc → Назначение клавиш → Wayfarer.
• Кнопка-книга в окне плеера.
Закладка «Азерот» — атлас ваших мест
• Слева: сколько мест открыто, материки, поиск по землям и местам, «Вы здесь», закреплённые земли, открытые земли (у каждой — «5 / 18»: сколько её мест вы видели). Закрытые земли свёрнуты одной строкой — по клику их список.
• Справа — выбранная земля: карта, «Исследовано X из Y мест», кнопки «Рассказ о земле», «Открыть карту» (карта мира на этой земле), «Закрепить». Ниже — все места земли в две колонки.
• Клик по месту — его история текстом и голосом рассказчика, ещё клик — стоп.
• Где вы не были — место закрыто («ещё N не открыто»): дневник не расскажет того, до чего вы не дошли. Место открывается, когда вы в нём побываете, даже если рассказчик выключен. Места, чью историю вы слушали до обновления, уже открыты.
Закладка «Истории» — библиотека «Путевых историй»
Появляется, если стоит пак «Путевые истории».
• Слева — рубрики и выпуски. «Хроники» разбиты по сезонам.
• Статус у каждого выпуска:
• новое;
• остановились на части N;
• прослушано;
• звучит;
• закрыт — «откроется на N уровне», «по ходу ваших приключений» или «когда дослушаете прошлый сезон».
• Справа — карточка выпуска:
• «Слушать» / «Продолжить» — с того места, где вы остановились;
• «С начала»;
• «Краткий пересказ» — напомнит прошлые серии сезона;
• части плитками — включить любую;
• весь текст выпуска.
• Внизу — «Включить эфир» и «Эфир…»: настройки радио.
Мини-гайд
1. Поставьте паки. Аддон, пак голосов своей фракции, «Общие квесты» и «Рассказчик» — обязательно. «Путевые истории» — по желанию.
2. Играйте как обычно. Новые места открываются сами, рассказчик читает их историю при первом входе. Пропустили или хотите послушать снова — откройте дневник, «Азерот», выберите землю и место.
3. Закрепите земли, где сейчас качаетесь. Они будут сверху списка. Поиск находит и земли, и отдельные места.
4. «Хроники Азерота» — с начала. Откройте «Истории», рубрика «Хроники», сезон «Темный портал», серия 1 → «Слушать». Серии идут подряд. Если прервались, дневник запомнит часть, а «Продолжить» начнёт с неё.…
addons.description:
Russian voice-over addon for WoW Forever (ruRU client): quests read aloud by NPC voices, zone lore and books read by a narrator, the Traveler's Journal and an optional radio of stories for the road. Get it on CurseForge.

Wayfarer читает вслух задания и рассказывает историю мест Азерота. Каждый NPC говорит своим голосом, подобранным по расе, полу и характеру: ворчливый дворф, суетливый гном, сдержанная эльфийка-часовая. Лор мест, книги, письма и таблички читает рассказчик.
Скачать
Рекомендуем — Wayfarer на CurseForge. Приложение CurseForge само поставит и будет обновлять аддон вместе с паками голосов.

Или вручную, отсюда: в последнем релизе — архив аддона Wayfarer-.zip и (с 1.0.0) архивы всех паков: голоса и «Путевые истории». Исходный код аддона — в папке Wayfarer/. Паки — те же, что на CurseForge:

| Пак | Что внутри |
|---|---|
| Wayfarer Voices - Alliance | квесты и квестовые диалоги Альянса |
| Wayfarer Voices - Horde | квесты и квестовые диалоги Орды |
| Wayfarer Voices - Shared Quests | общие квесты обеих фракций, новые квесты Forever |
| Wayfarer Voices - Narrator | рассказчик: лор зон и подзон, книги, письма и таблички |
| Wayfarer Stories (по желанию) | «Путевые истории»: радио и аудиокнига для дороги — 359 выпусков, почти 16 часов |

Нужны пак своей фракции, общие квесты и рассказчик. Если какого-то пака не хватает, аддон напишет об этом в чат. «Путевые истории» — по желанию.
Что озвучено
• Квесты Альянса и Орды 1–60 уровней и общие квесты: описание при взятии и текст награды при сдаче.
• Квестовые диалоги — разговоры, где по квесту выбираешь ответы (Тирион, Тралл, Эйтригг, «Испытание знаний» и другие).
• Новые квесты WoW Forever: Остров Зефрис, «Основы походной жизни», классовые и стартовые.
• Рассказчик: лор 994 зон и подзон, сверенный с сюжетом Forever, — при первом посещении места.
• Книги, письма и таблички: 1 143 страницы — открыли книгу, рассказчик читает страницу.
• Праздники и события (Лунный фестиваль, Любовная лихорадка, Детская неделя, Огненный солнцеворот, Тыквовин, Зимний Покров, война Ан'Киража, нашествие Плети) и поля боя.

Всего 11 012 реплик, 4 058 квестов, 75 голосов (модель ElevenLabs v4). Нужен русский клиент игры.

Пока не озвучено: промежуточные фразы квестов («Ну что, принёс?») и обычные реплики NPC в разговоре.
Установка вручную
1. Полностью закройте игру.
2. Если стоял Wayfarer 0.3–0.5, удалите папку Wayfarer_Voices (голоса теперь в паках). Если стоял VoiceOver RU — папки VoiceOverRU и VoiceOverRU_Data*, иначе реплики будут звучать дважды.
3. Скачайте из релиза Wayfarer-.zip и паки: голоса своей фракции, общие квесты, рассказчик и, по желанию, «Путевые истории» (Wayfarer_Radio). Они же есть на CurseForge (на странице пака — вкладка Files).
4. Распакуйте все папки в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns: должны получиться Wayfarer, Wayfarer_Voices_* и, если ставите «Путевые истории», Wayfarer_Radio.
5. Запустите игру. Нужен именно перезапуск: после /reload новые звуковые файлы игра не увидит.

Другие аддоны озвучки квестов (CatQuest, Spoken, VoiceOver) лучше отключить.
Дневник путника
Книга обо всём, что вы открыли в пути. Открыть — левый клик по кнопке Wayfarer (микрофон на краю мини-карты), /wf journal или клавиша «Дневник путника».
• «Азерот» — атлас: земли с картами и местами, сколько мест вы уже открыли, поиск, закреплённые земли. Клик по месту — его история ещё раз. Где вы не были, там закрыто: рассказчик не забегает вперёд.
• «Истории» — библиотека пака «Путевые истории»: «Хроники Азерота» (шесть сезонов от Темного портала до Королевства Отрекшихся и шесть сезонов народов), бестиарий, «Лица Азерота», «Тайны мест», байки у костра. У каждого выпуска — статус, «Слушать» / «Продолжить», краткий пересказ и весь текст. Включите эфир — и летописец будет рассказывать в дороге и в полёте; квесты и разговоры с NPC всегда важнее.
Управление…

releases.changelog:
Wayfarer 1.0.0 — аддон, все паки голосов и «Путевые истории» прямо в этом релизе (архивы ниже). То же самое есть на CurseForge.
Как установить
• Проще всего — Wayfarer на CurseForge: приложение CurseForge поставит аддон вместе с паками голосов и будет их обновлять.
• Вручную, отсюда. Скачайте ниже:

| Архив | Что это | Нужен? |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfarer-1.0.0.zip | сам аддон: плеер, дневник путника | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Alliance-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Альянса | если играете за Альянс |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Horde-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Орды | если играете за Орду |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Shared-3.2.0.zip | голоса: общие квесты, праздники | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Narrator-3.2.0.zip | рассказчик: лор мест, книги и таблички | да |
| Wayfarer_Radio-1.0.0.zip | «Путевые истории»: радио и аудиокнига для дороги | по желанию |

Полностью закройте игру, распакуйте все папки из архивов в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns (должны получиться Wayfarer, Wayfarer_Voices_… и, если ставите истории, Wayfarer_Radio) и запустите игру заново — после /reload новые звуки игра не увидит.
• Обновляетесь с 0.7.x: замените папку Wayfarer и папки паков голосов целиком (в паках 3.2.0 — 1 201 новая реплика и исправления ударений).
Что нового по сравнению с 0.7.0Дневник путника
Книга, в которой собрано всё, что вы открыли в пути, и всё, что можно послушать ещё раз. Зачем он нужен:
• рассказчик говорит о месте один раз, при первом входе — в дневнике любую историю можно переслушать;
• видно, сколько мест каждой земли вы уже открыли и где ещё не были;
• с паком «Путевые истории» дневник становится библиотекой: сезоны «Хроник Азерота», бестиарий, лица, тайны мест, байки — слушать по порядку, как аудиокнигу.
Как открыть
• Левый клик по кнопке Wayfarer — микрофон на краю мини-карты. Правый клик — быстрое меню.
• Команда /wf journal (или /wf j).
• Клавиша «Дневник путника»: Esc → Назначение клавиш → Wayfarer.
• Кнопка-книга в окне плеера.
Закладка «Азерот» — атлас ваших мест
• Слева: сколько мест открыто, материки, поиск по землям и местам, «Вы здесь», закреплённые земли, открытые земли (у каждой — «5 / 18»: сколько её мест вы видели). Закрытые земли свёрнуты одной строкой — по клику их список.
• Справа — выбранная земля: карта, «Исследовано X из Y мест», кнопки «Рассказ о земле», «Открыть карту» (карта мира на этой земле), «Закрепить». Ниже — все места земли в две колонки.
• Клик по месту — его история текстом и голосом рассказчика, ещё клик — стоп.
• Где вы не были — место закрыто («ещё N не открыто»): дневник не расскажет того, до чего вы не дошли. Место открывается, когда вы в нём побываете, даже если рассказчик выключен. Места, чью историю вы слушали до обновления, уже открыты.
Закладка «Истории» — библиотека «Путевых историй»
Появляется, если стоит пак «Путевые истории».
• Слева — рубрики и выпуски. «Хроники» разбиты по сезонам.
• Статус у каждого выпуска:
• новое;
• остановились на части N;
• прослушано;
• звучит;
• закрыт — «откроется на N уровне», «по ходу ваших приключений» или «когда дослушаете прошлый сезон».
• Справа — карточка выпуска:
• «Слушать» / «Продолжить» — с того места, где вы остановились;
• «С начала»;
• «Краткий пересказ» — напомнит прошлые серии сезона;
• части плитками — включить любую;
• весь текст выпуска.
• Внизу — «Включить эфир» и «Эфир…»: настройки радио.
Мини-гайд
1. Поставьте паки. Аддон, пак голосов своей фракции, «Общие квесты» и «Рассказчик» — обязательно. «Путевые истории» — по желанию.
2. Играйте как обычно. Новые места открываются сами, рассказчик читает их историю при первом входе. Пропустили или хотите послушать снова — откройте дневник, «Азерот», выберите землю и место.
3. Закрепите земли, где сейчас качаетесь. Они будут сверху списка. Поиск находит и земли, и отдельные места.
4. «Хроники Азерота» — с начала. Откройте «Истории», рубрика «Хроники», сезон «Темный портал», серия 1 → «Слушать». Серии идут подряд. Если прервались, дневник запомнит часть, а «Продолжить» начнёт с неё.…

Wayfarer 0.7.1 — с этой версии на GitHub только сам аддон. Голоса — паки на CurseForge.
Как установить
• Проще всего — Wayfarer на CurseForge: приложение CurseForge поставит аддон вместе с паками голосов и будет их обновлять.
• Вручную: скачайте Wayfarer-0.7.1.zip ниже и паки голосов с CurseForge (на странице пака — вкладка Files): Альянс, Орда, Общие квесты, Рассказчик. Нужны пак своей фракции, общие квесты и рассказчик. Полностью закройте игру, распакуйте все папки в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns и запустите игру заново.
• Обновляетесь с 0.4.x: удалите папку Wayfarer_Voices — голоса теперь в паках Wayfarer_Voices_*, иначе озвучка будет звучать дважды.
Новое в 0.7.1
• Рассказчик у мини-карты: кнопка ▶ слева от названия места над мини-картой — рассказ о месте, где вы стоите, не открывая карту. Правый клик — о всей зоне, повторное нажатие — остановить.
• Alt+Tab больше не обрывает озвучку. Если в настройках звука выключен «Звук в фоновом режиме», игра при сворачивании глушила реплику, а полоса плеера шла дальше. Теперь на время реплики звук в фоне включается, потом ваша настройка возвращается. Если звук всё же оборвётся — реплика встанет на паузу, «Играть» начнёт её заново.
• Исправлено: при прослушивании квеста кнопкой ▶ (список заданий, журнал) вместо говорящей головы NPC иногда была книга или значок. NPC, которых игра ещё не знает, аддон запрашивает у сервера; пока модель грузится — значок расы говорящего.
Что появилось после 0.4.1 (выпуски 0.5–0.7 выходили на CurseForge)
• Озвучены квесты Альянса и Орды 1–60, квестовые диалоги (Тирион, Тралл, Эйтригг, «Испытание знаний»…), новые квесты Forever со сдачами.
• Книги, письма и таблички — 1 143 страницы читает рассказчик; лор Острова Зефрис.
• Окно «говорящая голова», как в retail: 3D-портрет NPC (голова крупно или по пояс), фон в цветах расы, текст прокручивается за голосом; /wf move, /wf size 80.
• Прослушать квест ещё раз — кнопка ▶ у квестов в списке заданий и в журнале на карте.
• Голоса не накладываются: озвучка ждёт, пока NPC договорит приветствие.
• Очередь без ограничений: квесты, страницы диалогов и новые места звучат по порядку.

Всего 9 811 реплик, 994 места, 66 голосов. Сообщество и репорты — Discord.

Wayfarer 0.4.1: исправлен повтор рассказчика на границах зон.
Исправления
• Рассказчик больше не повторяет одно и то же. Некоторые места лежат на границе двух карт и описаны в обеих: Руины Лордерона (Тирисфальские леса и Подгород), Руины Альтерака, моря и реки, Мост Тандола, врата Дун Морога и Лок Модана и другие. На границе игра сообщает о «новом» месте, и рассказ о нём звучал второй раз подряд. Теперь такое место рассказывается один раз.
• Рассказ о зоне больше не теряется. Если войти в новую зону, пока рассказчик ещё говорит, рассказ о зоне мог выпасть из очереди, вытесненный рассказом о подзоне, и при этом считался прослушанным. Теперь звучат оба. Место отмечается прослушанным, только когда рассказ действительно начался: пропущенный рассказ прозвучит при следующем визите.

Разные места с одинаковым названием, например Каналы в Штормграде и в Подгороде, по-прежнему рассказываются отдельно.
Установка и обновление
• Уже стоит 0.4.0: скачайте маленький Wayfarer-0.4.1-update-from-0.4.0.zip (59 КБ) и замените им папку Wayfarer в Interface\AddOns. Голоса (Wayfarer_Voices) не менялись, после замены достаточно /reload.
• Новая установка или обновление с 0.3.0: скачайте полный Wayfarer-0.4.1-2026-09-30.zip (649 МБ). Полностью закройте игру и распакуйте архив в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns: замените папки Wayfarer и Wayfarer_Voices. После установки полностью перезапустите игру. Подробная инструкция — в архиве (Wayfarer_README.txt) и в README.

Wayfarer 0.3.0: первая публичная версия под новым именем (раньше аддон назывался VoiceOver RU).

Скачайте Wayfarer-0.3.0-2026-09-28.zip ниже (625 МБ) и распакуйте в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns. Подробная инструкция есть в архиве (Wayfarer_README.txt) и в README.
Что озвучено
• Квесты Альянса и общие квесты 1–40 уровней: взятие и сдача (2 784 реплики)
• Лор зон и подзон
Что нового
• Новое имя: ядро Wayfarer и модуль озвучки Wayfarer_Voices. Команда /wf, старая /vru тоже работает.
• Все модули озвучки объединены в один.
• Таймер реплики в окне плеера.
• Кнопка «!» и команда /wf report: сообщить об ошибке в реплике. /wf reports открывает список для отправки автору.
• Звук по умолчанию идёт через «Общую громкость». Если канал не воспроизводит звук, аддон пробует общий и подсказывает в чате, что проверить.

addons.summary: Путеводитель по Азероту: русская озвучка квестов голосами NPC, лор мест и дневник путника для WoW Forever. Озвучка — паки Wayfarer Voices: Альянс, Орда, общие квесты, рассказчик; радио и аудиокнига — пак «Путевые истории».

DS Forever 1.0.15: a low storage warning for direct installs.

New
• If the game was installed directly and the device has under 5 GB free, DS Forever says so before the chooser. The game keeps what it streams, so it needs room as you play. Press OK to carry on.

Update: DS Forever offers this update when it starts. Or download DS-Forever-1.0.15.apk below and install it over your current version; your login and settings stay. Don't uninstall first.

Desktop: no change, still 0.2.12. New users: download DsForeverDesktop-0.2.12-win-x64.zip, unzip it to a folder you keep, and run DsForeverDesktop.exe.

addons.description:
Android launcher and companion for the World of Warcraft: Forever beta. Forked
from WoW Forever and
GameNative; their contributors'
copyright/licence notices are retained.

Unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard,
WoW Forever's maintainers or GameNative. World of Warcraft and Battle.net are
their owners' marks. Supply your own authorised game installation/account.
No Blizzard client files, extracted art or QuestieDB are bundled.
Tested Scope
AYN Thor only; other devices are unverified. Android10/API29+, arm64-v8a.
Package app.dsforever.companion. Same-package, same-key
DS builds update in place. Do not uninstall or clear data for signing conflicts;
developer builds with another key cannot update an official installation.

The user accepted the predecessor's T3 walk-through. Full-catalogue storage and
map-reader checks are PC evidence, not a completed full-device bake. The native
peak includes the game; large-dungeon device memory/backoff was not captured.
Some layouts remain deferred. Whole-city/floorless/liquid coverage is incomplete.
Setup And Play
On first start choose Install directly (about 250 MB now; the game streams the
rest from Blizzard as you play, up to about 50 GB; needs Wi-Fi and 60 GB free), or
choose an existing folder containing .build.info and Data/, including hidden files.
Thor testing used /storage/emulated/0/Documents/WoW Forever; every game path
comes from the chosen root, not a hard-coded old /sdcard folder.

Two-screen setup checks environment readiness and automatically prepares art
from your installed game. Seven required steps gate Play; required failures
offer Try again. QuestieDB downloads after the art check. Optional interiors
and all-icons background work never gate Play. No extracted PC/server pictures
are used as a fallback.

Configure Login/Update Login manages sign-in; updating login restarts the game
to read it. Refused sign-in has recovery controls. Credentials are excluded from
diagnostic logs. Keyboard opens Android's keyboard on the Thor's top screen.
Authenticator challenges are manual; avoid repeated wrong-password tests.

The companion shows observed NPCs, not database-only ghosts. No suggested spells.
Old DS-created macros are removed silently, preserving user-created macros.
Map probe defaults ON, tracking auto-switch OFF, sparkles OFF. Indoor legend:
red main exit, green up, blue down. Outdoors remains visible while a plan loads.
Streaming From Your PC
DS Forever can play WoW Forever from your Windows PC instead of on the Thor,
with the companion on the bottom screen. It needs DS Forever Desktop on the PC:

1. Download DsForeverDesktop--win-x64.zip from the same release as
the APK, unzip it to a folder you keep, and run DsForeverDesktop.exe.
2. Pick Streaming on the Thor and enter the code Desktop shows.
3. Connect on your home Wi-Fi. Desktop starts WoW and signs in with the login
saved on your Thor.

Your saved login stays sealed on the Thor. When a stream starts it goes to the
PC over the paired, encrypted link and is written to WoW's own login.txt,
readable by your Windows account only and deleted about 20 seconds after
sign-in starts (5 minutes at most, or as soon as the Thor disconnects). No keys
are typed. Authenticator challenges stay manual.

Desktop updates itself from these releases once no Thor is connected, checked
against SHA256SUMS. It is not code-signed, so Windows may warn on first run.
WoW closes itself 5 minutes after the stream ends, unless the PC is in use.
Updates
The app updater uses
Jreese702/DS-Forever
and DS-Forever-.apk. Offline checks do not block Play. Downloads check
size/any supplied SHA-256; installation checks package, DS certificate and a newer
numeric versionCode. Android owns installer permission/confirmation. Updates are
held while the game runs. Release1.0.0 asset: DS-Forever-1.0.0.apk + SHA256SUMS.
The updater is not a working public channel until the public release exists.…

releases.changelog:
DS Forever 1.0.15: a low storage warning for direct installs.

New
• If the game was installed directly and the device has under 5 GB free, DS Forever says so before the chooser. The game keeps what it streams, so it needs room as you play. Press OK to carry on.

Update: DS Forever offers this update when it starts. Or download DS-Forever-1.0.15.apk below and install it over your current version; your login and settings stay. Don't uninstall first.

Desktop: no change, still 0.2.12. New users: download DsForeverDesktop-0.2.12-win-x64.zip, unzip it to a folder you keep, and run DsForeverDesktop.exe.

Everything new in 1.0.14 (Install directly, the Menu, Shortcuts, streaming at your PC's screen size) is in the 1.0.14 notes.

Sunshine (GPL-3.0) is bundled unmodified in Desktop; its source for this version is attached, and DS Forever's own source is in the source zip. SHA256SUMS lists every file.

DS Forever 1.0.14: install the game right from the app, no PC needed.

New: Install directly
• On first start, choose Install directly or point DS Forever at a game folder you already have.
• About 250 MB downloads now, and the game streams the rest from Blizzard as you play, up to about 50 GB. Needs Wi-Fi and 60 GB free.
• Setup then builds the game art, about 30 minutes in total on our test, with the time left shown for each step. Local and Streaming appear when it's done.
• This uses your own Battle.net account and Blizzard's public servers. It is unofficial, and DS Forever is not affiliated with Blizzard.

New: Menu
• Auto login on or off, change or forget your login, report an issue, controller layout and button pictures, all from the chooser and the waiting screen.
• On the waiting screen: Stream settings, Restart game, Switch mode and Exit game.
• Add home-screen shortcuts from the chooser's Shortcuts page. If your launcher restarts DS Forever when you reopen it, use a shortcut.

Streaming, with DS Forever Desktop 0.2.12
• WoW now shows as soon as its window opens, including its login screen.
• Your PC's screen can match the stream's resolution, so the interface isn't tiny on the Thor. It's on by default, and switches back when the Thor disconnects. Turn off Match PC screen to stream in Desktop if you don't want it.
• Stream settings: resolution, frame rate, bit rate, codec and sound.
• Desktop keeps trying to bring WoW forward for a minute.

Also new
• Picking Local starts the game straight away.
• The keyboard has a Tab key.
• The "The game closed" prompt is gone. Use Report issue if something goes wrong.

Known issues
• Streaming plays all of the PC's sound, not only WoW's.
• Cocoon can restart DS Forever when you reopen the main icon. Use a shortcut from Shortcuts.
• Indoor maps can show an incomplete bar or diamond.
• First visits to a zone load slower after a direct install, while the game streams its files.

Update: DS Forever offers this update when it starts. Or download DS-Forever-1.0.14.apk below and install it over your current version; your login and settings stay. Don't uninstall first.

Desktop: 0.2.11 updates itself to 0.2.12 once no Thor is connected. New users: download DsForeverDesktop-0.2.12-win-x64.zip, unzip it to a folder you keep, and run DsForeverDesktop.exe.

Sunshine (GPL-3.0) is bundled unmodified in Desktop; its source for this version is attached, and DS Forever's own source is in the source zip. SHA256SUMS lists every file.

DS Forever 1.0.13: stream World of Warcraft: Forever from your PC.

New: Streaming, with DS Forever Desktop
• Play WoW Forever on your Windows PC through the Thor's top screen, with the companion on the bottom screen.
• Install DsForeverDesktop-0.2.11-win-x64.zip from this release: unzip it to a folder you keep and run DsForeverDesktop.exe. Then pick Streaming on the Thor and enter the code Desktop shows. Windows may warn on first run, because Desktop isn't code-signed.
• Use your home Wi-Fi.
• Desktop starts WoW and signs in with the login saved on your Thor. The login goes over the paired, encrypted link into WoW's own login.txt, readable by your Windows account only, and is deleted about 20 seconds after sign-in starts (5 minutes at most, or as soon as the Thor disconnects). No keys are typed. Authenticator challenges stay manual.
• WoW closes itself 5 minutes after the stream ends, unless the PC is in use.
• Desktop updates itself from now on, once no Thor is connected.

Also new
• A new loading screen, and a Report and Keyboard button on the waiting screen, in Streaming and Local.
• The keyboard has a Trackpad tab.

Known issues
• Streaming plays all of the PC's sound, not only WoW's.

Remember who they are.

v3.2.0 (2026-11-02)Added
• Warn earlier: a cooldown shows 5 seconds before its time by default and counts down to the moment you press it, then shows Now. Change the default on the New messages page or per assignment; text messages can warn earlier too.
• The encounter page is one desk: the bosses of the instance as tiles on top, a toolbar, the timeline across the whole width and the selected assignment below it as a form with one line per setting: template, when (once, repeating or several times), what, for whom, overlay, duration and warning, sound and difficulties. A new assignment can start from a template right there. Advanced opens every setting in a window of its own. There is no separate encounter list or assignment page anymore.
• Demo playback: plays the plan from the playhead on your overlays, in real time or four times as fast. Click on the time axis to move the playhead.
• View as a role or player: the timeline and the demo playback show only what they get. Normal, Heroic and Mythic switch on and off one by one; the timeline dims the assignments that run on none of them.
• In the timeline, drag a marker to move the assignment, with Alt to copy it, and middle-click it to delete it (asks first). The mouse wheel zooms (out to 20 minutes, to plan after the last assignment), Shift + mouse wheel or dragging an empty spot scrolls the time, and repeating assignments show as a bar. The timeline and its markers list these controls.
• New encounter lists the dungeons of the current expansion besides the raids.
• On Retail it also lists the Mythic+ dungeons of the current season. A dungeon's page lets you add a boss the journal doesn't list, by its encounter ID.
• Each encounter has a Share with the group switch. Encounters you don't share aren't sent to your group and run only for you.
• Demo: Overlays → Demo or /prt demo plays a sample fight of about 40 seconds with every kind of message for you (text with countdown, marker, own sound, read aloud, healing and utility cooldowns, a repeating assignment) on your overlays, plus your next assignments and the raid plan in combat. It runs anywhere, out of combat and in every role.
Changed
• In a dungeon group every member can send plans; in a raid it stays the leader and assistants.
• Simpler window: the overview and the settings are one page (with About at the end), and importing an encounter moved to New encounter.
• The overview picks your role (lead, player or both) the same way as the first start guide.
• A message's sound is one choice: the overlay's sound, its own sound or TTS (text to speech).
• An assignment's targets are picked with ticks in one list (roles, your group, raid groups, classes), so several targets need no extra step.
• Save as template is one click; the template is named after the message and can be renamed on the templates page.
• The message editor has no Tools card and no Undo anymore; loading and saving templates and deleting the assignment are at the end of Display.
• Overlays have one Unlock switch instead of lock and unlock buttons, Raid plan in combat (formerly Lead status) one switch to place it, and the layout options are labeled.
• New messages is its own page with the same options as an assignment (type, text, targets, overlay, duration, sound) plus the difficulties of new assignments. Every new assignment and template starts as this message.
• Overlays lock again when you close the options window.
• A new profile is created by pressing Enter in its name field.
• The debug log shows one line per entry.
• Every overlay (messages, your next assignments, lead status) has the same text settings: font, size, outline (off, thin, thick) and shadow.
• Your next assignments shows every line in the same size; the next one is no longer larger.
Fixed
• The Every slider of a repeating assignment can be dragged again.…

Plan per boss which player sees which message when; the raid lead syncs the plan before the pull.

The raid lead plans each boss on a timeline. Before the pull the plan goes to
the group, and every player runs it locally and sees only the messages meant
for them. Since Midnight (also WoW: Forever) addons get no combat log, no boss
health or power and can't message the group during encounters, so everything
counts from the pull. Use it next to your boss mod (DBM, BigWigs).

v3.1.0 (2026-10-25)
PhenomRaidTools 3.1 for Midnight (12.x) and WoW: Forever. Since Midnight, addons get no combat log and no boss health or power, and they can't message the group during encounters. PRT therefore sends the plans to the group before the pull, and every player runs them locally.

Back up your SavedVariables first (WTF/Account//SavedVariables/PhenomRaidTools.lua). The update removes everything that can't run anymore, and this can't be undone.
New
• Everything is in one window with search: overview, encounters, templates, overlays, settings and profiles (/prt).
• The lead sends the enabled plans on every ready check or with /prt sync, and the overview shows who has them.
• Assignments: click into an encounter's timeline to add one at that time. An assignment shows once, repeating (every n seconds from–to) or at several times, and runs only on the difficulties you pick.
• The timeline shows spell icons. Hover a marker to see the text and who gets it.
• Cooldowns show the spell's name or your own text. Text to speech can read any message aloud.
• A preview beside the window shows the assignment or overlay you are editing.
• New encounter offers the bosses of the current raids. The encounter list is grouped by instance and shows boss portraits.
• New profiles start with three overlays: messages at the top, healing cooldowns on the left and utility cooldowns on the right. A cooldown chosen from the list goes on the matching overlay.
• Each overlay shows text, icons or bars and can grow in any direction.
• Your next assignments shows what is next for you during an encounter.
• The What's new window opens after updates, and /prt news opens it again.
Removed
• Rotations, health and power percentages, timers on combat log events, stop conditions, raid warnings, raid markers, placeholders (raid roster, custom and encounter placeholders), /prtm and the message filter.
• Encounter versions (the active version is kept) and timer groups. Each assignment takes over its group's difficulties.
• The old AceGUI options and Classic Era / Wrath Classic support.

addons.description:
Rarity: Collector's Edition is always looking for contributors!

If you're interested in following the development process or contributing, you should also check out our Github and our Discord.

We're always in need of more hands to help us make the addon better, and it is the best place to report bugs as well.

What is Rarity: Collector's Edition?

Rarity CE is the restored version of the old Rarity addon previously maintained by RDW. Volunteers from Collector Communities and the old Classic Rarity Dev have taken it upon themselves to keep the addon up to date in this new form.

Rarity tracks how many times you've tried to obtain various rare items like mounts, battle pets, and toys. It will tell you how likely you are to obtain the item, track how long you've been farming for it, and tell you how lucky you've been so far. Although it's mostly used for mounts, battle pets, and toys, it supports pretty much any item, including profession patterns, archaeology projects, and more.

Out of the box, Rarity includes support for the majority of Mounts, Battle Pets, and Toys in the game which require some time to farm. It also includes support for some mount-related items like Skyshards, Primal Eggs, and Giant Dinosaur Bones. It'll even notice if you mouseover a Mysterious Camel Figurine, plus lots of other stuff. Rarity factors in the size of a typical group when determining probabilities, and can also tell you if you've killed various bosses this week (or day). Holiday just started, and you didn't notice? Rarity will give you a helpful reminder to run those holiday dungeons or daily quests if you still need an item from them.

If Rarity doesn't track something you want to track, you can import it yourself! Just about everything is user configurable.

Main Features:

Rarity is primarily an LDB feed with a large tooltip. It can function as either a mini-map icon (you have to turn this on in the options), or as a standard LDB feed (use a display like Titan Panel).

Provides a progress bar, which you can toggle by clicking the icon or feed label.

Adds info to NPC and item tooltips, showing you if it drops or contains something that Rarity tracks. Rare mobs with a guaranteed drop show which item they drop and if you've defeated them yet.

Includes full source info, telling you how to obtain everything Rarity tracks.

Other Features:

Share packs of items with other users.

Can automatically add waypoints to TomTom for certain items.

Uses statistics whenever possible to keep track of attempts prior to installation.

Breaks your farming down by session, day, week, and month.

Looks at your instance locks to see if you've defeated various bosses recently.

Reminds you if you need to farm a holiday dungeon or daily quest, and hides holiday items that aren't available right now.

Supports bonus coin rolls.

Automatically screenshots when you obtain an item.

You can add your own items to track.

Lets you modify your attempt count manually without having to edit saved variables.

Slash Commands:

Simply typing /rarity should open the options menu (unless disabled).

For troubleshooting issues:

/rarity mapinfo
prints the current map name and ID, which can help track zonewide custom items.

/rarity dump
displays the most recent debug log entries (even if the debug mode is disabled).

/rarity validate
checks the consistency of your item database, including custom items (experimental).

/rarity multifarm <number>
if you're farming the same items simultaneously on multiple accounts, sets the number of attempts added per detected event (e.g. /rarity multifarm 3 adds 3 attempts instead of 1). This only lasts for your current session and resets to 1 the next time you log in. Run without a number to see the current value.

addons.changelog:
Highlights
Rotation Master 2.0 is a rewrite of the 1.x addon, built around a new in-game rotation editor.
• A new rotation editor. Cards and a tree, a rotation library with Class and Character scopes, tags and search, drafts with undo and redo, and Compare and Preview for imported rotations.
• Built In rotations. Ready-made rotations for Classic Era / Season of Discovery, TBC Anniversary, Mists, Forever and Retail, shipped as one load-on-demand add-on per class. Enable, disable and re-prioritize them per profile.
• Many more conditions. Talent trees by name, a talent picker, Branch and Stop steps, a live "currently matches" bar, raid marker conditions and units, a Set Mark step on Classic-family clients, and custom Lua conditions with a code editor.
• Retail and Forever support. The game's restricted combat data is handled explicitly: a condition reads what the game allows, shows as unavailable, or does not exist on that client.
• Sharing. Import and export rotations, item sets, announcements and effects. A rotation that uses a condition your client does not have imports disabled, with the condition kept, so you can replace it instead of rebuilding.
• Faster. An idle gate, a leaner evaluation engine and far less garbage per poll.
• Integrations. Masque, Questie, boss-mod timers, more action-bar addons, and tooltips that show your item sets and rotations.
• Ten languages, following the game's language. Translations are AI-assisted and have not been reviewed by native speakers.
Known issues
• Direct Set Mark has been verified on TBC; the other marker features and some client and addon-integration combinations have had less real-client testing. See the client support table in the repository.
Upgrading
• Install the whole package: RotationMaster and every RotationMaster_* folder.
• Back up RotationMaster.lua from your SavedVariables folder first. Your data is converted on first load and the conversion cannot be undone.
• Rotations saved by 1.x are kept in an archive and do not run until you adopt them (Rotations, then Recover unassigned rotations). Rotation Master tells you once in chat and in a banner in the settings window.
• To go back to 1.x, remove all of those folders, restore your backup and install 1.4.3e.

Full changelog: http://gitea:3000/wow/rotationmaster/compare/1.4.3e...2.0.0

![Tests][tests]

![GitHub Activity][commits]

![Retail 12.1.5][client-support] ![Forever 1.60.1][client-support]
![Classic Era 1.15.9][client-support] ![Season of Discovery 1.15.9][client-support]
![TBC Anniversary 2.5.6][client-support] ![Mists Classic 5.5.4][client-support]

Rotation Master is a World of Warcraft addon that highlights the next spell or item in a rotation you choose. Start with a
Built In rotation for your class, or create your own in game. You press the buttons: the addon does not cast spells or play
for you.

Version 2.0 is a rewrite of the 1.x addon. See the release notes for what changed and the
upgrade guide for backups, supported clients and going back to 1.x.
What it does
• Build rotations in game. Put spells and items in priority order, add conditions, and use Branch and Stop steps to
handle different situations. Start with a Built In rotation and adjust it for your character.
• Choose when to use them. Keep several rotations and select one manually or let Rotation Master switch when a
rotation's conditions match.
• Highlight your actions. Light matching buttons on supported action bars, show cooldowns alongside your main
rotation, and optionally display a movable recommendation preview.
• Understand and share your rules. Combine conditions with AND, OR and Unless, inspect their current match state,
compare rotations, and import or export Rotation Master data. Advanced users can also write custom Lua conditions.
• Configure extras. Create item sets, announcements, highlight effects and profiles, with optional integrations for
other addons.

Built In rotations are starting points, not guarantees of the best action for every character, encounter or play style.

Available conditions vary by client. See client support for details and in-game testing status.

Rotation Master uses your game language automatically: English, German, Spanish, Latin American Spanish, French, Italian,
Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Changed

addons.description:
Opinionated and highly optimized quality-of-life tweaks for WoW Forever in one neat package.

More than 50 tweaks, from a campfire timer and an XP tracker to better tooltips and automatic junk selling, each one switched on and set up in a single settings window. It also loads on Classic Era.

Type /hst in game to open the settings. Each tweak can be turned on or off at any time without a /reload. Tweaks that act for you or replace part of the game's interface start off. The full list of tweaks and how each behaves is in HastesSuperTweaks/README.md.
HighlightsCampfire Helper
On WoW Forever, a campfire on screen shows when you're near a fire, counts down while you sit by it, then shows how long your camp buffs have left and blinks when they're about to run out. Show it as a ring, a bar or an icon. /hst camp check lists every camp timer.
XP Tracker
An XP bar with rested XP, XP from completed quests, XP per hour and time to level. Mob tooltips say roughly how many more kills of that mob you need to level, and the quest log shows each quest's XP.
Better Tooltips
A health bar under unit tooltips (in class colors, or green to red by health), borders in class colors, guild ranks and notes, and who the unit is targeting. On WoW Forever, your Recent Allies show where and when you last played together. Item tooltips can say how many you have in your bags and banks, and item, spell and NPC IDs are optional. Works with tooltip styles from other addons.
Appearance Collector
On WoW Forever, a mark on gear whose look you haven't collected, in your bags, at vendors and in the Loot Window, and a line in item tooltips. Choose a hanger, shirt, sparkle or dot. Sell Clutter keeps that gear.
Consumable Macros
Macros that always use your best food, drink, bandage and potions as your bags change, plus one that eats and drinks at once, a hunter's Feed Pet, and ones that put your best stone, oil or poison on each weapon. Drag them onto your action bars from the Macros window.
Loot Window and Fast Loot
A compact loot list with a Take All button and hotkey. While you auto loot, it lists what you picked up for a few seconds. Fast Loot takes everything at once and still lets gathering trackers see the loot.
Sell Junk and Sell Clutter
Greys are sold at any vendor. Sell Clutter also sells the items you collect while leveling and won't use:
• cooking ingredients and monster parts that none of your professions use
• other classes' reagents
• gear your class can't use
• food, potions and white gear you've outleveled

It keeps quest items, items your RestedXP guide needs, equipment sets, profession tools, expensive materials, anything that opens and gear whose look you haven't collected. Item tooltips say what will be sold, and /hst clutter list shows the full list before you reach a vendor.
Better Scrolling Combat Text
Separate scroll areas for damage and healing you take and for notices: entering and leaving combat, low health and mana, combo points, auras, reputation, honor and skill-ups. Damage numbers can show on enemy nameplates. Choose fonts, colors, animations and filters, and move each area in Edit Mode.
Settings window
• Point at a tweak in the list to see its description, a preview and its main settings beside it.
• Search finds any tweak or setting by name, description or menu choice. Switches work in the results, and Enter jumps to the setting.
• Tweaks you can see on screen, like the XP bar, tooltips, the loot window and combat text, have a live preview beside their settings that redraws as you change them.
• The cog in the title bar picks the window's theme: Graphite, Ember or Moonwell.
• Profiles hold every tweak's settings. Switch, copy and reset them, or share one as text.
All tweaks…

addons.description:
This addon enables Masque (CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface) to skin the built-in WoW action bars.

If you like the base WoW interface and don't want to use a separate action bar mod, you're in the right place.

You can install this addon from CurseForge, Wago, or WoWInterface.
Features
Masque Blizzard Bars can currently skin the following bars, according to your game version:
• Main Action Bar
• Multi Bars (Action Bars 2 - 8)
• Possess Bar
• Stance Bar
• Pet Bar
• Vehicle Bar
• Pet Battle Bar
• Extra Ability Buttons (Extra Action Button, Zone Ability Buttons)
• Spell Flyout
• Cooldown Manager (with each bar type configured indepdendently)
• Essential Cooldowns
• Utility Cooldowns
• Tracked Bars
• Tracked Buffs

Support for Buffs, Debuffs and External Defensives bars is tentatively planned for a future update.

Alert, debuff, and pandemic styles for Cooldown Manager bars are not supported due to game restrictions. These will appear using the default style and may not match your skin.

Each bar type is its own group so you can configure them independently from Masque's Skin Settings.
Forever Support
World of Warcraft: Forever has nearly the same interface features as Retail, so it is fully supported.
Classic Support
Classic versions available in the US are fully supported. Bars not available in Classic will not appear in Masque's Skin Settings.

I don't play Classic so testing is somewhat limited, but I'll do my best to address bug reports promptly.
Compatibility
This addon is intended to skin the base WoW interface. Addons that heavily modify parts of the base interface may conflict. This is especially common with Cooldown Manager addons. If you experience a conflict, use Masque's Skin Settings to disable the affected group and reload your UI. This should allow the other addon to control the interface without interference.

If you'd like to see Masque support in a conflicting addon, try sending a feature request to that addon's author directly.
Localization
If you'd like to help localize this addon, please submit translations here.
LLM Policy
LLM ("Generative AI") agents are not used for development of this project and such contributions will not be accepted.
Other Addons
If you want to skin built-in Inventory UI elements as well, check out Masque Blizzard Inventory (CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface)!
Special Thanks
Thanks to StormFX, the author of Masque, for a ton of feedback and development tips and for creating a logo for the addon.

Thanks to Madnessbox, the author of the original Masque Blizz Bars addon, for the concept.
