addons.changelog:
FlareUI 2.5.1
Copy a whole chat tab, smarter spell rank upgrades, and faded action bars that show when you drag a spell.
New
• Chat: Copy Chat in a tab's right-click menu opens a window with that tab's lines as plain text, all selected for Ctrl+C. Lines the game keeps hidden, such as chat inside instances, are left out, and the window says so.
Fixed
• Update spell ranks: a Train All visit now takes your buttons to the newest rank whatever order the ranks were learned in, and a button also moves if you skipped a rank in between. Lower ranks you keep on your bars on purpose still stay.
• Action bars: faded bars now show while you drag a spell or item, without Fake Cooldown Manager bars.
• Damage Meter: a window saved as collapsed can be expanded again: its button shows in the middle of the window.
FlareUI 2.5.0
See when your interrupt is ready, jump straight to a setting from search, and spell ranks in the radial editor.
New
• Cast bars: an enemy's cast bar on the target, focus and boss frames turns green while your interrupt is ready (Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash, Counterspell, Earth Shock or Silence). While it's on cooldown the bar keeps its normal colour, and casts you can't interrupt stay grey.
• Settings: click the path above a search result to open its page, scrolled to the setting, which flashes briefly.
• Settings: new options can show a NEW label on their row, page and tab. Search for "new" to list them.
• Radial Menu editor: spells show their rank ("Frostbolt (Rank 3)"), so you can tell the ranks apart and search for one. Hovering a spell or item in the Catalog or the Buttons list shows its game tooltip.
Changed
• Unit, party, raid and boss frames: the hover highlight is brighter, a soft glow over the health bar that's easier to see.
• Settings: search ignores accents, so "ecran" finds "Écran".
Fixed
• Player and pet frames set to fade now stay visible while you're missing health.
• Cast bars: casts you can't interrupt now turn grey during combat too.
• Auto repair no longer says "Repaired" when you couldn't afford it. After selling junk it waits for the gold to arrive, then repairs.
• Auras: changing aura options no longer piles up hidden aura icons in the background.
FlareUI 2.4.5
Launch-day fixes: whisper tabs, Target of Target, and nothing reloads your UI in a fight.
Fixed
• Chat: a new whisper tab no longer opens with an empty window, and whisper tabs now fade in and out like your other chat windows.
• Target of Target and Target of Focus: health and power now update during the fight, not only when the target changes.
• Reload questions: if one was closed during combat, pressing Enter could still reload the UI. Enter now opens the chat as usual, and a dialog shown in combat no longer blocks your movement keys.
• Settings: closing the window in combat no longer leaves a clickable Reload now button on screen.
• Quest Tracker: Minimize in combat now works.
• Raid frames: Missing Buffs no longer throws errors when you die during a boss fight, and no longer marks members who are too far away to check.
• Raid frames: your own frame no longer flickers faded, and members whose range can't be checked are no longer faded.
• Quality of Life: turning the module off now puts back the game settings it changed (enemy nameplates, camera zoom, tutorials). Sync Blizz UI no longer copies "enemy nameplates off" from Combat Plates to your other characters.
• Radial Menu: Create macro now allows up to 30 character macros, and a Toggle keybind with no radial left no longer errors.
• Fake Cooldown Manager: bars no longer stay clickable after dropping a spell during combat.
• Target frame: the Elite & Rare icon follows changes, and an old ready check mark no longer shows on a new target.
• XP bar: hides more reliably when you reach max level.
FlareUI 2.4.4
Share your FlareUI profile as a text string.
New…
addons.description:
Your friendly UI overhowl for World of Warcraft: Forever.

FlareUI improves and extends Blizzard's own interface without replacing its look. Everything is split into modules you switch on one by one, so you only load what you actually use:
Action Bars, Unit Frames, Resource Bars, Buffs & Debuffs, Minimap, Chat, Damage Meter, Quest Tracker, Tooltips, Radial Menu and Quality of Life.

addons.description:
Midnight Changes: I have created a version of ArcHUD3 that is compatible with Midnight!! With the API changes in 12.0, it is no longer possible to create the exact smooth arcs used here, but I've made the closest approximation I could. There is some polish that is no longer possible for arcs that rely on secret values (health, power, etc), like the spark, smooth animations, angled tips, etc. If you notice any issues (there are likely several), feel free to open an issue on GitHub.

ArcHUD displays smooth arcs around your character in the middle of the screen to inform you about the health and power (mana, rage, ...) of you, your pet, and your target. In addition, it shows casts, combo points, holy power, soul shards, and a couple of other things. It discretely fades when you are out of combat and at full health/power.

This is a continuation of ArcHUD2 which managed to survive various patches... until the Cataclysm. Thanks to Nenie, the original author of ArcHUD2, for supporting me with this new version.

Please report any bugs or feature requests via the ticket system. The login is the same as your Curse login.

These arcs are currently supported:
• Health and power (mana, rage, focus, energy, runic power) for player, pet, target, and focus target
• Player's secondary power (Holy Power, Soul Shards, Chi etc.)
• Casting/channelling progress for player, target, and focus target
• Fatigue/breath (mirror timer)
• Combo points (including unconsumed combo points on previous target, e.g. on dead corpses)
• Custom (de)buff arcs: Ever wanted to keep track of the stacks and/or remaining times of some specific (de)buffs such as Evangelism, Savage Roar, Beacon of Light, Weakened Soul, etc? Then just create your own custom (de)buff arc for it!

In addition, some additional target information is displayed:
• Current target (name, class, guild, 3D model)
• Current (de)buffs on target
• Target-of-target and target-of-target-of-target

Small warning: Using this addon apparently bears a high risk of getting addicted to it, as these user comments suggest. I received those after taking over the development of ArcHUD when the Cataclysm happened:
• "...nothing ever quite matched the smooth, clean simplicity of ArcHUD's graceful rings."
• "Great job!! I've used this addon for years! None of the other HUDs come close to the functionality and elegance of ArcHUD."
• "Thanks for the work on it so far, much more lightweight than IceHud!"
• "Was staring at the various icehud/metahud alternatives with discomfort and sadness right after the patch [4.0]."
• "Awesome! Thank you so much for that miracle!"
• "Thank you so much for continuing this fantastic addon."
• "...nothing could compare to ArcHUD..."
• "For a whole 4years I had this mod and I missed it so much in the passed few weeks. I tried other HUD mods but they were too in my face >.< . Best HUD mod IMO! Thanks for resurrecting an old friend :D"
• "Loving the new ArcHUD my favorite HUD by far :)"
• "I don't think I could play wow without this addon :)"
• "I've actually grown kind of dependent on it because I'll occasionally run out of Mana/ die without this."
• "Hey mate, just came to thank You again for taking over this beauty, awesome job!"
• "THAT addon! So long I have been searching for a replacement when the development stopped, thanks for bringing it back to live!"

So use it at your own risk ;)

addons.description:
===========

Formerly Titan Social. An LDB addon to display information about your guild members, Battle.net friends, and character friends.
About
Socialite is an LDB plugin that combines all of your social interactions into one convenient tooltip! The end goal is to have a fully customizable and stylish display both on the Titan bar, and the plugin tool tip, while maintaining a low resource overhead and consolidation of social features. Socialite will allow you to see at a glance who is online, and streamline your communications process in-game.
Usage
You can customize which social section(s) you would like to be displayed through Socialite by right-clicking on the data text and checking/unchecking each option. The Battle.net, Friends, and Guild components work independently of each other, if you do not want to see/display them.

addons.description:
UA Forever is a Ukrainian localization addon for World of Warcraft: Forever
Beta, built for its modern Camelot interface. It translates quests, tooltips,
menus, character and profession panels, chat, NPC names, and other visible text.
Hold Shift to see the original tooltip; quest conversations have an EN/UA
switch. Target client: World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001).
Bundled client data: build 1.60.1.70450.

UA Forever — доповнення з українською локалізацією для World of Warcraft: Forever Beta, створене для сучасного інтерфейсу Camelot. Воно перекладає завдання, підказки, меню, панелі персонажа й професій, чат, імена NPC та інший видимий текст.
Утримуйте Shift, щоб побачити оригінал підказки. У діалогах завдань можна перемикатися між англійською та українською мовами. Цільовий клієнт: World of Warcraft: Forever (інтерфейс 16001). Клієнтські дані в аддоні: збірка 1.60.1.70450.
Реліз 0.22.0
Git-тег: 0.22.0. Зміни відносно 0.21.0:
• Оновлено клієнтські дані до збірки 1.60.1.70450.
• Додано українські назви й описи предметів і заклять, оновлено описи здібностей та аур.
• Виправлено переклад тривалості «до скасування» у підказках.
• Доповнено переклад тексту завершення завдання.
• Доповнено переклад ігрових об’єктів.

Для встановлення розпакуйте архів так, щоб папка UA_Forever опинилася в Interface/AddOns, після чого виконайте /reload або перезапустіть гру.
ClassicUA translations
We use Ukrainian texts and terminology from ClassicUA for classic quests,
NPCs, items, spells, gossip, books, zones, and basic interface strings. We
adapted those texts for Forever and added new translations. UA Forever has its
own Camelot integration; it does not load ClassicUA's old UI hooks.

ClassicUA: GitHub ·
CurseForge.

Classic translations can be outdated when Forever changes a spell or quest.
The bundled client catalog declares 1.60.1.70450 in its manifest;
/uaf scan reports a build mismatch when the running client differs.
Commands
• /uaf [status|on|off] and /uaf dev on|off
• /uaf ui, /uaf capture [seconds], /uaf scan, /uaf report
• /uaf menus (історичний лічильник меню), /uaf autoscan on|off
• /uaf owner, /uaf tooltip [rows], /uaf aura [seconds], /uaf window [seconds]

Scanned IDs, missing translations, menu captures, and diagnostics are saved in
UA_ForeverDB when the client reloads or exits. Run the translation audits in
tools/ when changing dictionaries. Contributor instructions are in
CONTRIBUTING_TRANSLATIONS.md.

У Налаштування → Додатки → UA Forever можна увімкнути автоскан
неперекладеного контенту. Він збирає нові предмети з текстом підказок, діалоги
й імена NPC, тексти та задачі квестів, навички, закляття, аури й вислови NPC
до UA_ForeverDB.scan.auto. Кнопка Показати зібрані дані відкриває експорт
частинами: натисніть Виділити для Ctrl+C, потім Ctrl+C і вставте текст на
сайті. Кнопка Форма для надсилання показує адресу
форми збору даних для копіювання й
відкриття в браузері. Користувач сам надсилає дані. WoW записує SavedVariables на диск під
час /reload або виходу з гри.
Після надсилання всіх частин натисніть Очистити дані у вікні експорту та
підтвердьте дію. Це видаляє UA_ForeverDB.scan.auto, локальну runtime/hook
діагностику поточної сесії та очищує видимий export.

Changelog
All notable changes to Horizon Suite are documented here.

[Unreleased]

[6.12.1] – 2026-10-27🐛 Fixes
• (Echo) Chat lines from other players show who said them again during boss fights and Mythic+, in conversations and in the All feed, and boss yells name the boss.

[6.12.0] – 2026-10-23✨ New Features
• (Insight) Cursor, fixed in combat — A new Tooltip Anchor choice follows the cursor out of combat and moves tooltips to your fixed anchor while you are in combat.

[6.11.1] – 2026-10-20🐛 Fixes
• (Focus) Tracked achievements now list only the criteria you still need by default, as Blizzard's tracker does. Turn off Missing Criteria Only to see every criterion.
• (Focus) In Minimal mode the header chevron and Options text stay hidden after a reload, and they disappear again when the cursor leaves the tracker.

[6.11.0] – 2026-10-19✨ New Features
• (Focus) Reverse sort order — A new Reverse order switch under Sorting flips the Quest level, Alphabetical and Zone sorts, so you can work through your lowest-level quests first or read your list Z to A. Quests that tie stay in A to Z order.
🐛 Fixes
• (Axis) The bottom of a settings page is no longer cut off after it opens; Focus → Layout scrolls all the way down to the Spacing options again.

[6.10.0] – 2026-10-18✨ New Features
• (Focus) Focused quest highlights — Active quest highlight now offers Left bar, Right bar, Gradient fade, Pointer, Coloured title and None, and none of them push your quests out of line. Each style keeps its own colour and turns green when the quest is ready to turn in, and with Show progress on the bars light up in four steps as you complete objectives.
🔧 Improvements
• (Focus) Fewer, cleaner highlight styles — Top bar, Bottom bar, Outline, Glow, Dual bars, Pill accent and Highlight have been retired. If you used one, you're moved to Left bar or Gradient fade automatically.

[6.9.0] – 2026-10-16✨ New Features
• (Augment) Faster auto-loot — With auto-loot on, every item on a corpse is taken at once; anything that won't fit in your bags stays behind and the loot window opens straight away showing just those. Off by default: turn it on under Augment → Loot Frame → Loot window.
• (Augment) Recipe learned alerts — The "new recipe learned" pop-up can show in your Horizon alert style, and Train all at a trainer shows one "12 Recipes Learned" alert instead of one per recipe. Off by default: turn on Recipe learned in Augment Alerts.
🐛 Fixes
• (Axis) Hovering Reset loot window position no longer raises a Lua error, and settings search no longer shows "function: 0x…" as a setting's description.

[6.8.1] – 2026-10-14🐛 Fixes
• (Augment) Gold, currency and reputation toasts no longer play the friend-online chime: gold plays the coin clink, currency and reputation play the loot toast sound, and the durability, bags and mail alerts play a neutral chime.
• (Focus) Quest items the game can't look up no longer flood chat with a warning every second, and their cooldown shows on the quest item button again.
• (Axis) The Integrations page shows an installed add-on built for a different game version as "Out of date" instead of calling it missing.

[6.8.0] – 2026-10-12✨ New Features
• (Vista) Map icon size — A new slider under Layout → Size & shape resizes the inn, repair and herb icons on the minimap without switching Vista off. Both it and Minimap size now redraw as you drag.
🐛 Fixes
• (Focus) Lock position now only controls the lock: it can be turned off with Shrink to fit on, and both the header and the body obey it.
• (Focus) Turning on Shrink to fit redraws every quest in full instead of cutting entries off half-way with gaps between sections.
• (Augment) The money, currency and reputation toast sounds play the toast chime again, and the durability, bags and mail alerts do too.

[6.7.1] – 2026-10-11🐛 Fixes
• (Focus · Forever) Group quests no longer show a group finder eye that does nothing when clicked; its option is greyed out until Forever supports group search.…
addons.description:
Driven by the community and customised for each member's sensibilities.
### Current Versions
_since-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=0FBF3E&logoSize=auto)

Seven modules, one download, for Retail (Midnight) and WoW: Forever. Each module switches on or off on its own, so you only run the parts you want. A fresh install starts with every module off: pick yours under Axis → Modules and reload.

New in 6.0: Echo, a chat module that gives every conversation its own tile. See below.

🌐 Retail and WoW: Forever
Horizon Suite runs on Retail (Midnight) and the WoW: Forever beta from the same download: install it once and every module loads on either client. Forever has no Mythic+, Delves, housing, Great Vault, specialisations or Traveler's Log, so the settings for those stay out of the way there.

Known beta issue: the Forever client doesn't yet read saved settings back at login, so your settings reset on reload there until Blizzard fixes it.

🎒 Augment \[Miscellaneous\]
Quality-of-life improvements to Blizzard's own UI, starting with loot that deserves to be seen.
• Loot toasts: Items, money, currency and reputation slide in with quality colours and smooth animations. Epic and legendary drops stay on screen longer, with a shine and an optional sound. Choose Compact, Framed, Accent, Ribbon, Rail or Card styling (shared with alerts, loot rolls and Echo; Card adds item level and slot under each item), which side the icon and slide-in sit on, and which way the stack grows. With Auto Loot off, Blizzard's loot window picks up the same style.
• Loot rolls: Horizon's own Need and Greed frames, matching your loot toast style by default. While the timer runs they show who has rolled and who is leading, whether the appearance is new to you, how the item level compares with what you're wearing, and whether it binds on pickup. Rolls below a quality you choose keep Blizzard's frame, so no roll goes missing. Off by default, and you can try a demo without a group.
• Alerts: Optional toasts for Great Vault rewards, low durability, nearly full bags, new mail, and friends coming online or going offline. Every kind starts off, so you switch on only the ones you want, each with its own threshold and colour.
• Auto Vendor: Sells your grey items when you open a merchant, with optional rules for unusable and low-level gear. Automatic repairs, from your own gold or the guild bank, are available but off by default.
• Talking Head: Restyles the NPC dialogue frame, with options to hide the portrait or mute the voice-over.
• Self Highlight: Uses Blizzard's "find yourself" outline, circle or icon, in combat, and optionally whenever you target an enemy. Off by default.
• Achievement Tracker: Removes achievements from your tracked list as soon as you earn them. Off by default.

🎯 Focus \[Objective Tracker\]
Your tracker shouldn't need babysitting. Focus keeps up with you: it surfaces nearby quests, updates as you move, and gets out of the way when you don't need it.
• Always relevant: Nearby quests rise to the top, and the list reorganises when you change zone. Delves, scenarios, raids and world events get their own sections with live progress bars and timers. Zone event quests appear under Events in Zone before you arrive and move to Current Event once you're inside.
• Proximity and auto-focus: Sort each section closest-first, and optionally super-track the nearest quest automatically. Toggle auto-focus with a key binding.
• Tracks everything: Achievements with full criteria progress, Endeavors and Decor for housing, transmog appearances, profession recipes and Traveler's Log objectives. One click opens the matching Blizzard panel.
• Recipe shopping lists: Tracked recipes list the reagents you need. Full reagent detail adds optional and finishing reagents. With Auctionator and the Auction House open, the magnifying glass runs a shopping search; right-click it to multiply every quantity by the number of crafts you want.…

All notable changes to Horizon Suite are documented here.

[Unreleased]

[6.12.1] – 2026-10-27🐛 Fixes
• (Echo) Chat lines from other players show who said them again during boss fights and Mythic+, in conversations and in the All feed, and boss yells name the boss.

[6.12.0] – 2026-10-23✨ New Features
• (Insight) Cursor, fixed in combat — A new Tooltip Anchor choice follows the cursor out of combat and moves tooltips to your fixed anchor while you are in combat.

[6.11.1] – 2026-10-20🐛 Fixes
• (Focus) Tracked achievements now list only the criteria you still need by default, as Blizzard's tracker does. Turn off Missing Criteria Only to see every criterion.
• (Focus) In Minimal mode the header chevron and Options text stay hidden after a reload, and they disappear again when the cursor leaves the tracker.

[6.11.0] – 2026-10-19✨ New Features
• (Focus) Reverse sort order — A new Reverse order switch under Sorting flips the Quest level, Alphabetical and Zone sorts, so you can work through your lowest-level quests first or read your list Z to A. Quests that tie stay in A to Z order.
🐛 Fixes
• (Axis) The bottom of a settings page is no longer cut off after it opens; Focus → Layout scrolls all the way down to the Spacing options again.

[6.10.0] – 2026-10-18✨ New Features
• (Focus) Focused quest highlights — Active quest highlight now offers Left bar, Right bar, Gradient fade, Pointer, Coloured title and None, and none of them push your quests out of line. Each style keeps its own colour and turns green when the quest is ready to turn in, and with Show progress on the bars light up in four steps as you complete objectives.
🔧 Improvements
• (Focus) Fewer, cleaner highlight styles — Top bar, Bottom bar, Outline, Glow, Dual bars, Pill accent and Highlight have been retired. If you used one, you're moved to Left bar or Gradient fade automatically.

[6.9.0] – 2026-10-16✨ New Features
• (Augment) Faster auto-loot — With auto-loot on, every item on a corpse is taken at once; anything that won't fit in your bags stays behind and the loot window opens straight away showing just those. Off by default: turn it on under Augment → Loot Frame → Loot window.
• (Augment) Recipe learned alerts — The "new recipe learned" pop-up can show in your Horizon alert style, and Train all at a trainer shows one "12 Recipes Learned" alert instead of one per recipe. Off by default: turn on Recipe learned in Augment Alerts.
🐛 Fixes
• (Axis) Hovering Reset loot window position no longer raises a Lua error, and settings search no longer shows "function: 0x…" as a setting's description.

[6.8.1] – 2026-10-14🐛 Fixes
• (Augment) Gold, currency and reputation toasts no longer play the friend-online chime: gold plays the coin clink, currency and reputation play the loot toast sound, and the durability, bags and mail alerts play a neutral chime.
• (Focus) Quest items the game can't look up no longer flood chat with a warning every second, and their cooldown shows on the quest item button again.
• (Axis) The Integrations page shows an installed add-on built for a different game version as "Out of date" instead of calling it missing.

[6.8.0] – 2026-10-12✨ New Features
• (Vista) Map icon size — A new slider under Layout → Size & shape resizes the inn, repair and herb icons on the minimap without switching Vista off. Both it and Minimap size now redraw as you drag.
🐛 Fixes
• (Focus) Lock position now only controls the lock: it can be turned off with Shrink to fit on, and both the header and the body obey it.
• (Focus) Turning on Shrink to fit redraws every quest in full instead of cutting entries off half-way with gaps between sections.
• (Augment) The money, currency and reputation toast sounds play the toast chime again, and the durability, bags and mail alerts do too.

[6.7.1] – 2026-10-11🐛 Fixes
• (Focus · Forever) Group quests no longer show a group finder eye that does nothing when clicked; its option is greyed out until Forever supports group search.…

Full Changelog Previous Releases

addons.description:
The new Blackfathom Deeps is under Instances in the settings. Normal is the old 5 player instance only in regular Classic and 10 is the new version in Season of Disocvery. The game client considers the new BFD a 10 player instance/dungeon and not an actual raid.
Overview
AutoCombatLogger is a World of Warcraft addon that automatically enables or disables the combat log based on location. It's specifically tailored to control the logging based on the raid name and difficulty.

Logging can be controlled for the following locations:
• Raid (Can be customized per raid, raid size, and difficulty)
• Instances (Can be customized per instance, current only)
• Arenas (Can be customized per arena)
• Battleground (Can be customized per battleground)
• World
• Garrison
• Brawler's Arena

Currently, you cannot customize instances and world.

It also provides an LDB launcher and a minimap icon to control it.

Options are set under Interface Options or typing /acl.

Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Fix Classic detection.
addons.description:
Character Notes is a World of Warcraft addon that allows you to set and manage notes on other player's characters. Notes are stored per realm so notes are shared across your characters on a realm. Notes can be set on any character name. The notes are simple and generic and are not tied to a friend, an ignored character, etc.

Notes are displayed:
• When that character logs on
• When you do a /who on that character
• In unit tooltips
• Optionally as a hyperlink in chat
• From a command line interface
• From a GUI interface

Notes can be set and managed:
• By right-clicking on a unit frame
• Right clicking a name in chat or in the friends list
• From a command line interface
• From a GUI interface
• LDB launcher to bring up the GUI interface
• Minimap button to bring up the GUI interface
Additional Features
Character Notes can use LibAlts to get main-alt information. If no note is found for a character but one is found for the main of that character, it will display the note for the main.

Notes can be stored for characters not from your server but you'll need to use /editnote or the "Edit Note" menu item due to the spaces in the name (from the server name added at the end).

Note Links will add a hyperlink in chat next to any player name that you have set a note for. Clicking the "note" link will display the note in a tooltip.
Command-line options
/notes - Brings up the GUI
/searchnote - Brings up the GUI. Optional search term allows filtering the list of notes.
/setnote Sets a note for the character name specified.
/delnote Deletes the note for the character name specified.
/getnote Prints the note for the character name specified.
/editnote Brings up a window to edit the note for the name specified or your target if no name if specified.
/setrating Sets the rating for a note. (Rating: -1 = Negative, 0 = Neutral, 1 = Positive)
/notesexport Brings up the notes export window.
/notesimport Brings up the notes import window.
Import / Export
Via the interface options or command line you can initiate an export or import of notes.

Exported notes can be used in spreadsheets, other applications, or imported into this
addon. The export is in the comma-separated value (CSV) format. If you choose to Escape values, it will put double quotes around text fields.

You can also import notes into the addon. This feature can result in data loss. Backup
your data (the Saved Variables) before importing in case you need to restore your data if
anything goes wrong. You can find the file at \\WTF\Account\\Saved Variables\CharacterNotes.lua. Flavor is the game type such as retail or classic.

In order to import notes from this addon, when you export you must select all fields and turn on Escape? values. Any spaces or newlines in a note will cause issues and possible corrupt the import. Escaping the values will preserve the data.

A preview window shows what will be imported giving you a chance to verify the data
looks correct. By default the addon will not overwrite existing data. If you wish to overwrite existing notes, then toggle the Overwrite Existing option.

addons.changelog:
First public snapshot from day one of the World of Warcraft: Forever beta (build 1.60.1.69893).

Addons (drop the folder into _classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns):
• ForeverCDM 0.3.4 - a cooldown manager that needs no Blizzard Cooldown Manager data (which is empty for Forever specs). Reads the spellbook and your auras directly. /fcdm opens the settings window.
• ForeverCompat 0.1.1 - loads first; defines the deprecated Retail globals Forever lacks so Retail addons stop crashing, adds /place to put abilities on bars while dragging is broken, and hosts the settings-loader workaround for the client not reading SavedVariables.

Also in the repo: the captured API surface (6,046 functions, 269 namespaces), a scanner that diffs any addon against it, a porting script, a secure-snippet guard, and a README of measured findings: the version-check trap, the missing loadstring_untainted, the saved-variables bug, the 100-error cap, and the in-combat aura lockdown.

Author: Thunderz. MIT.
addons.description:
Tools, findings, and three small addons for developing on the World of Warcraft: Forever beta
(build 1.60.1.69893, opened 2026-09-17). Everything here was measured against the live client,
not inferred from patch notes.

Author: Thunderz · Status: first-week snapshot, last updated 2026-09-24. Blizzard has started fixing the things below: build 1.60.1.70009 fixed secure snippets. Not every other row has been re-checked on that build.
Findings in one page
| Finding | Detail | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Interface number | 16001 (build line 1.60.x). Product folder _classic_beta_, exe WowB.exe. | Put 16001 first in ## Interface. |
| It is the Retail client | WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_MAINLINE. 269 C_* namespaces, Edit Mode, Cooldown Manager, the works. The old Classic globals are gone (GetItemInfo, GetSpellInfo, UnitAura, GetTalentInfo, GetMerchantItemInfo, CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo…). | Port from your Retail code, not your Classic code. |
| The version-check trap | Almost every Retail addon tests select(4, GetBuildInfo()) >= 100000 to mean "modern client". Forever answers 16001, so they load Classic code paths or refuse to start. | tools/port_to_beta.py rewrites that idiom to 120100 in the copy. |
| Talents and Legacy trees | Both run on Retail's trait system (C_Traits). The Legacy panel is ToggleLegacySystemUI, unlocks at level 25, has a seasonal point cap. | Read trees with C_Traits; see ForeverBeacon's trait walker. |
| No Retail specializations | GetSpecialization and friends are absent; spec IDs are new (paladin = 1486). | Spec-keyed addon logic misbehaves. ForeverCompat bridges the calls. |
| Midnight restrictions carried over | C_Secrets, C_RestrictedActions, restricted combat log, built-in C_DamageMeter. Creature health and damage numbers are secret. | Threat meters and combat-decision addons cannot work. Reference and tracker addons are fine. |
| Registering an unknown event throws | e.g. LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB does not exist; RegisterEvent errors and aborts the file. | Wrap registration in pcall. |
| Secure snippets: fixed in build 70009 (was a Blizzard bug) | Before 1.60.1.70009 every WrapScript, onstate-, initialConfigFunction and RunAttribute threw "attempt to call a nil value", because Blizzard_RestrictedAddOnEnvironment/RestrictedExecution.lua:22 captured loadstring_untainted as nil. The cause, traced in forever-bugs #74, was load order: Blizzard_EnvironmentCleanup loads first and deletes that global (EnvironmentCleanup.lua:279), and its dependency on the restricted environment applied only to the Classic and Standard game types, so on Forever the cleanup ran before the capture. 70009 applies that dependency to every game type. Verified in game: a SecureHandlerBaseTemplate Execute snippet returns 42. | Action bars, click-casting and state drivers can work again. Never test with type(loadstring_untainted): it is nil after load on every client, Retail included, by design. An addon that probes that global switches its snippet features off for good (EllesmereUI did up to 9.2.8; 9.2.9 removed its snippet checks after this was reported in PR #2143). Test by running a snippet. tools/guard_secure_snippets.py relies on that probe and is obsolete. |…

releases.changelog:
First public snapshot from day one of the World of Warcraft: Forever beta (build 1.60.1.69893).

Addons (drop the folder into _classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns):
• ForeverCDM 0.3.4 - a cooldown manager that needs no Blizzard Cooldown Manager data (which is empty for Forever specs). Reads the spellbook and your auras directly. /fcdm opens the settings window.
• ForeverCompat 0.1.1 - loads first; defines the deprecated Retail globals Forever lacks so Retail addons stop crashing, adds /place to put abilities on bars while dragging is broken, and hosts the settings-loader workaround for the client not reading SavedVariables.

Also in the repo: the captured API surface (6,046 functions, 269 namespaces), a scanner that diffs any addon against it, a porting script, a secure-snippet guard, and a README of measured findings: the version-check trap, the missing loadstring_untainted, the saved-variables bug, the 100-error cap, and the in-combat aura lockdown.

Author: Thunderz. MIT.

addons.changelog:
WowSimsExporterv3.2.6 (2026-10-29)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• chore: sync Forever talent table with wowsims/forever (#78)
Co-authored-by: generalwrex
• Merge pull request #71 from dodoels/feat/i18n-zhcn
Add localization support (enUS + zhCN)
• Offer wowsimscn.com next to the international site on zhCN
On Forever with a zhCN client, the main tab shows two copyable links:
the international sim (wowsims.com/forever) and the China mirror
(wowsimscn.com). The mirror only serves its root, so no spec path is
appended. Other clients/locales are unchanged.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Add localization support with enUS and zhCN
Introduce a lightweight locale system (Locales/Locale.lua) with no new
library dependency. All user-facing strings in the UI, options, chat
messages and saved-data manager now go through Env.L, keyed by their
English text, with a full Simplified Chinese (zhCN) translation.
Unsupported-class message now lists localized class names.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Merge pull request #77 from wowsims/feat/forever-talent-marker
feat: export the game flavor with each character
• feat: export the game flavor instead of a talent tree marker
Replace the Forever-only "talentTrees" key with "flavor", set by every flavor:
era, sod, tbc, wrath, cata, mists or forever. A sim can now tell which client
an export came from. The Forever sim uses it to apply talent strings only from
Forever exports. The existing "version" key is the addon release, the same on
every client, so it can't do this. The sod, tbc, wotlk, cata and mop addon
importers read top-level keys one by one, so the new key is ignored there.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• feat: mark Forever talent strings as built from the Forever sim's trees
Forever exports now carry "talentTrees": "forever". The Forever sim drops
imported talent strings because an Era/SoD export has the same shape but
indexes different trees; the marker lets it apply only strings this flavor
built from its own tree order. Other flavors don't set the field, so their
exports are unchanged.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Merge pull request #76 from wowsims/fix/forever-guards
fix: harden Forever talents and version guards found by comparing with forever-beta
• test: load files like the real client and cover missing Forever talent APIs
The snapshot harness now loads a file when the client recognises none of its
AllowLoadGameType values, as the game does. The classic clients don't know
camelot, so their snapshots load the Forever files and exercise the IS\_FOREVER
guard; removing it now fails all six classic snapshots. The Forever snapshot
gains exports through C\_ClassTalents and with no talent API at all.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• fix: guard the remaining version-specific files by flavor
ClassicTrees.lua, Glyphs.lua and Cata/Reforge.lua relied only on their
AllowLoadGameType line. A client that recognises none of the listed game types
loads the file anyway, and ClassicTrees.lua calls GetNumTalentTabs on
SPELLS\_CHANGED. Return early like the other files under Flavors/.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• fix: keep the Forever export working when talents can't be read
GetForeverTalentRanks called C\_SpecializationInfo.GetCombatConfigIDForSpecGroup
unguarded. Only the test mock defines it, so on a client without it the spec
lookup raised an error and /wse export produced no gear. Read the config through
C\_ClassTalents.GetActiveConfigID first, fall back to the spec group lookup, and
return nil (empty talents) when neither exists.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Merge pull request #73 from wowsims/feat/wow-forever-support
feat: add WoW Forever support
• Merge pull request #75 from wowsims/refactor/flavor-modules
refactor: describe each game version as a registered flavor
• ci: run the export snapshots before packaging a release
A tag pushed on a commit whose export differs from tools/test/snapshots
now fails the release job before the packager uploads anything.…
addons.description:
An exporter addon for World Of Warcraft: Classic Sims at https://www.wowsims.com/

Supports Classic Era/Anniversary, Season of Discovery, TBC, WotLK, Cataclysm and Mists of Pandaria Classic, and WoW Forever (https://www.wowsims.com/forever/).

The WoW Forever talent table in Flavors/Forever/Talents.lua is generated from the sim's talent trees. Regenerate it with python3 tools/gen_forever_talents.py
when they change, and check it with npm ci --prefix tools/test && node tools/test/forever_talents.js , which replays every talent string from the sim's presets through the export. The Forever talents workflow does both daily, and opens and merges a PR when the table changes.

The Interface versions workflow checks Blizzard's version service daily and opens a PR (for review) adding the interface number of any new client build to the TOC. Run it locally with python3 tools/update_interface_versions.py.

There is a channel on the wowsims discord call integrations to talking real time to people, please don't use the discord for support if it can be avoided please use the issue tracker. we may request to talk to you in the integrations channel involving a pull request or an issue though that's fine.

Invite is located here https://discord.gg/N9ZgAMXQ3p

Getting the addon

If anyone would like to test it, you can just download it from the releases page and you can also find it on Curseforge!

please use curseforge if you can as it helps support my programming endeavors!

To use the addon

/wse - will open up the options window - wip changes do nothing atm
/wse open - will open the exporter window.
/wse export will open the exporter window, generate the data, and have the data ready and highlighted for you to CTRL+C

If you change your gear, talents, enchants, glyphs or runes, you can either rerun /wse export if you closed the window and the data will be updated. or just click the Generate Data button.
INFO
The aim for this project is to have an addon to export your characters gear, enchants, talents, and runes to wowsims.github.io.

addons.description:
An addon that shows World of Warcraft: Forever in Japanese: quests, NPC dialogue, books, item and spell tooltips,
and the game's interface. Hold Alt and the game's own English comes back; let go and the Japanese returns. Alt
is only the default: any key can be chosen. Names of people, places, creatures, items and spells stay in English
everywhere.

With the free voice download it also reads its Japanese aloud: over 14,000 quest texts, NPC lines and book pages,
each NPC in a voice cast for who they are, with a panel that shows who is speaking and what they say.

It is made for World of Warcraft: Forever only. It is not for WoW Classic or for the modern game.

Plan journeys in WoW: Forever, on foot, by air, by sea and through portals.

Shift-click the world map or minimap, or choose a quest, to plan a journey. Shortest Path Forever gives directions in the objective tracker and on both maps.

Planning a journey from the map: the route settles, the next boat counts down in the tracker and the compass turns
with you.
Features
• Compare travel records. /path leaderboard routes|distance|transports|flights|portals shows player-reported guild and group totals, including your own row. Walking distance is approximate. Recording and sharing start on for new participation; saved opt-outs remain off. Turn either off in Travel journal.
• Plan a journey. Shift-click the world map or minimap, or choose Plan journey on a quest. Routes combine walking, flights, boats, zeppelins, lifts, the tram, portals and teleports, and replan as you move. A spot inside a dungeon or raid leads to its entrance. Walks go round zones whose lowest level is 4 or more above yours and round the other faction's towns, and say so in the tracker when they can't. Keep journeys after a reload in Guidance restarts your own journey after a /reload.

The tracker shows each step, with time and distance remaining. Hover the destination's pin on the world map for the same steps, and, with the other faction's routes hidden, whether their boats would be at least two minutes faster.
• Follow your guide. Journeys follow RestedXP's current target by default, without TomTom or a bridge addon; Resume guide returns to it after another journey, unless Adventure Guide's RestedXP display leads instead. With TomTom absent, other guides' TomTom waypoints start journeys here.
• Type a waypoint. /way [zone] x y [title] plans a journey there, written as for TomTom, while TomTom and other addons leave /way free; /path way always works. With TomTom installed, Follow TomTom's arrow in Guidance follows its arrow.

The current stop lights up like a tracked quest.
• Choose your guidance. Keep the route on both maps while hiding the Journey tracker or direction arrow. The arrow eases round to each new bearing; move and scale it in Interface. Click the current step to complete it manually; skipping a Hearthstone leaves it out for that journey.

Breadcrumbs show the walking route; the waypoint leads to the next step. A goal off the minimap waits on its rim.
• See flights and departures. Flight maps highlight your next flight, and a flight master's world map tooltip lists its flights and their times. Dock tooltips show destinations and departure times; nearby services count down in the tracker. Ride times improve estimates and are shared with other players.

Flight lines follow the route between flight points.
• Find nearby services. The map and minimap tracking menus offer trainers, repairs, reagents, vendors, inns, banks, auction houses, flight masters and stables. Requires installed QuestieDB; class trainers also use Tweaks Forever.

Choose a service to plan the trip there.
• Travel prompts and alerts. Hearthstone and teleport steps show the item or spell to use. A banner, transport sound and taskbar flash warn before your boat arrives. Play a sound when you reach the goal in Alerts plays the map's ping on arrival.

The prompt clears as the journey continues.
• Compass and corpse routes. The compass marks turns, stops and your destination, and can show the time left under it. As a ghost, a red route leads to your body; your journey resumes when you are alive.

The strip can be moved and resized separately from the tracker. While moving it or the arrow, Shift-drag, or rest the pointer on it and use the arrow keys, to place it to the pixel.
• Quest areas. Inside a quest's area, the client draws it in gold instead of a stop pin and line.

The highlighted area is the game's own quest boundary.

More detail: features and API.

• Travel data regenerated against the 1.60.1.70755 build. The travel data set (taxi network, teleports, transports and zone adjacency) is rebuilt from the new Forever client build. The regenerated values match the previous build, so the routes and boat times you see do not move.

• Travel leaderboards keep your own row visible. Guild and group totals are labelled player-reported, and approximate distance stays marked. New participation starts on, while saved recording and sharing opt-outs remain off. Disabling either cancels queued sends and hides cached peers while preserving personal history. Shared reports use the suite's bounded transport. Only travel records are cached.
• Following TomTom shows one direction arrow. While Shortest Path supplies directions, TomTom's arrow steps aside without stopping its waypoint queue. Its own settings take effect again when guidance pauses or ends.
For addon authors
• TravelStats().peers retains its addon, player, metric and subject layout, but now contains only spf travel reports. Unused foreign-addon caches are removed.

For longest time, I did not add support or Victory sounds or encounter music because it was already nicely done by a 3rd party addon called DBM-Victory sounds. However, this project seems long abandoned. Additionally, it's high time DBM supported these features built in.

Additionally, I hope many download this template and learn to make their own Event Sound packs to further expand options. Today, DBM has couple dozen voice packs out there. Lets see if we can do same for Event Sounds! Please do so properly though. Don't go downloading latest Taylor Swift or Kanye album, make a mod with it and upload a music pack. Find some free to use media or get permission from the artist.

addons.description:
A full reskin of tooltips for WoW Forever. PrettyTooltip replaces the game's tooltip with a compact, ornamented panel: the icon and name up front, the details in short colored rows grouped by kind, and the fine print gathered in a footer. Hold ALT (or the key you choose) at any time to see the game's own tooltip.
Item tooltips
Top to bottom, an item panel shows:
• Header. The icon with an item level badge, the name in its quality color, and a subtitle with the item's type and slot, such as Mail · Head or Staff · Two-Hand. The subtitle also names what the game leaves unsaid: Consumable · Potion, Crafting Reagent, Scarce. The binding sits below it, with the required level at the right, red while you are below it. The whole panel is tinted by quality; quest items, and items that begin a quest, are tinted quest gold.
• Weapon damage. DPS as the prominent row, with damage and speed beneath it.
• Armor and stats. Armor, then the stats in two blocks: the primary attributes, and everything else under a divider. Long stat wording is shortened (see below), and each stat is colored by kind.
• Equip effects and enchants. Equip effects that are not a plain stat, such as a zone-limited speed bonus, join the stat list in green without the Equip: prefix. A chance on hit joins them too, marked with a small sword instead of its Chance on hit: prefix. Its numbers follow the spell tooltip's highlighting: a lighter school color when the description names that school's damage, or a neutral highlight otherwise. Holyfire blends Holy and Fire. These highlights follow Stat colors and a custom Equip effects color in the panel. Enchants follow as green rows marked with a sparkle, one per bonus: Enchanted: Stamina +1 and Armor +8 becomes +1 Stamina and +8 Armor.
• Use effects and flavor text, as the game words them, each use effect marked with a small gear instead of its Use: prefix.
• Item set. The set name and how many pieces you own, the pieces you own highlighted, and the set bonuses, with active ones highlighted.
• Disenchant. For green, blue, and purple armor and weapons: what the item disenchants into, each result with its icon, count, and chance, and the Enchanting it needs, red while your skill is too low and grey if you have no Enchanting. The chances are Classic's published tables (Warcraft Wiki's Disenchanting tables); the game has no way to ask. Turned off under Item Details in the style editor.
• Footer. Durability as a small bar, the crafter's name for crafted items, other requirements such as skills or classes, and the sell price as coins alone; a stack shows its total first, then the count and one item's price, dimmed (2g (20 × 10s)), which can be turned off under Item Details in the style editor.

While the game shows a comparison, the comparison panels are tagged Equipped, and the game's own "If you replace this item" stat changes appear among the rows at the bottom, in their usual green and red.

Recipes are the recipe first: their own icon and name, Plans · Blacksmithing beneath, and the skill they need beside the binding, red while yours is too low. The item they craft follows under Creates as a smaller card with its icon, name, slot, required level, and its own armor, stats, and effects, then the Reagents with their icons and how many you carry (4 / 10, red while short).
Shorter stats
Common Equip wordings become short stat rows:

| The game says | PrettyTooltip shows |
| --- | --- |
| Equip: Increases healing done by up to 48 and damage done by up to 16 for all magical spells and effects. | +48 Healing Power
+16 Spell Damage Power |
| Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 12. | +12 Spell Power |
| Equip: Increases damage done by Fire spells and effects by up to 20. | +20 Fire Spell Damage Power |
| Equip: Improves your chance to get a critical strike by 1%. | +1% Critical Strike Chance |
| Equip: Increased Defense +2. | +2 Defense Skill |…

• Fixed the game's original tooltip showing under the panel as a world unit's tooltip fades, most noticeably in combat, and popping back up after combat when follow cursor is on.
• Fixed the panel briefly appearing at the tooltip's default anchor when moving between action buttons.
• NPC panels show the NPC's title next to its type ("Humanoid · Herbalism Supplier") and its faction above the PvP badge.
• Trainer recipes show the item they create, and their reagents in a list of their own, missing ones in red.
• "Locked" on chests keeps the game's color for how hard the lock is to pick, instead of always showing gray.
• Recipes no longer list their required skill as a reagent ("Cooking 0 / 80"), and show reagents listed without a count. Reagents no longer show icons, since the game only knows icons of items it has already loaded.
Reliability
• The addon no longer changes the game's tooltip data or hides the game's tooltip, which reduces taint in combat.
Bug reports
• Added /ptip trace: for a few seconds it records how the game's tooltips and their panels show, fade, and move, to copy into a bug report.
PrettyTooltip 1.3.0Languages
• PrettyTooltip now works on German, French, Spanish (Spain and Mexico), Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese clients, in addition to English. It relies heavily on built-in localization where possible. For custom addon text, we built separate per-language string tables and parsing logic. The translations are a first draft: please report anything that feels wrong.
Tooltips
• Added the Tooltip Details Modifier option: disenchant results, the spell power breakdown and rates, gathering contents, and IDs show only while Shift is held, or always with Always Show. Shift is the default, which means the details stay hidden by default.
• Item, spell, and NPC panels can show the item, spell, or NPC ID at the bottom. You can turn it off with IDs under each panel's details in the style editor.
• Improved in-combat behavior of spell, item and unit tooltips.…

ForeverArtisan changelog0.9.33 (2026-11-03)
• Fixed: two of the same weapon (like two Skinning Knives) now both come back after the fishing pole. 0.9.32 still left the main hand empty. Thanks to the player who kept testing it.
0.9.32 (2026-10-22)
• Changed: the fishing weapon swap puts back what you wore right before the pole, so changing weapons doesn't mean dragging them into the slots again. Slots you fill by hand still win until you wear something else. Thanks to the player who suggested it.
• Fixed: fishing weapon swap with two of the same weapon (like two Skinning Knives) now puts both back. Before, only the off hand came back. Thanks to the player who tested it.
0.9.31 (2026-10-22)
• New: on-screen goals list, like quest objectives. Right-click any item on a crafting shopping list (Progress tab) to keep it on screen, or click Track all. It counts your bags and bank, so buying, looting, fishing or gathering all move the number, and finished lines turn green and drop off. Gathering and fishing goals show there too, on characters that have that profession. Right-click a line to remove it. Drag it to move it; /fa goals shows or hides it, and /fa goals lock | unlock | reset | clear. Thanks to the player who asked.
• Fixed: fishing weapon swap now gives dual-wielders both weapons back, and anything in the off hand (a second weapon, a shield, an orb or book) comes back after the pole. Before, the pole blocked the off hand and only the main hand returned. Swapping back also works when your weapons weren't read at login. Thanks to the players who reported it.
• Fishing: the Main hand and Off hand slots fill in with what you're wearing when you open the window, without dragging.
• Fishing: adding a goal from Suggest from Cooking takes you back to your goals list, and fish that are already goals say so.
0.9.30 (2026-10-19)
• Changed: Cheapest to level ranks by what the materials cost per skill-up, with nothing taken off for selling what you make. Resale is a guess, worst at launch when everyone sells the same crafts. Hover a row for the skill-up chance in words, what selling or disenchanting would bring back, and a note that chances are averages. Level + profit still counts selling and disenchanting. Thanks to the player who asked.
0.9.29 (2026-10-18)
• New: plan ahead for a profession you don't have yet. Open its window on any character (/fa eng, /fa lw ...) and click Start planning, or go to the Progress tab: it plans from skill 1 to the skill you type, and the shopping list is the raw materials to save while you level something else. Materials the plan makes along the way (bolts, leather, tubes) count as crafted. It uses the recipes seen on the Forever beta, or an alt's once one has opened that window, with trainer levels from the beta. Past the trainer recipes we know, it says to open a higher-rank trainer's list (no need to learn the profession). Thanks to the player who suggested it.
• New: Disenchant sort in Best crafts (Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, Tailoring, Engineering, Enchanting): crafts ranked by what they disenchant into, minus the materials. Recipe tooltips show the disenchant value too.
• New: Cheapest to level counts disenchanting. When what you make is worth more disenchanted than sold, the cost per point uses that, and the row says "disenchant it". Level + profit counts it too. Thanks to the player who asked.
• The disenchant tooltip always shows what the item sells for as it is (the Auction House after its cut, or the vendor), and says "About even" when the two are close.
• Best crafts buttons are shorter (Profit, Return, Cheapest to level, Level + profit) to make room for Disenchant.
• Plans: something an earlier step of the plan makes (Copper Tubes, Light Leather) shows as made by the plan, not something to buy.…
addons.description:
Free tradeskill addons for WoW Forever. One download, one version; ForeverArtisan_Core is required, and each profession is its own module you can turn on or off in game (/fa).

Site, guides and feedback: https://foreverartisan.app
Layout
• ForeverArtisan_* – the fourteen addon folders (the game reads these through junctions in Interface\AddOns).
• docs\ – ARCHITECTURE.md (read first) and RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md.
• tools\release.py – sets the version in every TOC, syntax-checks, dates the changelog.
• tools\build_crafts.py – writes the crafting modules that share one engine (Alchemy, Leatherworking, Blacksmithing, Tailoring, Engineering, Enchanting) from tools\templates\. Edit the template, never the generated files.
Releasing
1. Add changes under ## x.y.z (unreleased) at the top of CHANGELOG.md as you go.
2. Run the in-game checklist in docs\RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md.
3. python tools\release.py . 0.9.2 – sets every TOC and dates the changelog.
4. GitHub Desktop: commit, then History > right-click the commit > Create tag v0.9.2 > Push origin.
5. The Release workflow builds the zip and uploads it to GitHub Releases, CurseForge and Wago.

Before launch builds are 0.9.x: they upload to the stores as Release so players can find them, and show no tag in game. Add -beta.N only for rough test builds (the stores hide those behind a Beta filter). Launch is 1.0.0; after that fixes are 1.0.1…, test builds 1.1.0-beta.1….

addons.description:
This is a simple plugin for the addon Bagnon that first and foremost shows the item level of your equipable gear, but also additional information like the bind status of items (BoE, BoU), a purple eye on uncollected transmog appearances and desaturates and tones down vendor garbage.

Unlike it's similarly named sibling Bagnon ItemLevel which is mainly a straight forward one-trick pony for people only needing the item levels, this addon has an options menu and gives you far more control over the various settings.
Configuration
To configure settings like whether BoE- and item levels should be rarity colored or how much darker garbage should appear, go to the Bagnon Itemlevel Plus entry in the blizzard interface options addons menu, or open the options menu directly in its own window with the command /bil.
addons.name: Bagnon_ItemInfo

Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Detect the guild bank by feature instead of expansion level
Forever reports expansion level 0, so has\_guild\_bank was false and guild slots could be left out of the bag scan. Ask C\_GuildBank.IsGuildBankEnabled where it exists, and keep the expansion check as a fallback.
• Use the retail sort button setup wherever the new bank exists
On Forever this could put BankStack's classic sort buttons on top of Blizzard's own. The hijack default and label follow the same check.
• Detect the new bank by feature instead of by project
Forever has the tabbed bank but is not the retail project, so has\_new\_bank was false and NUM\_BANKBAGSLOTS (nil there) was used. The account bank check used the expansion level, and the account tab list stopped at 5 tabs.

addons.description:
Updated and maintained fork of Atlas. This fork includes all maps from previous expansion map packs, as well as new SL, DF and TWW maps.
About Atlas
Atlas is an addon for World of Warcraft that includes detailed maps for every
instance in the game. Originally, Blizzard neglected to include maps for
instances. However, after a number of years Blizzard began to include official
maps for some instances. These official maps are in the same hand-drawn style
as the built-in world maps. Conversely, the Atlas maps are based on data used
by the minimap, which provides a more detailed, accurate, and colorful
representation. You can think of this as the difference between a street map
and a satellite image.

Furthermore, while the built-in maps mark the locations of some major bosses,
Atlas provides detailed and accurate information about all of the creatures,
NPCs, objects, and events you'll encounter in each dungeon. General information
about each zone is provided as well, including its location, level range,
player limit, attenuation requirement, and associated faction. All entrances,
exits, portals, and connections are labelled clearly. Because there are so many
instances in the game, you can categorize them by type, level, number of
players, continent, or expansion.

Finally, in addition to instances, Atlas comes with a handful of optional
components that add even more maps. These include outdoor encounter maps,
global transportation maps, dungeon location maps, and battleground maps. Each
optional component can be enabled, disabled or removed individually. A number
of third-party Atlas extensions are available as well, which further augment
the functionality of Atlas. AtlasLoot is the most popular of these, providing
detailed drop and item information for every encounter, but there are also
packages for quest information and major city maps as well.
Map Packs
Atlas (fork) v3 now includes the maps from the expansion addons (like Atlas Legion). It's recommended you disable or uninstall the expansion addons to prevent errors. The non-expansion addons (like Atlas Battlegrounds) aren't included directly, but will continue to work if you have those addons installed.
Past Contributors
• Arith - Project Manager
• dubcat - Artist
• Dynaletik - Co-author
• Resike - Co-author

addons.description:
There have been various different versions of DialogKey, sadly the original version by Foxthorn hasn't been updated since the beginning of Shadowlands. This version is loosely a continuation from ItsNoich's DF fork, with a large number of improvements, rewrites, and additions.

Our versions are not compatible with eachother, and should not be enabled at the same time; but all your settings will remain intact and untouched.

Previous versions can be found here:
• https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/dialogkey
• https://github.com/N0ich/dialogkey-DF
• https://github.com/TonyRaccoon/wow-dialogkey
• https://github.com/Kayakflo/wow-dialogkey

DialogKey is an AddOn designed to make handling dialogs and quest frames less of a hassle by allowing you to use the keyboard to control them. View the settings by typing /dialogkey, /dkey, or /dk

Note: Due to restrictions from Blizzard, this addon will not function during combat; once you drop combat you will once more be able to spam spacebar to skip conversations to your heart's content :)

It has two primary functions:
1. Button Clicking
DialogKey lets you bind a key which can be used to "click" on certain buttons without the hassle of moving your mouse over to it. By default it's Spacebar, but you can change it or add a second key as well. Note that this isn't a traditional keybind: the button will still perform its normal function if none of the buttons are visible. For example, your Spacebar will still make you jump, but if one of the buttons is visible, it'll click it instead of jumping.

By default, the following buttons are clicked when you press the key:
• The first available option when talking to an NPC. This could be a conversation topic or a quest.
• Accept quest button
• Continue quest button (When you click on a quest at an NPC and are about to hand it in)
• Complete quest button
• The OK/Accept button in popups, this click is done securely, which means you won't get any "AddOn 'DialogKey_Numy' tried to call the protected function .." errors!
• Popups include:
• "Are you sure you wish to exchange for ?"
• "Looting will bind it to you."
• "Do you wish to set your hearthstone to ?"
• has invited you to a group"
• And more!

You can also include other buttons for DialogKey to click. Just hover over the button and type /dialogkey add to start tracking it. Type /dialogkey remove to stop tracking the button under the cursor. You may also track/untrack by name, by typing, for example, /dialogkey add GameMenuButtonContinue. Capitalization matters!

You can also do this from within the Options (type /dialogkey to open them)
2. NPC Option Selection
DialogKey allows you to press a number key to select a dialog option at an NPC. Pressing 1 will select the first conversation topic or quest, 2 will select the second one, etc. It also adds numbers at the beginning of each line. Pressing the bound key (e.g. Spacebar) will also select the first option.

addons.changelog:
Fixed
• The map's art is there at once when you open it: since 0.7.4 the zones showed blank parchment
for a moment each time the map opened.
• Clicking a quest on the map keeps the map as it is: the quest is tracked and the map zooms in on
it, full screen or windowed. It opened the quest's details, which Blizzard shows in the windowed
map, so a full-screen map left full screen. With the quest log open beside the map, its details

addons.description:
OpenMap is an open-source, seamless world map addon for WoW Forever that keeps the original Vanilla art style. Zoom and pan across the whole world map with a truly open-source, community-built map addon.

Help us build it as a community into the best world map, while staying true to the classic spirit.

There are already a bunch of map addons for Forever, and some of them are great. What I couldn't find was one that's seamless (lets you zoom and pan through the entire world), open source, and keeps the map looking like Blizzard's original map.

OpenMap stitches every zone map into one continuous map. Scroll out of Elwynn and you're looking at Westfall, Duskwood and Redridge, then the whole continent, then the world. No more clicking in and right-clicking out between zones. It lives inside the normal world map, so your quest log, the map's buttons, Questie and the rest of the standard map work as intended.
What it does
• One seamless map. Zoom from the whole world down to street level, toward your cursor. It uses the map art from the game files, with the game's minimap blended in for extra detail at the closest zoom, without breaking the map's look.
• Zone borders that blend. Neighbouring zones fade into each other, and the border mountains are colour-matched.
• The whole map made visible. Land Forever has no zone map for (Gilneas, the ridges round Orgrimmar, the mountains west of Searing Gorge, the edges of Stonetalon, Feralas, Silithus and more) is drawn from Blizzard's own classic and pre-Cataclysm maps of it, which ship with the game but the game doesn't show. Land no map ever drew is left as clean parchment, like an unfinished map.
• Ocean and continent names rebuilt so they zoom properly, lettered in the game's own map font.
• Dungeon and raid entrances with level ranges, coloured for your level. Click one and Blizzard's own map of that dungeon opens right in the map, every floor of it, with its bosses and its quests beside it (with Questie, Dungeon Journal or NeedRoll). With Dungeon Journal, an entrance can open its page there instead. For loot, OpenMap recommends NeedRoll: every boss's drops, what you've collected and a wishlist.
• Boats, zeppelins and airships, WoW Forever's own too: click one to jump to the other end (the airships to Zephras Isle open its map), and see their routes. Dungeons, boats and zeppelins each have their own switch.
• Underground. Zoom into a cave, mine, crypt or a dungeon's entrance area and its map appears:
Blizzard's where it drew one, else the game's own minimap of it.
• Flight paths. Learned ones in colour, the rest greyed out. Click two flight masters to see the route you'd fly and roughly how long it takes.
• Getting around. Search for a zone, city, dungeon or flight master; a "Find me" button (or middle-click the map); choose how the map reopens; party and raid members are shown across the whole map. Or take your own arrow off the map and find your way old-school.
• Map pins and drawing. Ctrl-click for as many pins as you like, each with a note and a colour, followed with Blizzard's waypoint (and TomTom's); share them with your group, guild or a friend. Draw on the map with a pen, lines, arrows, circles and raid marks, on its own or on a pin.
• Vendors, spirit healers and rares (needs Questie): repair, innkeepers, trainers, bankers, auctioneers, stable masters, spirit healers and rare mobs. Questie's quest icons can be switched on or off from OpenMap's menu too. (Still working on performance here.)
• A map that fits your screen. No more black bars at the sides: resize the window to any shape, or go full screen and the map fills it.…
addons.name: OpenMap

releases.changelog:
Fixed
• The map's art is there at once when you open it: since 0.7.4 the zones showed blank parchment
for a moment each time the map opened.
• Clicking a quest on the map keeps the map as it is: the quest is tracked and the map zooms in on
it, full screen or windowed. It opened the quest's details, which Blizzard shows in the windowed
map, so a full-screen map left full screen. With the quest log open beside the map, its details
show there too.
• Hiding your pins hides their drawings too (the menu's Pins, right-clicked): what you drew on a
pin stayed on the map without it.

New
• Chat over the full-screen map (the menu's Look tab, and Options): the chat windows stay on show
over the map while it's full screen, to keep talking while you look. Off unless you turn it on (a
player's request).
• Faster to load: only your language's translations are read (the other nine were a quarter of
OpenMap's code), and its look through every addon's map icons for combat waits till you're in the
world, not the loading screen (a player's report: half a second more load time).
• The zones' detail comes in sooner when the map first opens up close: it took a couple of
seconds after a login or reload.
• /openmap status says what loading costs: OpenMap's files, the login, the map's setup and
building the map (a player found it added load time: this shows where).

New
• Key bindings (the game's Keybindings > OpenMap): Find me, Drop a pin, Pins, Quill,
Quest log and the map's menu, each opening the map first if it's closed (players' requests).
• The quill draws on dungeons' maps: with a dungeon's map up, what you draw goes on its picture
and is kept with that dungeon, not on the world map behind it (a player's request).
• Only places you've found (the menu's On the map tab, under Places): dungeon entrances, docks
and zeppelin towers once you've explored where they are, flight masters once you've learned them.
Off unless you turn it on (a player's request).
• Townsfolk from another addon's NPC database: an addon with a database in Questie's shape can
give it to OpenMap (OpenMapAPI.RegisterTownsfolkProvider, docs/api.md), so townsfolk and rare
mobs show without Questie (a player's request).
Fixed
• Smooth zooming at any Take colour out: the zones' fast pre-drawn art was only used at the
setting's default (10%); at any other, every zone was drawn from its hundreds of pieces and the
frame rate dropped as their detail came in. It's now used at every setting.
• Full screen stays full screen, and the quest log you closed stays closed, the next time the
map opens: it went back to the window and the quest log each time (a player's report).
• Improves performance under Fade icons while zooming no longer stays on show over the menu's
other tabs (a player's report).
• Riverglades and Zephras Isle show their levels on the zone hover (35-45 and 1-12, from the
Warcraft Wiki; a player's report).

Improved
• Zooming is smoother with unexplored areas darkened: greying the land you haven't found cost
a lot of frame rate while zooming; it now costs far less.
• Unexplored areas for one character only: the menu's Only for this character, under
Unexplored areas, gives this character its own choice (darkened, hidden or shown); every other
character keeps the shared one (a player's request).
• Fade icons while zooming says Improves performance under it in the map's menu, so it
isn't turned off unawares.
Fixed
• The map loads the zone you pan or zoom to again: with an addon adding map icons (Questie,
GatherLite ...), it could stay on the zone you started on, so the zone or continent you'd panned to
showed none of their icons until you clicked it (a player's report from 0.6, and ours). Its setting,
once Follow the view, is now Load the zone in view (the menu's More tab), saying what it does.
• The map window drags and resizes with Move Any installed but turned off: OpenMap asked whether
Move Any was on for a character named by your first name alone (WoW Forever gives a first and last
name), which the game took as on, and left the window to it (a player's report, with the fix).

addons.description:
A lightweight and fast World of Warcraft addon designed to track your gold farms. Track both raw gold and the gold value of looted items using the price source you pick in the configuration menu, TradeSkillMaster, Auctionator, Auctioneer, OribosExchange or RECrystallize, with reload protection so you don't need to worry about disconnections.
2.1 The Transmog update: AllTheThings and Scrap integration, improvements and bug fixes
In this version MoneyLooter can tell whether an item has a unique appearance, making it easier to distinguish valuable items from ones that aren't (any unique appearance is valuable to a collector). AllTheThings is used for this, and it takes into account whether shared appearances can be obtained or not; if none of that item's appearances can be obtained except the item's own, that item counts as a unique appearance. If you don't have AllTheThings, MoneyLooter gets all the appearances from Blizzard's API, but it can't tell whether the shared appearances can be obtained or not. For now, this mode has no threshold for the item's minimum value, but if you mark it as Junk in Scrap, MoneyLooter will treat it as junk even if it's a unique appearance.

In this version MoneyLooter also integrates with Scrap, so it can tell whether an item is marked as Junk. If so, MoneyLooter will directly mark it as an item to sell to the vendor. This check happens before the disenchant check, so if you want to disenchant certain items, don't mark them as Junk in Scrap.

Many improvements and bug fixes are included in how prices are determined, especially when it comes to disenchanting. Keep in mind that if you use TSM to get the disenchant price, it may not have the item cached and won't return a disenchant value. To mitigate this, MoneyLooter, in this specific case, doesn't cache the item's value and, if you get it again, will ask TSM for the disenchant value again.

To make this whole process easier, MoneyLooter now also includes a sell button in the top of the vendor window that sells every item MoneyLooter has marked for selling. Items are sold 12 at a time, so that if it sells something you didn't want to sell by mistake, you can get it back from the buyback. Due to Blizzard API limitations, the selling process is somewhat slow (and my implementation is a bit rough), and I'm working on improvements to make it faster without overloading Blizzard's API. IMPORTANT: The sell button is designed for transmog farmers, so BoP armor/weapon items will be sold, don't use this if you don't want to lose something valuable you keep in your inventory. It doesn't matter that you didn't loot it with MoneyLooter running, when you open the vendor, it will analyze ALL of your inventory and determine whether an item should be sold or not, using the same logic as when looting. BoP recipes are never sold.

Enjoy your transmog farms!
New in 2.0: Configuration menu, UI scale, selectable price source, Forever support and more
MoneyLooter 2.0 adds a proper configuration menu. Click the gear button in the bottom right corner of the addon to open it, change what you need and press Save to apply the changes.

Price source: You now choose which addon provides your item prices -> TradeSkillMaster, Auctionator, Auctioneer, OribosExchange or RECrystallize. There is no automatic fallback between addons anymore: only the selected addon is queried. Make sure you select your price source in the configuration menu, TradeSkillMaster is the default.

From the same menu you can also configure:
• Force vendor price: Use only the vendor sell price.
• Use disenchant value: Use the disenchant value when the regular price is below your minimum threshold.
• Force disenchant value: One toggle per quality (Uncommon, Rare, Epic). When enabled, that quality is always valued by its disenchant value.
• TSM custom string: Your custom TSM price string, with Validate and Reset buttons.…

addons.description:
One live desktop overlay and one local bridge for T3 Code and Hermes,
with a native World of Warcraft addon as a fallback. See what needs you, read
the conversation, reply, answer approvals and input requests, stop a turn, or
start a new T3 Code session without leaving or reloading the game.
What it is
• The Electron overlay is the primary UI. It receives live state and sends
actions over a private Unix socket owned by the bridge service.
• The overlay follows the active Omarchy theme live, using the same generated
t3code.json palette as T3 Code. Theme changes repaint without a restart.
• One Python bridge watches Hermes and T3 Code behind provider adapters. Its
service also auto-starts the overlay when WoW appears and hides it when WoW
exits.
• The native addon remains available for users who prefer it, but WoW addons
cannot open a socket or watch a file. Its data can only change on a UI reload,
so it is explicitly a fallback rather than the live experience.
• The T3 adapter attaches to the T3 Code server that is already running. It does
not start a second T3 Code instance or require a patched nightly release.

Use either provider or both. Rows are labeled T3 Code or Hermes, and actions
are enabled only when that provider supports them.
Requirements
• Linux with a systemd user session
• World of Warcraft Classic, interface 16001
• Python 3.10 or newer
• T3 Code and/or a local Hermes installation
• Node.js 24 or newer if T3 Code is enabled
• Electron 42+ or the Electron bundled with an existing desktop installation
• Git for the bootstrap installer; source checkouts only need Python

The bridge is tested on Linux. Windows and macOS bridge hosts are not verified.
