addons.changelog:
Changelog
All notable changes to Craft Compass. The text of this file goes into each release's notes.
0.5.3 — 2026-11-04
• With AtlasLoot Classic and AtlasLoot Continued both enabled, Craft Compass says at login, in chat, that they break
each other and one of them should be disabled. On CurseForge, AtlasLoot Continued is now the dependency that the
CurseForge app installs along with Craft Compass.
0.5.2 — 2026-11-04
• Works with AtlasLoot Continued, the most up to date AtlasLoot for Classic: it installs into its own folder, and
Craft Compass used to require the folder of AtlasLoot Classic. AtlasLoot Classic and its maintained fork still work;
the original hasn't been updated since 2023. Without any AtlasLoot, Craft Compass now loads anyway, shows quests and
says in chat that recipes need AtlasLoot.
• Season of Discovery recipes on Season of Discovery realms, with AtlasLoot Continued or the AtlasLoot Classic fork.
Their spells have ids the craft index didn't reach; on other realms they stay out, though AtlasLoot lists them with
Classic Era's.
0.5.1 — 2026-11-04
• The items a quest's window says to bring no longer show "0/0" marked as done: Questie mostly doesn't know how many
a quest asks for (it's in the quest's text), so the window now shows how many you have.
0.5.0 — 2026-11-03
• A click on a quest (or Alt over it, or a right click) opens its window: level and zone, whether it's done or in your
log, what it says to do, who gives it and who takes it back, the items to bring with how many you have, the quests
before and after it in the chain (they open too) and its Wowhead page. Shift-click still links it in chat.
• With Questie itself loaded, hovering a quest shows Questie's tooltip of it, and the quest's window has an "Open in
Questie" row for Questie's own window of the quest.
• The Wowhead address dialog keeps its size: it used to grow wider each time it was opened, until it ran off the
screen, and a long address stuck out of its box.
0.4.0 — 2026-11-03
• Drag a nested window away and it stays on its own: closing the window it came from no longer closes it, and that
window opens its rows in a new nested one.
• No more "Drops from", "Found in" and "Contained in" lines. Outside quest items, the data behind them comes from
private-server databases and was too often wrong (rogue quest mobs "dropping" herbs). Where to get an item now
shows the gathering profession and zones, vendors and quest rewards.
• No more "Not used in any recipe or quest" line and its setting: the sources don't know every use, so it was a
guess.
• Instead of drops, the last row of a pinned window is the item's Wowhead page: click it and press Ctrl+C to copy
the address, on the site of your game version and in your client's language. The dialog closes by itself.
• Enchants open in pinned windows too: Alt over an enchant row (or Alt-click, or a right click) shows what it does,
what it takes, where its formula comes from and its Wowhead page. Hovering an enchant row shows its tooltip.
• Herbs and ores show every zone they grow in. Questie clears the spawn points of the most common herbs and veins
(Peacebloom, Briarthorn, copper, tin, iron...), so only a zone or two used to show.
• The list of zones no longer shows how many spawn points each has: the numbers come from private-server data and
don't match the live realms. The richest zones still come first.
0.3.0 — 2026-11-01
• Where an item comes from, with Shift, in pinned windows and in the item window: herbs, ore, stone, leather and
hides show the gathering profession and the skill they need, and herbs and ore the zones they grow in. Any item
shows who sells it, which creatures drop it, what it is found or contained in and which quest rewards it.
• In a pinned window every source line opens the whole list in a nested window: all vendors (the other
faction's greyed out), all creatures with their level and zones, all objects, containers and quests, and every
zone with how many spawn points it has.…
addons.description:
**What is this item for, and what does it take to make that? A tooltip and pinned windows for World of Warcraft
Classic.**

English · Русский · Architecture

Hover any item and see what it is for: every recipe and quest that uses it, and where to get it. Pin that into a
window, follow a potion into what it is used for, and see for any craftable item which profession makes it, which
reagents it needs and how many of them you already carry, and where its recipe comes from — so you know what to
gather before you ask a crafter. And for a world drop no recipe or quest needs, the window still has its Wowhead
page.

*Someone offers to craft a pair of gloves: Alt-click the link in chat, see the reagents, and hover the one you don't
know where to get.*
What does it do?What an item is used for
Hold Shift (or Ctrl) over an item: the recipes it goes into, by profession and skill with how many of it each
takes, and the quests that ask for it, the completed ones marked.
Pinned windows
Hold Alt over an item to pin that list into a window that stays on screen. Hover a row for its tooltip, click it
for the item window, Shift-click to link it in chat. Long lists scroll; Escape closes them all.

Alt over a row (or Alt-click, or a right click) opens a nested window beside it, as deep as you like: from a herb to
the elixir made of it to the belt made of that. An enchant opens the same way: what it does, what it takes and where
its formula comes from. A nested window closes with the one it came from, unless you drag it away: then it stays on
its own.

| An enchant | A window dragged away |
| --- | --- |
| | |
Items from chat
Alt-click an item link in chat to pin it instead of opening the item window. A plain click opens the item window
as usual, with what the craft takes added and a reminder that Alt-click lets you open the reagents.

| Alt-click a link | A plain click |
| --- | --- |
| | |
What a craft takes
Pin a crafted item, hover it in a pinned window, click it, or hold Shift over it anywhere: the profession and skill
that make it, every reagent with how many you have (bags and bank) against how many it needs, and its recipe:
taught by the trainer, or the recipe item with who sells it and which quest rewards it. In a pinned window the
reagents open in nested windows like any other row, so you can follow an oil or a thread back to where it comes from.
Where to get it
The same places show where an item comes from. A herb, an ore or a stone shows the profession that gathers it with
the skill it needs and the zones where it grows most; leather and hides show the skinning skill they start at. Then
who sells the item and which quest rewards it. In a pinned window each of these lines is clickable and opens the
whole list: every vendor with their level and zone, every zone, the richest first.

| The zones of a herb | Every vendor |
| --- | --- |
| | |

Craft Compass is a compass: it points you the right way, it isn't a database. It doesn't say which creatures drop an
item or which chests it is found in: the data addons have on that comes from private-server databases and is too
often wrong. For that, the last row of a pinned window is the item's (or the enchant's) Wowhead page: click it and
press Ctrl+C: the address is copied and the dialog closes (addons can't open a browser or copy by themselves). The page
is in your client's language where Wowhead has it (German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean,
Simplified Chinese), in English otherwise, and on Wowhead's Classic or TBC site to match your game.
And also
• Quest windows. Click a quest in a pinned window (or Alt over it) for its own window: level, zone and whether
it's done, what it says to do, who gives it and who takes it back, the items to bring, the quests before and after
it, and its Wowhead page. With Questie itself loaded, hovering a quest shows Questie's tooltip, and an "Open in
Questie" row opens Questie's window of it.…

RGX-Framework v2.12.0
Package: RGX-Framework-v2.12.0.zip, 106 runtime files, plus release.json.
• Added onPreview to CreateNestedDropdown. Each leaf with a value gets a Play/Stop button that calls onPreview(value, item, holder). Use isPreviewing(value, item, holder) to show Stop while a value plays, previewLabel and previewStopLabel to change the text, and item.preview = false to skip a row.
• Menus with onPreview use the UIDropDownMenu path, because MenuUtil rows expose no list frame that ForceWidth can size. The framework reserves row width for the Play button, so consumers do not list its key in autoWidth.opts.
• Added holder:RefreshPreviews() to re-read Play/Stop labels after playback ends.
• Play buttons are cleared whenever any dropdown builds a menu level, because menu rows are shared between open dropdowns.
• Documented the Play button API in docs/DROPDOWNS.md.
addons.description:
The v2.11.0 release adds RGXTriggers, the clone-keyed trigger state
store behind the upcoming trigger evaluation engine. See the release notes.

One dependency. Everything your addon suite needs.

RGX-Framework is a modern, self-contained WoW addon framework for Retail,
WoW Forever (beta), Classic Era, TBC, Wrath/Titan, Cataclysm, and Mists. One shared dependency
provides events, timers, hooks, slash commands, minimap buttons, options panels,
database profiles, DataBroker, media, dropdowns, UI controls, and a visual design
system. It is not a player-facing addon; it loads silently and exposes an API.

Quick Start
Latest published release: v2.11.0

1. Declare the dependency:

2. Declare your addon — one call:

That is a complete addon: profile-aware saved settings, a tabbed options
panel with db-bound controls, a slash command, a minimap button, branded chat
output, and lifecycle work routed through scoped framework methods. The addon
object carries RegisterEvent, RegisterUnitEvent, RegisterMessage, After,
Every, Print, Warn, and Error, so consumers do not need raw WoW plumbing.

> Human on triggers remain frozen future contract forms. One-line controls
> ship in v2.7.15-beta.2; named every timers are implemented. Local
> options.columns work adds column flows, not the full declarative card/page model.
> Use scoped methods for events and other behavior that is not yet
> declarative.

3. À la carte — individual systems when you need them:

For module-dependent code, wrap in OnReady:

Core-only APIs (events, timers, hooks, slash commands) are available immediately — no OnReady needed.

What It Provides
| Category | Details |
|---|---|
| Lifecycle | OnReady, OnLogin, module readiness tracking |
| Events & Messages | Blizzard event registration + internal message bus + module-local emitters |
| Timers | After, Every, CancelTimer — native OnUpdate driver, no C_Timer |
| Hooks | Post-hooks via hooksecurefunc — safe for Blizzard UI functions |
| Slash Commands | RegisterSlashCommand — no raw SLASH_X boilerplate |
| Combat Queue | QueueForCombat, SafeShow, SafeHide, SafeSetPoint, and more |
| Fonts | 40 bundled + 4 WoW defaults (44 total), 10 blocked in unavailableFonts, grouped dropdowns, style objects |
| Colors | Named palette, class/quality/power colors, color math, wrapping, picker integration |
| Textures | Statusbar registry, LibSharedMedia import, dropdown controls |
| Dropdowns | Nested UIDropDownMenu with auto-width, inline buttons, dual-schema items |
| UI Controls | Slider, toggle, label, dropdown, color picker, section, preview, reset button |
| Options Panels | Tabbed settings windows registered with WoW Settings |
| Minimap | Circular-drag buttons with persistent angle, tooltip, show/hide |
| Design | Static brand palette (primary, accent, border, etc.) + visual building blocks |
| DataBroker | LibDataBroker-compatible proxy data sources |
| Sound | Level-up sound system with variant playback and SavedVar integration |

Module Reference
| Module | Global | RGX:Get*() | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Core | RGXFramework | — | Active |
| Fonts | RGXFonts | GetFonts() | Active |
| Colors | RGXColors | GetColors() | Active |
| Textures | RGXTextures | GetTextures() | Active |
| Dropdowns | RGXDropdowns | GetDropdowns() | Active |
| UI | RGXUI | GetUI() | Active |
| ColorPicker | RGXColorPicker | GetColorPicker() | Active |
| Minimap | RGXMinimap | GetMinimap() | Active |
| Design | RGXDesign | GetDesign() | Active |
| DataBroker | RGXDataBroker | GetDataBroker() | Active |
| Sound | RGXSound | GetSound() | Active |
| SharedMedia | RGXSharedMedia | GetSharedMedia() | Active |
| PetBattles | RGXPetBattles | GetPetBattles() | Active |
| Combat | RGXCombat | GetCombat() | Active |
| Reputation | RGXReputation | GetReputation() | Active |
| Achievement | RGXAchievement | GetAchievement() | Active |
| LevelUp | RGXLevelUp | GetLevelUp() | Active |
| Collectibles | RGXCollectibles | GetCollectibles() | Active |…

RGX-Framework v2.11.0
Package: RGX-Framework-v2.11.0.zip, 106 runtime files, plus release.json.
• New RGXTriggers module: a trigger state store for the trigger evaluation
engine (rgx-mod substrate). Trigger authors mutate clone-keyed state and the
engine diffs every field write — state.changed only flips when a value
actually changed or the clone is new, so consumers react to real changes
and identical writes cost nothing.
• Stale clones cannot survive: Sweep(keepIds) removes every clone the author
did not keep alive in one coalesced notification; Remove and Clear
cover the single-clone and all-clone cases.
• Guaranteed progress shapes: UpdateProgress applies the timed form
(duration/expirationTime/autoHide) or the static form
(value/total/inverse) with progressType on every state, and
switching forms clears the other form's fields in the same diff, giving
conditions and displays one stable shape to read.
• Change notifications (Triggers:OnChanged(id, fn)) are failure-isolated:
one handler error cannot break dispatch or other handlers.
• Design provenance: AddonLearner curated pass 5 (weakauras @ 37c3950c) —
the clone-keyed, engine-diffed state contract.
• Current public APIs and client Interfaces are unchanged. No SavedVariables
change is required.

Update RGX-Framework, then fully restart WoW.

RGX-Framework v2.10.0
Package: RGX-Framework-v2.10.0.zip, 105 runtime files, plus release.json.
Behavior changes
• CreateProfile on an existing name now returns false instead of wiping the profile, and RenameProfile refuses same-name and occupied targets. Previously a duplicate create silently reset the user's settings; these paths now fail loudly and safely. DeleteProfile on the active profile falls back to the protected Default profile deterministically.
• Declaring options without db (and without a table carrying its own db) now errors at registration instead of silently building no panel at ADDON_LOADED. The declarative contract documents options as db-bound; consumers now see the mistake immediately.
• Strict control-table validation on page/card layouts: unknown or empty control tables ({}, { toogle = "x" }), multi-kind controls, buttons without actions, and holes in control lists are rejected at declaration instead of silently rendering nothing.
• The C_AddOns global polyfill is removed. The framework no longer writes _G.C_AddOns on clients that lack it; every framework call site carries its own legacy fallback, so behavior is unchanged on every supported flavor, but co-loaded addons that test C_AddOns to detect the client no longer misdetect.
• RGX:QueueForCombat now returns false, "queued" when deferring so callers can distinguish a combat-deferred call from an immediate execution result; queued operations remain fire-and-forget at the flush.
• RGXReputation seeds first sightings silently: a faction seen for the first time (login, discovery, a Classic header expanding) no longer fires a spurious OnRankUp from zero or a phantom OnGain; gains fire only for real deltas, and duplicate faction names are tracked separately by faction ID.
Fixed
• A non-callback error inside event dispatch can no longer wedge the session: RGX:FireEvent restores _dispatchDepth on every exit path and reports the fault through the failure-isolated error channel instead of latching registrations pending forever. String-method owners that break after registration are isolated per handler.
• Profile serialization round-trips backslash paths: Interface\AddOns\BLU\sounds\levelup.ogg and every escape character survive export/import through a single-pass decoder (the old chained-gsub decode corrupted them). Table keys are escaped; the wire format is unchanged.
• Migration progress is durable: a failing migration step no longer re-runs earlier steps on every login.
• Unit-event dispatch snapshots its handler bucket like the plain-event path, so handlers registered mid-dispatch no longer run in the same dispatch.
• OnPlayerHealed passes the real overheal (payload index 16) instead of the absorbed amount, and the combat-log payload is captured exactly once per event instead of up to nine API calls.
• Light media rescans no longer wipe generic-scan bridge results; first currency gains of a session fire via the event's own quantityChange; quest progress suppressed by the 0.25s cooldown is delivered on the next update instead of being lost.
• The default slash handler prints actionable guidance instead of a literal v? placeholder.
• Slider snapping is relative to min, so sliders can reach their own minimum (min=1 step=2 now yields 1,3,5,7,9).
• The internal error log is bounded at 50 entries and drops the oldest reports.
• Dead code removed: the never-called reportEventRegistrationError and the never-true allFrameEventsRegistered flag; the superseded colorpicker SV-box/hue-bar builders (~168 lines) whose live counterparts already guarded dragging.
• Dispatch-side test coverage grew the events harness 74→120 checks and the login harness 32→123, plus new combat (13 checks) and reputation/loot/quest gameplay gates. A dev-only mutation-smoke tool measures test strength: events 69%, runtime 68% killed on full enumerations.
Tooling…

RGX-Framework v2.9.0 - 2026-10-19
• New declarative layout model: options tabs can contain page nodes that create
multi-page tabs. Each page uses grid = 1|2 to distribute cards across a
card grid, and each card uses columns = 1|2 for its internal control
flows. Cards and controls fill in declaration order and reuse the same
db-bound factories as plain tabs, so reopening a panel restores values and
displayed control state.
• The MCP generator accepts declarative pages and emits contract-congruent
page/card layouts; generated output is deterministic and parses as Lua 5.1.
• Layout declarations are validated before addon registration. Invalid grids,
columns, empty cards/controls, nested layouts, mixed page/control tabs, and
malformed control strings fail without registering the addon or creating a
panel.
• Existing options.columns control-list behavior is unchanged and cannot be
combined with page layouts.
• Current public APIs and client Interfaces are unchanged. No SavedVariables
deletion is required.

Update RGX-Framework, then fully restart WoW.
Package: RGX-Framework-v2.9.0.zip, 114 runtime files, plus release.json.

RGX-Framework v2.8.2 - 2026-10-19
• New declarative compat key resolves the first callable global API path on
the current client into addon.compat.(...). Bare path and ordered
fallback-list forms cover the common expansion-drift case; the advanced
prefer/fallback form adds an optional normalize function that receives
the raw return values. Declarations with no callable path fail before the
addon registers, so a wrong-API-for-expansion call site cannot reach runtime.
• The runtime package now ships the expanded AGENTS.md project entry point
for both installed-addon agents and source-tree agents. It replaces the
shorter AGENT-DIRECTIVE.md; the runtime file count is unchanged.
• Current public APIs and client Interfaces are unchanged. No SavedVariables
deletion is required.

Update RGX-Framework, then fully restart WoW.
Package: RGX-Framework-v2.8.2.zip, 114 runtime files, plus release.json.

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon for Classic Era and World of Warcraft: Forever:
letters from the people you helped.
• The letters. Finish a quest chain that changed someone's life, and
they write to you: Iverron from the cave you found him by, Maybell Maclure
after her secret visit to the river, Gryan Stoutmantle once VanCleef is
dead, Gazlowe, who still owes you. Each in their own voice, about what
happened and what came after.
• The mailbox. The letter spends a little while in the post, then waits
at the next mailbox you open, sealed, beside the game's mail window, a row each
as the game's inbox lists mail. Click one to break its seal, or open them
all at once.
• The book. Every letter you receive, kept: who wrote, from where, the
chain it answers. A few achievements along the way.

English and French. /yourstruly opens the book.

The game's data comes from wow-data:
the game clients' tables, Questie's
database and the cmangos Classic
database. The letters are original.

MIT licence.

releases.changelog:
Yours Truly 0.3.0
• The letters were revised in English and French, with a reworded welcome line ("A letter waits") and the minimap button's lines taken from the shared kit.
• French is finished, brought to the final English, with the client's spacing before : ? ! and percent signs.
• The interface is in English and French. German and Spanish stay English for now.

Yours Truly's first release on CurseForge and Wago (it has been on GitHub since 0.1.0).
• Your letters are listed the way the game lists mail: a row for each letter, a pager, open all, and back to the list.
• The letter window docks beside the mail window, on the mail window's stone and parchment, the same size, in the game's own text face.
• The game's own mail icon shows on the minimap while a letter waits.
• No more bundle: letters from chains you finished before installing arrive together at your first mailbox, a row each. Break the seals one by one or all at once.
• The welcome page says the minimap icon tells you a letter is coming.
• Laid out from the game's own mail window, for Classic and for Forever.
• French, German and Spanish read again.

Yours Truly 0.1.0

The first release.
• Letters from the people you helped. Finish a quest chain that changed someone's life and they write you a letter, in their own voice, about what happened and what came after. It waits for you, sealed, at the next mailbox you open.
• 69 letters on Classic Era and 73 on Forever to start with, the extra four from Zephras Isle. They are written in English and French, and translated into German and Spanish.
• A book for them all. Open the mailbox panel to read every letter you have received. If several are waiting, they come as one bundle, and the book keeps them in order.
• Classic Era and Forever in one download, a slash command, an options page, and achievements for the letters you collect. German and Spanish are first translations.

addons.description:
A WoW Forever addon. Open a mailbox, press the Mailworthy button, and
every bag item worth more on the auction house (after fees) or disenchanted
than at the vendor goes to your bank alt. The rest stays in your bags to vendor.
• Prices come from Auctionator (optional, recommended). Disenchant values of
green, blue and purple gear come from Siz DisenchantValue (optional; learned from your
own disenchants) or from the era disenchant tables priced with Auctionator, the same
number Disenchantry's tooltip shows; either addon installed switches the disenchant
comparison on. Without Auctionator, Mailworthy mails every unlocked, tradeable white
(common) item.
• Preview first: it shows the recipient, what goes and why, what stays and
why, and a Settings button to fix anything before you press Send.
• Keyboard/mouse first, controller too: everything works with keyboard and mouse, and with a gamepad alone.
• Lock items you never want mailed: Alt+click (mouse) or L3 in your bags (controller); the lock follows the item.
• Every bag counts: backpack, bags 1-4 (profession bags too) and the reagent bag.
Using it
• At a mailbox: click Mailworthy under the mail window (controller: Send Mail
tab with R1, then Triangle). The window shows who gets the mail, what goes and why,
what stays and why, and the total gain. Send mails it all in one press, 12 stacks
per mail. Pressing an item locks it, so it stays.
• Lock items you never want mailed: Alt+click (mouse), L3 in your bags (controller),
or press the item in the Mailworthy window. Locked items glow blue while a mailbox is
open (a setting keeps the glow on everywhere); away from one a new lock glows for a
moment so you see it took. Locks stay wherever the item moves.
• On your bank alt: bag slots carry AH / B / DE / V tags (list it, bank it for a
later phase, disenchant it, vendor it now) recomputed with that character's own prices;
tooltips show today's verdict and why the item was mailed; the Mailworthy button (or
/mw summary) sums it up.
• Bank alt on a second WoW account (played on another monitor): mail crosses accounts,
saved settings don't. On your main, type the alt's name under "Or type it" in /mw
(press Use name twice: Mailworthy hasn't seen that character). On the alt's account
install Auctionator and Mailworthy, run an Auctionator scan there, open /mw and press
This character is my bank alt: the tags, tooltips and summary come on. Each account
keeps its own price scans, and the "Mailed for" tooltip line stays on the sending account.
• No math needed: prices are the 3-day median of Auctionator's scans (one undercut
can't flip a verdict), half the deposit counts (the game refunds it on a sale), a flooded
market is valued at its floor, and the rule knows the realm's launch day: in launch week
unpriced white trade goods are mailed, before the first raids enchanting materials, herbs
and elementals are tagged B (bank them, they sell higher later), and later the
minimum gain grows with the gold supply. Details: docs/PLAN.md "Decision rule".
• After sending: your main's bags tag what's left for the vendor with V (grey
junk too) for the rest of the session. Lock an item to keep it and its V goes.
• Send a profession's materials to a friend (/mw friends, or the settings' "Send
materials to friends" button): pick a guild member, party member or one of your own
characters (online players first; their professions are shown and suggested), then the
profession. From then on everything that profession uses (dust, essences and shards for
an enchanter, cloth for a tailor, ...) is mailed to them, every time, for all your
characters on that realm and faction (or this character only). Each binding has a
price cap (default 5g each): a material the market suddenly wants goes to your bank
alt instead. The Mailworthy window lists the bindings with Skip once (this mailbox
visit only) and Remove. Locked items still stay. If the friend runs Mailworthy too,…

Full Changelog Previous Releases

feat: a bank alt on a second WoW account declares itself in settings
• feat: a bank alt on a second WoW account declares itself in settings
SavedVariables are per WoW account, so a main's bank alt pick never reaches
an alt played on another account: BankAlt.IsBankAlt() stayed false there and
the player had to flip "tags everywhere". The settings window now has a
"This character is my bank alt" button (mouse, and the controller through
Nav/PadKey; created at login). It writes the same bankAlts[realm|faction]
slot a pick uses (Config.SetBankAltHere / ClearBankAlt / IsBankAltHere), so
the account's other characters mail to it and the tags, tooltips and summary
come on; pressed again it clears the bank alt. The typed path still refuses
the character's own name and points at the button; the Mailworthy window
still refuses to mail to itself.
The bank alt view degrades cleanly on an account that never sent: no
"Mailed for" line without a record, a non-table record is ignored, the
summary stays correct. README documents the two-account setup; HANDOFF
records the decision (price scans and the mailed-for history stay per
account; nothing is carried in the mail body or subject).

ForeverTome 0.3.0
Expanded recording coverage and durable database exports, with consistent addon, exporter and installer versions.
Downloads and upgrading
• ForeverTomeSetup.exe: recommended Windows installer for exporter 0.3.0.
• ForeverTomeExporter-0.3.0-windows-x64.zip: portable Windows bundle, including the executable, instructions, license and version file.
• ForeverTomeExporter.exe: standalone Windows exporter.

A World of Warcraft addon. Download locations: CurseForge | Wago

Equip Recommended Gear (ERG) adds a button to your character pane that equips the highest item level gear for your class & spec. Inspired by the same feature available in Final Fantasy XIV Online.

Features
• Adds a button. When you click the button, it does the thing.
• Instead of the button, you can also set a keybind or use EquipRecommendedGear:DoTheThing(). Refer to the API.lua documentation for more information.

Limitations
• It will only consider soulbound items.
• It will only consider weapons suitable for your specialisation. (2-handed weapons for Survival Hunter, daggers for Assassination Rogues, etc.)
• It will only consider weapons with your primary stat (Agility, Intellect, Strength) on them.
• It will not check rings or trinkets for your primary stat.
• It will not check the secondary stats of any gear.
• It will not use weights of any kind. It just looks at the item level. Number go up, happy brain chemicals.
If you are experiencing issues
• Check if the issue occurs with only this addon enabled, or if the issue is a feature you can disable from the addon's settings menu.
• If you run into any issues or if you have other feedback, feel free to join the Discord and ask in the #equip-recommended-gear channel, or create a ticket on GitHub. :)

Slacker's Tweak Suite (STS) is a collection of QoL tweaks.

Features

Features marked with [F] are available on Forever; features marked with [R] are available on Retail.
• General
• [R&F] Adds your current realm name to the character panel.
• [R&F] Cursor Guide: Show a guide around the cursor to help you keep track of it.
• [R&F] Skip Seen Cinematics: Automatically skip before-seen cinematics.
• Inventory
• [R&F] Disable Always Compare: Disable the always compare items behavior.
• [R] Show WoW Token Price: Show the current WoW Token price on the WoW Token item tooltip.
• [R] Split Reagent Bag Count: Shows the free slots of your regular bags and your reagent bag separately on top of the backpack icon.
• Loot
• [R] Instant Catalyst: Hold Shift to instantly catalyze an item, skipping the 5 second timer.
• [R] Instant Great Vault: Hold Shift to instantly receive your reward from the Great Vault and skip the 5 second timer.
• [R] Hide Loot Roll Window: Hide the window that shows loot rolls and their results. You can show the window again with /loot.
• [R&F] Extended Merchant Frame: Allows configuring how many rows and columns of items are displayed on merchants, and adds a search filter.
• [R] Disable Merchant Filter: Automatically set all merchant filters to All to display items normally not shown to your class.
• [R&F] Disable Merchant Compare: Disable the automatic gear comparison on merchant items.

• [R] Play Queue Sound: Play the queue sound on the Master channel when any queue pops, including battlegrounds and pet battles.
• [R] Play Ready Check Sound: Play the ready check sound on the Master channel when a ready check is initiated.
• [R] Play Countdown Sound: Play the countdown sound on the Master channel when any countdown / pull timer is initiated.
• Addons
• [R] Disable HandyNotes Alt+RMB: Disable HandyNotes' keybind on the map, re-enabling it for TomTom waypoints instead.
• [R] AH Price Tooltip: Show the most recent pricing information from either Auctionator, Oribos Exchange, or TradeSkillMaster
• Holidays
• [R] [Hallow's End] No Trick: Sit down before completing a Candy Bucket quest, preventing getting tricked and pacified.
If you are experiencing issues

Fixes
• If the companion's self-update cannot swap the folders, it now gives up after 30 seconds and restarts your current version, instead of waiting two minutes and then starting by itself.
Notes
• This release is the first real test of the updater for anyone on 0.8.4: start the companion normally (Explorer or a shortcut) and accept the update prompt. It should close, restart on 0.8.5 and show these notes.
addons.description:
Find the most profitable crafting shuffle (any profession, with Disenchanting, AH resale or vendor exits) from your Auctionator auction house prices.
• addon/ShuffleDetector/ - WoW addon (requires Auctionator). Records profession skill, recipes (known and not yet learned, with reagents), item names and vendor prices to SavedVariables, and runs the shuffle tracker. It does no scanning of its own.
• companion/ - cross-platform Python app (CLI + PySide6 GUI) that reads those SavedVariables plus Auctionator's own price database (Auctionator.lua, in the same SavedVariables folder) and ranks shuffles for every profession (--profession, or the GUI profession box), with a per-step cost/yield breakdown and suggestions for recipes to acquire.
• common/ - shared data format doc and reference data (data/reference.json: items, vendor prices, recipes, disenchant yields). The bundled values are unverified seed data; recipes, item names and vendor prices recorded by the addon in game are layered over them (see ROADMAP.md).
• CLAUDE.md - working notes and handoff for AI assistants (environment quirks, rules, status).
Run from the source tree
The first run creates a per-machine virtualenv, .venv-, and installs the dependencies; it reinstalls when companion/pyproject.toml changes.
Run the companion (manual)
See ROADMAP.md for future considerations.
Addon install and updates
The GUI finds your WoW install(s) (or use Addon > Choose WoW folder..., or set WOW_PATH), shows the installed addon version, and installs or updates the bundled addon from the Addon menu. "Update addon automatically" (on by default) updates an outdated installed copy at startup. The .toc in the repo carries a @project-version@ placeholder; installing from a source checkout stamps it as dev-. Dev builds can't be ordered against releases, so a source install always replaces a different install, and a release bundle never replaces a dev install. SavedVariables are never touched. Close WoW first if an update fails.

To bundle the addon into a built package, run python companion/scripts/bundle_addon.py before building; from a repo checkout the app uses addon/ directly.

Copy addon/ShuffleDetector into Interface/AddOns. Open each profession window (and a vendor) once so the addon can record recipes and prices, then /reload or log out so the game writes them.

To have the addon look up names and vendor sell prices for every recipe item without you meeting them first, run shuffledetector --local-recipes --send-items (it writes the item ids to the addon's ItemList.lua), then /reload in game; the addon requests them in the background (/shuffledetector items repeats it). Vendor buy prices still come only from visiting a vendor.
Shuffle calculator
Recipes the character has not seen can also come straight from the game's own data files: shuffledetector --local-recipes (optionally --wow "C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft") reads reagents, products, trivial levels and craft times for every profession from your installed client, takes a few seconds, downloads nothing and stores nothing. Recipe skill requirements are not in the client, so those recipes show status "unknown" until a character has seen them.…

Changes
• Linux: the companion is now a Flatpak (ShuffleDetector-Companion-v0.8.3-linux.flatpak) instead of a tar.gz, so it no longer depends on your distribution's libraries. It can see your home folder, /mnt and /media; if WoW is installed elsewhere, see the README for the one-line flatpak override.

Notes
• Windows and macOS: this is the first release to try the companion's built-in updater. Start 0.8.2, accept the update prompt, and the app should close and reopen on 0.8.3 with these notes shown.

addons.description:
Priestly is a lightweight buff manager for priests, inspired by PallyPower. It tracks
Power Word: Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Shadow Protection across your party or raid and lets
you rebuff with a single click.

This is the World of Warcraft: Forever edition (client 1.60.1, Interface 16001).

> Buffy is the new consolidated version. It combines
> Priestly, Magely and Wildly in one addon on the same engine, and picks Priest, Mage or Druid
> buffs for the character you log in. It starts with fresh settings rather than importing
> Priestly's, so disable Priestly while you use it, or you get two buff windows.

Example from an earlier build; the current window has additional controls.

> Playing TBC Classic Anniversary? Install v1.0.6 — the last release for that client. It
> stays available on CurseForge and the CurseForge app will keep offering it for the Anniversary
> game version. The Anniversary line is no longer being developed.

Features
• One row per group, per buff — colour-coded by how many people are missing it, with the lowest
remaining timer on the bar.
• One-click buffing — left-click casts the group Prayer, right-click buffs the first person
missing it. No targeting.
• Works before you have the Prayers — while you only know the single-target spells, left-click
simply buffs whoever needs it. Nothing is wired to a spell you do not have.
• Per-member popover — mouse over a row for the full list with range indicators and per-person
click casting.
• Group-aware — follows party and raid changes, subgroups, and pets.
• Reagent tracking — shows the candles and Light Feathers needed by spells you know.
• Shadow Protection when it counts — always, only when someone in the group already has it, or
only inside instances you pick.
• Window controls — minimize without closing, lock its position, adjust opacity and choose
which side the member popover opens on.

Usage
If a member shows ?, note where it appears: beside the class icon it means the
spell's range is unknown; in place of a timer it means the buff cannot be read and
there is no cached observation. These are independent, and neither proves a language
problem. For a battleground report, include a screenshot showing the column, whether
you are in combat, whether it recovers afterwards, and the spell-name report at the
end of /priestly help (locale, game build, addon/library versions and resolved names).

The window opens on its own when you join a group.

Settings persist between sessions. Buff choices and window options are shared across your priests;
whether the window is open is saved per character. If you previously configured different priests
and want one character's older setup to become the shared setup, log into that character and use
/priestly adopt.

Use - in the header to minimize to a small header, and + to restore the
buff rows. This keeps the window accessible; X still closes it. Minimize and
restore wait until combat ends. The choice lasts for the current session and
resets to expanded on /reload or login. Dragging, locking and resetting the
window work in either mode outside combat.

Row colours: green = everyone has it · yellow = some missing · red = nobody has it ·
grey ? = buff state cannot be read right now (the client hides aura data during combat; Priestly
keeps counting down from the last reading instead of guessing).

Changelog
All notable changes to Simple Arsenal Swap will be documented here.
Unreleased0.2.1 - 2026-10-20Added
• A Show swap notifications checkbox in /sas to turn swap-success text on
or off. It is enabled by default and saved per character.
0.2.0 - 2026-09-19Added
• Support Forever beta 1.60.1 (69913) support with a Camelot TOC (interface 16001)
and namespaced C_Item APIs with legacy fallbacks. Live testing was confirmed
by the maintainer on 2026-09-19.
• Regression coverage for modern and legacy APIs, item-cache misses, combat
lockdown, overlapping arsenals, hotkey failures, capture, and status messages.
Fixed
• Keep cursor item capture from writing to the global underscore variable.
• Display correctly formatted custom arsenal names in /sas status.
• Release hotkey capture and pending replacement confirmation when combat starts,
and release arsenal-name keyboard focus before capturing a hotkey.
• Prefer an explicit off-hand match over an overlapping main-hand-only arsenal.
• Follow the game's current key-down/key-up setting through the secure template.
• Preserve existing bindings when assigning a new hotkey fails and restore session
bindings if removing an old hotkey fails; save only a successful replacement.
• Guard the direct equipment API against combat lockdown as well as its caller.
0.1.2 - 2026-08-11Added
• Allow middle and extra mouse buttons, the mouse wheel, and keyboard-modified
mouse clicks anywhere on the screen as the swap hotkey while excluding primary
left and right clicks.
0.1.1 - 2026-08-11Fixed
• Use a dedicated 256px TGA icon in the in-game AddOns list.
0.1.0 - 2026-08-02Added
• Initial stable project structure for Classic Era/Hardcore and TBC Classic.
• Two configurable main-hand/off-hand arsenals with drag-and-drop item capture.
• Two-handed weapon handling that clears and disables the matching off hand.
• One configurable WoW keybinding backed by a hidden secure action button.
• Out-of-combat state-aware A/B switching and a precomputed Classic combat macro path.
• Compact movable settings window and /sas commands.
• Lua 5.1, database, macro-generation, and TOC validation tests.
• Double-click Windows deployment tool using the existing ssh minipc workflow.
• Shared Windows deployment launcher that validates and updates Simple Scrolling Loot,
Better Loot Rolls, and Simple Arsenal Swap in one run.
• Close the Windows deployment window automatically on success and keep it open on failure.
• Custom Simple Arsenal Swap logo as the in-game addon icon.
• Confirmation dialog before replacing a hotkey already used by another action.
• On-screen confirmation after the requested arsenal is successfully equipped.
• Large 32px swap confirmation near the scrolling combat-text area.
• Optional custom names for Arsenal A and B, also used in status and swap-success messages.

addons.changelog:
🚀 v3.2.7🎨 New Look (All Versions)
• A cleaner window in your class color: text tabs along the top, colored section titles, slimmer stat bars, and your profile and total score at the bottom.
🔀 Off-Specs (All Versions)
• Off-Specs (was Secondary Specs & Baselines): tick the profiles a character also plays and tooltips show an (off-spec) upgrade line for each, judged against the best gear you own for it (worn, bags and bank). Saved per character.
• Dual Specialization now works on Season of Discovery and TBC Anniversary too.
🔌 API for Other Addons
• Loot council and loot distribution addons can ask Gear Judge how much an item upgrades each player (see API.md). Turn it off with Share Scores With Group Addons.
📊 Leveling and Farming Weights Rebuilt (WoW Forever)
• Every class reviewed one by one: leveling weights rebuilt from our updated models and the new Talents builds, with many class fixes (talents counted twice, missing or renamed talents, leveling names matching the Talents builds).
• Mage solo weights assume single-target play; AoE leveling has its own, with Intellect and Stamina first.
• New leveling weights: Arcane solo, Elemental dungeon and Balance dungeon.
• Level-60 farming weights rebuilt, with new ones for Arms, Retribution, Elemental and Balance farming.
• From level 50 leveling weights blend smoothly into your level-60 profile.
• Spell hit caps are 1% higher (Forever seems to drop the 1% minimum miss).
• Ranged weapons no longer score like melee weapons for Warriors and Rogues at 60, and the stats panel shows the new Human and Orc racials.
• Rogue leveling weights value Agility fully again (it was missing the Attack Power it gives).
⚔️ Raid Weights Rebuilt (WoW Forever)
• Every level-60 raid profile rebuilt in the simulator on pre-raid best-in-slot gear with the new Talents raid builds: damage dealers, healers and tanks.
• Hit is worth its full value up to the cap and little past it.
• Hunter profiles follow a better ranged rotation, and Bear armor now counts at its real value.
• Old hand-made profiles retired (Default, the hybrids and placeholder profiles): a saved choice now uses the matching simulator profile, and they're gone from the profile lists.
🐛 Bug Fixes (all versions)
• Quest rewards no longer lose their Equip: stats when the quest window opens before the game has loaded that text.
• Upgrade arrows now show in the bank too: the default bank and ElvUI's bank.
• Stat Logic and tooltips name off-hand weapon DPS properly ("Off-Hand Weapon DPS" instead of "Msc weapon dps oh").
addons.description:
Sharpie's Gear Judge (Classic Era, TBC Anniversary & WoW Forever)
The Final Verdict on your gear.

Sharpie's Gear Judge (SGJ) is a real-time theorycrafting engine and UI enhancement for World of Warcraft: Classic Era, the TBC Anniversary Edition, and the WoW: Forever beta.

Unlike addons that give items static points (e.g. "Hit = 10 pts"), SGJ understands context. It knows if you are hit-capped, if a helm swap will break your Meta Gem, whether a quest reward beats what you're wearing, and in TBC it can project the best gems and enchants for an item before you equip it.

🔥 What's New3.2.7
• New look: a cleaner window in your class color, with tabs along the top, colored section titles, slimmer stat bars, and your profile and total score at the bottom. The plugins match it.
• Off-Specs: tick the profiles a character also plays and tooltips show when an item upgrades them, against the best gear you own (bags and bank included).
• Dual Specialization on Season of Discovery and TBC Anniversary.
• Leveling and farming weights rebuilt (WoW Forever) class by class, blending into your level-60 profile from 50.
• Raid weights rebuilt (WoW Forever) in the simulator for every spec on pre-raid best-in-slot gear (Experimental until tried at 60).
• Loot council addons can ask Gear Judge how much an item upgrades each player.

🚀 Key Features⚔️ Built for WoW Forever
• Level-60 weights for every class, worked out with each build's own talents: damage and tank profiles from the wowsims Forever simulator, healer profiles from a healing model in which healers downrank as they do in game.
• Profiles that match how you play: Raid, Solo Leveling, Dungeon Leveling, AoE Farming and PvP, named after the builds in the Talents plugin (for example "Arms: Raid", "Holy: Dungeon Leveling").
• Leveling weights level by level for every Forever spec, from 10 to 59, built from the talents, spells and gear stats each spec actually has at that level. Your actual talents adjust them.
• Hit and defense targets follow your level. While leveling that's 5% hit (3% spell hit) against same-level mobs. With Gear for Raiding on, the targets slide toward the raid caps (9% hit, 16% spell hit, 440 Defense, uncrushable) from level 50.
• Gear for PvP: Stamina, armor and burst count for more, and hit stays at the player-vs-player caps. The first time a realm looks like a PvP realm, Gear Judge offers to turn it on.
• Relics are rated, and new race/class combinations are supported.
🧠 Dynamic "Cap Guardian" Engine
The Judge watches your stats in real time and penalizes gear that would drop you below a critical threshold.

1. Weight scalers (proactive): hit and defense weights shrink as you approach your caps, so every item is scored with your current needs in mind.
2. Cap Guardian (reactive): if you're at or above a cap and a swap would drop you below it, the item gets a score penalty and a tooltip warning.
• Tank defense: 490 at 70 on TBC, 440 at 60 on Era, and on Forever a slide to 440 from level 50 (with Gear for Raiding on). Only applies when your profile weights defense.
• Judged without buffs: caps and thresholds read your gear and talents, not the food, elixirs or party buffs you happen to have on.
• Buff Assumptions (all versions): turn on Assume Raid Buffed or Assume World Buffed to credit the buffs you'd have in a group, raid or with world buffs.
• Hybrid live preview: tooltips answer "if I swap this piece, where does my hit land?" without you equipping it.
🔮 Smart Projection (SimC-Lite)
• Gem simulator (TBC): three strategies — The Skeptic (empty sockets = 0), The Casual (respect socket colors), The Pro (min-max, off-color gems included).
• Gem quality tier (TBC): project sockets with Common, Uncommon, Rare or Epic gems.
• Enchant projector: compare items as if they had the best enchant for your level and spec. Your worn item shows which enchant that is.
• Meta gem enforcement (TBC): detects when a swap would turn off your Meta Gem.…

• Stat Logic and tooltips name off-hand weapon DPS properly ("Off-Hand Weapon DPS" instead of "Msc weapon dps oh").

🚀 v3.2.6🎒 Bag Arrows in DaylightUI (WoW Forever)
• The upgrade and downgrade arrows now show on items in DaylightUI's bag and bank window (bottom-left corner, since DaylightUI uses the other three). They follow the Show Bag Arrows setting and update when you change gear, level up or change talents.
🥤 Dungeons, Raid Healers and Farming: Forever's Food and Drink (WoW Forever)
• Food and drink restore a fixed amount per second by level in Forever. The solo leveling weights already used that; now the dungeon weights, the raid healer weights and the farming weights do too (they still drank 3.75% of your mana a second, which is 30-45% too fast at levels 20-50).
• Raid healers: Spirit counts much more (Holy Paladin about 1.3, was 0.5; Restoration Shaman 2.1, was 0.84; Discipline Priest 3.0, was 1.5; Restoration Druid 3.2, was 1.9). Holy Priest mana per 5 seconds about 2.8 (was 4.9), Restoration Druid Intellect about 0.9 (was 1.3).
• Dungeon healers (all four): Spirit, Intellect and mana per 5 seconds re-balanced the same way; Discipline / Holy Priest Intellect counts more, Holy Paladin Intellect less.
• Protection Paladin AoE farming: survival stats count 15-20% less and damage stats 15-25% more against Spell Power.
• Dungeon trash has 3 times an ordinary mob's health (measured in Forever; was 2.5), so trash fights last about 34 seconds, as logged. Dungeon tank and healer weights move a little.
• Protection Paladin dungeon tank: Intellect counts more at 35-45 (up to about 2.4, was 0.6): Holy Shield from 40 costs mana every 10 seconds.
🗡️ Weapons and Trinkets Against One Creature Type (all versions)
• Bonuses like "+81 Attack Power when fighting Undead" or "+9 Attack Power Vs Humanoids" now count at the share of the mobs you actually fight while leveling, from the Classic world's hostile mobs weighted by spawns (was a rough guess of Humanoids 35%, Beasts 30%, Undead 15%). Below level 50, Beasts and Humanoids are about 45% and 42% and Undead only 3%; from 50 (Plaguelands, Burning Steppes, Felwood) Undead rise to 17% and Demons and Elementals to 6% each. Undead-slaying gear counts much less while leveling below 50.
🩹 Hotfixes of October 16-20 (WoW Forever)
• Mage: Elemental Precision now counts 2% spell hit a rank (3 ranks, was 1% x 5) toward your hit cap; Piercing Ice, removed from the game, no longer adds Frost damage in the leveling weights (Frost levels about 4% slower in our model).
• Paladin: Champion of the Light is back to 20/40/60% of Intellect as spell damage, so Intellect counts twice as much again for Retribution Paladins with it.
• Priest: Holy Fire rank 1 deals a little less damage (53-65); the effect on the weights is negligible.
• Mage: Ice Barrier absorbs 10% more (Frost Warding adds 10% a rank) and gives 3% Frost damage for a minute, 6% while the shield holds. Solo it about pays for its mana, so leveling barely moves; Stamina counts a little less for Frost from 40, since the barrier soaks more.
• Warlock (PvP): Amplify Curse makes your next Curse of Exhaustion 20% stronger (was 50%).
📚 Spell Values Checked Against the Game Files (WoW Forever)
• Every spell table in our leveling models was checked rank by rank against the current game files. What changed:
• Mage: Frostbolt, Fireball, Ice Lance, Cone of Cold, Fire Blast, Arcane Explosion and Flamestrike ranks now grow for a few levels after you learn them, as in the game, and are no longer counted 10% above their real damage (a few ranks also had older values). Mages level about 5% slower than we had; Spirit and mana per 5 seconds count about 10-15% less, Fire's Stamina more from 45.
• Enhancement Shaman: Lightning Bolt now has WoW Forever's values (well below Classic's from rank 4), and Windfury Weapon's attack power grows for the eight levels after each rank (about +46 at 30 to +104 at 38), as in the game. The Shaman tank's Earth Shock, Flame Shock, Lightning Shield and Magma Totem values were corrected too.…

🚀 v3.2.5📏 Leveling Weights From the Game's Own Ability Data (WoW Forever)
• The leveling models behind the stat weights now take every ability's cooldown, duration, cast time and cost from the Forever client. Druid, Hunter, Mage and Shaman leveling weights are rebuilt where something didn't match:
• Mage: a frozen Frostbolt was charged the mana of your main spell, so Fire and Arcane valued Intellect and mana regeneration up to about 20% too high; those come down.
• Druid: Cat and Bear Form cost 55% of base mana (we had 30-35%); Feral Hit and Crit come down about 8%.
• Hunter (Sniper Shot's 4-second cast, Aimed Shot's 2 seconds, no Aspect of the Cheetah before 20) and Shaman (Rage of the Farseer on a 3-minute cooldown) move by 1% or less.

🚀 v3.2.4🐞 Fixed: Lua Error on Login (Secret Auras)
• Logging in could show "GetAuraDataByIndex(): Auras cannot be accessed when secret while tainted by 'SharpiesGearJudge'". While your buffs are still locked by the game, Gear Judge now skips them for that update instead of erroring, and the Totem of Wrath check uses the same safe read. Thanks to dasper for the fix (pull request #21).
🎯 More Item Effects Scored (all versions)
• Damage procs now count. "Chance on hit" effects that deal damage (a Shadow bolt, a Fire blast, a poison or bleed over time), damage dealt to attackers when you're struck, and extra damage on every melee swing were scored as 0 unless the item had a hand-made entry, which only 4 of about 160 such WoW Forever items had. They're now scored as an estimate: the average damage of one trigger, at 1 trigger a minute for "Chance on hit", one hit taken every 3 seconds for "When struck" and one swing every 2.5 seconds for "attacks deal", turned into Attack Power at 14 Attack Power per 1 damage per second (Ranged Attack Power on a ranged weapon). Damage that also hurts you ("to both you and your target") counts half. Casters, whose profiles give Attack Power no weight, still see melee procs as worthless. The tooltip says how much Attack Power the proc counted as. Items with a hand-made entry keep it.
• For example, "Chance on hit: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy causing 105 to 175 Shadow damage" counts as about 33 Attack Power.
• Heal, shield, mana, slow, stun and armor-reduction procs are still not scored, and the tooltip still says so.
• Bonuses against one creature type count. "+9 Attack Power Vs Humanoids", "+81 Attack Power when fighting Undead", "+3 Spell Damage Vs Undead" and "damage done to Undead by magical spells" scored 0. They now count at the share of leveling mobs of that type: Humanoids 35%, Beasts 30%, Undead 15%, Demons and Elementals 5%, Mechanical, Dragonkin and Giants 3%.
• Fixed: set bonus lines read as the item's own procs. "(4) Set: Chance on…" lines were read as a proc of the item, so every piece of a set with a proc bonus said "Proc not yet modeled" although the set bonus is scored from the set tables.
• Fixed: "+3 Daggers Skill" (WoW Forever) and the other weapon skill lines in that form weren't read at all. They now count, at 2.5 Weapon Skill Rating per skill point like Forever's other weapon skill bonuses.
• New WoW Forever item sets get their bonuses (WoW Forever). The set tables are regenerated from the current client (build 1.60.1.70425). Violet Sorcerer's Vestments, Krol'dok Battlegear and Defias Enforcer's Garb had no set bonuses scored; they now do. The client moved "+X Armor" set bonuses to a new effect type in this build, which the generator now reads, so armor bonuses keep counting.
⚔️ Weapon Racials Removed (WoW Forever)
• The 2026-10-15 beta patch removed Forever's weapon racials, so Gear Judge no longer scores them. Human Sword Specialization, Orc Axe Specialization and Dwarf Mace Specialization gave extra crit with that weapon type, which made swords, axes and maces score higher for those races. Their replacements don't depend on your weapon: Human Ruthless (+2% crit), Orc Savage (+1% crit) and Dwarf Earth Fury (+2% critical damage and healing). Weapons now score the same for every race, and weapon swaps no longer list a racial under Gains or Losses.
🌍 Fixed: Talent-Based Weights in Other Languages (WoW Forever and Classic Era)
• Talent adjustments now work on non-English clients. Gear Judge reads your talents to adjust the weights (for example Ice Shards raising Crit, Natural Instinct, Summon Hawk, Bloodthirst) and to pick your leveling profile. On Forever and Classic Era it compared the English talent names with the names your game reports, so in German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Korean and Chinese none of those adjustments applied. Talent names now use the game's own name in every language (Burning Crusade already did).…

🚀 v3.2.3⚖️ Leftover Profiles Fixed (WoW Forever)
• Druid Healers: The old Healer: Moonglow and Healer: Regrowth (Crit) profiles now use the Restoration: Raid healing model. They were never modelled and counted Spell Power twice (an item's Spell Power already heals at the Healing weight).
• Hybrid: Heart of the Wild and Priest Default: Spell Power no longer counts twice; it now scores at the Healing weight like on the other healer profiles.
• Mage and Warlock Default: The fallback profile now uses the Frost: Raid (Mage) and Affliction: Raid (Warlock) weights. The old table valued Hit and Crit at about a tenth of what the simulator gives.
• Paladin Protection: Raid: Re-simulated with Reckoning working as beta testers found it: each proc is an instant free swing that leaves your swing timer alone (the simulator used to pull your next swing forward instead). Block chance is worth about a fifth more and Hit about an eighth more; the rest barely moves.
• Shaman Enhancement: Raid: Re-simulated for the new Enhancement 33 / Restoration 16 / Elemental 2 build (Talents plugin). Mana Tide Totem and Mindfulness ease the mana shortage, so Mp5 is worth less than half what it was and spell hit and crit count for less; melee Crit counts a little more. Tidal Focus already gives 5% hit, so Hit is valued as it is below the raid cap and the hit cap logic takes it down once you reach it.
• Druid Bear: Raid: Re-simulated for the new Bear: Raid talents (Talents plugin), with Heart of the Wild's extra Stamina now counted in the health part of the tank score. Defense and Dodge count a little more; the rest moves by 2% or less.
🩸 Warlock Leveling With Drain Life (WoW Forever)
• Affliction: Solo Leveling now assumes Drain Life fills each fight once you have Fel Concentration (level 20 in the Talents plugin's build), instead of the wand. Forever's Drain Life deals its damage and heals you for the same amount, so it is both a damage spell and most of your healing. The old weights treated it as a heal only.
• Wand DPS counts for a quarter of what it did from level 20 (about 10-14 instead of 38-56). Below 20 nothing changes.
• Crit counts 10-27% more (Drain Life can crit, the wand couldn't) and Hit 25-45% less next to Spell Power, since Drain Life grows with Spell Power. The hit cap logic still applies.
• Stamina, Health and Hp5 count half as much: the drain heals back most of what Life Tap and stray hits cost, so you rarely stop to eat.
• Affliction: Dungeon Leveling is unchanged (Shadow Bolt fills there).

addons.description:
A small addon for World of Warcraft: Forever that makes lootable things sparkle, so you never walk past them.
• Quest items always show the game's loot sparkle, even after a graphics preset turns it off.
• Herbs and ore veins sparkle as you approach them, which the game can't do on its own.
• Gathering icons float above the node you're heading for.
• Everything is optional, under Esc > Options > AddOns. No slash commands, nothing to set up.
Quest item sparkles
The game only shows the sparkle on quest items while the outline mode is off. Graphics presets switch the outline back on, so the addon sets the needed console variables at login, and again about a second after any graphics change resets them. During combat it waits until the fight is over.
Herb and ore sparkles
The game has no sparkle for ore veins and herbs, so the addon adds its own. As you approach a node, a small cluster of golden glints twinkles over it, and the game's gathering icon appears above it.
• Out of reach: the glints are dim.
• In reach: they brighten with a short burst, so you know you can gather now.
• Can't gather: they turn grey, for example when your skill is too low.

This uses Blizzard's soft targeting, which picks the nearest interactable object around you, up to about 15 yards away. Only one node sparkles at a time: the one the game would interact with. Quest objects can get the same treatment, but that is off by default, since the loot sparkle above already marks most of them.

The addon only switches on the game's name and icon for nodes that sparkle. NPCs, mailboxes and other objects still work with the interact key as usual. During combat nodes don't sparkle; they come back as soon as the fight is over.
Corpse sparkles
The game's loot sparkle leaves some corpses out, bosses among them. Once the fight is over, a corpse that still holds loot for you gets the same golden glints as you approach it. The game doesn't let addons say what is in a corpse before it is opened, so the glints only say "there is loot left", not what it is.
Options
Open Esc > Options > AddOns > Forever Loot Sparkles.

| Checkbox | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Show quest item sparkles | on | Keeps the outline mode off and the loot sparkle on. |
| Ore veins | on | Sparkles and icon on mining nodes. |
| Herbs | on | Sparkles and icon on herbs. |
| Quest objects | off | Extra sparkles on quest objects nearby. |
| Corpses with loot | on | Sparkles on corpses that still hold loot for you, after the fight. |

The four bottom checkboxes take effect at once. Show quest item sparkles works at once when you switch it on, but switching it off only takes effect after restarting the game (/reload is not enough). The panel shows a reminder.

addons.description:
Alts is a World of Warcraft addon that allows you to setup main-alt relationships and have that information displayed in various areas. It uses the LibAlts library to share data with other addons. For a list of other addons using LibAlts, see here.
Bugs/Enhancements
You can submit tickets here: https://www.wowace.com/projects/alts/issues
Features
Main/Alt information is displayed:
• When that character logs on
• When you do a /who on that character
• In unit tooltips
• From a command line interface
• From a GUI interface

Main/Alt information can be set and managed:
• By right-clicking on a unit frame
• From a command line interface
• From a GUI interface
• LDB launcher to bring up the GUI interface
• Minimap button to bring up the GUI interface

Command line options:

alts - Brings up the main window. If search term is provided, it will use it to search the main-alt data.
setmain - Adds the specified alt as an alt of the specified main.
delalt - Deletes the specified alt for the specified main.
getalts - Gets the list of alts for the specified main.
getmain - Gets the main for the specified alt.
Automated Guild Import
Alts will automatically scan the guild notes for a character who is in a guild. It the notes are in a certain format it will then store the main/alt information into a separate area from the main-alt data that a user enters. Every time the player logs onto a character in that guild, the guild main/alt data will be updated. This information is kept separate from main/alt data a user enters so it can be easily sync'd.

The following guild note formats work:
• [main name]'s alt
• Alt of [main name]
• ALT: [main name]
• AKA: [main name]
• ([main name]) Must be at the start of the note though.
• [[main name]] Must be at the start of the note though.
• [main name] alt
• [main name]
• ALT([main name])

The matching is not case sensitive. If a note with one of those formats is found and the main name is in the guild, then it will create a main/alt link.

The guild imported data and user-entered data are merged automatically when displayed or searched. The guild imported data cannot be modified from the user interface. The UI ignores edits to that data since all changes are performed only on user-entered data.
Guild Export
You can now export your guild roster in a comma-separated format (CSV). You can find this feature in the options under Guild.
• Fields to Export: You can choose which fields to export. The fields are in the order of the checkboxes on the export screen. The Alts field will add a field that lists all the alts for the character.
• Escape?: You can choose if the appropriate fields are escaped using double quotes. If some of the fields such as the notes have commas then you may want to try this option.
• Only Mains: This option will export all character in the roster who are not marked as an alt.
• Only Guild Alts: This option controls if the Alt field lists all alts you have defined or only alts defined by the guild notes. If you have setup alt relationships outside the guild notes and do not want them in the export, leave it checked. If you want all alts listed then uncheck it.

After you click Export, you can use Ctrl-A then Ctrl-C to copy the data in the export box to the clipboard. If you're using a Mac, use Command-A then Command-C. From the clipboard, you can paste the exported data into the target application.
Guild Log
Alts now takes a snapshot of your guild at logon and will report any changes at each logon. You can also bring up the log manually in the options menu under Guild. It does not monitor the guild roster while you are playing so it should not affect performance.
Friend/Ignore Logging…

ForeverNet 1.1.1English — changes since 1.1.0
• Hold Shift while hovering equipment to compare it with currently equipped items, including native stat differences and paired-slot comparisons. Pressing or releasing Shift updates the comparison without moving the mouse.
• Restored Requests as a permanent sidebar tab for direct access from every page.
• Added native WoW item tooltips: armor, stats, effects and requirements now appear when hovering an item. Planning quantities, bank counts and price hints remain below the description.
• Tooltips cover recipes, network cards, sidebar items, selected items, production chains and reagents, queue materials/crafts, market, tracker and auction results. Uncached items show a loading message and refresh when data arrives; reused and hidden cards clear stale tooltips.
• Restored recipe chat-link buttons beside recipe names in the native profession window. Click to insert the recipe link into a chat draft, then press Enter to send. With ForeverLink enabled, its existing button is used without a duplicate.
• Auction results now use compact rows with item icons and individual hover targets. Both Modern and Classic appearances and all 12 interface languages are supported.
• Expanded diagnostics for intermittent bag item-use blocks: bank scan stages, open windows, combat state and available native security attribution are recorded. /fn taint status shows the current logging level; detailed bank tracing runs only after enabling diagnostics.

Known issue: the intermittent block when using an item from a bag remains under investigation. This update improves diagnostics; a fix is not confirmed.

Descriptions use base item IDs from the catalog, without a particular inventory copy's enchantments or random variants. Saved recipes, bank snapshots, favorites and queue data are retained.
Русский — изменения после 1.1.0
• Удерживайте Shift при наведении на экипировку для сравнения с надетыми вещами: штатная разница характеристик и сравнение парных слотов. Нажатие и отпускание Shift обновляют подсказки без движения мыши.
• Вкладка «Запросы» снова постоянно отображается в боковой панели и открывается напрямую с любой страницы.
• Добавлены штатные подсказки предметов WoW: при наведении видны броня, характеристики, эффекты и требования. Количества для плана, запасы банка и подсказки о цене остаются ниже описания.
• Подсказки работают в рецептах, карточках сети, списках слева, выбранном предмете, цепочках и реагентах, материалах и крафтах очереди, рынке, трекере и результатах аукциона. Для незагруженных предметов показывается сообщение о загрузке с последующим обновлением; скрытые и повторно используемые карточки очищают старую подсказку.
• Возвращены кнопки ссылки на рецепт рядом с названиями в штатном окне профессии. Нажмите кнопку для вставки ссылки в черновик чата, затем Enter для отправки. При включённом ForeverLink используется его кнопка без дубля.
• Результаты аукциона представлены компактными строками с иконками и отдельной областью наведения. Поддерживаются обе темы и все 12 языков интерфейса.
• Расширена диагностика редкой блокировки предметов из сумки: сохраняются этапы сканирования банка, открытые окна, состояние боя и доступные сведения об источнике taint. /fn taint status показывает текущий уровень журнала; подробная запись этапов банка работает после включения диагностики.

Известная проблема: редкая блокировка использования предметов из сумки ещё исследуется. Улучшена диагностика; исправление не подтверждено.

Описание относится к базовому ID из каталога; чары и случайные варианты конкретного экземпляра из сумки не отображаются. Сохранённые рецепты, снимки банка, избранное и очередь сохраняются.

English · Русский
English
1.1.1 Release · Forever 1.60.1 (70124), Interface 16001

Download · Support Andrew Woolfi

ForeverNet connects your profession recipes with crafters in your guild or home group. Build a plan for one item or a shared queue, account for carried materials and your saved personal bank, and request help for missing components.
Features
Changes since 1.0.0

Changes in 1.1.1: native item descriptions and Shift equipment comparison on hover, with planning hints below; restored recipe chat-link buttons in the native profession list.
• Character overview with professions, rank/max skill and progress only in the left sidebar; queue/network state and saved-bank status on the right. Profession rows open filtered recipes.
• Recipe catalog grouped by profession, search and combined filters. One item row retains all known recipe/crafter variants; your character never appears as a duplicate network member.
• Other players' profiles grouped by profession. Favorite up to 5 profiles, 5 recipe items and 5 independent market-watch items; favorites appear first and are saved between sessions.
• Production chains with quantities, batch surplus and shared stock. Choose to obtain an intermediate material separately, craft it with a known recipe or restore automatic source selection.
• Per-character queue of up to 50 goals, editing/reordering and a movable material tracker. Save up to 10 goal sets, preview before loading, and undo the last successful load or cleanup.
• Maintained stock targets recalculate after use. Goals, sets and source choices persist; finished stock may remain in the saved bank.
• Native profession panel with finished-item quantity, Add to queue, Materials and Find a crafter. Crafter search also supports unlearned recipes with a supported item output; it does not send messages or add them to your own profile.
• ForeverNet auction-house tab for targeted material scans, observed unit/shortage prices, market volume and daily price history with 30/90-day views. Auction buttons open native name search; buying remains manual.
• Source comparisons recalculate additional purchases for the entire plan, including shared stock and batch surplus. Automatic source selection uses eligible known purchase costs while preserving explicit choices; unknown/stale prices, volume gaps and unknown crafting fees do not drive it. This is a bounded comparison, not a global economic optimizer.
• Private snapshots of purchased personal-bank tabs. Carried/bank quantities remain visible; unavailable tabs retain their last snapshot. Account/guild banks are excluded.
• Guild/home-group requests and offers, manual Sync and optional automatic refresh every 1/2/5 minutes. Queued profiles are coalesced; short interruptions preserve progress and send-rate limits retain queued messages with automatic retry.
• Switch Modern / Classic in Settings. Modern uses flat dark surfaces, bundled Sans typography and compact icon navigation; Classic restores native portrait borders, red buttons, side-tab art and game fonts. The saved choice applies immediately. Translated buttons wrap with measured height and surrounding spacing. The queue shows goals once on the left and shared material cards or crafting order on the right; selected-goal quantity autosaves. Sets/cleanup/undo live in one scrolling menu, and material cards open source comparisons. Native scrollbars remain. All 12 WoW locale codes, a language selector and bundled CJK fonts for Korean and Chinese even on a different client locale.

Recipe chat-link buttons have been extracted from ForeverNet. They belong to the separately prepared ForeverLink, which is not included in this repository or release. Blizzard's existing profession-share control remains available.
Getting started
1. Extract the release ZIP into Interface/AddOns, so the file is Interface/AddOns/ForeverNet/ForeverNet.toc. Enable the addon and restart the client after first installing its fonts.…

• Professions on the character page are shown only in the left sidebar, with rank/max skill, recipe counts, progress and scan-age tooltips. The right side shows queue, network and saved-bank state.
• Translated button labels wrap with measured height; headers, filters, language-menu rows and queue-set dialogs adapt their spacing.
• Commands replaces Example. The demo command, synthetic sample profiles and special sample inventory have been removed. Help retains the short walkthrough.
Automation and market
• Automatically scan your own learned recipes when opening/updating a profession. Reads current native filters and merges without deleting previously saved recipes; can be disabled in Settings.
• Automatically compare known ways to obtain intermediate materials and choose a lower known purchase cost. Only fresh, complete, sufficiently stocked and otherwise eligible estimates drive selection; explicit choices and pinned crafters remain in control. The bounded comparison is not a global economic optimizer.
• Open production plans recalculate after inventory, bank, profile, price or valid target-quantity changes while retaining manual choices and scroll position.
• Independent market favorites: up to five watched items in a top sidebar group, retained even without price history. Empty-deficit auction scans include recipe bookmarks and market watch items.
• The ForeverNet auction tab reserves the native bottom balance strip in both themes so content does not cover the money display.
Version notifications
• Built-in version announcements through guild/group addon messages, with short delayed replies, coalescing and bounded retries. Sends only the installed version and works independently of profession-profile sharing.
• A higher version reported by another player is saved and reminded on the next login, once per session. Normal startup prints the installed version; notices can be muted in the updates window.
• Uses player reports, not a live GitHub/CurseForge query. No external helper, special launch shortcut or background service is required.
Validation and compatibility
• 52 Lua 5.1 test groups: transport, stock/plans, automation, 12 locales, both themes, larger translated buttons, version announcements/cache/retries and auction wallet spacing.
• Five refreshed Modern UI images with the game’s screenshot-saved overlay removed. Captures were supplied from the development build before the version-number bump; Settings therefore retains its captured 1.0.0 label.
• Target: Forever 1.60.1 (70124), Interface 16001. Crafting, buying and trading remain manual. The previously reported protected-action popup after a bank visit remains under investigation.
Русский — изменения после 1.0.0Интерфейс
• Современный и классический стили: переключение в настройках, сохранение выбора и применение сразу. Оба сохраняют компактную компоновку и поддержку корейских/китайских шрифтов.
• Более наглядные рецепты и цепочки: карточки вещей, счётчики наличия/потребности/крафтов, иконки реагентов, прогресс, цены в подсказках и раскрываемые подробности.
• Цели очереди показаны один раз слева. Справа — общие материалы или порядок изготовления, следующий доступный локальный крафт и компактные действия цели. Валидное количество сохраняется при вводе; наборы, очистка и отмена собраны в одно меню.…

ForeverNet 1.0.0 ReleaseEnglish
This release brings the saved crafting queue, personal stock planning and auction-price tools together with the profession network. It includes all changes since 0.4.0 Beta:
• Character overview, up to 50 queue goals, 10 goal sets, maintained stock and a movable tracker.
• Native profession actions and exact-item crafter search, including supported unlearned recipes.
• Auction tab, targeted scans, purchase estimates and observed daily history; whole-plan material-source comparisons.
• Compact dark UI, profession grouping, filters, favorites, locale-aware CJK text and fixes for filter initialization, tab anchoring and overlapping recipe blocks.
• Improved message recovery: brief pauses retain progress; identical snapshots are coalesced; codes 3/8 retain the queue and adapt pacing; code 11 uses bounded backoff without repeated chat notices.
• Removed the recipe-chat-link integration and its unused translations from ForeverNet. The separate ForeverLink addon was prepared privately and is not included or published here.

Manual crafting/buying remain required. Price history is based on observed scans, equipment variants are not priced and client messaging restrictions may still pause exchange. The reported protected item-use popup after visiting a bank remains under investigation; native auction/layout verification continues.

Install by replacing the ForeverNet folder in Interface/AddOns, then /reload; retain SavedVariables. After first installing the bundled CJK fonts, restart the client. Both players should update for matching UI/transport behavior.

Релиз объединяет сохраняемую очередь изготовления, учёт личных запасов и аукционные цены с сетью профессий. Включены накопленные изменения после 0.4.0 Beta:
• Обзор персонажа, до 50 целей очереди, 10 наборов, поддержание запаса и подвижный трекер.
• Действия в штатной профессии и поиск мастеров по предмету, включая распознаваемые неизученные рецепты.
