Español
Primera versión pública de Forever Leveling Companion (FLC), el compañero de subida de nivel para WoW: Forever.

Qué trae
• Guías de subida con flecha, seguimiento de misiones y Modo Grupo (ayudar a un jugador, subir juntos).
• Ventana de guías (/flc guides): elegí qué guía seguir. Rutas de subida por zona, guías de mazmorra y de banda,
solo las de tu personaje, con sus niveles y tu progreso. "Automático" le devuelve la elección a FLC.
• Misiones solas: FLC acepta y entrega las misiones de la guía (nunca en combate, nunca con Shift apretado). Si
hay que elegir recompensa, FLC no elige: marca la que te sirve, o la que más paga el vendedor. /flc auto u
Opciones para apagarlo.
• Botón en el minimapa: clic izquierdo muestra u oculta FLC; clic derecho, un menú con Guías, Atlas de botín,
Modo Grupo, Aspecto, Opciones y Reportar un error. Shift + arrastrar lo mueve.
• Guías de mazmorra (23) y de banda (12): la entrada, los objetivos de misión adentro, cada jefe en el orden del
juego y la salida.

addons.description:
NPC voices and quest narration for WoW Forever.

Website ·
Discord ·
CurseForge ·
What’s new ·
Report a problem

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The addon requires the ForeverDubbed companion app to work. The addon cannot generate or play voices on its own.

Have you always wondered what WoW would be like with full voice acting? Wonder no more! Using text-to-speed models that run locally on your computer, Forever Dubbed generates audio for any quest, conversation, or dialog in the game!

Features unique voices for each race/gender and it will even will say your character's name.

Try it out and experience Azeroth like never before!
Install
| Platform | Download | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | Installer | Windows 10/11, 64-bit |
| macOS | DMG | macOS 14+, Apple Silicon |

Windows: run the installer, then launch ForeverDubbed from the Start menu.

macOS: open the disk image and drag ForeverDubbed.app into Applications. Grant Screen Recording permission in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then quit and reopen the app.

The application will install the WoW addon automatically.
Connect to WoW
1. Open ForeverDubbed. It finds WoW Forever in the usual Windows locations or /Applications/World of Warcraft/_classic_beta_/World of Warcraft Beta.app on macOS and installs or updates its bundled addon automatically. If needed, select your WoW client with Locate WoW…: usually WowB.exe (Windows) or World of Warcraft Beta.app (macOS). Renamed clients are supported; on Windows, switch the picker to All executables. The selected client must be inside its WoW installation, and capture uses that exact path.
2. Follow the narrator and banner: restart WoW for a fresh install, or type /reload for an update. Enable the addon in WoW’s AddOns list and keep WoW in windowed or borderless mode.
3. Type /fdb test in WoW. The companion should show Connected and read the test aloud.
4. Use /fdb unlock to drag the small data square somewhere unobstructed, then /fdb lock to finish.

On Windows 10, the companion uses desktop capture while the game is visible to avoid the yellow capture border. Other windows must not cover the data square. Windows 11 uses game-window capture.

The square passes dialogue to the companion. Keep its entire border visible and your pointer off it; it hides after sending text (after ~15 seconds). While unlocked for positioning, it stays visible until you lock it again.

Use Locate WoW… to change the installation or retry. If access is denied, run the Windows companion as administrator and retry, or manually copy the bundled ForeverDubbed addon folder into the exact Interface/AddOns location shown in the error banner. The bundled folder is beside the Windows executable under addon; on macOS, use Show Package Contents → Contents/Resources/addon in Finder.
Make it yours
• Settings: choose quest dialogue, NPC conversations, and ambient NPC speech. Quest titles and objectives are optional and off by default. The Voice volume slider below Read aloud adjusts playback from 0–100% and remembers your setting. Changes apply during native voice playback; the system speech fallback applies them to the next utterance.
• Voices: choose Default, Narrator, or None for each race and gender. None silences that selection, including speech already playing or queued. Your choices are saved.
• Queue new dialogue: finish each message before starting the next. When off, new dialogue interrupts the current line.
• Open an accepted quest in the quest log and click the play arrow to hear it with the narrator voice. This uses your quest title/objective preferences and works even while automatic reading is paused.…

Added
• A new experience bar window shows your XP as a bar with texts you place yourself, and percentages count across several levels.
• The experience bar has four presets. A click on it opens a menu, pinning fixes the position, and a pencil button opens the layout editor.
• The experience bar has no title bar or frame. Unpinned, drag the bar itself and scale it with the grip at the bottom right. A click brings the window to the front.
• Pause and reset the session and see the time per level from your played time. Percentages, rested XP and targets end at the highest level your game allows.
• An optional chat message at a level up goes to your own chat window, the group, the guild or Say. The game usually blocks Say for add-ons, so you get a hint and the line in your own window.
• A page in the tools area gathers all experience bar settings. The command /fg xp (also erfahrung, xpbar) takes pause, reset, edit, time and chat, and a key binding and a settings card are included.
• Experience bar layouts can be created, duplicated, renamed and deleted, on the page, in the click menu and in the layout editor.
• Layout editor: set bars, texts and rectangles with colors, font, size and placeholders. A text can have a background, and a warning names too little contrast.
• Layout editor: a slim band under the title bar holds save, undo, redo, reset, export and import, and the layout list sits beside it. A star marks unsaved changes, and a dialog asks before you switch.
• Layout editor: eight handles change width and height in the preview, the border has its own opacity, and Live, info, grid and real values sit in one row.
• Layout editor: add, remove (trash button, Ctrl+Z brings it back) and rename elements (F2). Names survive export and import, and every element type has a short description.
• Mouse cursor ring: a ring, shape or crosshair follows the mouse cursor, with presets and layouts of your own from the layout editor. It is off by default, and while it is off nothing runs for it.
• Mouse cursor ring: color, opacity, rotation, blending, line thickness (1 to 64 pixels) and an inner fill are adjustable, and all eight shapes also exist filled.
• Mouse cursor ring: visibility rules for combat, instances, target, mount and vehicle, the screen layer, and the behavior while the camera turns (hide, keep at the cursor, screen center).
• Mouse cursor ring: the command /fg cursor (also mauszeiger, ring) takes on, off, edit and reset. A key binding, a settings card on the General tab and a page in the tools area are included.
• Mouse cursor ring: the Trail element shows particles or lightning behind the pointer, and the Click effect element a growing ring on left and right click. Reduced motion turns the trail off.
• Mouse cursor ring: timers for the global cooldown, for casting and channeling (with a flash on interrupt) and for the swing of each weapon (main hand, off hand, ranged) as a ring or a bar.
• Mouse cursor ring: when the game's own swing bars are on, the panel of the swing timer points it out and never changes the setting.
• Mouse cursor ring: a health ring and a resource ring with start point, direction and colors, red at low health. The game hides these values from add-ons, so the rings show no numbers.
• Mouse cursor ring: the range element shows whether the target is in range, out of range or unknown, as a ring, a dot, text with the distance band (0-5 up to 35+ yards) or both.
• Mouse cursor ring: the range check asks your spells first, then items and the interact distance, or you choose melee, a distance or a spell. The status line names the source.
• Mouse cursor ring: more presets (ring with trail, ring with click effect, timers, swing timer, health, resource and range, distance text) and an editor preview with simulation.
Changed
• Dropdowns have a little more space between the label and the field.
Fixed
• Pressing keys in combat with a window open no longer adds entries to the error list.…

Added
• The start page, the Help page and the last setup step invite you to the livestream and the community server, each with a button that opens the address for copying.
• The setup shows both addresses below the text, and the livestream button uses the color of the channel.
• The title bar channel field is filled purple and shows the live channel address in a larger font.
• Group Finder: choose the search languages from all the game offers. Your game language is always included, one search shows at most 100 groups.
• Group Finder: the new section "I search as" stays in sync with the roles of the game's listing view, you can switch off all roles, and roles your class cannot play are disabled.
• Group Finder: the switch "Show matching groups" hides groups with no free slot for your role. Single players stay visible.
Changed
• Group Finder: the filter panel stays open on all three tabs. A click on Search shows the Search tab with the results, whichever tab you are on.
• Group Finder: the Show section has three buttons for groups, players or everything. Groups without a free slot are always hidden.
• Group Finder: when you switch the category in the panel, nothing is checked at first. "All" checks everything, the first start still checks all dungeons.
• Group Finder: the text filter ignores case, accents and umlauts and finds Russian, Korean and Chinese names.
• Group Finder: raid groups whose slots the game does not count stay visible.
• Group Finder: the panel check boxes react at once and can be clicked anywhere on their row or icon.
Fixed
• Group Finder: switching "Show all dungeons" in the settings no longer leaves the game's own search blocked. A reload is offered after the change.
• Group Finder: the role choice no longer flickers or jumps back on a fast click.
• Group Finder: the Dungeons category shows in the panel dropdown even when the game delivers the categories late.

Added
• Beta: A small label at the minimap shows the layer of your zone. A left click opens the layer window, a right click reads the layer again.
• Beta: The layer window shows your layer, the zone, when it was last confirmed and the layer before. A button reads it again.
• Beta: Switch your layer with one click. The add-on asks a host on another layer, accepts that host's group invite, waits until your layer changed and leaves the group.
• Beta: The layer window lists the hosts of your zone with their layer. "Pick best host" tries them one after the other.
• Beta: Layer sharing and hosting are off by default. Sharing sends your zone, layer, class and character name to other add-on users in a hidden channel.
• The layer is read from the NPCs you see. Target any NPC or move the mouse over one to find your layer.
• The command /fg layer opens the layer window, /fg layer hosts lists the hosts and /fg layer switch starts a switch.
• A new settings card "Layer" holds the switches and a button to reset the position of the label.
Changed
• Declining invites of strangers no longer declines the invite of the host you asked for a layer switch.

Added
• A filter panel docks to the right side of the Group Finder and opens with it. A tab below the game's tabs shows or hides it.
• The group list can be filtered by role, class, group size, leader level, playstyle, name or dungeon, and how long a listing has been up. Entries that do not match are hidden.
• Choose dungeons in the panel and start the search there, without listing yourself first. All dungeons are checked by default.
• The dungeon list shows every dungeon with its level range and marks those that fit your level. Long names are shortened, the level range always stays readable.
• Show only groups looking for players, only players looking for a group, or only groups with a free slot, with presets for one click.
• A new settings card "Group finder" shows whether the Group Finder lists all dungeons or only those for your level, and switches it.
• The panel can be switched off, shown automatically when the Group Finder opens, and docked to the window.
• With docking on, the game's tabs and ours move to the right edge of the panel.
• The command /fg gruppensuche (also /fg lfg) shows or hides the panel.

addons.description:
The addon for World of Warcraft: Forever, and the small program that runs beside the game.
Together they show you, in game, what your professions still need, less what you already have
(/fwc), and they record what the auction house lists and send it on, which is where the prices
come from.

It is plain Python 3.10+ with nothing to install, and a WoW addon. MIT licence. Questions and
help: the Discord, . What is sent and what is not: The pipe
below, and .
What it does
| | |
|---|---|
| The addon (addon/ForeverWowCraftScanner) | /fwc: the cheapest route for each profession from your skill on, with what you have (bags, bank, mail, your own auctions) taken off, across your characters if you like. A Make button on the game's profession panel crafts that route a step at a time, and says what to buy or learn when it cannot, with an arrow to the nearest trainer, vendor or anvil: the addon comes with the vanilla world's (Seed.lua, data from the VMaNGOS database, GPL-2.0, apart from the addon's MIT code) and notes the ones it sees you at. At the auction house a shopping list buys what the step needs, a click and a confirm an item. And it records the auction house's prices, by itself, whenever you open it and it can (once every 15 minutes): a small button on the auction house frame lights up when there is something to save, and that click is all it asks. Nothing of yours is sent: prices only |
| fwch.py | Finds the game, installs the addon, reads what it saved, sends it through the pipe, and writes the lists and the routes it is given into the addon |
Setting up
1. Download ForeverWowCraft-Helper-.msi and run it. Nothing else needs installing:
Python is inside (python\, python.org's own build). It installs for your own user, under
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ForeverWowCraft Helper, so Windows asks for no administrator; it
may warn that the installer is not signed (SmartScreen: "More info", then "Run anyway").
2. The helper starts when the installer is done, and when you log on to Windows from then on:
an icon by the clock, in the notification area. It finds the game, installs the addon,
fetches the lists to scan and the routes, and waits. If it cannot find the game, right-click
the icon and Choose the game folder: the "World of Warcraft" folder, the one that holds
the client folder (forever).
3. Start the game (restart it if it was running: it only finds a new addon when it starts).
/fwc opens the window. Open the auction house now and then: the prices are recorded by
themselves, the Save Prices button on its frame lights up when there is something to
save, and that click is all it asks; the helper sends them within seconds. (Interface,
AddOns, ForeverWowCraft has the switches, among them the scanner's own bar for running
scans by hand.)

Point at the icon for how things stand: what was last sent, how many auction houses have
routes, or what is wrong. Its menu: Send prices now; Fetch routes now; **Choose the
game folder; Open the log; Start with Windows**, ticked when it does (Windows' own
Settings > Apps > Startup has the same switch); Help; Quit. A balloon comes only when
something needs you: the game not found, the addon not installed, prices that could not be
sent, the game to restart. Everything the helper does is in its log, with the date and time at the start of
every line: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ForeverWowCraft\Helper\helper.log. The same folder holds the
helper's name and token at the pipe (identity.json), what it sent (sent.json), and the
routes, lists and freshness it fetched; an uninstall leaves it, so a reinstall is the same
sender. FWC_STATE names another folder. One instance runs at a time: starting the helper
again while it runs only says so.

Each auction house in the scan file is sent on its own: one the service does not take
(not sent, : ...) does not hold the others back, and is tried again. A scan is sent
once: the helper remembers what it sent by what the scan says, so an update of the helper…

addons.description:
Know your keybinds at a glance.

Long keybinding names can get cut off on your action bars, making binds like
Mouse Wheel Up and Mouse Wheel Down hard to tell apart. Clean Binds lets
you give each button a clear, short label such as MWU or MWD in **World
of Warcraft: Forever**. Your keybindings stay exactly the same.

Download on CurseForge |
Wago |
GitHub releases
Features
• Short labels you choose. Customize each button individually, including
mouse buttons, the mouse wheel, and Shift, Ctrl, or Alt combinations.
• Labels for MMO mice. Use names like N1 or N12 for side-button keybinds
on a Razer Naga or similar mouse, even when those buttons are mapped to
keyboard keys.
• Blizzard's familiar action bars. Change the text without replacing your
bars or changing their layout.
• Adjustable keybind font size. Make labels easier to read without
enlarging your action buttons. Keep Blizzard's font style and colors.
• Optional label and macro-name hiding. Hide keybinding labels (while
keeping the range indicator dot) or macro names on your action buttons without
changing your bindings or renaming your macros.
• Built into Options. Browse buttons by action bar and preview your labels
as you type.
• Shared or character-specific settings. Labels automatically follow WoW's
keybinding setting, with no extra profile selector.

while retaining the behavior and saved-variable format of the upstream addon.

on Blizzard's modern 12.1 UI engine. That combination requires compatibility
work beyond simply changing the interface number.

addons.changelog:
FlockSync 0.9.0Guild identity, desktop setup, and remote server deployment
• The dashboard shows the guild name at the top center. The newest timestamped collector sync supplies the name and realm; guild identity is stored in SQLite so new backups retain it and restore brings it back.
• Wipe clears the stored guild identity until a fresh collector sync. Existing backups without guild metadata remain usable; sync a collector and refresh the dashboard to populate the name.
• Fixed database restore ordering for populated character records: accounts are restored before character/theme records that reference them.
• Desktop fresh installs default to C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft\forever, including the backslash before forever. Existing custom or older saved paths remain unchanged and editable.
• Deployment is hardware/vendor-neutral. Use FlockSync_Remote_Server_Deploy.zip and scripts/package-remote-server-deploy.ps1 for an ARM64 or AMD64 Linux Docker host. Backup storage can be local, attached, or network-mounted.
• Existing NAS_BACKUP_PATH configuration values, mount locations, and persistent folder settings remain valid; no storage relocation is required.
• Database administration remains available: verified online backups, optional local downloads, latest/selected/uploaded restore, and confirmation-protected guild-data wipe with a final backup. Refresh clears old status messages; restore options show local date/time; inaccessible folders report actionable errors.
Release channel and scope
This is a normal Release-channel, pre-1.0 feature release. The new bundle is 0.9.0, following the existing local v0.8.0-release tag; that tag is not modified or reused. The new release uses standard tag v0.9.0, without a literal -release suffix.

API/web and shared types advance 0.5.0 -> 0.6.0. Desktop advances 0.5.0 -> 0.5.1. Main addon 0.6.0 and AppHelper 0.2.2 are unchanged from the existing 0.8.0 tag. Unchanged addons are repackaged for a complete download set; already-current installations do not need reinstalling.
Upgrade instructions
1. Preserve the remote server's .env, data, and independent backups. Extract FlockSync_Remote_Server_Deploy.zip; from the deployed project directory run sh deploy/update-server.sh. It verifies a pre-update backup before rebuilding/recreating API/web. Never use docker compose down -v.
2. Keep the existing NAS_BACKUP_PATH and mount location. Verify the backup storage is mounted and the API user can list and write it. Run docker compose exec api id to check the actual identity; a successful root-run scheduled backup does not prove API-user access. Do not copy example storage paths over a working configuration.
3. Startup automatically applies the guild-identity migration. Sync a collector and refresh the dashboard to populate the header. Backups made before this metadata existed need a new collector sync; they do not contain a recoverable guild name.
4. Quit desktop fully through its tray before updating to 0.5.1, using either the installer or portable app. Preserve settings. Fresh installs use the Forever path; existing installations keep their saved path. Existing desktop 0.5.0 remains usable if the saved location is correct.
5. Keep main addon 0.6.0 and AppHelper 0.2.2 if already current; neither needs reinstalling. Older members install the main addon; older collectors install the bundle. Exit WoW before replacing files, extract into Interface\AddOns without an extra nested directory, and preserve SavedVariables.
6. No wipe or restore is required to upgrade. If using restore, a pre-restore safety backup is saved first; restored accounts/credentials replace current ones. Wipe requires typing its confirmation, saves a final backup, then clears guild records/themes while retaining accounts and backup-folder settings.…
addons.description:
Your guild's characters, raid plans, and crafting knowledge in one place.

FlockSync connects a WoW Forever addon, a Windows desktop sync companion,
and a guild-hosted web dashboard. Members share their character data in game;
officers collect it and bring roster management and planning onto the web.
Built by GearDuckDev for WoW Forever, Interface 16001.

Release-channel, still pre-1.0. Features continue to evolve. This project does
not claim official server endorsement or guarantee that its use is ban-safe.
Confirm your server's rules before using the addon and desktop bridge.

Downloads |
Server setup | Release notes |
Screenshot gallery
See it in action
The addon images below are developer-supplied in-game captures. Web and desktop
images use fictional demonstration data; desktop watcher/sync responses are
simulated. The two sets are labeled separately.
Addon: find a guild crafterAddon: roles, main character, and collectionAddon: useful item tooltipsWeb: roster and linked charactersWeb: plan the lineupDesktop: save, sync, and stay in the tray
The full gallery also covers gear, crafters, goals,
attunements, attendance, tasks, administration, and themes, plus all eight
in-game captures and CurseForge image-hosting instructions.
Which download do I need?
| You are... | Install |
| --- | --- |
| A guild member | FlockSync from CurseForge or FlockSync-Raider-Only.zip |
| An officer/admin collecting data | FlockSync + AppHelper from FlockSync-Addon-Bundle.zip, plus one Windows desktop download |
| Hosting the guild server | FlockSync_Remote_Server_Deploy.zip; follow DEPLOYMENT.md |

Regular members do not need AppHelper, the desktop app, or a website account
to broadcast their character data. The guild needs an active collector and a
configured server for dashboard and server-returned information.

There is one main addon, not separate member/officer editions. CurseForge
updates the main addon only. Officers using CurseForge can extract just
FlockSync_AppHelper from the GitHub bundle alongside their managed installation.
What you can doIn game
• Complete a first-time walkthrough to choose your role, main, and feature toggles.
• Share gear, roles/off-spec, availability, lockouts, professions, goals, and attunements.
• View returned raid assignments and standby placement.
• Search guild crafters, see relevant crafting/goal tooltip lines, and find matching goals.
• Use officer invite tools, subject to WoW's normal group/leadership restrictions.
• Open Features with /fs; open Options with /fs options or minimap right-click.

Shared views depend on the last received snapshot, not a continuous website
connection. Profession recipes require opening each profession window in game.
Item search is a bounded local cache, not a complete game-item database.
On the web
| Tab | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Roster & Gear | Mains/alts, aliases, gear inspection, roles, availability, and officer cull/restore/delete controls |
| Team Builder | Raid, dungeon, and PvP lineups; groups, bench, role targets, class/utility coverage, and same-player conflict checks |
| Availability & Recruitment | Weekly availability by role and lineup recruitment gaps |
| Crafter Directory | Search synced recipes, professions, and item IDs |
| Gear Goals | Find players chasing the same item or sharing run-note keywords |
| Attunements | Group by the main's step; expand initially collapsed alts to see their individual progress |
| Loot & Attendance | Recorded loot and 30/60/90-day attendance, counting mains and alts as one player |
| Officer Tasks | Character-linked task board for officers/admins |
| Admin Settings | Account roles, database backup/restore, persistent backup folders, guild-data wipe, and server update notices |
| Theme Settings | Custom UI/page colors, optional backgrounds, custom uploads, admin defaults, and personal overrides |

API/web and shared types advance 0.5.0 -> 0.6.0. Desktop advances 0.5.0 -> 0.5.1. Main addon 0.6.0 and AppHelper 0.2.2 are unchanged from the existing 0.8.0 tag. Unchanged addons are repackaged for a complete download set; already-current installations do not need reinstalling.
Upgrade instructions
1. Preserve the remote server's .env, data, and independent backups. Extract FlockSync_Remote_Server_Deploy.zip; from the deployed project directory run sh deploy/update-server.sh. It verifies a pre-update backup before rebuilding/recreating API/web. Never use docker compose down -v.
2. Keep the existing NAS_BACKUP_PATH and mount location. Verify the backup storage is mounted and the API user can list and write it. Run docker compose exec api id to check the actual identity; a successful root-run scheduled backup does not prove API-user access. Do not copy example storage paths over a working configuration.
3. Startup automatically applies the guild-identity migration. Sync a collector and refresh the dashboard to populate the header. Backups made before this metadata existed need a new collector sync; they do not contain a recoverable guild name.
4. Quit desktop fully through its tray before updating to 0.5.1, using either the installer or portable app. Preserve settings. Fresh installs use the Forever path; existing installations keep their saved path. Existing desktop 0.5.0 remains usable if the saved location is correct.
5. Keep main addon 0.6.0 and AppHelper 0.2.2 if already current; neither needs reinstalling. Older members install the main addon; older collectors install the bundle. Exit WoW before replacing files, extract into Interface\AddOns without an extra nested directory, and preserve SavedVariables.
6. No wipe or restore is required to upgrade. If using restore, a pre-restore safety backup is saved first; restored accounts/credentials replace current ones. Wipe requires typing its confirmation, saves a final backup, then clears guild records/themes while retaining accounts and backup-folder settings.…

FlockSync 0.7.1Gear sync reliability
• Fixed the addon capturing unavailable inventory during logout/reload and replacing valid gear with an empty snapshot. Logout now preserves captured equipment while preparing the character record for WoW's SavedVariables write.
• Equipment changes are captured immediately instead of waiting for the delayed broadcast, so a quick logout does not lose the slot change. Main and alt equipment remains attached to each character's own profile.
• Incomplete item-cache results retain the previous valid gear. Explicit equipment-removal events still remove the affected slot, including the final item. Multiple local changes within one server second are preserved in the saved record.
• WoW itself writes SavedVariables on /reload and logout; addons cannot force arbitrary disk writes. The running, signed-in desktop app already watches changed/replaced saves automatically. New integration coverage verifies reload, logout, and character-switch saves upload both characters and write AppHelper without a manual Sync click.
• Includes desktop 0.5.0 from the previous release: explicitly indexed Lua gear tables parse correctly, and missing/malformed lists fail validation rather than silently clearing equipment.
• Genuine equipment removals still replace older gear snapshots. Refreshing the roster does not delete stored equipment, and older or equal-timestamp syncs cannot overwrite newer gear.
• Gear already overwritten by an older desktop sync needs a fresh in-game scan; installing the fix or refreshing the browser alone cannot reconstruct that equipment.
Release channel and scope
This is a normal Release-channel build with no alpha/beta suffix. FlockSync remains pre-1.0; this is not a declaration of 1.0 completeness.

The overall release advances from 0.7.0 to 0.7.1, and the main addon advances from 0.5.0 to 0.5.1 for this fix. Desktop, API/web, shared types, and AppHelper are unchanged. Unchanged components are rebuilt/repackaged for a complete download set and do not need reinstalling if already current.
Upgrade instructions
1. Exit WoW completely and update FlockSync to 0.5.1. Members install FlockSync-Raider-Only.zip or update through CurseForge once published. Collectors install FlockSync-Addon-Bundle.zip, or update only FlockSync if AppHelper 0.2.2 is already installed. Preserve SavedVariables and avoid an extra nested AddOns directory.
2. Keep desktop 0.5.0, API/web 0.4.1, and AppHelper 0.2.2 if already current. No server deployment, migration/reset, or reinstall of unchanged components is required. Desktop versions older than 0.5.0 still need the earlier parser fix: quit completely through the tray, then install FlockSync-Setup-0.5.0-x64.exe or use FlockSync-Portable-0.5.0-x64.exe. Preserve settings, select the correct WoW folder, and use the full server URL without /api.
3. To restore gear previously cleared by an older sync, log in on each affected character and use Force Scan & Broadcast in the addon settings. An authorized guild catcher must be online to collect other members' broadcasts. Log out to save the catcher's data, wait for successful desktop sync, then refresh the dashboard.
4. To load server-returned information, use the logout -> desktop sync -> login sequence. Each WoW account folder needs its own sync. Website-linked collection applies only within the authorized guild and realm; unrelated guilds, realms, and guildless characters do not inherit it.
5. If your server is older than 0.4.1, preserve .env and data, obtain the deployment source, and run sh deploy/update-server.sh. It verifies a backup before rebuilding/restarting API/web. Do not bypass the backup guard or use docker compose down -v. Check container logs, public login, and sync.…

FlockSync 0.7.0Gear sync reliability
• Fixed desktop sync treating equipment saved with explicit Lua indexes as empty gear. These records now retain their items when uploaded and displayed after a web refresh.
• Missing or malformed equipment lists now fail sync validation instead of silently uploading an empty list.
• Genuine equipment removals still replace older gear snapshots. Refreshing the roster does not delete stored equipment, and older or equal-timestamp syncs cannot overwrite newer gear.
• Gear already overwritten by an older desktop sync needs a fresh in-game scan; installing the fix or refreshing the browser alone cannot reconstruct that equipment.
Release channel and scope
This is a normal Release-channel build with no alpha/beta suffix. FlockSync remains pre-1.0; this is not a declaration of 1.0 completeness.

Using the requested minor increment, the overall release advances from 0.6.1 to 0.7.0, and desktop advances from 0.4.0 to 0.5.0. API/web, shared types, and both addons are unchanged. Unchanged components are rebuilt/repackaged for a complete download set and do not need reinstalling if already current.
Upgrade instructions
1. Quit the desktop app completely using Quit FlockSync in its system tray. Install FlockSync-Setup-0.5.0-x64.exe, or replace your portable executable with FlockSync-Portable-0.5.0-x64.exe. Choose one, not both. Preserve existing settings and configure the full guild server URL without an /api suffix.
2. Keep API/web 0.4.1, main addon 0.5.0, and AppHelper 0.2.2 if already current. No server deployment, database migration/reset, or addon reinstall is required for this fix.
3. To restore gear previously cleared by an older sync, log in on each affected character and use Force Scan & Broadcast in the addon settings. An authorized guild catcher must be online to collect other members' broadcasts. Log out to save the catcher's data, wait for successful desktop sync, then refresh the dashboard.
4. To load server-returned information, use the logout -> desktop sync -> login sequence. Each WoW account folder needs its own sync. Website-linked collection applies only within the authorized guild and realm; unrelated guilds, realms, and guildless characters do not inherit it.
5. If your server is older than 0.4.1, preserve .env and data, obtain the deployment source, and run sh deploy/update-server.sh. It verifies a backup before rebuilding/restarting API/web. Do not bypass the backup guard or use docker compose down -v. Check container logs, public login, and sync.
6. For older addon installations, exit WoW before replacing files. Extract directly into Interface\AddOns, without an extra ZIP-named directory, and preserve SavedVariables. If upgrading from before 0.4.0-beta, deploy the API before the desktop app for newer sync-field compatibility.

No settings, SavedVariables, or database reset is required. Do not delete saved data to troubleshoot missing equipment.
Download choices
• FlockSync-Setup-0.5.0-x64.exe: updated Windows installer for officers/admins collecting guild data; includes the gear parser fix.
• FlockSync-Portable-0.5.0-x64.exe: updated portable Windows alternative with the same fix; choose this or the installer.
• FlockSync-Raider-Only.zip: main addon 0.5.0 for all guild members. Unchanged; no reinstall needed if current. Regular members do not need AppHelper, desktop, or a server account to share addon data.
• FlockSync-Addon-Bundle.zip: the same main addon plus AppHelper 0.2.2 for collectors. Both unchanged; no reinstall needed if current. Collectors additionally need the desktop app and an authorized OFFICER or ADMIN website account.
• FlockSync_Pi_Deploy.zip: complete 0.4.1 API/web source, shared contracts, theme assets, existing database migrations, and Docker deployment tooling. Server behavior/version unchanged; redeployment is not required for this desktop fix.…

FlockSync 0.6.1Web dashboard improvements
• Added custom UI and background colors in Theme Settings, for both personal themes and administrator-managed server defaults.
• Colors are linked by default: one color picker controls the dashboard surfaces and the page behind the background emblem. Enable Separate UI and background colors to choose them independently. Disable it again to use the UI color for both.
• Panel, table, and control shades follow the UI color. Neutral text adjusts for light or dark surfaces; action buttons, class colors, and status indicators retain their recognizable colors.
• The live preview shows the page color behind the selected emblem together with a sample panel and control before saving.
• Color choices persist with the website account and follow users across browsers, just like background emblems. Administrator defaults apply only to users without a personal override; Use server default removes that override.
• Existing themes retain their original appearance until customized. Changing the emblem preserves color choices, and existing custom-image uploads and opacity settings continue working.
• PNG/JPEG uploads remain limited to 5 MB, resized to at most 1024 pixels per side, and checked against the encoded storage limit. Emblem opacity remains adjustable from 0% to 40%. SVG and external image URLs are not accepted.
Release channel and scope
This is a normal Release-channel build, with no alpha/beta suffix. FlockSync remains pre-1.0: version 0.6.1 does not mean every planned feature is complete or that the software has reached 1.0 maturity.

The overall release advances from 0.6.0 to 0.6.1, and API/web and shared types advance from 0.4.0 to 0.4.1, using the requested 0.0.1 increment. Desktop, main addon, and AppHelper are unchanged and rebuilt/repackaged only to provide complete downloads. Current installations of unchanged components do not need reinstalling.
Updating the server, desktop app, and addons
1. Preserve the server's existing .env and data directory. Obtain the new source or extract FlockSync_Pi_Deploy.zip while preserving those files, then run sh deploy/update-server.sh from the deployed project directory. It verifies a database backup before rebuilding/restarting. Do not bypass the backup guard or use docker compose down -v.
2. Deploy API and web together at 0.4.1. No new database migration or reset is required for color settings; they use the existing theme storage. Upgrades from before theme support still apply the additive theme-table migration automatically. Check docker compose ps and docker compose logs --tail 100 api web cloudflared, then verify public login and sync.
3. Open Theme Settings. Choose a linked UI and background color, or enable Separate UI and background colors and select each independently. Check the preview and click Save theme. Administrators can also save a server default. Default changes appear on browser focus or within a minute for users following that default.
4. Keep desktop 0.4.0 installed if already current; it does not need reinstalling. For older desktop installations, quit completely through Quit FlockSync in the tray, then install FlockSync-Setup-0.4.0-x64.exe or replace the portable executable with FlockSync-Portable-0.4.0-x64.exe. Preserve settings and use the full server URL without an /api suffix.
5. Keep main addon 0.5.0 and AppHelper 0.2.2 installed if already current; neither addon changed. For older installations, exit WoW before replacing files. Members install FlockSync-Raider-Only.zip; collectors install FlockSync-Addon-Bundle.zip. Extract directly into Interface\AddOns, without an extra nested directory, and preserve SavedVariables.
6. After an older addon/desktop upgrade, log in, complete the addon walkthrough if necessary, and /reload or log out to save current data. Wait for desktop sync success, then /reload to load helper return data. Refresh the dashboard to check synced records.…

FlockSync 0.6.0Desktop improvements
• Added Start minimized to system tray, available in App Settings and the tray menu. It applies on the next launch and defaults off.
• Startup visibility is independent of Start on Windows boot and Minimize to tray on close. Windows startup no longer unconditionally hides the app; an explicit --hidden argument still hides it.
• If the tray icon cannot be created, the window opens even when start-minimized is enabled.
• Updated the desktop window, tray, installer, and portable-app icons using the FlockSync artwork.
Web dashboard improvements
• Attunements now group linked alts under their main instead of placing each alt in a separate step section. Sections and completion totals count mains, not individual characters.
• Alt lists start collapsed. Expand a main to see indented alts with their own completed/total counts, including alts on the same step as their main.
• Missing main progress remains explicitly unknown, rather than being inferred from an alt. Inactive mains can remain as anchors for active alts; task creation still targets the chosen character's actual step.
• Added Theme Settings with bundled Alliance, Horde, and World of Warcraft backgrounds, plus custom PNG/JPEG uploads. The example guild image is not bundled.
• The initial theme is None, with no background emblem. Administrators can set a server-wide default; each user can save a personal override or choose Use server default.
• Backgrounds stay faded behind content and do not intercept clicks. Opacity sliders range from 0% to 40%, with a 12% starting value for a chosen image.
• Theme settings and uploaded images persist with the website account in SQLite and are included in normal database backups. Admin-default changes appear on browser focus or within a minute for users following that default.
• Custom uploads accept PNG/JPEG files up to 5 MB, resize to at most 1024 pixels per side, and must fit the encoded storage limit after conversion. SVG and external image URLs are not accepted.
• Updated the browser favicon using the FlockSync artwork.
Release channel and scope
This is a normal Release-channel publication, with no alpha/beta suffix. FlockSync remains pre-1.0: version 0.6.0 does not mean every planned feature is complete or that the software has reached 1.0 maturity.

Desktop, API/web, and shared types are updated. The main addon and AppHelper are unchanged from 0.5.0 and 0.2.2 respectively and are included for complete downloads. Existing addon installations on those versions do not need reinstalling.
Updating the server, desktop app, and addons
1. Preserve the server's existing .env and data directory. Obtain the new source or extract FlockSync_Pi_Deploy.zip while preserving those files, then run sh deploy/update-server.sh from the deployed project directory. It verifies a database backup before rebuilding/restarting. Do not bypass the backup guard or use docker compose down -v.
2. Deploy API and web together. The API automatically applies the additive theme-table migration at startup; no database reset is required. Check docker compose ps and docker compose logs --tail 100 api web cloudflared, then verify public login and sync.
3. Quit the desktop app completely through Quit FlockSync in its tray menu. Install FlockSync-Setup-0.4.0-x64.exe, or replace your portable executable with FlockSync-Portable-0.4.0-x64.exe. Keep existing settings and use the full server URL without an /api suffix.
4. To start quietly, enable Start minimized to system tray in desktop App Settings or the tray menu, then quit and relaunch. Leave it disabled to open the window normally. Older Windows startup entries containing --hidden are rewritten without that argument when the updated app runs.
5. Open Theme Settings on the website. Administrators can save a server default; users can save their own theme or return to the default. New installations start with None. Attunement alts start collapsed and expand with the chevron beside their main.…

GoatQuest release-2026.10.14.1
Guide update for both addons from the latest upstream guide sources.

| Addon | Version | Client | WowUp flavor |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GoatQuest | 1.4.1 | WoW Forever (Interface 16001) | forever |
| GoatQuestRetail | 1.0.1 | Retail (Interface 120100) | mainline |
ChangesGoatQuest 1.4.1 (Forever)
• Guides updated to Classic source revision 37349 (was 37145). Five guide files changed;
none were added or removed:
• Profession guides: First Aid step wording, a corrected Bright Baubles vendor location and a
new weaponsmith trainer step.
• Sunken Temple (dungeon and raid versions): the Fetish of Hakkar collection steps are gone.
GoatQuestRetail 1.0.1 (Retail)
• Guides updated to Retail source revision 37370 (was 37179). 17 guide files changed, mostly
Midnight Leveling, Dungeons, Mounts and Pets content, plus Events and the Cataclysm Alliance
leveling guide. None were added or removed.

No viewer or engine code changed in either addon.
Install
• WowUp (2.24.0-beta.6 or later): choose Install from URL, enter
https://github.com/GoatXYZ/GoatQuest. Forever installs GoatQuest and Retail
installs GoatQuestRetail.
• Manual: extract GoatQuest-1.4.1-forever.zip into _classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns, or
GoatQuestRetail-1.0.1.zip into retail/Interface/AddOns. Fully restart the game afterwards.
Validation
• py -3 build.py all: tooling tests, both flavors' Lua 5.1 offline suites and package
dependency checks passed.
• py -3 build.py --verify-release dist: checksums and release metadata verified.
• Retail guide sync: no Zygor branding left after renaming.
• Forever: the 208 unchanged upstream files come out byte-identical to the previous import
after renaming, which confirms the renaming step.
Known limitations
• These builds have not been tested in game yet.
• Two changed Retail guides use features the engine doesn't support yet: the step keyword
family in the Midnight achievements guide and GetCurrentTitle in the events guide. Neither
category ships in GoatQuestRetail, so this has no effect in game.
• Retail guides need the user's own subscription data. It is not included in the ZIP; see the
Retail LICENCE-USAGE.md.

addons.description:
GoatWay 1.0.0
In-world waypoints and navigation for WoW Forever (Interface 16001), in the GoatQuest look.
GoatWay marks your destination in the world, points the way when it is off screen, and follows
GoatQuest's guide arrow. It is based on Waypoint UI 1.7.3 by AdaptiveX, rebranded and restyled.
First launch
1. GoatWay lives next to GoatQuest in Interface/AddOns/GoatWay. Fully exit and restart WoW so
the new folder is found, then enable GoatWay (Forever).
2. If Waypoint UI is also installed, disable it. Both draw a marker for the same destination;
GoatWay says so in chat if it finds Waypoint UI enabled.
3. /gw (or /goatway) opens the settings, also under Options → AddOns → GoatWay.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| /gw | Opens the settings. |
| /gw clear | Clears the destination. |
| /gw arrow, /gw halo | Picks the Navigator (the same words as GoatQuest's /gqviewer). |
| /way [name] | Sets a destination on your map. /way # [name] for another map. When TomTom is loaded, /way is TomTom's. |
What you see
• Waypoint (far away): a flat diamond in the accent with the destination's icon, a thin beam,
and under it the name in the text colour, the distance in the accent and the arrival time muted.
• Pinpoint (close, within 100 yds on Forever): a GoatQuest card (ink, 1px hairline, the accent
rule along its top) with the objectives or description, and three chevrons flowing down to the spot.
• Navigator: Arrow, a GoatQuest chevron orbiting the destination's icon at the screen edge
when the destination is off screen; or Halo, GoatQuest's ring at your character's feet whose
notch points toward the destination with the distance beside it. On arrival the ring lights up
in the accent and says Here. For waypoints (GoatQuest's, /way, map pins, TomTom) the halo
points by your facing and the true bearing; for other destinations it points along the screen.

Quests take their kind's colour: ready to turn in in the accent, unfinished in soft grey,
repeatable in blue, important in lilac. Every icon is redrawn flat in GoatQuest's style.
With GoatQuest
GoatQuest is an optional dependency, so it loads first.
• Follow GoatQuest's Arrow (Extensions → GoatQuest, on by default): whatever GoatQuest's arrow
points at, the step's waypoint or the next leg of a travel route, becomes GoatWay's destination,
titled from the step and marked with the goat. A new place re-navigates; progress in the title
(3/8 boars) does not, so the marker's intro does not replay on every kill. Corpse arrows are left
to the game, and the mark clears when GoatQuest's arrow hides. Turn off Auto-Replace Waypoint
to be asked before GoatQuest replaces something else you are tracking (once per place).
• Accent (Appearance → Colour): Match GoatQuest, the default, uses the GoatQuest viewer's
accent, its class colour or your custom colour, and follows it when you change it there. Without
GoatQuest it is GoatQuest gold. Also Class Colour, GoatQuest Gold or Custom.
• Halo: uses the ring position you set with GoatQuest's movers (**Use GoatQuest's Ring
Position), or its own Ring Height**. While GoatQuest's own halo is on screen, GoatWay's steps
aside so only one ring shows.
The design
GoatWay uses GoatQuest's tokens (packages/goatway-style, matching GoatQuest's
Skins/Default/GoatQuest/Style.lua): flat surfaces, square corners, 1px hairlines, no bevels or glows
on panels, and one accent.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Ink | #0F1115 | Sidebar, pinpoint card, marker fill |
| Slate | #15181D | Settings content |
| Ridge | #1B1F25 | Dialogs, menus |
| Hairline | white 7% | Borders, dividers |
| Text / Soft / Muted / Dim | #ECEAE6 #C5C8CD #8D939C #6F757E | Text by importance |
| Gold | #F5BF29 | The settings accent, primary buttons, checks |

Type is GoatQuest's: Archivo for text (SemiBold for names and headings), Archivo Narrow for
distances and times, and Atkinson Hyperlegible Bold for the halo's distance. They are the default…

Gold Forever0.17.0 (2026-11-04)
• Coin looted fast is kept. With auto-loot, looting several corpses in a row could leave a corpse's
loot with no coin while the money still arrived. A coin rise no loot window took is now given to the
window whose coin it is, if it comes within two seconds; no rise is counted twice.
Loot in old raids where the game gives no map, such as Molten Core, now records the instance it
was looted in.
• The mail panel no longer covers an opened mail. The Gold Forever box at the mailbox now sits under
the inbox, or to its left when there is no room below, never where the opened mail shows. When a mail
opens, closes or is moved by another mail addon, the box moves out of its way, at any UI scale.
• Mobs whose tooltip the game hides are no longer looked up every session (retail). Retail hides
the tooltip of a mob looted in a delve or dungeon, even after the loading screen out of it. Such a mob
is now left alone for 10 sessions, or until you loot it outside an instance. Where the tooltip can be
read, the mob is filled as before.
• Stale prices show beside the window's X. While everyone's prices are over a day old, the main
window shows it small, in the look's warning colour, left of its close button: "Prices 38 h old", then
in days from two days. It goes once fresh prices are loaded, as the login warning does.
• Previous and Next under the wide Sell list. In the Sell tab's wide layout, when your items fill
more than one page, Previous and Next buttons and the page you are on (such as "2 / 4") sit under the
list at its right. Each is off at its end; the mouse wheel still pages. The narrow layout is unchanged.
• The auction house's Sell tab can be wide. A Wide button beside Rule › on the Sell tab widens the
panel: the list of items to sell gets more rows and more width, and the chosen item's prices, listings
and Post button stand in a column beside it. Narrow brings back the layout you know. Your choice is
remembered. Only the Sell tab widens, never over the auction house; where the screen has too little
room beside it at your UI scale, the tab stays narrow and says so.
• Mobs from delves and dungeons get their creature type (retail). The game shows a mob's type on
its own line under "Level ?? (Elite)"; that line is now read, so a delve's mobs are stored as Beast,
Humanoid and so on rather than with no type. A mob already stored without a type gets it the next
time you loot it, after the loading screen when you loot it in an instance.
• Every auction house sale's gold is tagged mail+sale. When gold from several mails taken quickly
arrived in one step, only the first mail was tagged and the rest was left plain mail; each mail's gold
is now its own Ledger row with its own kind.
• /gf probe opens a box to copy from. Its lines now also show in the same copy box as /gf check,
already selected, so Ctrl+C takes them whole to paste into an issue or a chat. Escape closes it.
• Mobs named later get their creature type and level more often (retail). A mob looted in an
instance and named afterwards now takes its type from its tooltip's own words when the game's list of
creature types doesn't name it, and a level the game colours by difficulty is read as a level. A mob
shown at level ?? still gets no level. /gf probe now shows the last looted mob's whole tooltip.
• Gold taken from mail says what kind of mail it was. The Ledger's mail rows now tell an auction
house sale (mail+sale), a bid given back when outbid or the auction was cancelled (mail+outbid), other
auction house mail (mail+auction), mail from an NPC, the game or a GM (mail+npc) and a player's mail
(mail+player); gold from your own characters stays mail+transfer. Only the kind is kept, never a
sender's name or a subject. Plain mail is left only when the kind can't be told.
• The guild bank's gold and your rank's withdrawals are recorded. At the guild bank the addon now…
addons.description:
Records what your characters see and earn in WoW: Forever (it also loads in retail), for the
Gold Forever web app, which turns it into prices, ledgers and plans. The
addon only records; /gf export gives you the text to paste at gold-forever.app, or the
companion app uploads it for you.

It records your own characters and what you loot and scan, and never other players: auction
owners and bidders are not read. The web app's privacy page:
.

Gold Forever0.16.1 (2026-10-25)
• Text takes the same room in every look. Web and Arcane size their text so a line is as wide as in
Classic, measured in game against Friz Quadrata at login. The Scan tab's "Scan when I open the auction
house" no longer runs out of the panel in Web.
0.16.0 (2026-10-25)
The auction house tools and a new window. Gold Forever gets a panel beside the auction house (scan, post,
shop, cancel undercut, rules and sale profiles), a hub window with pages for your money, characters,
crafting, sessions and rares, three looks to choose from, a session HUD, and more in your tooltips.
The auction house
• A panel beside the auction house (/gf ah hides or brings it back). Its Buy, Sell and Auctions tabs
follow Blizzard's and move them. It opens on Scan when a full scan may start, else on the tab
Blizzard's window shows. Prices show gold and
silver, as the auction house sets them.
• Scan: the full scan made visible: asking, reading N of M, the cooldown and the last result. A
scan starts when you press Scan now, or by itself on opening if you switch "Scan when I open the
auction house" on.
After a scan, one chat line names your list items now listed at or under your price.
• Sell: the items in your bags the auction house takes, each priced by your rule against the
cheapest listing by someone else, with the reason (Undercut, No one else, Normal price, At floor,
Under your floor). The floor and normal price are measured against the item's 7-day average where
the shared prices have one, so a day's dip does not move them. An item held under your floor can be
posted anyway at the undercut price, on a second press. Click Post or press Space; it waits for the
server, then moves to the next item. A price under
vendor value or far under the market asks for a second press. The duration and the quantity you
choose are remembered for each item. Alt-click an item in your bags to choose it; its tooltip says
what Post would ask.
• Buy: a shopping list's items with what can be bought at your price; click one to see its
listings. Buy next asks the auction house for the price and a second press buys; a price more
than 10% above the deal is named first. Edit lists › opens the Shopping lists page.
• Auctions: checks your auctions against other players' listings and cancels the most undercut
one a press, past your tolerance (5% at first), showing the cancel cost. Click one to see its
listings in Blizzard's window.
• Shopping lists, a page of the window (Trading → Shopping lists): make, rename, delete, import and
export lists (GFL1: strings); add an item by dropping it on the slot or shift-clicking it anywhere;
for each, the most you pay (under market, a fixed price, or a share of the market value) and how many
you want in all, bags and bank counted. Lowest, ask over % is for what you need (raid consumables):
Buy next buys the cheapest first, and above your share of the market value it asks before buying, so
you can choose something cheaper instead. The craft queue's list is there too, its prices set the same way.
• Selling rules, a page of the window (Trading → Selling rules; Rule › on the Sell tab opens it
for the item in view): undercut by 1 silver or a percentage, a floor and a normal price as shares of
the market value, and hold or post at the floor, each with a line saying what it does, and beside them
what the rule does to an item worth 10g. Rule for adds a rule for one item or a whole category.
Sale profiles (GFP1: strings, made at gold-forever.app/me/lists or shared by others) price the
items they name: keep this many, undercut, a fixed price or a point in the supply, with a floor; their
buy rules become a list in the Buy tab.
• With the companion app, lists and profiles you keep on gold-forever.app come into the game (the
newer edit wins).
• Prices are whole silver unless the auction house takes copper (the addon asks the game). One or two…

cheap units more than 30% under the next price are ignored when pricing ("sneaky prices"), the same way
in Sell, Auctions and the sale profiles.
• The panel's title row says what your bank and mailbox hold that the auction house pays for; a click
opens the Bank tab: click an item to see its listings, then Take all or Take… an amount;…

Gold Forever0.14.1
• Retail: the rare announcer is off for now. Retail's cities are full of minimap markers for ordinary NPCs,
and it took them for rares. /gf rares says so. WoW: Forever is unchanged.
• Every item an auction scan names now reaches the item catalogue: about half were lost when the
catalogue's queue was emptied while a scan was still adding to it.
• Retail: each auction scan records every item's class and, when the client knows it, its stack size,
so commodities and gear are told apart even before the catalogue has loaded the item.
0.14.0
• Retail: auction scans are filed under the connected realm group, as retail's auction house trades gear,
so prices from every realm of the group meet in one market. WoW: Forever is unchanged.
0.13.2
• Retail: the addon is no longer out of date on patch 12.1.5 (interface 120105).
• The first release from the addon's own repository, github.com/gold-forever/addon.
0.13.1
• The website moved to gold-forever.app. /gf export and the addon's notes name the new address; the
old one forwards there.
0.13.0
• /gf claim : prove a character is yours when another Gold Forever account uploaded it first.
Get the code on the website's Characters page.
0.12.0
• /gf export: a text to paste at gold-forever.evensberget.com/me/upload, so you can upload without
finding the saved file.
• Loads in retail as well as WoW: Forever.
Earlier
• A window (/gf ui) with your characters, levelling, ledger, mobs and inventory.
• A loot appraiser while you farm: gold per hour, XP per hour and bag space.
• At a vendor: what to vendor, post or disenchant. Alerts for big drops, rares and quest starters.
• A shopping list of profitable crafts at the auction house.
• Records your characters, loot, auction scans, your own auctions and sales, for the website.

addons.description:
Forever Game Suit is a campfire arcade addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001).

It adds four short minigames built around campfire downtime while keeping the presentation close to the native WoW Forever client. The addon deliberately prefers Blizzard/Forever frames, fonts, buttons, icons and UI textures instead of generic custom fantasy artwork.

> Current version: 3.5.0

📦 Download Forever Game Suit v3.5.0
•
Release notes
Interface preview
The hub, highscores and options stay inside the same compact Blizzard-style window so the addon feels like one coherent part of the WoW Forever UI.
GamesPolymorph Chicken Run
Run, jump and survive the campfire timer while the route becomes increasingly chaotic.
• Bombs, rockets and meteors
• Event waves and recognizable hazard patterns
• Near-miss and combo bonuses
• Power-ups
• Layered scrolling scenery
• Final Meltdown phase
Murloc Lotus Hunt
Guide a growing Murloc through the bog while collecting Lotus flowers and avoiding hazards.
• Lotus streak system
• Golden Lotus bonuses
• Connected growing Murloc body
• Bog hazards and warning phases
• Increasing speed and difficulty
• Final Hunt phase
Gnomeregan Block-Matrix
A Gnomeregan-themed falling-block minigame with modern quality-of-life features.
• Ghost piece
• Hard Drop
• Hold piece
• Three-piece preview
• 7-bag generation
• Combos and Back-to-Back bonuses
• Lock delay and wall kicks
• Hold A / D for continuous movement
• Pressure, Overdrive and Meltdown phases
Goblin Circuit Breaker
A Goblin-engineering Arrow Jam puzzle. Remove directional components only when their escape path is clear.
• Solvable randomized boards
• Frozen components
• Repair nodes
• Golden bonus arrows
• Combo scoring
• Increasing puzzle density and difficulty
Campfire Arcade
The default round lasts 60 seconds and can be changed from the built-in Options panel.

While a minigame is active, the addon captures the relevant movement keys so your character remains seated at the campfire. ESC pauses and resumes the current game.
Highscores
Each game keeps its own highscore. Forever Game Suit also supports guild score sharing so guild members can compare results.

Your own highscores can be reset from Options → Maintenance. A confirmation dialog prevents accidental resets.
Options
Options stay directly inside the Forever Game Suit hub and use native WoW-style controls.

Current settings include:
• Game sounds
• Round duration
• Highscore reset
• Addon version/status information
Controls
Controls are shown on each game's start screen. Common controls include:
• A / D — movement
• SPACE — jump / hard drop depending on the game
• E — hold piece in Block-Matrix
• ESC — pause / resume
Opening the addon
Use any of the following:
• /fgs
• Minimap button
• AddOn Compartment

Useful commands:
• /fgs status — show addon/campfire status
• /fgs debug — toggle debug messages

addons.description:
A fast, lightweight macro-icon search and filter addon for WoW: Forever.

Instead of scrolling through thousands of macro icons, Macro Icon Search adds a search field and quick filters directly to the normal macro icon picker.

> Current stable version: 2.10.3
> Embedded Forever icon set: 27,714 icons

Deutsche Beschreibung
Before / AfterBefore
Default WoW: Forever macro icon picker.
After
Macro Icon Search adds a search bar, color filters, class filters, profession filters, and fast browsing directly inside the macro icon picker.
Features
• Fast text search for icon filenames, e.g. fire, sword, shadow, bear
• Real pixel-color filters based on offline icon-image analysis
• 13 color filters: Red, Orange, Yellow, Gold, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple, Pink, Brown, Black, Gray, White
• Color strength levels: broad, strong (!), dominant (!!)
• Class filters: Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Shaman, Mage, Warlock, Druid
• Profession filters: Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Herbalism, Leatherworking, Mining, Skinning, Tailoring, Cooking, Fishing, First Aid, Jewelcrafting
• Combine filters with AND logic
• Right-click reset for individual quick filters
• Mouse-wheel page navigation through filtered results
• Works with the normal All Icons / Spells / Items selector
• English and German UI

How it worksText search
Most normal text searches use a pre-generated 2-/3-character filename index.

Instead of scanning all 27,714 icons for every search, the addon first narrows the search to a much smaller candidate set and then verifies only those icons.

addons.changelog:
TerrainMap 1.36.6
Two downloads; install one of them:
• TerrainMap-1.36.6.zip (531 MB, 798 MB unpacked): the full map. Every land tile is a picture of the terrain, buildings and props seen by a tilted camera, sharp close up.
• TerrainMap-1.36.6-topdown.zip (226 MB, 355 MB unpacked): the game's own minimap images seen straight down, with the same light, water colour and lamps laid over them.

Routes, the guide, caves, building interiors, the capitals' maps, labels and the battleground maps are the same in both.
New since 1.28.14
• Free zoom and panning (on by default): the mouse wheel zooms smoothly from the whole world down to street level, and the map drags anywhere, across the sea too. A left click flies into the city or zone under the cursor, a right click out to the map above. The open map follows what you look at, so quest and other addons' pins come with it, and it reopens where you closed it. Untick Free zoom and panning in the eagle eye's right-click menu (or /tmap zoom standard) for the standard map's zooming and clicks.
• The map in 3D (full download): tilted pictures of every land tile, with sharp 1024-pixel close-ups when zoomed in.
• Capitals: Stormwind, Ironforge, Darnassus, Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff and Undercity fade into their painted city maps as you zoom in on them, so streets, halls and the cities under the ground show.
• Battlegrounds: Alterac Valley, Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin and Darkspear Islands show their terrain.
• Search knows Forever's world: every NPC and monster the Forever server spawns can be found, Riverglades' and Zephras Isle's included, at the spot it stands, under the name Forever gives it; a monster spawned all over a zone is found at its pack nearest you. Friendly NPCs that showed as hostile (some innkeepers and stable masters) don't any more.
• Routes to Forever's new NPCs (Zephras Isle and the new quest givers) end on the floor the NPC stands on, not on a ramp or tower above them.
• Flights follow the live client's routes (build 70707).
• Lamps stay lit when zoomed in at night.
• Much less CPU while nothing is moving.
• Nordrassil and the Dream Bough no longer hide everything round them.
ForeverGear 0.4.0 (data for client 1.60.1.70707)
Lists every item your character can use in each slot, ranked by stat weights from the Forever simulator, with each item's gain over what you wear, its level and where it comes from. /fg opens it.
• Gear lists rebuilt for the live client: 52 new items, 117 with changed stats, and the 297 items Forever removed from the game are gone.
• PvP and battleground gear stays hidden until launch (4 Nov, 15:00 PST) and opens by itself; raid gear opens when its raid does.
• Extract the whole zip: ForeverGear plus one ForeverGear_ folder per class.
RXPSkin 1.2.0
• Smaller navigator text under the arrow (/rxpskin navfont 14 for bigger).
• Turns off the game's new-player tutorials; the guide does their job.
Install
Download a ZIP below, not the automatic "Source code" archives.

Exit the game, delete the old Interface/AddOns/TerrainMap folder, extract the ZIP into Interface/AddOns, then start the game. The official Forever client's folder is forever/Interface/AddOns. The result must be AddOns/TerrainMap/TerrainMap.toc, not nested inside another folder. Leave WTF alone to keep your settings. RXPSkin needs RestedXP (RXPGuides). SHA-256 checksums are attached.

FishingForever is a lightweight, quality-of-life fishing addon for WoW Forever. It streamlines casting, managing lures, and alt-tabbing so you never miss a catch!
Features
• Double-Right-Click to Fish: Forget about dragging the Fishing skill to your action bars! Simply double-right-click anywhere while you have a fishing pole equipped to cast your line.

Usage
• Equip a fishing pole.
• Double Right-Click to start fishing.
• If a lure is required, select one from the popup menu.
• Options Panel: Configure the addon settings from the WoW AddOns Options panel.

addons.description:
> See, before you pull, who in your party has already done this quest.

You're grouped with a friend. You walk up to an NPC and there's a quest. Do they
need it too, or are you about to drag them through content they finished months ago?

Quest Together Forever answers that. It asks everyone in your group about the quest you are
looking at, and shows you who has already completed it.

> Status: v0.0.4 — early prototype. Chat-driven, plus a status popup and a settings page.
> The addon-message round-trip between two real clients is not yet verified
> (see docs/TESTING.md). What works today and what is only
> planned are listed separately below.

How it works, in one paragraph
Quest completion is stored server-side and is never sent to other players' clients,
so there is nothing to query about a groupmate's quest history. Quest Together Forever works
the only way it can: each client answers questions about its own character, over
addon-to-addon messages, within the group.

Everyone in the group runs the addon. That is the premise of the design, not a
caveat attached to it.

"We don't know" is never rendered as "no." A false ✗ would send you and a friend
on a quest one of you has already finished — the exact failure this addon exists to
prevent.

What you see for a group member:

| Situation | v0.0.4 (today) | Planned |
|---|---|---|
| Peer running the addon, answered | yes / no / on it now | ✓ / ✗ / ◈ glyphs |
| Peer running the addon, no answer (yet, or timed out) | ? (no answer) | ? with a "no response" hint |
| Peer on an incompatible protocol revision | ? (incompatible addon version) | same, with an "outdated" hint |
| Peer not running the addon | ? (no addon heard from) | ? with a "no addon" hint |
| Peer who has left the group | Dropped on roster change | same |
| Nobody else in the group has the addon | Every member ?, above the hint "None of your group has Quest Together Forever." | same |
| You're solo | Popup shows your own state only, under "Not in a group." | same |

The list is driven by the group roster, so every member of your group gets a
line whether or not they run the addon — and each "?" is worded differently, so
you can always tell why an answer is missing. None of them is ever rendered
as "no".

What it doesWorks today (v0.0.4)
• Status popup beside the quest frame. Open a quest at an NPC: the popup slides
out from under the quest frame, on the quest's own parchment, and shows your own
completion state (live from the client) and one line per group member, taken from
the roster so that nobody is silently missing.
• Auto-ask. Opening a quest — offered, in progress or ready to turn in — asks the
group about it, silently: the answers appear in the popup, not in chat. Every
opening asks afresh, so the popup shows what is true now, not a cached answer.
• Chat output. For /qtf only: answers print live as they arrive. After 3 seconds
the members who did not answer are listed — nobody is printed twice.
• "On it now". A peer who has the quest in their log but has not completed it is
reported separately from a plain "no".

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon that adds small colored circular chat channel buttons next to the chat tab for quick channel switching.
Features
• Circular color-coded buttons anchored above the chat tab
• Supports: Say, Yell, Guild, Officer, Party, Raid, and Instance Chat
• Buttons are shown/hidden automatically based on your current group and guild status:
• Guild and Officer — visible only when in a guild (Officer requires officer permissions)
• Party — visible only when in a party (not a raid)
• Raid — visible only when in a raid
• Instance Chat — visible only when in an instance group
• Clicking a button opens the chat box pre-filled with the correct slash command (e.g. /g )
• Favorite numbered text channels (/1 through /20), including zone and player-created channels
• Custom channel favorites follow changing channel numbers automatically and hide while unavailable
• Prepared phrase bubbles with custom text, tooltip, and color
• Clicking a phrase bubble inserts its text at the chat cursor without sending it
• Prepared Phrases can keep the current chat or switch to a preferred built-in channel before inserting their text
• Configurable handling for existing non-empty chat drafts when a phrase prefers another channel
• Built-in chats, numbered channel Favorites, and Prepared Phrases are separated by a shared configurable 10–60 px group gap
• Built-in chats, numbered channel Favorites, and Prepared Phrases can be arranged in any group order
• Optional button labels identify built-in chats, current numbered channels, and prepared phrases by their tooltip initial
• Optional comfortable click targets provide a minimum 20 px interaction area without enlarging the colored circles
• Colors match WoW's built-in ChatTypeInfo theme
• Movable frame — drag the button bar anywhere on screen; position is saved across sessions
• Compatible with ElvUI
Moving the Button Bar
The bar is locked by default. Use these slash commands to reposition it:

| Command | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| /ecb unlock | Unlocks the frame for dragging (yellow tint visible) |
| /ecb lock | Locks the frame and saves its position |

Position is stored in ECB_DB and restored automatically on login.
Settings and Accessibility
Open the addon settings with /ecb. Appearance controls adjust bubble size, spacing, group spacing, and bar orientation. Button Group Order arranges Built-ins, Numbered Channels, and Prepared Phrases from left to right in horizontal layout or top to bottom in vertical layout. The Built-in Buttons grid uses checked boxes for buttons that should be shown whenever their chat type is available.

Show Button Labels is disabled by default. When enabled, built-in chats show their abbreviation, numbered channels show their current local number, and Prepared Phrases show the first character of their explicit Tooltip. Phrases without an explicit Tooltip remain unlabeled. Comfortable Click Targets is also disabled by default and gives small bubbles a non-overlapping minimum 20 px click area.
Custom Channels
Open the addon settings with /ecb, then click Manage Custom Channels. The manager lists saved favorites and currently available numbered text channels. Add an available channel directly or enter a channel name or active /N manually.

On the first launch with this feature, the addon adds all currently available numbered text channels to Favorites once. If the first discovery happens in an instance or another location with no available supported channels, initialization waits and retries after the next channel or zone update. Favorites are stored by channel name and stable zone-channel identity rather than by their temporary number. If a channel becomes unavailable after changing zones or characters, its button is hidden but the favorite remains saved and returns automatically when the channel is available again. Community streams are not included, and the addon never joins or leaves channels.

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon for WoW: Forever, Classic Era and Retail. It puts the damage (or healing) of each spell on your action buttons and adds a line or two to the spell tooltip. The numbers come from the spell's own description, in English or German, whichever each text is in; an optional estimate adds your spell power, at the share the game's own spell data gives each spell on WoW: Forever and Classic Era (Classic's coefficient rules for a spell the data does not cover), and says so. Debuffs that lower the enemy's damage or attack power, such as Curse of Weakness or Demoralizing Shout, show the reduction in red ("-3", "-10%"). A lower attack power shows what it takes off each hit of your target, "-7" for -50 attack power on a target that attacks every 2 seconds (14 attack power are 1 damage per second of its attack speed), or "-50 AP" while that speed is not known, as in combat on a target you had not selected before.

Abilities that hit with your weapon (Heroic Strike, Maul, Claw, Shred, Sinister Strike, Aimed Shot and the like) show their potential damage in blue: your weapon's average hit, times the ability's percentage, plus its bonus. Spells that raise attack power (Battle Shout, Rockbiter Weapon, Blessing of Might, Seal of the Crusader, Bear and Cat Form, Aspect of the Hawk) show what they add to each hit, as "+103". Both are estimates from your weapon's numbers, read out of combat, and the tooltip says so; /sdi weapon off turns them off. /sdi misses lists the spells on your bars that give no number, which is the list to send when something is missing.

Seals show what they add to every hit (Seal of Righteousness and Flametongue Weapon, whose texts give a range for all weapon speeds, at your weapon's speed), and Judgement shows the damage of the seal that is active. Effects that trigger by chance (Windfury, Seal of Command, Seal of Light, poisons, Frostbrand) show what one trigger does, and the tooltip gives the chance. Shields show what they absorb (in purple), finishers their damage at five combo points with the other points in the tooltip, and totems, Lay on Hands, Execute and Mana Burn what their descriptions work out to (a totem's or trap's number gets no spell power estimate: it is the totem's own spell, which the data does not name). /sdi dump writes your spellbook's descriptions, as your client shows them, to the saved variables, for testing; /sdi dump all does the same for every class's abilities.

The pet bar shows the pet's spells too (the Imp's Firebolt, for example), with the numbers from the description only, since the pet has its own spell power.

The numbers are drawn on Blizzard's own action bars, the pet bar and Forever's Totem Bar. Bars from Bartender4, ElvUI and other addons built on LibActionButton get none (/sdi status says so when one is loaded); the tooltip lines work with them all the same.

On Retail, whose descriptions already include your stats, the numbers are the descriptions' own: the spell power estimate and the weapon arithmetic are off there.

The addon's interface language (labels, chat messages, number formatting) can be switched independently of the game language via the settings window or /sdi lang auto|en|de. Auto follows the game's language.

Install: unzip SpellDamageInfo-0.7.3.zip into Interface\AddOns of your game folder (_classic_beta_ for Forever, _classic_era_ for Classic Era, retail for Retail), then restart the game: a new addon folder is only picked up at start. Type /sdi (or open Options > AddOns > SpellDamageInfo) for the settings window, with a live preview of the numbers on a sample button; /sdi help lists the commands, such as the size (/sdi size 50-200) and place (/sdi position bottom|center|top) of the numbers.

Inspired by DrDamage by Gagorian. The options window is adapted from DoesItDie by Joe Greive (MIT). Licence: MIT (see LICENSE).
