addons.description:
Chess, cards, dice, puzzles and more, inside World of Warcraft.

Play your guildies and friends one move at a time, or play on your own.

Forever Games is an addon for playing games with your guildies and friends. You challenge
someone, make your move, and go back to whatever you were doing. They answer whenever they're next
online, even if that's tomorrow. When it's your turn again, the addon lets you know.

Nobody around? Nearly every game for two or more can be played against the computer, and there are
puzzles and solo games with a new challenge for your guild every day.
• Install
• The games
• Getting started
• Playing with other people
• How to play each game
• Commands and options
• Good to know
• Making a game of your own
Install
1. Download ForeverGames-.zip from the
latest release.
2. Unzip it into Interface\AddOns, inside the folder for the version of the game you play in your
World of Warcraft folder. Create the AddOns folder if it isn't there.
3. You should now have eight folders there: ForeverGames, ForeverGames_Freedoom,
ForeverGames_Freedoom_Maps, ForeverGames_Pinball, ForeverGames_Runeweave,
ForeverGames_Starfall, ForeverGames_Where and ForeverGames_Where_Places. Keep all eight.
Freedoom, Pinball, Runeweave, Starfall and Where in Azeroth are addons of their own. ForeverGames_Freedoom_Maps holds
Freedoom's maps and ForeverGames_Where_Places the places of Where in Azeroth, which is why
the download is large. The maps are only loaded when you play Freedoom, and a place's pictures
only when you are taken there.
4. Restart the game if it was running, and check Forever Games is ticked in the AddOns list on the
character screen.

To update, unzip the new version over the old one. Your games in progress and your best times are
kept.

Everyone you play needs the addon too. Try to stay on the same version as your friends: if yours
differ, the challenge tells you.
The gamesWith friends, or against the computer
| | Game | Players | |
|---|---|---|---|
| | Chess | 2 | Take as long as you like between moves. |
| | Checkers | 2 | Jump to capture, reach the far side to be crowned. |
| | Reversi | 2 | Trap discs between yours to flip them. |
| | Mancala | 2 | Sow seeds round the board, land in your store to go again. |
| | Connect Four | 2 | Four in a row: across, up or diagonal. |
| | Nim | 2 | Take stones from one row a turn, and take the last. |
| | Dominoes | 2 | The classic Block game, to 100 over several hands, or the Draw game. |
| | Tic Tac Toe | 2 | Over in a minute. |
| | Battleship | 2 | Hide your fleet, then hunt for theirs. |
| | Backgammon | 2 | Race your checkers home by the roll of the dice. |
| | Chinese Checkers | 2, 3, 4 or 6 | Hop your marbles across the star. |
| | CarcassonneWoW | 2 to 5 | Lay tiles to build Elwynn Forest, and put footmen on its towns, roads, abbeys and fields to score them. |
| | Crazy Eights | 2 to 6 | Match the suit or the rank. Eights are wild. |
| | Words with Warcraft | 2 to 4 | A Scrabble-style word game where Azeroth's names count, and score extra. |
| | Yacht-Z | 1 to 4 | Five dice, three rolls, thirteen boxes to fill. |
| | Wormcraft | 2 to 4 | Artillery the way Worms played it, with fireballs, grenades and sheep. |
On your own
| | Game | Daily challenge | Race a friend | |
|---|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| | Solitaire | Yes | | Klondike. |
| | FreeCell | Yes | Yes | Every card face up, four free cells. Microsoft's numbered deals. |
| | Minesweeper | Yes | Yes | Three field sizes, best time kept for each. |
| | Sudoku | Yes | Yes | A fresh puzzle every time, Easy to Expert. |
| | 2048 | Yes | | Slide and merge tiles. Boards of 3, 4 or 5. |
| | Tetris | Yes | Yes | Marathon, 40-line Sprint, or two minutes for points. |
| | Warcraftstein 3D | Yes | Yes | Fight through the Scarlet Monastery in first person, as your own class. |
| | Freedoom | | Yes | The free version of Doom, drawn inside WoW. Race the ghost of your best run. |…

addons.description:
Auto-play music during Bloodlust / Heroism / Time Warp

Features
• Automatically plays start music when Bloodlust, Heroism, Time Warp, or similar raid-wide haste buffs are cast
• Automatically plays end music when the buff fades away
• Supports all Bloodlust-family spells:
• Bloodlust / Heroism
• Time Warp (Mage)
• Ancient Hysteria / Primal Rage (Hunter)
• Fury of the Aspects (Evoker)
• Custom audio file support — use your own MP3 files (see Custom Audio)
• Independent duration control for start and end music
• Audio channel selection: Master, Music, SFX, Ambience, Dialog
• Built-in volume slider per channel
• Multi-select dropdown — choose multiple audio files, random playback each time
• Preview on click — instantly preview a file by selecting it in the dropdown
• Standalone preview buttons for start and end music
• Stops playback automatically on player death
• Stops playback on UI reload or logout
• Clean Blizzard settings panel (/bl or /blm)
• Lightweight, no unnecessary libraries or dependencies
Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| /bl or /blm | Open BLMusic settings panel |
How to Use
1. Install the addon and type /bl to open settings
2. Select start and end music files from the multi-select dropdowns (choose multiple for random playback)
3. Set playback duration for each (how many seconds before auto-stop)
4. Optionally select audio channel and adjust volume
5. Next time Bloodlust/Heroism/Time Warp is cast in your group, the music plays automatically!
Custom Audio
Simply dropping a file into the Media/ folder is not enough — you must also register it in MediaTable.lua so it shows up in the in-game dropdown.

1. Put your audio file into the Media/ folder
2. Open MediaTable.lua and register the file in the matching list:
• ns.start — start music (Bloodlust/Heroism/Time Warp begins)
• ns["end"] — end music (buff fades)
• ns.pi — Power Infusion music (file name must start with pi-)
3. Add an entry in that list, e.g. { path = "yourfile.mp3", name = "Display Name" }
4. /reload the UI — the file now appears in the dropdown for selection

Supported formats: MP3 / OGG.

中文说明功能特色
• 施放嗜血 / 英勇 / 时间扭曲等团队加速技能时自动播放开始音频
• 效果消失时自动播放结束音频
• 支持所有嗜血系技能：嗜血、英勇、时间扭曲（法师）、远古狂乱/原始狂怒（猎人）、巨龙之怒（唤魔师）
• 支持自定义音频文件：放入 Media 文件夹并在 MediaTable.lua 登记后，即可在下拉菜单中选择（详见下方"自定义音频"）
• 开始音频和结束音频可分别设置播放时长
• 音频通道可选：主音量 / 音乐 / 音效 / 环境 / 对话
• 内置音量滑块，快速调节当前通道音量
• 多选模式：可同时选择多个音频文件，播放时随机选取
• 试听模式：勾选时自动播放预览，也可通过独立试听按钮播放
• 死亡时自动停止播放，重载/退出时自动停止
• 使用暴雪原生设置面板，简洁轻量
使用方法
1. 安装插件后输入 /bl 打开设置界面
2. 从多选下拉菜单中分别选择开始/可用时音频（可多选，随机播放）
3. 设置各自的播放时长（多少秒后自动停止）
4. 可选音频通道和音量
5. 下次团队开嗜血/英勇时，音乐自动响起！
自定义音频
仅把音频文件放进 Media/ 文件夹是不够的，还需要在 MediaTable.lua 中登记，才能在游戏内下拉菜单里显示出来。

1. 将音频文件放入 Media/ 文件夹
2. 打开 MediaTable.lua，把文件登记到对应列表：
• ns.start — 开始音乐（嗜血/英勇/时间扭曲施放时）
• ns["end"] — 结束音乐（效果消失时）
• ns.pi — 能量灌注音乐（文件名必须以 pi- 开头）
3. 在对应列表中新增一条，例如 { path = "你的文件.mp3", name = "显示名称" }
4. 重载界面 /reload，即可在下拉菜单中选择

支持格式：MP3 / OGG。
作者
简繁 — 无尽之海 (CN)

如需自定义音频或反馈问题，请在 /bl 设置中点击"联系作者"，或发送邮件至 32655163@qq.com

addons.changelog: Full Changelog: https://github.com/jkloss4/advanced-graphics/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
addons.description:
Graphics settings for World of Warcraft that aren't in the game's options menus, on one options page
(Options → AddOns → Advanced Graphics) in Blizzard's settings style.

Retail (Interface 120100) and WoW: Forever (Interface 16001). Settings a client doesn't have are left off the page:
the HDR section and Linear Lighting / Bloom are WoW: Forever only.
Settings
• HDR (WoW: Forever): HDR output, highlight strength, and overrides for peak brightness and paper white (nits).
• Lighting: Linear Lighting and Bloom (WoW: Forever), surface shine, light draw distance.
• Sharpening: sharpen even without FSR upscaling, sharpness amount, crisper CMAA2 anti-aliasing.
• World Detail: ground clutter density, distance and fade, weather density, cloud detail, object detail and fade
distance, footprints, soft edges.
• Distance & Detail: how far terrain, buildings and characters keep full detail, where the distant landscape
begins, small-object culling and keep distance, and full-quality (uncompressed) character textures.
• Screen Effects: full-screen glow, the gray death effect, the nether effect.

Each control reads and sets the game's own setting (console variable), so the game saves it in its config; the addon
saves nothing. Defaults puts every setting on the page back to the game's default. Some of these (clutter,
object detail) are also set by the menus' quality presets, so moving the matching menu slider later replaces them.

Slash commands: /advancedgraphics or /advgfx (opens the options).
addons.name: advanced-graphics

addons.description:
Sets the font size of chat bubbles in World of Warcraft, including the speech bubbles NPCs use while questing and
players' /say and /yell bubbles (they all share Blizzard's ChatBubbleFont).

Retail (Interface 120100) and WoW: Forever (Interface 16001).
Features
• Font size from 6 to 24 pt, set from Options → AddOns → BubbleFont (Blizzard's slider with arrow steppers).
• "Reset to default" returns to the game's own bubble font size.
• The size is saved and reapplied at login. Bubbles size themselves to their text when they appear, so a change
applies to every bubble shown afterwards (ones already on screen keep their size).
• The options page is built from the addon's own frames rather than Blizzard's pooled Settings controls, so it
can't taint Blizzard's own settings pages.

Slash commands: /bubblefont (options), /bubblefont (set the size), /bubblefont reset.

addons.description:
Keeps your weapons drawn in World of Warcraft when the game puts them away on its own, such as when you loot or
leave combat. Weapons you put away yourself stay away.

Retail (Interface 120100) and WoW: Forever (Interface 16001).
Features
• Drawn again after the game sheathes them. If your weapons were out and the game puts them away (looting,
leaving combat), they're drawn again once the loot window closes.
• Your choice wins. Putting them away with the Sheathe/Unsheathe key (Z by default), sitting or an emote is left
alone.
• After eating or drinking. Weapons that were out are drawn again once the food or drink is gone and you get up
and move.
• Out of the way. Mounting, druid forms and Ghost Wolf, swimming, taxis and vehicles, and dying all put weapons
away on purpose, so those are left alone too.
• Optional triggers: draw your weapons when you target an enemy, or when you enter combat.
• Sheathe after combat (optional): put your weapons away once you've been out of combat for a set delay
(0.5 to 10 seconds).
• Per character. Enable on This Character is saved per character, so it can stay off on a caster.

Options are in Options → AddOns → Smart Sheathe.

Slash commands: /smartsheathe (options), /smartsheathe on / off (this character), /smartsheathe trace (prints
what it sees and does to chat, and keeps the last 500 lines in SmartSheatheDB.traceLog in the saved variables file,
written on /reload or logout), /smartsheathe trace clear (empties the saved trace).

addons.description:
CustomNames
Adds Management of Custom Names
Managing names
Open the CustomNames window with /cn, through the Addon Compartment (Retail) or with the button under Options -> AddOns -> CustomNames.
• Right-click a player or npc (unit frames, friends list, chat, guild and community rosters) and pick CustomNames to set, change or remove a name without opening the window. For Battle.net friends the name can be set for the whole BattleTag. Bosses are not supported, their names are not available to addons.
• The window lists your names on the left. Select one to change or remove its name on the right, press Enter to save.
• Characters tab: names of single characters (Name-Realm) and npcs, colored by class once the character was seen.
• BattleTags tab: a name for a BattleTag (BattleTag#12345, your own account is always listed) applies to all characters linked to it. The linked characters are shown on the right, grouped by realm.
• Search filters the list and also finds a BattleTag by one of its characters. + Add name lets you type a name yourself, Export creates a string with all your names and Import adds the names of such a string to your list.

The chat commands still work:
Plugins
The Plugins tab of the window lists the plugins and addons that show custom names in other parts of the game. It only shows the ones that fit your setup: plugins for the default UI, plugins for addons you have enabled, and addons that support CustomNames on their own. Each entry shows whether it is active, missing, disabled or waiting for a reload. Missing plugins come with a download address and count towards the badge on the tab, unless you tick Don't suggest this plugin.
Adding your addon
Open a pull request that adds an entry to Data/Plugins.lua:
UsageCallbacks
event names: Name_Removed , Name_Update, Name_Added

Name_Removed (Name) -- will return the name in the database that got removed

Name_Updated (Name, newCustomName, oldCustomName) -- will return the name in the database, the new CustomName the database was updated to and the old CustomName as it was previously returned by the Getter functions

Name_Added (Name, customName) -- will return the name in the database aswell as the CustomName that was added

Name is always in the format Name-Realm for all player characters and Name for npc's as returned by UnitName()
Example:
Check CustomNames.lua for more code examples.

addons.description:
A WoW Cooldown Manager addon for filling the gaps of the Blizzard's
Cooldown Manager (CDM).

TerribleBuffTracker is designed to be used alongside Blizzard's CDM
instead of just replacing it, it's configured through a tab inside the
default CDM window. Positioning and style can be configured through
edit-mode, making it familiar to new users. We also offer limited
(where API restrictions allow us) support to create custom trackers to
extend the CDM, like our built-in Bloodlust tracker or the
Buff Reminders.
ShowcaseFeatures
• Merge Mode - Enable it on config via /tbt: Blizzard's Cooldown
Manager icons and bars are moved into TBT containers alongside your
own trackers. Have the CDM buffs be centred and have your custom

addons.description:
Petit site privé pour la guilde sur World of Warcraft: Forever : qui joue quoi, qui a quels métiers,
agenda des sorties. Le cahier des charges complet est dans docs/cahier-des-charges.md.
Développement local
Prérequis : uv, Node 20.19+ (ou 22), Docker.

En développement, SITE_URL vaut http://localhost:8000 et FRONTEND_URL vaut http://localhost:5173 :
l'URL de retour OAuth à déclarer côté Discord est donc http://localhost:8000/api/auth/discord/callback/.
Commandes utiles
| Où | Commande | Rôle |
|---|---|---|
| backend | uv run pytest | tests |
| backend | uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format . | lint + format |
| backend | uv run python manage.py createsuperuser | accès à /admin/ (demande un ID Discord) |
| backend | uv run python manage.py seed_gamedata | recharge les données de référence sans toucher aux ajouts manuels |
| backend | uv run python manage.py discord_setup_channels | crée les salons agenda / demande-de-craft en lecture seule et les enregistre (rejouable) |
| backend | uv run python manage.py runbot | lance le bot Discord (outbox, rappels, commandes slash, révocation, synchro de l'onglet Événements) |
| backend | uv run python manage.py import_gamedata | télécharge les tables du client WoW Forever (wago.tools) et importe objets, sets, enchantements, talents, recettes (~2 min, rejouable) |

En production : docker compose exec web python manage.py import_gamedata après la première mise en ligne, puis
à chaque patch du jeu. Les ajouts manuels faits dans l'admin (lignes « gérées à la main ») sont conservés.
| frontend | npm test / npm run lint / npm run format | tests, lint, format |
| frontend | npm run gen:api | régénère openapi.json et src/api/schema.d.ts depuis le backend |

L'API est documentée sur http://localhost:8000/api/docs/ (Swagger).

Sans application Discord, on peut tester en créant un superutilisateur puis en se connectant sur
/admin/login/ : la session est reconnue par le site.
Application Discord
Dans le Discord Developer Portal, créer une application :

1. OAuth2 : récupérer Client ID et Client Secret, ajouter l'URL de retour dans Redirects.
2. Bot : créer le bot, copier son token, activer l'intent privilégié Server Members. Inviter le bot sur le
serveur avec les scopes bot et applications.commands, et les permissions Voir les salons, *Envoyer des
messages*, Gérer les messages, Intégrer des liens, Lire l'historique, Créer des événements et
Gérer les événements (onglet Événements synchronisé avec l'agenda ; Discord sépare les deux), Gérer les salons et Gérer les rôles (commandes de
configuration). Puis manage.py discord_setup_roles et manage.py discord_setup_channels créent les rôles
et les salons #agenda / #demande-de-craft (lecture seule pour les membres) et les enregistrent dans
Guilde › Paramètres, où le GM peut aussi choisir les salons dans une liste.
3. Activer le mode développeur dans Discord pour copier l'ID du serveur, des rôles autorisés et du premier GM.

Les variables à remplir sont décrites dans deploy/.env.example.
Addon du jeu
addon/WoWForeverGuilde/ est l'addon WoW (Lua pur + LibDeflate) qui collecte la progression de chaque personnage et
produit le code d'export que le site importe (Profil › Importer depuis le jeu), ou que le compagnon enverra tout
seul. Cahier des charges, étape 11.
• Installation à la main (tant que le compagnon n'existe pas) : copier le dossier WoWForeverGuilde dans
World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns/, puis /wfg en jeu.
• Carte de la guilde : chaque membre qui coche « Partager ma position » dans /wfg apparaît en point couleur de
classe sur la carte du monde des autres (survol : nom, niveau, zone, talents ; clic : inviter ou chuchoter). Les
positions circulent par messages addon dans le canal de guilde, jamais hors du jeu. Avec : points sur la minimap,
liste « Guilde en jeu » par zone (/wfg qui, roster + positions), recherche de groupe (/wfg lfg texte) et appel à…

Changelog
All notable changes to OneKeyFishing are listed here. The format follows
Keep a Changelog and the project uses
Semantic Versioning.
[1.0.0] - 2026-10-23
First public release, for WoW Forever.
Added
• One key for the whole fishing loop: cast, hook the bobber and loot. The same key also applies a lure
(the best one in your bags that is not on cooldown) and opens fished clams and containers.
• Fishing mode: one toggle that sets up auto loot, soft-target interact, the camera and your fishing gear,
and puts everything back when you leave it, after a /reload, a disconnect or a crash.
• Gear swap: the best pole in your bags (or the one you chose) plus your extra fishing items. Only the slots
that were changed are restored. Alt+Click items in your bags to add or remove them.
• Action indicator with the next action, a cast bar, a "No bobber" warning and the session timer.
• Catch notifications.
• Statistics per session, per zone and in total: casts, catches, misses, fishing time (paused while AFK),
catch value, catches per hour and gold per hour. The window explains every row, updates when something
happens (only the time ticks while you fish), has a Refresh button and shows the date of the last
auction scan.
• Auction house scan of everything you have caught; the catch value uses the higher of the vendor and the
auction price.
• Fishing rank cap warning with where to learn the next rank.
• Minimap button and Addon Compartment entry with a menu for every action; a settings panel for every feature.
• /okf debug: a report to copy into bug reports.
• Works with a game client in any language. The interface is in English for now.
addons.description:
Fish with one key in WoW Forever: the same key casts, hooks the bobber and loots. No mouse, no clicking on the bobber.

Every action in the game is a real key press. The addon never reacts to a bite by itself, does not listen to sounds and uses no external tools, so it stays within Blizzard's add-on rules.

It works with a game client in any language. The addon's own interface is in English for now.
Features
• One key for everything: cast → hook → loot. The same key also applies a lure (the best one that is not on cooldown) and opens fished clams when needed.
• Fishing mode: one toggle that sets everything up and puts it all back afterwards.
• Gear swap: equips the best pole in your bags (or the one you chose) plus your fishing items. On exit it restores only the slots it changed.
• Auto loot while fishing, and the soft-target icon over the bobber.
• Indicator: shows what the key will do next (Cast, Hook!, Apply lure, Open), a cast bar and a warning when the bobber is in the water but not targeted.
• Catch notifications for every catch and every miss.
• Statistics: casts, catches, misses, fishing time and value of the catch. Kept per session, per zone and in total.
• Auction scan: prices of everything you have ever caught, used for the catch value.
• Rank cap warning: tells you when your Fishing rank is full and where to learn the next one.
• Camera zooms in while fishing and back afterwards.
• Safe in combat: when attacked, the weapons come back at once and fishing mode ends after the fight.
• Minimap button with a menu: every action is available without typing a command.

addons.description:
Add-on for World of Warcraft: Forever (interface 16001, client 1.60.1) that extends
the built-in Cooldown Manager:
• Custom spells: add any spell, including instants with no cooldown like Swipe, into the
Essential or Utility row next to Blizzard's icons. Each icon shows the cooldown/GCD swipe,
charges, usability and range tint, and proc glow. Icons follow your highest learned
rank (an entry for Swipe rank 1 shows rank 5 once you learn it). Unlearned spells
stay hidden. Lists are saved per class, or per class and spec if the client reports one.
• Form bars (druids): a separate Essential and Utility bar for each form (Caster, Bear,
Cat...). The bar swaps when you shift. A spell can go on several bars and forms. Spells Blizzard already shows in that bar keep Blizzard's
icon; the rest use ours.
• Centered layout (Cooldown Manager Centered behaviour): Essential/Utility rows are
centered (or left/right aligned) and grow down or up, buff icons can be centered and
buff bars grow from the top or bottom. In Edit Mode the bar's selection handle stretches to
cover the added icons too, and Edit Mode's placeholder icons are hidden once the bar has
icons of its own.
Using it in game
Custom spells are managed in Blizzard's own Cooldown Settings window (Spells tab; druids use
the form tabs instead, see Form bars below):
• Add: Not Displayed already lists every active spell you know that the Cooldown Manager
doesn't track itself (Swipe, Shred, Maul…), once each at your highest rank. Your class's
spells that you haven't learned yet (trainer spells and talents, from a built-in Classic list)
follow them, grayed out like Blizzard's own unlearned tiles; you can already place them, and
they appear on your bars once learned. Drag one into
Essential or Utility Cooldowns, at the spot you want. Drag it back to Not Displayed to stop
tracking it. For anything that isn't in your spellbook, click the + tile and type a name
or spell ID.
• Move / reorder: drag a custom tile (marked with a green dot), or click to pick it up and
click to drop, just like Blizzard's tiles. Right-click cancels a drag.
• Right-click a custom tile: move it to Essential/Utility, stop displaying it, or remove it.
• Custom tiles follow the search box. Unlearned spells show desaturated and stay off your bars.

Options (row alignment and growth, buff icons and bars, custom icon behaviour) are in
the same window: click the Advanced Cooldown Manager side tab (add-on icon) below Spells,
Auras and Group Buffs. Click one of Blizzard's tabs to go back. Esc → Options → AddOns only
links there.

Form bars (druids only, always on): Blizzard's Spells tab is replaced by one side tab per
form under Auras / Group Buffs (Caster, Bear, Cat...; the tooltip marks your current form), and
Cooldown Settings opens on your current form's tab. A form you haven't edited shows the default
layout (Blizzard's tracked cooldowns plus custom spells); your first edit saves its own copy.
Each tab works like the Spells tab:
• Essential Cooldowns, Utility Cooldowns and Not Displayed sections (click a header to
collapse it). Not Displayed lists every spell that isn't on this form's bars.
• Drag tiles to reorder, between sections to move, into Not Displayed to remove. Hold Shift
while dropping into the other bar to keep it in both. The search box filters these tabs too.
• Right-click a tile: move to / also show in the other bar, add to that bar in every form,
don't display. The + tile adds any spell by name or ID.
• Copy to... copies this form's bars to another form (or all), or resets it to the default
layout.
• Your bars' contents and order come from the form tabs. Spells Blizzard shows in a bar keep
Blizzard's icon. Dire Bear counts as Bear Form. Saved per class (or spec).

Commands: /acm opens Cooldown Settings, /acm options opens it on
the options tab, /acm add Swipe, /acm add 779 utility 3, /acm remove Swipe, /acm list, /acm formbars (druids: opens your current form's tab), /acm forms…

addons.description:
All-you-can-buff. Raid buff coordination for every class, not just paladins.

Targets World of Warcraft: Forever (interface 16001, client 1.60.1).

Buffeteria works out who casts what, and a one-click tracker serves it. Players can
choose their own buffs, while paladins can manage class blessings for the whole group,
including players who don't have Buffeteria installed. No PallyPower addon is required.
How it works
• You order, the kitchen cooks. Each player ranks the paladin blessings they want
(drag to reorder) and lights up the buffs they care about (Fortitude, Spirit, Shadow
Protection, Mark of the Wild, Arcane Intellect). In /buff, these appear as
three named panels: Blessings, Buffs (including Battle Shout for warriors
and Inner Fire for priests), and Tank role (Righteous Fury for paladins and
Thorns from a druid). Each buff row names its caster; missing casters are grey.
• Smart assignments. Paladins serve your highest available blessings, subject
to their spells and the class plan. Greater Blessings cover a whole class, so
each class gets what most of its players ranked highest. Priests, druids and mages split the raid groups by
work: a group is one cast for someone with the group spell (Prayer, Gift, Arcane
Brilliance) but one cast per player without it, so the work evens out. On a tie, a
caster keeps their own group, where they are in range. Everyone should update
together: copies that split groups differently disagree on who buffs which group.
• Personal priorities. With Use my own order ticked, put less useful
blessings at the bottom, for example Salvation while tanking. Paladins serve
your highest available blessings first. With it off, you get your class's
blessings from the shared plan, including manual assignments.
• No raid leader needed. Every copy of Buffeteria computes the same answer from the
same preferences. Players without the add-on get sensible class defaults.

Blessing rankings use larger rows. While dragging, the lifted row follows your
cursor, an outlined slot marks where it will land, and the other rows slide aside.

New installs start from a class default ranking: warriors and rogues want Might
first; mages, warlocks, priests, druids, paladins, and shamans want Wisdom first;
hunters want Kings first (Might doesn't raise ranged attack power). Kings and
Salvation follow for everyone. Might is last for mages, warlocks and priests;
Wisdom is last for warriors and rogues. All six blessings remain eligible;
lower-ranked blessings are served when enough paladins can provide them. Saved
rankings keep their blessing order when the old divider is removed.
Players without the add-on are planned from the same defaults,
and so are classes Auto and Lock in Auto picks cover on the Paladins tab. If your saved
ranking still matches the old Kings-first default, it moves to the new one; a
ranking you reordered is kept.

Warriors see Battle Shout in the Buffs panel. It is on by default; click it to
skip it. The tracker reminds you when your own shout is missing or reaches
the configured percentage of its duration left (by default, 5% of its two
minutes is six seconds), and the big button casts it once you have enough rage. Other
classes never see it, and warriors without Buffeteria aren't tracked for it.

Priests likewise see Inner Fire in the Buffs panel, on by default and skippable.
The tracker reminds you when it is missing (including after its charges run out)
or reaches the configured remaining percentage (by default, 5% of its ten
minutes is 30 seconds), and the big button casts it
once you have the mana. Other classes never see it, and priests without
Buffeteria aren't tracked for it.

Battle Shout and Inner Fire are also tracked during combat. When combat starts,
the head is set to cast your shout or Inner Fire, so if it runs low or falls off
mid-fight the head demands it and a click recasts it. Other buffs wait until combat…

releases.changelog:
• Changed Expiring below from minutes to a percentage of each buff's full
duration, adjustable from 1% to 50% and defaulting to 5%. Ten-minute Thorns
now warns at 30 seconds remaining; a one-hour buff warns at three minutes.
• Warnings use each recipient's actual aura duration, including group spell
versions and talents. Battle Shout and Inner Fire use the same percentage
setting, including while their auras are hidden in combat.

preserved. The Settings controls and tracker preview now show percentages.

• Removed Don't want, blessing exclusions, and the tracker's unwanted-buff

• Use my own order now starts enabled for new characters and after resetting

• Tracker icons, counts and expressions now follow your assigned buffs. Other

to you makes it angry until your missing buffs are served.

• Simplified Blessings preferences with one Use my own order checkbox.
The saved ranking greys out when unused, and the panel names the blessings
you receive. Hover a row to see its caster or why nobody can provide it.
• Added the Extra tab and Resurrect with the head, enabled by default.
Priests, paladins, shamans and druids can resurrect nearby dead group members,
including players who released, before buffing and outside combat. Players
who can resurrect are served first; feigning hunters and players already
being resurrected are skipped. Mana, reagents and Rebirth cooldown are checked.
• Added None (clean) to the head menu for a tracker with just small buff
icons and a plain cast button that appears when you have something to cast.
Drag a small icon when unlocked to move it, or use Edit Mode. The Settings
preview follows the selected style.

• Fixed paladins never recognizing each other: this client names addon-message
senders "Name Realm" instead of "Name-Realm", so no message matched a group
member. Every other paladin stayed Unverified, edits were discarded, and each
client planned Kings for its own paladin. Both forms now resolve to the same player.
• Normal parties and raids now always use party or raid chat, and a message the
client rejects is reported once instead of holding back every later message.
• Added /buff sync to show the sync channel, sent and failed messages, and who

addons.description:
A local-first Windows companion for World of Warcraft: Forever. It backs up
and restores your WTF folder, tracks your characters and gold, adds alt-aware
item tooltips through the ForeverBuddy addon, turns addons on or off per
character, and shows your macros. Its core features work offline, with your data kept on your PC.

> Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft
> and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of
> Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

Built with Tauri 2, React, Tailwind CSS 4,
shadcn/ui, and the Warcraft-styled components from
warcraftcn/ui (MIT).

Specs and the addon bible live in the wow-forever-buddy mycelium room (context/specs/, procedures/addon-bible/).
Offline by design
Everything the UI needs ships inside the app — no CDN, no Google Fonts:
• The warcraftcn components and their art live in
src/components/ui/warcraftcn/. Their stylesheet originally hot-linked
images from warcraftcn.com; it now points at the local copies.
• Fonts (Cinzel, Geist) come from @fontsource packages and are bundled at
build time.

If you add more warcraftcn components, check the new files for https://
URLs, and fetch binary assets straight from the GitHub repo — the shadcn CLI
has corrupted the .webp files it installed from the warcraftcn registry.
Develop
Needs Node 20+ and Rust (plus the
Tauri prerequisites for your OS).
Releases
Publishing a GitHub release runs .github/workflows/release.yml, which builds
on Windows and attaches to the release:
• WoW Forever Buddy__x64-setup.exe — installer
• WoW Forever Buddy__x64_en-US.msi — MSI installer
• a plain .exe — portable, runs without installing (needs WebView2, which
ships with Windows 10 and 11)

Bump version in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (and package.json) before
tagging. Start the release notes from .github/release-notes-template.md,
which carries the not-affiliated notice. The builds are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen will warn the first
time you run one: More info → Run anyway.

EasyFishv2.8.7 (2026-10-07)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Window shows with the pole for upgraders; double-click works on pools
• The status window never appeared for players who had hidden it in an
older version: the minimap right-click and /fish show used to flip
showFrame, which 2.8.6 reads as "never show the window". showFrame is
reset to on once (windowSettingsV2).
• Double right-click refused to cast while any world-object tooltip was
under the cursor, which includes fishing pools, and a tooltip still
fading out could block it at random. Pools (recognised by name) never
block now; other objects (herbs, chests) still do, and so does an
active cast such as herb gathering started by the first click.
• Sync watcher: Windows can drop change notifications, and it missed
nine saves in a row. Every 15 s it now also compares the save's
timestamp and syncs anything it missed.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
addons.description:
Everything a fishing addon is allowed to do, and nothing it isn't. EasyFish never detects the bite or clicks the

key; everything else is information.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5

EasyFishv2.8.6 (2026-09-28)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Status window appears with the fishing pole
The window is no longer on screen all the time: it shows when a fishing
pole is equipped (PLAYER\_EQUIPMENT\_CHANGED) and hides when it comes
off. New setting "Only while a fishing pole is equipped" (autoShow,
default on) under Window; "Show status window" stays the master switch.
Minimap right-click and /fish show toggle it by hand until the pole
next goes on or off. The window contains the secure Lure button, so a
show/hide or resize that happens in combat is deferred to
PLAYER\_REGEN\_ENABLED instead of being blocked. Hidden, its update loop
does not run, so the addon costs nothing while you aren't fishing.
Also: window settings live only on the Window tab (the General tab had
them twice plus a duplicated Display heading), and
tests/check\_syntax.py compiles every file with real Lua 5.1 after a
pure-Python parser accepted a string with a raw line break.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• CurseForge description: invite comments and feedback
Short invitation under the intro, and a fuller Feedback section:
what helps most (bugs with error text, Forever vs Classic differences
only players can report, ideas, favourite features) and where to post
(Comments tab for quick reports and ideas, GitHub issues for detailed
bugs).
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5

EasyFishv2.8.5 (2026-09-24)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Cut the status window's work ~15x and stop creating empty spots
Measured with a new harness that runs the whole addon in Lua 5.1 against
a simulated WoW API (tests/). With a large history the once-a-second
status refresh took 0.29 ms and allocated 28 KB; it now takes 0.02 ms
and 1.7 KB, and no longer grows with history size.
• NS.Memo caches values that only change when something happens; every
game event, slash command and settings change bumps NS.gen, and a
map change also recomputes. Used for the materials line (15 KB per
refresh on its own), pools in the zone (scanned every spot on every
map), chests here, and the top-fish rows (prices and icons included;
rows whose item info the game hasn't loaded yet are retried rather
than cached blank).
• Bug: the pool line looked up "the spot here" with a function that
creates a spot when there is none, so until the first cast of a
session the dashboard saved an empty spot wherever you walked (5 of
the 10 spots in real saved data). Looking never creates a spot now,
and never-fished spots are pruned on load.
tests/test\_core.py (23 behaviour tests), tests/smoke.py (every command,
settings tab and handler, surfacing errors pcall would hide) and
tests/perf.py; excluded from the packaged addon.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5

EasyFishv2.8.4 (2026-09-24)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Double right-click only fishes; history moves to its own addon
Double right-click equipped the fishing pole from anywhere, including
right-clicking an enemy to attack it. It now only arms with a fishing
pole already equipped, never with a creature, NPC or object under the
mouse, never in combat, and never equips anything. The double-click
reaches the cast button as its own virtual button ("EasyCast"), so the
cast button checks again at the moment of the click and swallows it if
anything changed; the Cast key binding can still equip the pole since
pressing it is deliberate. Verified by running EasyFish.lua against a
simulated WoW API through 12 scenarios.
Lua warning "Error loading EasyFish\_Saved.lua": the TOC listed a file
only the sync tool creates, so every install without the sync warned
on every login, and updating EasyFish deleted it until the sync put it
back. The sync now writes the history as a companion addon,
EasyFish\_History, which EasyFish loads through OptionalDeps: no
warning without it, and updates never touch it. Older installs that
still list EasyFish\_Saved.lua keep being fed until they update.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5

EasyFishv2.8.3 (2026-09-24)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Publish to CurseForge automatically on version tags
GitHub Action runs the BigWigs packager whenever a v* tag is pushed:
builds the zip, uploads it to CurseForge (project 1709292, via the
CF\_API\_KEY secret) and creates the GitHub release with the zip.
.pkgmeta lifts the EasyFish/ subfolder to the top of the package so
the zip holds EasyFish/EasyFish.toc, keeps tools/ at EasyFish/tools,
and leaves out branding/, curseforge/ and repo files. The TOC version
is now @project-version@ so it always matches the tag. Dry-run
verified locally: detects Forever (1.60.1) and the project ID.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Target WoW: Forever only
Drop the Retail interface numbers (120105, 120100) from the TOC.
EasyFish is built and tested for Forever (16001) only, and the TOC
decides which game versions CurseForge lists it for.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Add CurseForge project description
Markdown source plus an HTML copy for rich-text editors. Every
command and feature listed was checked against the code.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Restyle the logo in a fantasy-MMO look
Hand-painted style float with thick outlines, rim light, a riveted
brass band, brass cap and eyelet, and a teal and gold feather plume.
Saturated dusk sky with light rays over mountain and pine silhouettes,
turquoise water. Bevelled bronze frame with teal corner gems.
Wordmark in Cinzel Black with gold gradient, extrusion, dark outline,
glow and gloss. Cinzel is SIL OFL (license in branding/fonts) and is
embedded in the SVGs so they render the same anywhere. Still entirely
original: no game assets or Blizzard fonts.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Add EasyFish logo for CurseForge
Original artwork (no game assets): an egg-shaped red and white float
in rippling water at sunset, in a gold frame. Icon-only avatar and a
version with the EasyFish wordmark, as SVG sources plus 1024/512/400
PNG renders. branding/make\_logo.py regenerates them (renders with
Edge headless).
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5

addons.changelog:
Alts Forever 1.0.1
Fixes found in a full review of the code before the live launch.
• Rulesets (Normal, PvP, Roleplaying, Hardcore) are now named from what the game says it's running, not only from the realm name, so the overview and tooltips name them correctly on live realms whatever they're called.
• Moving to the live game: characters from the beta are recognised in older saves too (from before 0.12, which didn't record realms), and a live character whose realm couldn't be read once is never taken for one of them.
• Played time no longer counts time spent logged out.
• Professions: a profession you drop is no longer offered for crafting or skill-ups, and its recipes are forgotten (learn it again and its recipes read "Not scanned" until you open it). A login where the game hasn't sent your professions yet no longer loses them.
• Recipe tooltips: recipe lines no longer go missing after hovering a recipe before it has loaded.
• Upgrades: the same item with a better random suffix ("of the Monkey") now shows as an upgrade; a second copy of a ring that isn't unique can go on the other finger; an off-hand weapon is never compared with a shield.
• Bags window: a character's bank you haven't visited no longer shows their bags instead; a bag name that loads late fills in.
• Search: opened from another ruleset's bags window, it finds that character's items; item names that load slowly are waited for.
• Overview: the Mail column updates while the overview is open when you read your inbox or mail an alt.
• Gold history: days start at local midnight during daylight saving time too, not an hour off.
• Character sheet anvils: worked out once when a batch of items arrives instead of once per item; forgetting a crafter updates them.
• Sturdier saved data: more kinds of damage are repaired at login instead of causing errors.
• Hovering the same Waylaid Crate again is quicker.
Alts Forever 1.0.0
Ready for the launch of WoW Forever. Thank you to everyone who tried Alts Forever during the beta and sent ideas and reports: many of the features here came from you.
• Item names for use outside the game (off by default; options, or /af itemnames): for players who read Alts Forever's saved file with their own tools. Bags, bank and mail store only item IDs and counts there; with this on, the name and quality of every item your characters have are saved too when you log out. It adds nothing in the game and uses a little more memory, so leave it off unless you read the file. Thanks to the player who asked for this!
• Ready for the live game: the first time you log in on a live realm, Alts Forever forgets your characters from the beta, who don't carry over, along with their gold history and Legacy points, and tells you in chat (your settings are kept). A new character with the same name as one of your beta characters starts fresh instead of inheriting the beta one's bags, bank and gold.
• Sturdier saved data: if Alts Forever's saved file is damaged (edited by hand, or written by another copy of the addon), it's repaired when you log in instead of stopping the addon from loading. Only the damaged values are dropped and recorded again as you play; everything else is kept.
Alts Forever 0.16.0
• Export your characters (the note button in the overview's title bar, or /af export): every character's level, XP, rested, Well Rested, Legacy points, gold, professions, mail expiry, zone, time played and when you last played them, ready to copy with Ctrl+C, grouped by ruleset and faction like the overview. Pick the format: Spreadsheet (columns that paste straight into Excel or Google Sheets, with gold, percentages and dates as numbers), Text (readable lines for notes or chat) or Markdown table (for Notion, Obsidian and the like). (A player's request.)
• The overview's "Online" (your own row, under Last seen) is now in your game's language.
Alts Forever 0.15.0…
addons.description:
By Kadmai.

A World of Warcraft: Forever addon that adds a total and a per-character breakdown of an item to its tooltip:

Locations are shown as icons: a linen bag (bags), banker (bank), mailbox (mail) and white shirt (wearing). You can pick your own icons, or words instead, with /af icons.

The current character always comes first. Other characters are sorted by count. Already have counts from a bag addon such as Baganator? Turn ours off with Show item counts in the options (or /af counts); everything else in the tooltip stays.

Hovering the money at the bottom of your bags lists each character's gold and the total, laid out the same way (also in ElvUI's bags, and in EllesmereUI's when its own gold tracking is turned off). Hovering the experience bar lists your other characters still levelling, with their level, XP and rested XP, and hovering the reputation bar lists their standing with the faction you're watching.

Type /af to open the overview: every character with level and XP, rested XP (including what they've built up since logging out), Legacy points left to spend and their Well Rested rank, gold, main professions, zone, time played and when you last played them, with total time played at the bottom. With characters on more than one ruleset or both factions, they're grouped under headings such as "Normal · Horde", each with its gold total; click a heading to collapse it. Hover a row for details such as rested XP until full, hearthstone location and item level. Click a row to see that character's gear, laid out like the character panel: hover any item for its tooltip, shift-click to link it in chat. Nearly broken items are tinted red and the lowest durability is shown.

Export: the note button in the overview's title bar (or /af export) shows the overview as text, selected and ready to copy with Ctrl+C. Choose the format: Spreadsheet pastes into Excel or Google Sheets as columns, Text gives readable lines for notes or chat, and Markdown table becomes a table in Notion, Obsidian and the like. Reading Alts Forever's saved file (AltsForever.lua in your WTF folder) with your own tools instead? Bags, bank and mail store only item IDs and counts there; turn on Save item names for use outside the game in the options (or /af itemnames) and the name and quality of every item your characters have are saved too when you log out. It adds nothing in the game and uses a little more memory, so it's off by default.

Bags and bank: your own bags and bank (an entry in the bag's portrait menu, or a small Alts Forever button in the header of Blizzard's bank and of ElvUI's and EllesmereUI's bags and bank), the bag button in the overview's title bar (or /af bags, /af bank, or right-click a character) opens a window showing any character's bags or bank slot by slot, as you last saw them: each stack with its count, empty slots, how many slots are free, and a coloured border for uncommon and better items. Everything shows in one grid, or tick By bag for a section per bag or bank tab, e.g. "Red Linen Bag (7 / 8)". The character's gold is at the bottom. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize: the width sets the slots per row (10 to 30), the height how tall it gets before scrolling, and both are remembered. Pick the character from the dropdown and switch between Bags and Bank. Hover an item for its tooltip, shift-click to link it. A character's slots are recorded the next time you log in on them (bags) or visit their bank; until then the window shows one slot per item with its total.…

addons.description:
Better group loot rolls for WoW Forever, Classic Anniversary, Classic Era (including Hardcore
and Season of Discovery), and progression Classic (Mists): see how many players chose Need,
Greed, Disenchant, Transmog or Pass,
who they are, and move the rolls anywhere on the screen.
Features
• Its own roll frames in place of the default ones, built on the game's loot toast art.
• A count on every roll button: how many players chose Need, Greed, Disenchant, Transmog or Pass so far.
• The buttons' tooltips list those players, class-colored and with their roll numbers, plus (if
enabled) everyone who hasn't chosen yet.
• Disenchant is offered when the client allows it; Transmog is available on Forever.
• Your own instant Need roll's number is shown on Forever when the game rolls it.
• Native Edit Mode integration on supported clients: select the roll stack to move it or adjust
scale, spacing, growth direction and undecided-player tooltips.
• Move the rolls anywhere: unlock them, drag the anchor, lock them again. Scale, spacing and
stacking direction are adjustable, and every setting is per profile.

Roll counts come from the game's loot history. Classic clients match entries by roll ID;
Forever matches encounter drops to rolls. Rolls the loot history doesn't list show no counts.
Retail WoW is not supported. This replaces group loot rolls; personal loot and master loot
continue to use the game's UI.

addons.description:
Small World of Warcraft addon to add buttons to the mailbox to speed up sending mail - just click one of the buttons and the name will be set as mail recipient!
UsageMailbox
• Open Mailbox >> Send Mail
• Use "+" to add a Mailbutton (opens dialogue popup)
• Use "-" to show the remove buttons, then remove the ones you don't need ("Undo" brings them back)
• Press a Mailbutton to set the mail recipient to the corresponding character name
• Press "Clear" to clear the mail recipient
• With more than 8 Mailbuttons, use "" to switch pages or the search box to find a name
Options
Open via the gear button, /mb or Settings >> AddOns >> Mailbutton.
Here you can edit the whole list (one name per line) and import/export it.
Command Line
• type /mb to open the options
• type /mb help to show the command list
• type /mbadd charactername to add a Mailbutton for charactername
• type /mbremove charactername to remove the Mailbutton for charactername

On WoW Forever, names have a first and last name, e.g. /mbadd Sylvanas Windrunner.
Compatibility
Works on Classic Era, Anniversary, Mists Classic, Retail and WoW Forever.

Developed for the default Blizzard UI, but should work on any UI.

YATA Forever (Yet Another Totem Addon)5.0.4 (2026-10-21)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Merge pull request #5 from kayti-wow/fix/libkeybound-revision
Fix/libkeybound revision
• Replace bundled libraries with CurseForge packaged builds
The libraries were copied from source, so SVN keywords like $Revision$
were never expanded; LibKeyBound's locale files do arithmetic on that
value and errored on load. Use the CurseForge/WowAce packaged builds,
which have the keywords filled in.
• Ace3 r1422-alpha (AceAddon, AceConfig, AceConsole, AceDB, AceEvent,
AceGUI, AceLocale, CallbackHandler, LibStub)
• LibKeyBound-1.0 r128-alpha
• LibSharedMedia-3.0 v12.1.3
• LibDataBroker-1.1 v1.1.4
Ace3 and LibKeyBound use alpha builds because their latest stable
releases (r1403, r125) predate code the Forever port relies on, such as
secret-value handling and AceDB's regional character keys. These builds
match the previously bundled code apart from the expanded keywords.
Ace3 r1423 is skipped because it drops AceDB's nil check on surname.
LibSharedMedia moves up from v12.0.0-4 to v12.1.3 (error message
changes only).
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Fix LibKeyBound locale load error from unexpanded $Revision$
The embedded LibKeyBound locale files were copied from source, so the
SVN $Revision$ keyword was never expanded and match("%d+") returned nil,
causing "attempt to perform arithmetic on a nil value". Fall back to 0
so a properly packaged copy from another addon still takes precedence.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Update Yata.toc
• Merge pull request #4 from kayti-wow/fix/release-uploads
Fix GitHub release and workflow artifact uploads
• Fix GitHub release and workflow artifact uploads
The packager reads GITHUB\_OAUTH, not GH\_API\_TOKEN, so tagged builds never
created a GitHub release. upload-artifact skips dot-directories by default,
so the zip in .release/ was never uploaded; include hidden files and fail
when no zip is found.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
• Update Yata.toc
addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon that replaces the Blizzard multicast totem bar for Shamans. It shows one pop-out column per element (Earth, Air, Water, Fire) plus columns for the multicast "Call of…" spells and weapon imbues, and adds totem timers, a generated totem-stomp macro, saved layouts ("totem sets") and per-spec settings.
• Version: 5.0.0-forever, a port of 4.7.5 (November 2011)
• Game client: WoW Forever, interface 16001 (client 1.60.1). The original 4.7.5 targeted Cataclysm (40200).
• Authors: Kaytikat (maintainer), originally by Tornhoof
• Framework: Ace3

Forever keeps the Cataclysm multicast totem bar (GetMultiCastTotemSpells, TOTEM_MULTI_CAST_SUMMON_SPELLS, MultiCastActionBarFrame), so Yata's bar design carries over unchanged. Everything else was updated to the modern API: C_Spell, duration objects for timers, Edit Mode, and the current macro functions. The port was written against Blizzard's Forever UI source and has not yet been tested in game.
AI usage
The WoW Forever port of this addon (5.0.0-forever) was developed with the assistance of Claude code. That covers the code changes for Forever, the bug fixes since, and the offline tests in Tests/. The commits involved say so in their message or carry a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer. The original addon, up to 4.7.5 (2011), is the work of Tornhoof and Kaytikat.

KerimAnka UI 0.37.0 — Classic Era inventory, economy and settings update
This release updates Classic Era (1.15.9 / Interface 11509). Forever runtime files and standalone products are not updated by this release.
• Added the Organized bag layout with category filters, pinned quick access, recent items, category ordering and compatible empty-slot handling.
• Improved sorting options, bag backgrounds, bank and recorded-character inventory presentation, inventory tooltips and bag capacity warnings, including specialty bags.
• Added a character-focused Economy page for recorded money movements, income/expense summaries, charts, source filters, item details, search and sorting. Includes merchant, travel/training, auction/deposit, mail and player-trade tracking, with own-character transfers shown separately.
• Bounded Economy detail history to 5,000 records with separate retained summaries, cached reports and lists. Recording is event-driven; reports/charts are prepared when viewed. Historical activity before tracking began is not reconstructed.
• Reorganized Home, Chat and Micro Menu, Bar Backdrop, Class Art, Unit Frames, Minimap, Bags, Experience/Reputation and Threat settings with clearer groups and tabs, shared compact switches, help and three settings-text sizes.
• Improved Unit Frames preview navigation and aura visibility; added Druid cat-form combo-point and energy-tick support.

addons.description:
A modular interface suite for World of Warcraft: Forever and Classic Era, with class-themed artwork,
ready layouts for all nine classes, and a shared settings panel in nine languages.

Downloads ·
Report a bug or suggest a feature ·
Twitch ·
Changelog

Current version: 0.35.0.
Download the latest release
and choose the attached complete-suite ZIP.

KerimAnka UI brings class artwork, action-button backgrounds, unit frames,
minimap presentation, quest tracking, experience and reputation displays,
threat, sound controls, and profile management into one settings panel.
Class designs and ready layouts
KerimAnka UI includes class-specific action bar artwork and ready layouts for
Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Shaman, Mage, Warlock and Druid.
The package includes all nine classes; it is not limited to Hunters.

Open Profiles, choose your current class's ready layout, review the
confirmation and apply it. The preset sets up the class-themed appearance and
layout together. Ready layouts are tuned for 1920 x 1080; other resolutions or
UI scales may need adjustments.
Screenshots
**The screenshots below show the Hunter design as an example. Each of the nine
classes listed above has its own themed design and ready layout.**
Hunter ready layoutShared settings panel
Class Art settings ·
Unit Frames preview and settings

These screenshots show the Forever client. The world is shown at night, and native
game text follows the player’s German client language.
Compatibility
Supports Forever (Interface 16001) and Classic Era (Interface 11509).
The same complete-suite ZIP includes separate client loaders. Classic Era uses
separate saved settings; its new features have not been ported to Forever yet.
Retail support is not claimed.

Ready layouts are tuned for 1920 x 1080, with the Classic layouts prepared
at 100% UI scale. Other resolutions or UI scales may need manual positioning;
automatic rescaling of saved layouts is not included.
New for Classic Era
• Ready layouts for all nine classes, with optional Bartender4 and Blizzard layout transfer.
• In-game layout editing with quick settings, previews and save/cancel.
• Combined bags and bank, item cooldown counters and saved inventory views.
• Main-hand, off-hand and ranged swing timers; Rogue combo points; player cast bar.
• Energy and mana tick indicators, minimap coordinates and movable clock/day-night controls.
• Optional World latency (MS) beside FPS, disabled by default.

These Classic additions use their own code path. Existing Forever functionality
is retained; this release does not claim the new Classic features for Forever.
Main features
• Ready layouts for all nine classes, with confirmation before applying a layout.
• Class-themed action bar artwork, minimap presentation and unit frames.
• Supported Blizzard action bars or optional Bartender4 integration.
• Character snapshots, named profiles and import/export.
• Transfer of captured Blizzard Edit Mode and Bartender layouts when available.
• Quest tracking, target threat, experience and reputation displays.
• Sound controls, ready mute groups and custom sound FileDataID entries.
• Hunter range and aspect reminders.
• English, German, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, Spanish,
Brazilian Portuguese and Russian panel languages.

This candidate adds opt-in, own-character battleground capture for the Forever

addons.description:
Raid and guild management for **WoW Forever, Classic Era/Hardcore, Burning Crusade Classic,
Mists Classic and Retail**: an in-game addon, a Discord bot and a small
Windows companion app that connects the two (optional for the addon alone, needed for Discord and website features; Windows only).
Free for noncommercial use (license).

| Part | What it does | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Addon | Raids, attendance, EPGP, four loot systems (GP bids, loot council, soft reserves, EPGP priority), recipes and cooldowns, the guild calendar, gear and consumable checks, a live Ready page, a friendly window (gold coin on the minimap). Works alone, no Discord needed. Party/roll games are in the separate optional Guilded Games Alpha. | addon/Guilded/ |
| Discord bot (optional, hosted Guilded Lite with approval for full access, or independent hosting) | Raid signups with roles and waitlist, raid cores with a bench and their own loot system and item prices, weekly raids, EPGP standings, loot log, soft reserves, who can craft what, guild calendar sync, dungeon challenge, craft board, readiness board, polls, Warcraft Logs, applications, moderation helpers. | src/ |
| Windows companion (optional for the addon alone; needed for Discord and website features) | Tray app that sends the addon's saved data to the bot after each /reload or logout and writes standings back into the game. Get it from Microsoft Store first; the unsigned GitHub download is the fallback. Windows only. | companion-app/, companion/ |
| Phone app (optional, not a store release) | Public leaderboards, plus Discord sign-in for linked characters, reserves, wishlist, raid standings and on-device raid reminders. It does not read the game's saved files. | mobile/ |

Every in-game and Discord command, and who can run it, is in COMMANDS.md.
What changed in each version: CHANGELOG.md.

Latest release: 8.4.2, fixing a companion startup crash on launch and polishing the
Link everything screen (8.4.1 added that screen, the redesigned owner console, quick
reference page, achievement cards and guild rank). See the
release notes and acceptance checklist.
GitHub and CurseForge downloads are 8.4.0 until a newer one is uploaded; the Microsoft Store companion updates separately (8.4.1.0 is live; do not rely on it, 8.4.2 fixes its startup crash).
Quick start
• Guildmates or addon-only players: follow the member install guide.
Install into the client you actually play: the folder beside the game's .exe (the beta used
_classic_beta_; check again on 4 November). To connect the companion, choose Sign in with Discord
(a /character pair code still works).
• Add the hosted bot: add it to your server and run /setup start; no hosting or database account needed. Guilded Lite (setup, help, bug reports, dungeon groups, basic signups) works right away; KCaron's approval unlocks addon sync, EP/GP, seasons and the guild page. Optional support never buys approval.
• Run your own guild's bot: follow the illustrated beginner walkthrough, with Discord and Oracle account links, screenshots and success checks.
• Plan a quick installation: use the 30-minute setup checklist, including what must be ready first.
• Optional Windows companion: install Guilded Companion from Microsoft Store, or use the standalone installer from GitHub Releases. Store installations update through Microsoft Store. Check the version offered by each channel.
• Want an AI to guide you: copy a setup or troubleshooting prompt.

Current version: 8.4.2 (3 November 2026, protocol 2). Release notes and acceptance record.
Supports Forever, Classic Era/Hardcore, TBC Anniversary, Mists Classic and Retail
across the addon, Discord bot and companion, including several guilds in one Discord.
Use the edition-specific ZIP from GitHub Releases.
The unsuffixed ZIP is the Forever build.

The owner authorized release before the unavailable Forever two-PC tests.
Game checks remain pending follow-up; benchmarks are provisional.…

Guilded 8.4.0 — Private battleground records and launch fixes
This candidate adds opt-in, own-character battleground capture for the Forever
adapter, private history, withdrawal corrections and scoped participation
statistics. Reports remain provisional: no verified match totals, rankings or
automatic awards are inferred. The client adapter is capability gated and still

Discord /bg privacy, /bg history, /bg result, /bg correct and /bg stats
keep personal reports private and require separate consent for guild statistics.

and consent revocation excludes reports from corroboration and shared statistics.

to install or repair localized groups, results and statistics panels. Existing

Installation does not enable capture, automatic posts or awards.

example. Help menus fit narrow viewports. Companion connection tests explain
missing setup and refresh actions no longer imply successful sync when unconfigured.

Existing published8.3 artifacts remain unchanged. Actual acceptance and provider
availability are tracked separately in the release acceptance checklist.

Guilded 8.3.0 — Simpler navigation and optional automation
Prepared for the October 30 launch. Provider availability is separate from
source readiness. Acceptance: V8_3_0_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.md.
• Website: direct My Guilded and leaderboard navigation, clearer edition
context, season boundaries and weekly-versus-selected-period explanations.
Short EN/FR member quick starts link separately to officer/self-hosting help.
• Companion: Home with a state-specific next action, direct guild/ranking
shortcuts, simpler navigation and optional tools. Web sync is retained for
browser/non-Windows use; Windows provides local background watching. Both
still need WoW to save addon data with reload/logout.
• Optional automation: private member weekly recap DMs, approved weekly
questions and opt-in vacancy alerts. Quiet hours, pause, delivery state,
permission/consent checks and duplicate suppression apply. Everything begins
off; configure it with /automation. No automatic awards.
• Private Battleground organization: EN/FR Create, Join, My groups and Upcoming
controls, one-off scheduling, owned-character edition/level checks and
waiting lists. Retail Blitz has a reviewed duo/healer queue policy. Other
formats remain explicitly planning-only until their queue rules are verified.
Limits and testing
BG capture and statistics are not included. Normal-realm/faction choices are
player declarations, not verified game telemetry. Hardcore BG remains disabled.
Game acceptance is NOT RUN — timing waived until after launch by the owner;
Forever tests cannot precede its November 4 opening. This is not a claim that
native, game or multi-account tests passed. Security, migration/recovery, CI and
non-game checks remain release gates. Frozen 8.2.0 provider files are unchanged.
Français
• Navigation plus simple : Mon Guilded, classements, édition choisie et périodes
visibles. Guide membre EN/FR court, séparé des références officiers/hébergement.
• Compagnon : accueil avec prochaine action, raccourcis et outils facultatifs.
La synchronisation Web reste disponible; Windows surveille les fichiers en
arrière-plan. WoW doit toujours enregistrer via recharge/déconnexion.
• Automatisations facultatives : bilan privé, question hebdomadaire et places
disponibles, avec accord, silence, pause et contrôle des doublons. Désactivées
par défaut; /automation permet de les configurer. Aucun point automatique.
• Organisation JcJ privée : formulaires, inscriptions personnelles et attente.
Les formats de file non vérifiés restent en planification seulement.

Les tests en jeu sont reportés après lancement, non exécutés, et ne sont pas
présentés comme réussis. Aucune capture ni statistique JcJ n'est publiée.

Guilded 8.2.0 — Release preparation
October 30, 2026. Protocol remains 2. Publication and final installed-client
acceptance are tracked separately in the integration record.
Use the 8.2.0 acceptance checklist for final testing.
This includes the 8.1 improvements and the additions below.
For members
• My Guilded has private calendar export, a personal data centre and shortcuts
for upcoming raids, sync and the private weekly recap (/report stats personal:true).
Calendar export is a manually refreshed snapshot of raid signups and team responses;
it includes cancellations and stable event identifiers, with UTC times for DST safety.
• Raid plans show approved playbooks, missed-raid catch-up notes and dated resources.
Private officer notes are never copied into them. Resource dates are supplied by
the author; Guilded does not fetch or independently verify the linked advice.
• Supply plans calculate targets from confirmed signups. Members can voluntarily
pledge supplies and record deliveries, change their own pledge or withdraw it.
Deliveries are self-reported, not verified inventory. A revised plan needs fresh pledges.
• Optional onboarding tracks professions and a first raid without restricting access.
• Targeted dungeon watch preferences and cooperative challenges reuse existing
participation data. Challenges are cosmetic and do not award competitive points.
For officers
• Preview and explicitly approve versioned raid playbooks, recaps and supply plans.
Concurrent stale edits are rejected. Withdrawal and revision history support recovery.
• Explainable bench advice uses recorded benches, signup order and role capacity.
Unknown history does not count against a member. Officers retain final selection;
the advice never changes a roster or awards points.
• The private handover page collects recent audit activity, pending reviews, upcoming
raids and delivery state. It links recovery procedures without claiming a backup was verified.
• Weekly community questions have preview, Post, Skip and Pause controls. Automatic
recurring delivery remains disabled until audience, channel and cadence are approved.
Reliability and polish
• Companion Activity distinguishes saved, uploaded and bot-received evidence for the
same snapshot, with edition, character, selected source and the next step. Receipt
does not imply officer approval. Diagnostic previews omit identities and paths.
• Stronger personal pairing, guild/realm/edition checks, browser revocation, stable
update notices, retry delivery, diagnostic audience checks and character correction.
Correcting a provisional character preserves its identity and dependent records.
• Test raids use disposable pools and exclude real members from simulated awards.
Cleanup removes referenced bot-authored test signup posts; older orphan posts still
require manual removal. Raid-edit confirmations now respect French guild language.
• Retail no longer displays the fallback Classic dungeon catalog without a season.
Clearing a simulated result dismisses its card. Setup backgrounds, translated
controls and save-button sizing are corrected in both addons.
Availability and testing limits
All five recognized WoW editions retain separate packages and data scopes.
Retail testing does not establish Forever compatibility; Forever opens November 4.
The authorized upcoming Season 1 timing review sets Forever Deadmines to 30 minutes,
Blackfathom Deeps to 35 and City of Dalaran to 40. These are provisional design
targets informed by authored guide ranges, not measured calibration. Other ordinary
editions retain their own design estimates; Retail native Mythic+ timers stay
mode-specific. Historical runs and active season snapshots are not rescored.
The five exported rule files carry timing provenance; production installation
requires a separate verified upcoming-season receipt.
Battle.net discovery still requires the server owner's Blizzard application setup.…

Guilded 8.1.0 release candidate 1
Testing prerelease for the November 4 launch. Application version: 8.1.0; protocol 2. Exact source: 6bdc80e97dd8294bb4226774dfc15c2552385706.

Includes confirmed RCLootCouncil/Gargul history import, per-device/background sync, optional Battle.net linking, editable December raid pricing and companion pricing/leaderboards. Existing pools are not automatically enabled.

Choose the addon ZIP for your actual WoW edition. Back up addon folders and SavedVariables before installation. The optional Windows EXE is unsigned and is the standalone distribution, not a Microsoft Store update. Preserve your existing profile; do not run two companions against the same game folder. Stable Store and CurseForge downloads remain 8.0.2.

Automated Linux/PostgreSQL/restore and Windows packaging checks passed on this exact source: https://github.com/kevincaron28/Guilded/actions/runs/40947760250 . Backend and authenticated browser checks passed; actual WoW gameplay, cross-PC sync and candidate installer execution remain unperformed.

Full notes: https://github.com/kevincaron28/Guilded/blob/6bdc80e97dd8294bb4226774dfc15c2552385706/docs/V8_1_0_RELEASE_NOTES.md
Pricing guide: https://github.com/kevincaron28/Guilded/blob/6bdc80e97dd8294bb4226774dfc15c2552385706/docs/RAID-PRICING.md

This prerelease does not replace the stable 8.0.2 release. Verify downloads using SHA256SUMS-v8.1.0-rc.1.txt.

Guilded 8.0.2 Release
Safety and reliability corrections from the final 8.0.1 audit. All agreed 8.0
features and the complete FR/DE/ES addon catalogues are retained. Protocol stays 2.
• In-game /guilded sheet protects formula-like text in spreadsheet cells,
including raid titles and loot fields. Numbers and formatted decimal values
stay numeric. Exporting does not alter SavedVariables or original field values.
• /participation status calculates season/weekly totals in PostgreSQL and
returns at most six rows. Old helper awards reversed this week, season/guild
scope, caps and financial history keep their existing behavior.
• Historical development notes now point to the published feature inventory.

This is a new patch release; published 8.0 and 8.0.1 files are preserved. Keep
SavedVariables and connection profiles when updating. The companion, bot and site
remain English/French; the addons also include German and Spanish.

The free Microsoft Store companion
uses Store signing and Store updates. The optional GitHub EXE remains unsigned.
No paid signing service or license change is introduced.

Validation/publication: release completion.
Forever game data and live calibration remain dependent on game availability;
the owner's earlier manual testing waiver remains recorded.

Current publication, installed Microsoft Store signature/profile verification and acceptance limits: 8.0.2 release evidence.

This addon alllows changing the colors of various background images and text, allowing you to not be blinded by the bright spellbook colors when opening the spellbook.

Spell Text
Large Text (like the Specialization and Class)
Sub-Text (such as what indicates a spell being passive)
Separators (art pieces below each Large Text)
Bookmark
Page Number Text
Backplate / Backplate Highlight (the faint texture behind each spell text)
Background

An option to show/hide the "Spellbook Colors" button can be found in the AddOn Compartment Frame, located by the Calendar Button on the Minimap. It is purposefully not clickable in the settings menu in case it's accidentally clicked.

This effects the following type of items: Quest items, items that start quests, some cooking recipes, and learnable mounts. Many of these items can be found / filtered here.

It's just meant to add a little bit of immersion into the game without a vast negative impact.

If you've found a quest item missing flavour text, you can send it here.

If there's a grammar or lore mistake, you can send it here.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.

Slash Commands

There's 3 main slash commands:

/lit or /litt or /loreitemtooltips

This will bring up the colour picker to change the colour of the custom flavour text on items. You can also do /loreitemtooltips or /loreitemtooltip just in case some other addon has the same chat command of /lit (Legion Invasion Timer)

/lit reset

This will reset the colour back to the default yellow, but it'll also tell you the previous colour you had chosen in case you didn't want to actually reset so you can choose the colour values again.

/lit credits

This will bring up a list of people who've helped contribute to this project:

Rheä-WyrmrestAccord(US)

Komboloi-WyrmrestAccord/BloodsailBuccaneers(US)

If you've found a quest item missing flavour text, you can send it here.

addons.description:
Did you think that Vanilla was the best expansion? Do you miss your old artwork that sat behind those cookie cutter talents? Well I'm here to bring that back!

Yes, that's right. I change the artwork in the talent frame. I've used a mixture of artworks from Blizzard's concept art, Blizzard class website page, and the Artifact trait backgrounds.

Why? Well, this addon actually has a little bit of history. It's one of the first addons I actually worked on, and originally it was for the purpose of placing the old artworks back into the talent frame. Before the Dragonflight talent rework, they didn't have a background image. The talents were boring to look at. For the most part, it was nostalgia. The current ones are great, and now they're just the default option that's selectable as a new option in a dropdown menu in the Interface Addons pane under TalentArt.

I've had this idea to reintroduce the addon for a long time, but it wasn't until recently I was able to bring it back.

To do list:

More artworks.

Background Color Selection / Texture Color Selection.

Re-build compatibility with ElvUI, Aurora, and other Skin-like addons.

This is a screenshot album of some of the older addon

Thank you so much to everyone who supported me while making this addon! I've spent almost ~~20+~~ many hours working on this between the artwork and making sure everything was right. Beyond that, I'm going to lose track.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.
addons.name: TalentArt

addons.description:
Because sometimes some unit frame addons (unintentionally) remove the targetting / deselect sounds.

Very simple script for playing the target selection sound and deselecting a target. Many unit frame addons will (unintentionally) lose this sound as a result of replacing the target unit frame. All this does is bring if back. If you play without an addon that skins the target unit frame, you probably won't see any difference.

Should work in all versions of the game including Dragonflight.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.
addons.name: TargetSwapSound

addons.description:
Makes as clickable button in both Edit Mode and the Talents frame to wipe your action bars of all abilities.

Ever log in to an old alt character after a billion years of taking a break and find it'd be easier to just nuke all your buttons off your action bars and begin anew? Well this may be the solution for you.

This addon creates a clickable button in Edit Mode and the Talents frame to wipe all buttons off your action bars (for your currently selected talent build).

When the clickable button is pressed, it will open a dialog popup box asking to confirm if you wish to wipe your action bars.

Additionally this provides a chat command of "/wipebars" that does functionally the same thing as the clickable buttons.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.
