addons.description:
Dwarf Explorer's Bible (WoW: Forever) v1.0.4
What can I make with this? Pick any material and Dwarf Explorer's Bible shows every recipe that uses it, what each one is worth at the auction house right now, and where the result goes next.
• Pick a material: Alt-click any item (bags, chat links, loot, the AH), type /deb linen cloth, paste a link, or use the search box.
• Every recipe that uses it: profession, skill level (orange when it's above yours), the other reagents, and whether you know the recipe.
• Prices and profit: the latest auction price for the material, every reagent and every crafted result, the reagent cost, and the estimated profit after the 5% AH cut. Each price says which addon it came from.
• Follow the chain: click a result to see what that makes: Linen Cloth > Bolt of Linen Cloth > Linen Bag. Back walks the chain back. "Made from" flips to the recipes that create the item.
• Tooltip line: "Used in N recipes (Dwarf Explorer's Bible)", with its price and source.
• LDB launcher for Titan Panel, ChocolateBar and other broker displays.

Price sources
Dwarf Explorer's Bible reads prices from whichever price addon you already use. The first source in your order that has a price wins:

| Source | API used | Forever (16001) build |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PriceLog (mine) | KennyPriceLog.GetLatest(itemID) | Yes |
| Auctionator | Auctionator.API.v1.GetAuctionPriceByItemID | Yes (341, Oct 13 2026) |
| TradeSkillMaster | TSM_API.GetCustomPriceValue("DBMarket"), then DBMinBuyout | Not yet; works when it ships one |
| Auctioneer (Forever) | AucAdvanced.API.GetMarketValue | Yes (4.0.0) |
| Dwarf Explorer's Bible scan | prices it sees in AH searches you do | Always on |

No price addon? It still works: every AH search you make (browse or commodity) is cached. It never searches on its own.
Change the order with /deb prefer auctionator or /deb order tsm,auctionator,scan; /deb sources shows the order and what's installed.
Where the recipes come from
The recipe list (1,971 recipes across Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Cooking, Enchanting items, Engineering, First Aid, Leatherworking, Mining and Tailoring) comes from WoW: Forever's own client tables (build 1.60.1, via wago.tools), so it has Forever's reagents, not vanilla's: for example Minor Healing Potion in Forever uses an Empty Vial, Mild Spices and Peaceblooms. tools/gen_data.py regenerates it after a patch. Skill levels are where a recipe turns yellow and grey, coloured against your own skill. Each time you open a profession window the addon also records what you know and adds any recipe the bundled list doesn't have.

Reagent cost uses the vendor price for reagents a vendor sells (thread, flux, vials, spices, dyes), as Auctionator's crafting view does: learned from merchant windows you open, else Forever's listed price. Everything else uses the auction price. Profit is shown only when every reagent and the result have a price, so a missing price can't make a recipe look better than it is.
How it's different
Reverse lookups exist (Recipe Master by BrenoLudgero, ATT, Auctionator's crafting info, TSM's crafting tab, CraftSim on retail, Crafting Dictionary on retail), but they either track which recipes you're missing, price recipes you already know, or start from the recipe rather than the material. This one starts from the material, prices every option from your own AH addon, and lets you walk the chain material > intermediate > final, like the Guide in Terraria.
Commands
/deb (or /craftguide) open · /deb · sources · prefer · order a,b,c · tooltip · altclick · report · help. Source ids: pricelog, auctionator, tsm, auctioneer, scan.

• Stopping a session during combat now counts the loot from that last fight (before, it was dropped).
• Stopping a session shorter than 1 minute says it wasn't saved, instead of leaving you to wonder why it's missing from /goldspot history.
• /goldspot resetpos confirms in chat that the frame moved back.

• Smoother: bag counts are no longer read on every bag update while no session is running or the session is paused.

• Quieter: the first-login welcome is one line instead of three.

• /goldspot resume only resumes and /goldspot pause only pauses (before, both toggled, so resume could pause a running session).

• Loot valued at AH prices from PriceLog or MatTooltip; old prices (over 3 days) are flagged.
• Shows NeutralFlip's flip value and MatTooltip's verdict for your loot.
• /goldspot spots compares your farming spots.
• No timers running when you are not farming.
• A short guide on first login; one shared display-bar entry.
• /goldspot debug checks your setup: client version, every game API the addon needs, and which of Kenny's other addons it is working with.
• A loud chat warning if this client is missing an API the addon needs, instead of failing silently.
• English text now lives in Locales/enUS.lua, ready for translations.
• Shared code (KennyShared) is identical in every addon of the family and checked in CI, along with every Blizzard API call (against the Forever UI source) and every DBM/BigWigs/Questie API call (against their source).

• LibDataBroker display (Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka...): live gold/hour; tooltip shows the session; left-click shows/hides the window, right-click starts or pauses.
• Tests now fail CI on any luacheck warning, and the API check also covers LibDataBroker calls.
0.1.0 (first public release)
• Added the CurseForge and Wago project IDs to the TOC for automatic packaging, and an icon for the AddOns list (media/icon.tga).
• Renamed from FarmTracker (GitHub pre-release FarmTracker-v0.1.0 in masterred92/wow-forever-addons) so the name is unique on CurseForge, Wago and GitHub. The folder, TOC title, slash commands (/goldspot, /kspot), SavedVariables (KennyGoldPerSpotDB) and frame names all changed. Sessions saved by FarmTracker 0.1.0 are not carried over, because the folder rename gives a new SavedVariables file and that build was never released on CurseForge.
• Session gold/hour, top items, history per spot, and a "this spot vs your best" verdict. Movable, lockable frame.
• Game version: WoW: Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001).
addons.description:
GoldPerSpot (WoW: Forever) v0.3.4
Formerly "FarmTracker" in wow-forever-addons. It was renamed because several addons on CurseForge already use "FarmTracker".

Tracks a farming session and shows, in a small movable frame:
• spot name and session time
• total value and gold per hour
• coin looted
• the top 5 items by value ((v) = valued at vendor price)
• a verdict such as this spot: 3.2g/hr vs your best 4.5g/hr (Westfall boars). Under 75% of your best it adds "consider "; beating it shows "NEW BEST".

How it counts:
• Items: it compares your bags before and after, so skinning, herbs and loot all count in any language. Changes while a vendor, mailbox, bank, trade or AH window is open are ignored, so purchases and mail don't count. Bag changes during combat are counted when combat ends.
• Coin: only money gained while a loot window is open (not quest rewards or sales).
• Value: your newest AH scan price (PriceLog or MatTooltip) minus the 5% AH cut, or the vendor price if there's no scan. /goldspot value vendor forces vendor prices.
• History: sessions of 1 minute or more are saved per spot (up to 50 each). Only sessions of 5 minutes or more count as a "best".

Read-only: it never loots, clicks or moves for you.

Extras
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, GoldPerSpot shows your current gold/hour. Hover for the full session, left-click shows or hides the window, right-click starts or pauses a session.

Works with: PriceLog or MatTooltip (AH prices for your loot), NeutralFlip (flip value), MatTooltip (sell-or-craft verdict). Without them it uses vendor prices. Works fully on its own.

addons.description:
Mat Tooltip (WoW: Forever) v0.4.3
Adds lines to item tooltips for every crafting mat (Trade Goods: cloth, herbs, ore and bars, leather, elemental, enchanting and more):
• AH (your scan): the lowest per-unit buyout from your newest full AH scan (this addon's or PriceLog's).
• Vendor: the vendor sell price.
• NEVER VENDOR: a flag for scarce mats. The list is seeded with Pristine Leather 249427 and Frilled Lichen 249399, and you can edit it.
• One verdict, SELL ON AH, VENDOR or HOLD:
• SELL ON AH when the AH price after the 5% faction cut beats vendor by 10% or more; otherwise VENDOR.
• HOLD when there's no scan yet. Never-vendor mats are never VENDOR.
• A scan older than 3 days adds "price is old".

It never buys, sells, posts or clicks anything. The scan only runs when you type the command.

Extras
• Bagnon bag markers: with Bagnon, crafting mats in your bags get a small SELL, VEND or ? tag, so you can see the verdict without hovering. /mattip bagnon turns them off.
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, it shows what your bag mats would fetch on the AH after the cut, with the verdict for each in the tooltip.

Works with: PriceLog (uses its prices and shows its 7-day trend; no second price store), NeutralFlip (one tooltip block, no repeated AH price), GoldPerSpot (shows the sell-or-craft verdict on your loot). Works fully on its own.

addons.description:
NeutralFlip (WoW: Forever) v0.3.2
In WoW: Forever each faction has its own auction house. The goblin auctioneers in Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook run the only cross-faction market. Prices there often differ a lot from your faction's house (see auctionhouse.fyi Horde vs Alliance).

NeutralFlip keeps separate prices for your faction AH and the neutral AH. It then tells you which items are worth carrying across, after the cut:
• Both directions: faction to neutral, and neutral to faction.
• Net of the cut: each listing is priced 1c under the lowest one you saw, and the profit shown is after the 5% or 15% cut.
• Filters: a flip only shows if its profit is at least 20% of the buy price and at least 50c a unit. Prices older than 24 hours are ignored.
• Quantity: capped at what's listed at the lowest price and at what the other house lists.
• Deposit at risk: you get the deposit back if the item sells. The rate is measured with C_AuctionHouse.CalculateCommodityDeposit the first time you open each kind of AH.
• Thin-market flag: shown when the gap is 20x or more, because that's usually a troll listing.
• Tooltip: adds one or two lines: both prices, plus the flip if there is one.

It never buys, posts or clicks anything. It only records prices the AH already shows you, from your own searches or a full scan you start yourself. It also picks up full scans started by PriceLog or MatTooltip. You make every purchase and post.

Good to know: the 5% faction / 15% neutral cuts come from AHledger, and you can change them with /nflip cut. If a spot is detected as the wrong auction house, /nflip here neutral or /nflip here faction fixes it for that spot.

Extras
• TomTom arrow: /nflip way points a TomTom arrow at the nearest neutral AH (Gadgetzan on Kalimdor, Booty Bay in the Eastern Kingdoms), or /nflip way everlook. Only if TomTom is installed. It sets a waypoint; you do the walking.
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, NeutralFlip shows the number of flips, the top five in its tooltip, opens the list on left-click and sets the TomTom arrow on right-click.

Works with: PriceLog (uses its saved prices; one scan feeds both), MatTooltip (one tooltip block, no repeated AH price), GoldPerSpot (shows the flip value of farmed items). Works fully on its own.

Price Log (WoW: Forever) v0.3.2
Records auction house prices from your own scans and searches into SavedVariables, kept separately for each realm and faction:
• Full scan: /pricelog scan at an open AH. This is Blizzard's full-AH replicate, limited to about once per 15 minutes; the addon tells you how long is left. For every item it stores the lowest unit buyout, the median unit buyout and the total quantity.
• Your searches: when you browse or search the AH yourself, the shown lowest price and quantity are recorded too, at most one point per item per minute.
• A full scan started from MatTooltip is captured as well, so one scan feeds every addon.
• Up to 200 points per item, kept for 90 days.

Trend: /pricelog trend compares the latest price to the median of the previous 7 days. It shows RISING (more than 10% above), FALLING (more than 10% below) or STABLE, and NOT ENOUGH DATA with fewer than 3 points.

Works with: NeutralFlip, MatTooltip and GoldPerSpot all read its prices, so you only scan once; MatTooltip shows its 7-day trend. Falls back to Auctionator's prices if you have Auctionator. Works fully on its own.
Export
WoW addons can't write files, so there are two ways to get the data out:
1. /pricelog export [days] [itemID or link] opens a window with CSV text already selected: press Ctrl+C and paste into a spreadsheet. The columns are itemID,name,date,min_buyout_copper,median_copper,quantity,source, with UTC ISO dates. Large logs are capped at 20,000 rows, so narrow by days or item if it says "truncated".
2. Offline path: after you log out or /reload, everything is in World of Warcraft\forever\WTF\Account\\SavedVariables\PriceLog.lua (the KennyPriceLogDB table), which a Python script can read next to auctionhouse.fyi data.

Extras
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, Price Log shows how many prices are logged and when your last full scan was. Left-click prints stats, right-click opens the CSV export.

addons.description:
Find your class rhythm. Forever.

Everfrost is a lightweight, standalone Lua addon for WoW Forever. It displays a compact, class-aware ability reference for levels 1–30, with profiles for all nine classes and 27 talent trees. Recommendations are informed by Icy Veins Forever guides and filtered against the spells your character has actually learned. Guide-based gear comparisons add a shiny border to estimated bag upgrades and highlight Need or Greed on the standard loot-roll window.

Built with new players in mind. Everfrost grew out of playing alongside brand-new players and people trying WoW for the first time. Its guides focus on basic rotations and gear stat priorities for your class and spec, giving you a simple starting point while you learn. The aim is to keep the basics visible and make early decisions about abilities and gear easier to understand.

Written with OpenAI Codex. The project uses Codex for AI-assisted development, review, and documentation. Automated validation uses a simulated client. Early in-game checks confirmed the gear eligibility fix, rarity pulse and settings layout; the latest talent fix and broader client compatibility still need verification.

CurseForge · Download v0.6.5 · Report an issue · Guide sources

CurseForge targets WoW Forever 1.60.1. Third-party addon-manager distribution is enabled. New version tags trigger automatic packaging; file processing and moderation can delay availability.
Project status
| Item | Current status |
| --- | --- |
| Addon version | 0.6.5 |
| Supported levels | 1–30 |
| Class coverage | Nine classes, 27 talent trees, and nine general leveling profiles |
| Target interface | 16001 — compatibility with the actual Forever client remains unverified |
| Runtime | Lua 5.1-compatible syntax; no third-party addon libraries required |
| Validation | Lua syntax checks, a luacheck globals check and mocked-client regression tests, run automatically on GitHub Actions |
| In-game verification | Selected gear/glow/settings behavior confirmed by user; latest talent fix and broader compatibility outstanding |

Everfrost is an independent project. It is not an official Icy Veins, Blizzard, or OpenAI addon and is not affiliated with or endorsed by those organizations.
Screenshots
Captured in WoW Forever on a level-18 Elemental Shaman.

| Rotation reference | Spell hover guidance |
| --- | --- |
| | |

Gear upgrade comparison: an estimated upgrade is labelled in the tooltip, alongside its score and stat priority. The carried staff is highlighted in the bag.

| Specialization | Rotation Panel | Gear Upgrades |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

Open any screenshot for its full-size view. Use /everfrost to open these settings.
What Everfrost does
• Detects your class, level, and dominant talent tree, with a manual specialization override.
• Displays learned abilities using the trained ranks found in your spellbook.
• Provides concise hover guidance for openers, maintenance effects, fillers, and situational abilities.
• Offers single-target and AoE views, healing and damage views, and dedicated Feral and Survival role controls.
• Shows native cooldown sweeps when the client supports cooldown duration objects.
• Highlights estimated bag upgrades with a pulsing border in the item's rarity colour using the detected class/spec stat priorities.
• Highlights Need for estimated loot upgrades and Greed for known non-upgrades or class-irrelevant loot; you make the roll.
• Adds a clear UPGRADE label, score comparisons and stat priorities to item-button hover tooltips.
• Provides native-style Specialization, Rotation Panel and Gear Upgrades settings, plus a draggable minimap button.
• Saves panel position, scale, visibility, mode, and specialization preferences per character.
• Refreshes spellbook and talent metadata outside combat, deferring changes until combat ends when necessary.
A reference panel, not a next-cast engine…

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon plus a small Windows tray app.
• Alerts for players you watch (whispers, or talking in any channel you can see), chat
keywords, whispers and mentions while you're away, group invites, dungeon and battleground
queue pops, and ready checks.
• Phone alerts through Pushover, sent by the companion app.
• Quest helper: a movable progress panel, a notice when an objective or a whole quest is
done, and /lo way to point at a quest's next step with TomTom or the game's map pin.
Other addons can add location sources through LookoutAPI.
Why there are two parts
Addons can't reach the network or write files while you play, but they can take a
screenshot. For each phone alert the addon draws a QR code in the bottom-left corner for
about a second and takes a screenshot. The companion watches the game's Screenshots
folder, reads the code, sends the push through Pushover, and deletes that screenshot once
Pushover has accepted the push. Your own screenshots are left alone.

Screenshots are rate limited: at most one every 20 seconds (5 for group invites, queue pops
and ready checks) and 30 an hour. Alerts raised in between go out together in the next
screenshot, as one push. If more than 20 pile up, the oldest ordinary ones are dropped and
the next push says how many. During a fight you're at the keyboard for, ordinary alerts
wait until it ends so the code doesn't cover your screen. /lo rate shows or changes the
limits.

When a push fails, the companion saves the alert in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Lookout\pending-alerts.json,
leaves its screenshot in place, and tries again 10 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes and 15 minutes
later, also after a companion restart. After five failed tries it gives up, says so (a tray
notification, or a line in the console), and keeps the screenshot. Retries wait while alerts
are paused. Alerts that arrive while paused are still dropped.

The older route, /lo transport chat, whispers each alert to yourself
(LOOKOUT :: CHARACTER :: KIND :: TEXT) for the companion to read from
Logs/WoWChatLog.txt. On Forever beta 1.60.1.70009 the game only writes that file at
logout, so it can't deliver alerts during play there.
Setup
1. python -m venv .venv and .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
2. Copy config.example.json to config.json and add your Pushover app token and user key.
3. .venv\Scripts\python install.py copies the addon into every installed game version.
4. In game: /reload, then /lo for commands.
5. Run start-companion.cmd for the tray icon. --test-push sends one test alert.
Commands
| Command | Does |
| --- | --- |
| /lo add NAME, /lo remove NAME, /lo names | players to watch |
| /lo word add TEXT, /lo word remove TEXT, /lo words | chat keywords |
| /lo alert KIND phone\|screen\|off, /lo alerts | where each kind of alert goes |
| /lo phone on\|off, /lo hide on\|off, /lo test | phone alerts, hiding the signal whispers, a test alert |
| /lo transport screenshot\|chat, /lo rate [seconds perHour] | how phone alerts leave the game, screenshot limits |
| /lo quests, /lo way [questID], /lo providers | quest panel, waypoint, location sources |
| /lo help QUESTION | ask the companion's assistant; the answer arrives as a phone alert |

Alert kinds: whisper, seen, keyword, invite, queue, readycheck, afk, quest, test.
Asking the assistant
/lo help how do I see which realm I'm on? sends the question to the companion the same way an
alert goes out, with your character's level, class, faction, realm and zone appended in square
brackets. The companion asks an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint and pushes the answer to your
phone as a Lookout answer alert (and a tray notification). Settings live in the assistant
block of config.json: url is the API base (.../v1), model the model name, key optional.
url and key fall back to the LOOKOUT_AI_URL / LOOKOUT_AI_KEY environment variables,
then OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL / OMNIROUTE_API_KEY; model falls back to LOOKOUT_AI_MODEL.…

addons.description:
Keep your real names and Battle.net contacts out of World of Warcraft. Hide Battle.net friends entirely, show BattleTags instead of real names, or filter the list down to the friends who are actually playing WoW. Every change shows up live in your friends list.
Why?
• Streaming and screenshots - real names never show up on stream: not in the friends list, tooltips, whispers, pop-ups or chat.
• A cleaner friends list - see only the people playing WoW right now, not everyone idling in the Battle.net app or playing another game.
• The classic feel - one click turns the friends list back into the plain WoW friends list, without Battle.net clutter or modern tabs.
Profiles
Pick a starting point, then fine-tune any option by hand.

| Profile | What you get |
|---|---|
| Classic experience | No Battle.net at all: friends, requests, notifications, your BattleTag and the modern tabs are hidden. |
| No Battle.net | Same, but keeps the tabs. |
| Online friends | Every friend, but only those who are online. |
| WoW friends | Only friends playing World of Warcraft right now. |
| Show everything | Nothing hidden, the friends list as Blizzard made it. |
Options
Friends list
• Hide Battle.net friends
• Hide friend requests
• BattleTags instead of real names, everywhere a real name can appear (see below)
• Hide friend notes and friends' broadcasts
• Hide offline WoW (character) friends

Battle.net friends filter
• Hide offline friends
• Hide friends who are only in the Battle.net app or mobile app
• Hide friends playing another game

Privacy
• Hide your own BattleTag at the top of the friends list
• Hold Shift while opening the friends list to see everything until you close it

Notifications
• Mute Battle.net notifications (online, offline, broadcasts, requests). Your previous settings come back when you turn it off.
• Hide Quick Join pop-ups

Tabs (Retail)
• Hide the Quick Join, Recent Allies and Recruit A Friend tabs

Options that do not exist on your version of the game are not shown.
Where real names are replaced
With BattleTags instead of real names, the BattleTag (without its #number) replaces the real name in:
• the friends list and its tooltip
• Battle.net whispers, sent and received, and the "Tell ..." line while typing (/r still works)
• separate whisper tabs
• online/offline messages in chat (clicking the name still opens a whisper)
• Battle.net pop-up notifications
• the right-click menu on a Battle.net friend
• the block, remove and note confirmation dialogs
Commands
| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| /hbnf | Open or close the settings window |
| /hbnf off | Turn all hiding off until the next /reload |
| /hbnf on | Turn it back on |
| /hbnf help | List these commands in chat |
Where to find the settings
• Friends list: the HideBattleNetFriends button at the top right of the friends list, next to the close button.
• Minimap: the round HideBattleNetFriends button (drag it to move it).
• Addon compartment: the addons button under the minimap (Retail).
• Game options: Options > AddOns > HideBattleNetFriends.
• Chat: /hbnf.

A key binding for on/off is in Options > Key Bindings > AddOns.

Hiding the minimap button is safe: /hbnf always opens the window.
Compatibility
| Client | Supported |
|---|---|
| Retail | Yes |
| Classic (Mists of Pandaria) | Yes |
| Classic Era | Yes |
| Anniversary Edition | Yes |
| Forever | Yes |

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean and Chinese (simplified and traditional).

Nothing is changed on Blizzard's side: the addon only changes what your game displays. Your Battle.net friends are still there in the Battle.net app, and whispers and friend requests keep working.

addons.description:
Outil de guilde WoW Forever : addon, site, bot Discord et app compagnon, autour d'une base Supabase.
• Conventions et fonctionnalités : CLAUDE.md.
• Tests encore à faire en jeu : docs/tests-en-jeu.md.
• Résultats de la sonde sur WoW Forever : docs/phase-0/resultats.md.
• Charte graphique « La Taverne », maquettes et captures : docs/design.
Démarrer
Depuis le terminal de VS Code, lancer Electron avec env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE … : sinon il se comporte comme Node.
Structure
Dépôt unique géré par les espaces de travail npm. Un dossier n'est créé que quand il a du contenu.

| Dossier | Contenu |
| --- | --- |
| apps/web | Site et API, Next.js 16 sur Vercel (vxv-web.vercel.app), et adresse des interactions du bot (/api/discord/interactions) |
| apps/companion | Compagnon de bureau (Electron, Windows et Mac) : relie le jeu au site (@vxv/companion) |
| packages/server | Cœur du serveur partagé par le site et le bot : domaine, cas d'usage, PostgreSQL (@vxv/server) |
| packages/bot | Bot Discord en interactions HTTP : signature, commandes, boutons (@vxv/bot), hébergé par apps/web |
| packages/raid-data | Schéma et validation des données de raid (@vxv/raid-data) |
| packages/lua | Données Lua 5.1 : écriture pour l'addon, lecture des SavedVariables du jeu sans les exécuter (@vxv/lua) |
| packages/design | Jetons de la charte (couleurs, polices), thème du site et de l'addon générés (@vxv/design) |
| addon/VXV | L'addon, en un seul dossier : le socle (Core), une partie par lieu (Raid, Paris…), le lien avec le compagnon (Sync) et les données des raids (Data) |
| data/raids | Source des données de raid en JSON, une par raid (format) |
| data/dungeons | Dernier boss de chaque donjon en JSON, pour la quête des donjons en guilde (format) |
| supabase/ | Schéma, migrations et tests de la base (@vxv/database) |
| tools/data-generator | Données des raids : addon/VXV/Data/Raids.lua et script SQL dans dist/generated (npm run generate) |
| tools/addon-release | Copie l'addon à publier et inscrit la version (npm run release:prepare -- v1.2.0) |
| tools/addon-harness | Banc d'essai de l'addon hors du jeu, sur un client simulé, et export du journal de la sonde (npm run export:probe -- ) |
| tools/VXV_Probe | Sonde : addon de mesure sur WoW Forever, jamais distribué |
| tools/install-addon.sh | Construit l'addon comme une publication (version de développement) et l'installe dans un client, à la place des anciens dossiers VXV_… |
| tools/install-probe.sh | Copie la sonde dans le dossier AddOns d'un client |
| tools/deploy-database.sh | Déploie la base : migrations puis données de raid |
| docs/ | Charte graphique, résultats de la sonde, tests à faire en jeu |
Environnements
| | Test | Production |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base | Supabase vxv-test | Supabase vxv-prod |
| Mise à jour de la base | Automatique à chaque fusion dans main qui touche supabase/migrations ou data/raids | Manuelle : gh workflow run deploy-database.yml --ref main -f target=production |
| Site et bot (Vercel, projet vxv-web) | Prévisualisation de chaque demande de fusion, la dernière sur https://vxv-web-test.vercel.app (protégée par Vercel) | main, sur https://vxv-web.vercel.app |

Tout part de la CI, après les tests : le déploiement automatique de Vercel depuis git est désactivé (apps/web/vercel.json).
La CI rejoue aussi le déploiement de la base deux fois sur un PostgreSQL jetable à chaque demande de fusion. La base de
test ne contient jamais de vraies données de membres : son mot de passe est considéré comme exposé.
Secrets et variables
Aucun secret dans le dépôt (.env et ses variantes sont ignorés par git). Un secret se saisit sans l'afficher :
gh secret set pour GitHub, vercel env add pour Vercel.

| Où | Secrets | Variables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub, flux « Deploy database » | SUPABASE_TEST_DB_URL, SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_DB_URL (« Session pooler » : GitHub ne joint pas l'IPv6 de la connexion directe) | |…

• On Forever with Orbit, herbs and ore spotted by the minimap or HUD now appear below the compass as round icons with thin gold borders. They follow Orbit's existing resource setting.

addons.description:
An independently installed navigation ribbon and destination arrow built on LibOrbitUI, with an optional Orbit host
bridge.
Purpose
Keep native map points, saved locations, HandyNotes and GatherMate2 markers, world-wide landmark search and waypoint
commands usable without Orbit. A compatible Orbit supplies its profile, theme, fade, layering and Canvas services in
place of the standalone store.
Implementation
• Load order. Orbit_Compass.toc loads the embedded libraries (Libs/LibOrbitUI-1.0, Libs/LibStub,
Libs/LibOrbitSearch-1.0), Core/Foundation/CompassClientFeatures.lua (frozen client policy),
Core/CompassCompatibility.lua (host selection), Localization/Localization.xml and Core/Core.xml. Core follows
Orbit's module conventions: Foundation, Plugin, Discovery, Navigation, Integrations, Ribbon, Search and Config each
own a directory, XML bundle and README; Core/README.md maps the data flow and startup phases.
Assets/ owns the arrow texture, logo and private fonts.
• Orbit boundary. The TOC declares ## OptionalDeps: Orbit, HandyNotes, GatherMate2, Orbit_Navigation.
Core/CompassCompatibility.lua accepts a host only when Orbit.ExternalUIHost.legacyPluginVersion == 1 and no
Compass plugin is already registered; it exports Addon.OrbitHost or sets Addon.incompatibleOrbit.
Core/Integrations/Orbit/Orbit.lua is the bridge: it registers the real Orbit_Compass plugin (indices 1 and 2 plus
the CompassLocations collection) and rebinds the Services hooks (pixel, tooltip, profiler, fonts, text styling,
strata, persistence, Edit Mode, secret labelling); OrbitCanvas.lua adds Canvas text editing for the arrow.
Core/CompassBoot.lua always creates the LibOrbitUI UI.Addon shell and its move/reset commands; without a
bridge it also owns OrbitCompassDB, the settings window, Edit Mode entry, native font, gold arrow text, standard
text placement and configurable units, name and distance text. Both modes run the same Discovery, Navigation, Ribbon,
Search, HandyNotes, GatherMate2 and command code. Search places reach Orbit's Spotlight through LibOrbitSearch, not
through the bridge.
• Player surface. /orbitcompass opens Appearance and Points settings; /orbitcompass move enters Edit Mode and
reset restores the ribbon. Points selects visibility in Cities, World and an alternate Toggle column, including
HandyNotes and GatherMate2, and a hotkey above the table switches between the current area and the Toggle choices.
Zarillion's packs provide native tooltips, numbered instructions and coloured guide dots; following a dot keeps the
note's instructions. Hold Alt to label the nearest visible untracked POI. The search field at the ribbon's bottom-left
finds any dungeon, raid, delve, zone, city, continent, flight master, portal or named point; category words ("raids",
"flight masters") and place names ("Khaz Algar") narrow the list. With a compatible Orbit the ribbon hides its own
search because places appear in Orbit's search instead. Tracked world-map pins, placed map pins and search choices
follow the game's own route, including portal shortcuts. Arrow controls live in Compass: Arrow settings, opened by
selecting the arrow in Edit Mode. /oway and /orbitway keep waypoint, saved-location and nearby-target commands;
/way is claimed only when free. ORBIT_COMPASS_TARGET and ORBIT_COMPASS_TOGGLE_POINTS are this addon's bindings.
• GatherMate2. One GatherMate2 row in Points shows recorded locations for every category enabled in GatherMate2;
import GatherMate2_Data there for a prebuilt database. Records are possible spawn locations, and arrival-based
auto-advance can visit them in sequence.
• Live resources. On Forever with a compatible Orbit host, the ribbon mirrors the herb/ore item icons detected by
Orbit's active minimap/HUD resource scanner. These temporary, approximate observations appear below the line and
cannot be selected for navigation. They follow Orbit's resource switch and do not start another minimap scan.…

addons.description:
SharedMedia textures, HUD artwork, cast-completion sequences and animated LibOrbitGlow textures. Orbit is not required.
Previously Orbit-Glow-Pack; the CurseForge project ID and all glow keys are unchanged.
Purpose
Supply optional artwork to compatible addons without a rendering engine or Orbit dependency. Orbit retains Pixel, Soft, Softer, Round, Chamfer, Notch, Blade and their masks without this pack.

Install the pack and select its artwork in a compatible addon's glow, status-bar, HUD or cast settings.
Browse the interactive gallery for the glow and status-bar collection.
The pack has 40 icon glows and 102 status-bar fills; LibOrbitGlow owns two baseline dispel outlines.
Implementation
Catalog.lua publishes the read-only OrbitMedia.catalogApiVersion = 1 API with data-only Get and Enumerate
methods. It freezes copied records, rejects duplicate keys/cycles and builds deterministic snapshots during registration.
Consumer reads are immutable and allocation-free; consumers own rendering, masks, placement, lifecycle and settings.
Legacy apiVersion = 1 remains; borders is a frozen empty array so older consumers can enumerate it safely.

Pack files register through Orbit-Media's private addon namespace during file load, before consumers snapshot a catalog.
Keys are unique within each media type and remain the saved-setting identity. Get(mediaType, key) returns one frozen
record; Enumerate(mediaType) returns a cached frozen array ordered by order, provider and key. HUD records carry
leftPath, rightPath, aspectRatio and randomEligible; cast records carry CAST/CHANNEL frames, frameStarts,
holdDuration and fadeDuration. Labels expose
an optional consumer localization key plus a plain fallback.

HUDArtwork.lua registers 15 paired hud-artwork records. Thrall, Kael'thas and Gul'dan preserve their reversed filename mapping; consumers own slots and selection.

CastCompletion.lua registers four styles and 148 loose full-UV TGAs so consumers can retain stable masks while owning playback and presentation.

RegisterStatusBars.lua registers 102 grayscale 256x64 fills with the same SharedMedia pattern. Fifteen styles keep
five types with one selected finish per type; seven favourites remain. Published names omit review IDs and finishes.
output/orbit-status-textures/orbit-media-selection.json fixes the 75 choices. Twenty Orbit Rustic ... fills recreate
the unit-frame materials; sources live in output/unit-frame-status-textures-20260922/. Consumers own tint and masks.

Register.lua independently registers all 40 glow names immediately if LibOrbitGlow exists, or waits for
ADDON_LOADED in the same way. Existing glow textures and registry names remain unchanged.
Their BLEND body and ADD core share a 5-column, 6-row, 30-frame atlas with 128px cells and straight alpha.
36 perimeter designs supply square/soft/softer/round/chamfer/notch/blade; four radial designs supply square only.
Rounded outlines also ship soft-small, soft-large, softer-large, round-large and round-full at
6.25%, 18.75%, 30%, 43.75% and 50% radii. Consumers choose the nearest available contour for the icon size;
the last two keep small Round icons curved through the corners instead of using the 40-unit reference bake.
Chamfer follows straight 45-degree cuts at 5/40 of the icon side, retaining each design's timing and layers. Notch
cuts concave quarter circles of 5/40 into every corner; Blade cuts only the top-left and bottom-right at 7/40.
Workspace .scripts/make-glow-pack.py and make-fine-edge-flipbooks.py share glow_chamfer.py and glow_corners.py
geometry; glow_rounded.py owns their radius ladder. GLOW_SHAPES and --glows-only --shapes restrict regeneration.

.pkgmeta packages the inner addon under CurseForge project 1586459 with runtime Lua, the TOC, icon, 872
glow, 102 status-bar, 30 HUD and 148 cast TGAs. Authoring stays in output/; site/ is excluded…

addons.description:
Your action bars follow you to the highest spell rank you know.

Forever has Vanilla-style spell ranks on the Retail client. Train Frostbolt rank 4 and the button on your bar still casts rank 3 until you drag the new one over. This addon does the drag for you, out of combat, every time you learn something.

Contents
Highlights · How it works · Quick start · Commands · Development · Beta note · Repository map · Credits · Support · License

For contributors: CONTRIBUTING.md · CHANGELOG.md

Highlights
• 🔼 Always the top rank - Every spell button on every bar is checked a few seconds after login and again whenever you learn a spell. A button holding an old rank is replaced in place.
• 🎮 Gamepad UI too - The game's Gamepad UI (Alpha) keeps its own bars in action slots above the normal 180; those are upgraded the same way.
• 🛡️ Only ever upgrades - The client is asked for the highest rank by name, then the spellbook is cross-checked. A swap happens only when the new rank is strictly higher and known to you.
• ⚔️ Combat-safe - Nothing moves while you are fighting; the scan waits for combat to end. Macros, items and empty slots are never touched, and a scan waits if you are dragging something.
• 💬 Says what it did - One chat line per spell, such as Demon Armor -> Rank 3 (2 buttons). Turn it off with /asr report off.
• 🪶 One file, no settings window - Two toggles, both on by default, controlled from chat.

Name-based macros such as /cast Demon Armor already cast the highest rank on their own. This addon covers plain spell buttons dragged from the spellbook.
How it works
• Triggers - Three seconds after login, and one second after any spell-learned event (LEARNED_SPELL_IN_SKILL_LINE, or its older name, plus SPELLS_CHANGED). /asr scan runs it on demand.
• Rank lookup - C_Spell.GetSpellInfo(name) returns what /cast name would cast. If that answer is missing, the same rank, or lower, the spellbook is scanned for every entry with that name and the highest non-low-rank entry wins. Rank numbers come from C_Spell.GetSpellSkillLineAbilityRank, with the "Rank N" subtext as fallback.
• Swap - Pick up the new rank, confirm the cursor holds a spell, place it on the slot, clear the cursor. If PlaceAction throws, the addon prints one line and disables itself for the session rather than retrying.
• Guards - Every value that could be a secret passes through issecretvalue before it is compared. Every C_* call is checked for existence first.
Quick start
1. Install:
• CurseForge app - pick the Forever flavour and search for Auto Spell Ranks, or
• Manual - copy the AutoSpellRanks folder into World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns\, or
• Development - run .\install.ps1 to link this repo's AutoSpellRanks folder into the game (-Copy to copy instead, -Path for another install).
2. Start the game and tick Auto Spell Ranks on the AddOns screen.
3. Play. Type /asr to see the status line.
Commands
| Command | What it does |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| /asr | Show whether upgrades and chat reports are on |
| /asr on, /asr off | Enable or disable automatic upgrades |
| /asr report on\|off | Print a chat line for each swap, or stay quiet |
| /asr scan | Scan the bars now and print a summary |
| /asr debug | List what each button on screen holds, saved to AutoSpellRanksDB.debug on /reload |
| /asr help | List the commands |

/autospellranks works the same as /asr.

addons.description:
Quality of life for World of Warcraft: Forever, from one settings window.

Sells greys, loots instantly, accepts and hands in quests, repairs, combines bags, and marks the best quest reward. Twelve small modules behind a purple star on the minimap, each one a tick you can turn off.

Contents
Highlights · Modules · Architecture · Quick start · Commands · Development · Beta note · Repository map · Credits · Support · License

For contributors: CONTRIBUTING.md · CHANGELOG.md

Highlights
• 💰 Vendors - Greys are sold the moment a vendor opens, gear is repaired, and chat tells you what it cost or earned.
• 📜 Quests - Accept, hand in, and take the follow-up without clicking. Low-level quests are skipped, the best reward is framed in gold, and a note at the bottom of the window explains anything left for you.
• 🎁 Loot - Everything is taken the instant loot is ready. Optionally leave the greys.
• ⚔️ Combat - A main-hand swing timer under your portrait for melee classes, pet-attack macros so a pet charges when a cast starts, and bar buttons that follow you to the highest spell rank.
• 🎒 Interface - One combined bag with a one-click sort, clean icons without macro names, wider camera zoom, and the beta Issue Reporter tucked away.
• ⚙️ One dialog - A sidebar for Vendors, Quests, Loot, Combat and Interface, with search across every setting. Each feature is a collapsible card with its on/off switch in the header, and the finer settings open under a chevron. Help shows in tooltips. Options for other classes (pet macros, swing timer) stay out of the way unless you turn on Other classes. /mm, the minimap star, or Options > AddOns > MooseMode opens it. Hold Shift at an NPC or vendor to skip automation once.
• 💾 Beta-proof settings - The beta client does not load saved variables yet, so settings are also backed up in an account macro and restored at login.
Modules
| Module | Group | What it does | Default |
| ------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| Auto Sell | Vendors | Sells every grey item when a vendor opens, using the game's sell-all. Optional chat summary. | on |
| Auto Repair | Vendors | Repairs all gear at repair vendors. Sub-options: guild funds when allowed, cost in chat. | on |
| Auto Quest | Quests | Accepts quests, hands in completed ones, picks up follow-ups, picks the only gossip option, and can share accepted quests with your party. Skips low-level quests (grey only, or green and grey). Debug log to chat. | on |
| Quest Rewards | Quests | Vendor value on each reward choice. | on |
| Quest Lists | Quests | A line at the bottom of NPC quest windows names what Auto Quest left for you and why. | on |
| Quest Announce | Quests | Questie-style group chat lines: finished objectives and quest-starting items (on); accepted, abandoned, turned in (off). Party, raid, both or off; optional copy in your own chat. | on |
| Fast Loot | Loot | Takes every slot the instant loot is ready. Sub-option: leave grey items. Takes over the game's auto-loot setting while on. | on |
| Fishing | Professions | One toggle (/mm fish, the MooseFish macro, or a dialog button): pole in, Fishing on button 1. Press 1 to cast and press it again when the bobber splashes. Toggle again to get your weapons and button back. | on |
| Pet Attack | Combat | Creates one macro per damage spell with /petattack in front. Shown for Hunters and Warlocks; other classes see it (with an "only on pet classes" switch) under Other classes. | off |
| Spell Ranks | Combat | Swaps bar buttons holding an old rank for the highest one you know. Sub-option: report swaps in chat. | on |…

addons.description:
LibResInfo-2.0
LibResInfo-2.0 is a CLEU-free resurrection tracking library for World of Warcraft addons.

The library tracks:
• single-target resurrection casts
• mass resurrection casts
• resurrection targets becoming alive
• self-resurrection availability
• fastest resurrection resolution per target

Supported clients:
• Classic Era
• TBC Classic
• Wrath Classic
• Mists Classic
• Retail
• WoW Forever

Features
• No COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED dependency
• GUID-first tracking
• Fastest resurrection detection
• Multiple simultaneous resurrection casters per target
• Self-resurrection tracking
• CallbackHandler-1.0 support
• Ace3-style embedding

addons.changelog:
ForeverCompanionv2.8.0
• The step window reads like RestedXP: what you do at one place is grouped in a numbered box (every quest to hand in and to take at the same NPC together), one line per action with its icon (! to accept, ? to turn in, sword for objectives), the progress of each objective under its quest, then the NPC and the place.
• The current box is highlighted; the next ones are dimmed. Actions already done inside a box are ticked.
• Click a box: the arrow points to it. Right-click: mark its next action as done.
• New option: width of the step window (300 by default).
v2.7.0
• New Professions tab in the leveling guide (/fc lvl prof, or Professions in the minimap menu):
• The best profession pairs for your class (Skinning + Leatherworking, Mining + Blacksmithing or Engineering, Herbalism + Alchemy, Tailoring + Enchanting...) and why they go together.
• Leveling plan from 1 to 300 for Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking, Tailoring, Cooking and First Aid: the cheapest recipe for each skill range, how many to craft, the materials and an estimated cost. Your current step is highlighted and the materials still needed from your skill are added up.
• Recipes come from the trainers; when a vendor recipe is cheaper, the vendor and its place are shown for your faction. Recipes with a cooldown or a reputation requirement are left out.
• Mining, Herbalism and Skinning: what to gather at each skill level and the zones to do it.
• Trainer ranks (Journeyman, Expert, Artisan) with the level they need.
v2.6.0
• Levels 1 to about 22: the leveling routes now follow the RestedXP Forever guides step by step, in their order, with quests grouped the way they do (accept everything around, do the objectives together, hand everything in at once). Credit: RXPGuides by RestedXP (https://github.com/RestedXP/RXPGuides), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; that part of the routes keeps this licence.
• Every race and class has its own version of these guides (Orcs and Trolls through Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest like RestedXP, Hunters with their own start, Night Elves to Darkshore...). About 95 % of the RestedXP quests are kept; the others are missing from the Forever quest database or placed on the wrong continent in it.
• From about level 22 to 60 the route is still computed by the simulator, starting from where the RestedXP part ends.
v2.5.3
• Routes checked against tested leveling guides, quest by quest, for levels 1 to 22, and corrected:
• Orcs, Trolls and Tauren no longer take the boat to Tirisfal Glades at level 3-4: they level in Durotar or Mulgore up to 12, like every guide. No route crosses the sea before level 10.
• Every route now does its starting zone fully (all its quests) before moving on: Durotar, Mulgore, Tirisfal Glades up to 12, Elwynn Forest, Dun Morogh, Teldrassil up to 11, Zephras Isle up to 12.
• 20 quests the database refused to some races although they get them in game are now offered (Elwynn Forest chain from Rascally Rodents for Humans, Skyborne class quests...).
• A route chapter that ends with dungeons now shows the right levels.
v2.5.2
• /fc lvl > Leveling route: right-click a zone to see every step of it (quest, level, quest ID, NPC to talk to and place), to check a route before playing it. Click the first line to go back.
v2.5.1
• Quest requirements checked: a quest that needs a previous quest (all of a list, or one of several) is no longer shown to accept until that quest is turned in. When the route reaches a quest whose previous quest was passed, it passes it too and says in the chat which quest was missing (example: Aggressive Encroachment needs Aetheen of the Gales).
• The "quests around you" list uses the same requirements.
v2.5.0
• First time a leveling route is picked for a character, a window asks: follow it, choose another start in /fc lvl, or no thanks (the step window then shows the quests around you; /fc lvl to follow a route again).…
addons.description:
Le compagnon complet hors combat pour WoW Forever (le Classic+ officiel de Blizzard).
The complete out-of-combat companion for WoW Forever. English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Russian.

WoW Forever applique les restrictions d'addons de Midnight : aucun addon ne peut lire le combat.
ForeverCompanion se concentre donc sur tout le reste : montée, routes d'XP, donjons et raids avec
taux de drop, rerolls, sacs, carte, campements, interface et sécurité.

English
Stable release, tested in WoW Forever Beta (1.60.1).

Make EUI buff and debuff timers more compact and readable with fonts such as Chinese Heiti. Install and enable the addon; no setup is required.
简体中文
稳定版本，已在 WoW Forever Beta（1.60.1）中实测可用。

改善中文黑体等特殊字体下 EUI 增益与减益倒计时字符间距过宽的问题，安装并启用后自动生效，无需设置。

Author / 作者：Ballyh (B站八厉害)
addons.description:
English · 简体中文
English
Make EUI buff and debuff timers more compact and easier to read.

Some fonts, including Chinese Heiti, can make EUI's default buff and debuff duration text look too widely spaced. EUI Aura Fonts sets the timer text to size 11 for a more compact appearance, while keeping your chosen font and icon layout.

Install and enable it—no setup required. There are no settings to configure, commands to enter, or font parameters to adjust.
简体中文
让 EUI 的 Buff / Debuff 倒计时更紧凑、更易读。

addons.description:
StoryQuest provides a more immersive quest dialog experience inspired by the original quest dialog interface found in Guild Wars 2.

Left-click, spacebar, or interact key to advance text. Right-click or backspace to go back in the text.

⸻
SETTINGS
Settings are found in the default AddOn options location: ESC → Options → AddOns → StoryQuest.
• Lock Position: check this to prevent the StoryQuest frame from being dragged/moved.
• Scale Window: adjust the size of the StoryQuest window to your preference.
• Title Style: sets the style of the title header to be normal, thin, or transparent.
• Left-Click to Accept/Complete: controls if left-clicking anywhere in the StoryQuest window counts as clicking on the Accept and Complete Quest buttons.
• Head Slot Behavior: global and per-character override setting that lets you control if your character's head slot item is shown or if it should always be hidden.
• Weapon Behavior: global and per-character override setting that lets you control how your weapons are shown. They can be stowed (sheathed), drawn, or hidden completely.
• Scale Player Model: adjusts the size of your character model in case the default racial scales don't feel quite right for you.

⸻
STORYLINE / GW2 UI
Isn't this just Storyline? Did you just steal the GW2 UI's immersive quest interface?

This project is a straight fork of the immersive quest interface from the GW2 UI. I have been a developer on that project for years and wrote a bunch of that immersive quest code :) Lately, however, I have been leaning towards a more "default UI" experience and wanted to pull out the one piece I still regularly use as a standalone addon while trying to make it more "default" looking.

Storyline is a great addon too, though the original GW2 UI's quest interface (and therefore this addon) was not inspired by or cloned from it in any way. There's no question they've grown in parallel to offer a similar experience, but I happen to like the wider, darker, simpler, foot-less style that the GW2 UI started from, so I rolled my own version of that.

⸻

addons.description:
Records every detail of your WoW Forever (client 1.60.x) journey for storytelling.

This is the Forever version. For Retail, see wow-storytracker-addon-retail.
What It Tracks
Every session is recorded to SavedVariables with timestamps, zones, and details:

| Category | What Gets Recorded |
|----------|-------------------|
| Quests | Accepted, completed, abandoned — with names and levels |
| Zones | Every zone, subzone, and continent change |
| Levels | Your dings and your party members' dings |
| Deaths | Where, who killed you, and with what ability |
| Dungeons | Entered, bosses killed, completed (via ENCOUNTER_END) |
| Loot | Rare, epic, and legendary items — plus mounts |
| Reputation | Every faction standing change |
| Professions | Skillups and recipes learned |
| Gold | Earned, spent, and session net totals |
| Combat | Notable elite/rare/world boss kills |
| Social | Guild join/leave, party/raid formation |
| PvP | Honorable kills, battlegrounds, duels |
| Sessions | Login/logout times, duration, zones |
Compatibility
WoW Forever only (client 1.60.x, interface 16001). Does not work on Retail.

Forever installs as the _classic_beta_ client folder (Battle.net may list it
as "Classic" or "Classic Beta"), not _classic_era_.

addons.description:
A tiny WoW addon that anchors the default game tooltip to the mouse cursor
instead of Blizzard's default lower-right corner. Built for WoW Forever
(the Classic beta, client flavor wow_classic_beta, version 1.60.x),
which doesn't offer this as a built-in option.
How it works
Blizzard's FrameXML routes almost all "default position" tooltips (action
bars, bags, character panel, quest log, merchant frame, etc.) through a
shared helper function, GameTooltip_SetDefaultAnchor(tooltip, parent).
This addon uses hooksecurefunc to run after that helper and re-anchor
the tooltip to the cursor, using Blizzard's own native ANCHOR_CURSOR /
ANCHOR_CURSOR_LEFT / ANCHOR_CURSOR_RIGHT anchor types (applied via
SetAnchorType, never SetOwner). This gives continuous, zero-lag cursor
tracking straight from the engine with no per-frame Lua involvement — an
earlier manual SetPoint-based implementation was found (through testing)
to interfere with GameTooltip's own internal fade timer, causing unit
tooltips to visibly "stick" for about a second after the mouse moved away
before fading out.

It intentionally does not reassign the global function directly.
Forever taints the global itself when an addon replaces it, and every
later caller — including unrelated Blizzard code such as party/raid frame
updates — inherits that taint for its whole call chain, which then trips
Forever's new "secret value" protections (e.g. health-bar color
comparisons throwing errors). hooksecurefunc runs strictly after
Blizzard's own untainted call, so the original global is never
contaminated.

Tooltips deliberately anchored elsewhere on purpose (comparison tooltips,
contextual anchors next to a specific button, static minimap tooltips,
etc.) are left untouched — they don't go through the shared helper, and
there's no reliable way to tell "the default corner tooltip" apart from an
intentionally custom-positioned one just from the anchor type, so this
addon doesn't try to guess.

addons.description:
Samostatný český překlad Auctionatoru, spravovaný projektem Azeroth česky.

Verze 0.1.2 pro WoW: Forever 1.60.1 a Auctionator 341. Přeloženo je všech 451 textů jeho lokalizačního katalogu. Vydání obsahuje font s českými znaky a kratší popisky podle prvního testu ve hře. V seznamu addonů se modul jmenuje Azeroth cesky: Auctionator, používá původní herní font a stejné logo jako hlavní Azeroth česky. Kontroly katalogu a izolované testy v Lua 5.1 jsou součástí projektu; úplná herní kontrola posledních oprav fontů a rozložení ještě čeká.
Instalace
1. Nainstaluj Auctionator.
2. Stáhni instalační balíček AAzerothAuctionator-.zip z příloh v Releases. GitHub tlačítko Code → Download ZIP stahuje vývojové zdroje, nikoli instalační balíček.
3. Při vypnuté hře rozbal složku AAzerothAuctionator do Interface/AddOns svého klienta WoW: Forever. Složku nepřejmenovávej.
4. Ve výběru addonů zapni Auctionator i Azeroth cesky: Auctionator a přihlas se do hry.

Výsledná struktura:

Čeština se použije automaticky. Hlavní addon Azeroth česky není potřeba. Pro návrat k jazyku herního klienta vypni pouze Azeroth cesky: Auctionator a znovu načti rozhraní. Ostatní překladové moduly Auctionatoru nech vypnuté; sdílejí jeden přepis jazyka.

Při aktualizaci nahraď celou složku a úplně restartuj klienta, aby se načetla nová metadata a nezůstaly staré soubory. Rozhraní Auctionatoru používá přibalený Gentium Book se zachováním velikosti písma a barev. Seznam addonů a sdílené herní fonty se nemění; název bez diakritiky je čitelný i před přihlášením.

Nepřekládaná jména v seznamu překladatelů zachovávají původní font kvůli cizojazyčným znakům. Nápovědy nastavení Auctionatoru používají český font dočasně; při skrytí nebo přechodu k jinému vlastníkovi se obnoví původní font.
Co se překládá
• Vlastní texty Auctionatoru: nákup, prodej, rušení aukcí, seznamy, nastavení a aukční nápovědy.
• Nové texty, pro které ještě nemáme překlad, Auctionator automaticky doplní anglicky.
• Názvy předmětů, kouzel a kategorií dodané hrou i některá tlačítka používající přímo texty Blizzardu zůstávají v jazyce klienta.
• Pořadí částí data určuje Auctionator; tento modul překládá názvy měsíců a dní, ale formát data nepřepisuje.

Jde o komunitní překlad používající rozhraní doporučené autorem Auctionatoru. Balíček neobsahuje samotný Auctionator ani nemění jeho soubory, herní globální texty, ceny, vyhledávací údaje či uložená nastavení. Podpora dalších variant WoW zatím není ověřená; TOC cílí pouze na Forever (16001).
Vývoj a kontrola
Potřebuješ Python 3.9 nebo novější. Při běžném hraní Python ani žádný nástroj nepotřebuješ.

fetch stáhne konkrétní oficiální vydání Auctionatoru a ověří SHA-256. Testy používají jeho skutečný lokalizační resolver; nepouštějí WoW. Instalační ZIP a jeho kontrolní součet vzniknou v dist/. Na Windows použij .venv\Scripts\python.exe.

Překlady se upravují v locales/csCZ.json. Po úpravě spusť:

Vygenerovaný addon/AAzerothAuctionator/Translations.lua se ukládá do repozitáře, ale neupravuje ručně. Po každé změně spusť kontroly a testy. CI navíc vytvoří instalační ZIP jako artefakt; nic automaticky nepublikuje na CurseForge.

Postup aktualizace: CONTRIBUTING.md. Kontrola ve hře: docs/GAME_TEST.md. Architektura: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Autoři
Auctionator: plusmouse, Borjamacare a přispěvatelé původního projektu. Český překlad: Azeroth česky / No898. Původní autorské údaje a odkazy na podporu Auctionatoru zůstávají zachované.

Přibalený nezměněný Gentium Book 7.000 Regular: Copyright (c) 2003–2025 SIL Global. Licence SIL Open Font License 1.1 je v Fonts/OFL.txt; původ a kontrolní součty jsou v dokumentaci.

addons.description:
The Auctioneer addon suite made to run on the WoW: Forever beta client. It is
profdumbbelldore's Auctioneer 12.x fork (itself a
continuation of Norganna's Auctioneer, official source
gitlab.com/norganna-wow/auctioneer, GPL v2 - see LICENSE) with the changes the
Forever client needs; the git history keeps the upstream commits. Nothing else is touched: the same nine addon folders, the
same features, the same settings.

Why a separate branch: Forever runs Blizzard's Mainline UI (the retail-style auction house) on the 12.1.5 API set.
Patch 12.1.5 removed the deprecated item functions that the 12.1.0 build still relies on (GetItemInfo,
GetItemQualityColor, GetDetailedItemLevelInfo, GetItemIcon), and the Forever client also has no
GetMouseFocus, MouseIsOver, UIParent_OnEvent, InterfaceOptionsFrame_OpenToCategory or NUM_ITEM_QUALITIES.
Each of those was a Lua error waiting to happen on Forever; on retail 12.1.0 they still work, which is why upstream
never saw them.

addons.description:
Useful WoW addon (compatible with WoW Forever) to show statistics.
Level Time
Shows statistics in a small, movable window, either for your current level or your current session (switch with the "Level | Session" tabs at the top):
• Play time: on this level synced with the server (/played), for the session since login; both counted up live.
• XP bar with the rested bonus shown as a lighter segment (can be turned off).
• XP per hour, the estimated play time until the next level and an estimate until max level (based on your recent levels). Optionally without AFK time.
• Current XP/h (optional row): XP per hour over the last 15 minutes, so slow phases show right away.
• Kills/quests to level (optional row): how many kills or quests are left at this level's average XP.
• Time breakdown (optional row): play time in combat, on flight paths, AFK and the rest.
• Kills, split into:
• PvE: every kill that granted experience, including group kills. Grey mobs and kills at max level don't count.
• PvP: honorable kills.
• Elite and rare kills (optional rows): enemies are classified when you target, hover or see their nameplate.
• Deaths, with time spent dead or as a ghost and kills per death.
• Near deaths (optional row): health dropped below 10 % and you survived (counted once health is back above 30 %).
• XP sources: share of XP from kills, quests and other sources (exploration, professions, ...).
• Rested XP: bonus XP gained from rest and its share of the XP; optionally the rested XP still left.
• Level-up summary in chat: how long the level took, kills, deaths and XP/h (can be turned off).
• Quests turned in.
• Income: money earned (loot, quests, sales, mail); spending is not subtracted.
• Spending (optional row): repairs, merchants, flights, trainers and other, plus income from sold junk.

The window shows them as a table, label on the left and value on the right. Every value can be switched on or off on its own (e.g. PvE and PvP kills separately). Level statistics restart on level-up. A session runs from login to logout; a /reload or a short break (up to 5 minutes) continues it.

Statistics are recorded separately for every character. They are stored account-wide, so you can look at all your characters from any of them. Use "Delete data" in the history window to remove a character's statistics (e.g. after deleting the character).

addons.description:
Owner policy supersedes earlier runtime version and package-verification gates:
on Classic Era and Forever, in DEV and PROD, never disable an addon or feature
solely because client/build/interface text, package versions, advertised API/schema
revisions or legacy/unverified metadata differ. Select the native client adapter
and check actual methods and data contracts. Preserve combat/protected-action,
restricted-value, failed-initialization, incompatible saved-data and actual
DEV/PROD ownership safeguards. Do not infer binding ownership from APHB metadata.
Exact exports, immutable source pins and installer/release validation remain
offline development/distribution requirements, not runtime expiry rules.
Current policy implementation is coordinated by ApogeeForever's
distribution/RUNTIME_CAPABILITIES.md; historical release bytes remain frozen.

Apogee has separate public packages for World of Warcraft Forever 1.60.1 and
Classic Era 1.15.9. Choose the file for your WoW instance. Era 1.14.12 and
Forever 1.14.13 are published on GitHub and CurseForge; see the
release links and verification
and each version's player notes for changes and testing status. The historical
beta selection remains frozen for reproducibility.

Five focused addons:
• Heals: party frames, click healing and buff reminders.
• Keybinds: configurable keyboard and mouse actions with combat HUDs.
• Group Alert: dungeon group discovery and recruitment alerts.
• Essentials: chat conveniences, UI fading and error controls.
• Stats: role-aware gear guidance with NEED during loot rolls and UPGRADE on other item tooltips.

Tank and the standalone Auction addon are retired from both package families.

Keep the top-level Apogee or Apogee Era addon enabled and select the
components you want in WoW's AddOns list. Gameplay modules retain their own
settings. Stats evaluates all supported roles outdoors and uses your assigned
role or instance fallback in dungeons. Its character-window Gear filter applies
only while that window is open. Era stat reading supports English tooltips.

Legacy profiles are not imported, and Dungeon Guide is not included.

Install using the CurseForge listing
or a packaged GitHub release.
For a manual installation, extract all six addon folders into Interface/AddOns.
GitHub source archives are not installable packages.

Contributor documentation: build workflow,
release checklist, client API reference.
Current unreleased Forever candidate: live validation.

For work across the five addons, use the sibling
Apogee workspace and its
current handoff. These are local sibling
links; the workspace has separate publication status. Distribution authority
remains in this repository.

Stats auction browsing: click the left-side dice to enable upgrade filtering.
Then optionally narrow by Max gold and role (All roles by default). Dice off
restores normal native results. Select best requires a specific native equipment
slot, one role/playstyle, and complete checks; the status explains missing choices.
Click it to select a freshly verified buyout. Buying remains manual. Each visit
starts off with no gold cap and All roles; native filter preferences are preserved.

Filtering is available only in Armor and Weapons and their subcategories.
Elsewhere, normal results appear with dimmed/disabled controls and guidance.
Returning restores the dice preference, gold and role; the filtered list waits
for a matching native Search.

Stats ranks Warrior and Paladin tank shields by Armor, then Stamina, followed by
existing defensive tie-breakers. Warrior tank weapons prioritize Weapon DPS, then
Stamina and existing tie-breakers within the current shield, two-handed or trained
dual-wield setup. Hand restrictions are preserved; cross-layout switches are not
recommended. Other equipment and role priorities are unchanged.

Install: download MiniReload-1.0.0.zip below and extract it into World of Warcraft//Interface/AddOns/. The zip includes the libraries it needs.
addons.description:
A minimap button that reloads your UI. One click, no typing.

Handy when a controller or bar addon breaks and you can't reach /reload:
the button sits on the minimap, independent of your action bars.
Usage
| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Left-click the minimap button | Reload the UI |
| Hover over the minimap button | See when you last reloaded (or logged in), e.g. Reloaded 12 min ago (14:32) |
| Drag the minimap button | Move it around the minimap edge |
| /rl or /minireload | Reload the UI |
| /minireload hide / /minireload show | Hide or show the minimap button |

If another addon also registers /rl, whichever loads last owns it. Both
reload, so it doesn't matter.

addons.changelog:
Changelogv1.0.0 - 2026-10-12Changed
• Automatic /who scans now run at most every 10 seconds instead of every 5,
and the new option "Seconds between /who scans" lets you pick anything from
5 to 60 seconds.
• Chat announcements now default to the first player of each leaderboard only:
the global and class top N sliders start at 1, like the race one. Existing
installs keep the top N values they already have.
• The guild hears far less from the addon. The game client scrolls the chat
window for every addon message sent to the guild although the message itself
is never shown, so the addon now only announces itself to the guild at login
and about once an hour, to meet the guild members who run it. Dings and
leaderboards reach those members by whisper from then on, like they reach
every other player the addon traded with before. Before, every ding and a
sync round every 5 minutes went through the guild.
• The debug window lists at most 20 players of a received or sent batch, then
how many more it held.
• The realm channel is now the one place the addon syncs through, from login
on. The guild announce, the buddy whispers and the group sync only run when
the channel does not work: when the addon could not join it, or when its own
channel messages stop coming back for five minutes. They start the moment
that happens and stop again when the channel is back. Before, they ran next
to the channel until another addon user was heard on it, which on a quiet
realm or with the beta's chat lag meant most of the time.
• Level-ups spotted in the seconds between login and the channel join now wait
for the channel instead of going out by whisper.
Fixed
• Level-ups spotted in the first minute after joining the realm channel now
reach it. They wait that minute for the join sync and then went out as one
message; on a busy day that was hundreds of players, the game client's
channel throttle cut the message off and it was lost. They now go out 50
players at a time, a few seconds apart, and a message the channel throttle
refused is sent again after a longer pause.
v0.1.0-beta16 - 2026-10-10Changed
• The bundled compression library (LibCompress) is updated to r87 from its
new home on GitHub. Nothing changes in what the addon sends; a damaged
compressed message is now dropped instead of raising an error.
v0.1.0-beta15 - 2026-10-10Changed
• The zone sync at login, the beacon that announced your leaderboards to the
zone every minute and the shout of every new level to the zone are gone: the
game client refuses addon messages to the zone (a yell), so none of them ever
reached anybody. Logging in no longer waits 5 seconds for zone answers that
could never come; the guild sync, the realm channel and the players your addon
traded with before carry the data as before.
Fixed
• Turning sharing on after logging in with it off now starts the sync right
away. Before, the addon stayed quiet until the next login.
v0.1.0-beta14 - 2026-10-02Added
• The addon tells you when a newer version is out on CurseForge. Players who
already updated let the others know, so from this version on you get one
line in chat per session, and the options window and the minimap tooltip
name the new version until you update.
Fixed
• Leaderboards and player history sent from one player to another could arrive
with pieces missing, or not at all, when the sender's addon sent several chat
packets at once. The addon now sends its packets one at a time, a moment
apart, so longer messages arrive whole.
• Damaged data that still looked valid could end up in your player history,
as wrong level times or names that don't exist. Every message now carries a
checksum, and one that doesn't match its checksum is thrown away. Messages
from players on older versions carry none, so those can still arrive
damaged.
• When something a player sent you arrives damaged, your addon notices and asks
that player again about a minute later, instead of staying without that data…
addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon for WoW Forever that keeps track of the top 50 players on your
faction-realm in the race to max level, overall and per class, and records who
was first to reach every level. Data is gathered with /who scans, from the
guild roster and from your party or raid, and shared between addon users over
the addon channel: realm-wide through a hidden chat channel per faction, with
the guild, your group and whispers as the backup.

Built for WoW Forever: the race goes to level 60 and Paladins and Shamans are
tracked on both factions. Other WoW clients are not supported.
Releases
For latest releases that you can just unzip into your Interface\AddOns folder,
see the Releases page on GitHub.

Slash commands: /wfr toggles the leaderboard window, /wfr debug opens the
debug window, /wfropts opens the options.
Dev setup
Everything needed to lint, test and package the addon lives in a Docker image
(Dockerfile), so the only host requirements are Docker and git. This is the
recommended setup on Windows, where Lua, LuaRocks, make and svn are painful to
install.

`bash

as wrong level times or names that don't exist. Every message now carries a
checksum, and one that doesn't match its checksum is thrown away. Messages
from players on older versions carry none, so those can still arrive
damaged.

that player again about a minute later, instead of staying without that data
until your next login. Both players need this version for that.

noticed and fetched again.

instead of being dropped silently, unless the client refuses everything sent
that way.

a few seconds late.

addons.changelog:
First release of Alt+Z Forever, for World of Warcraft: Forever.

Install: use your addon manager, or download alt-z-forever-0.1.0.zip below and unzip it into Interface\AddOns\. The install page walks you through it.

Docs: https://ordainty.github.io/alt-z-forever
Fading
• Fades action bars, unit frames, party and raid frames, the minimap, quest tracker, buffs, chat and other addons' frames when you aren't using them.
• Brings elements back on hover, in combat, when you pick a target, cast a spell, gain a buff or get a whisper.
• Hovering one element brings back its whole group, such as all your action bars at once.
• Buffs and debuffs at 2 or more stacks stay visible while the rest of the buff frame fades.
• Nothing fades inside dungeons, raids, battlegrounds, arenas or scenarios unless you turn that on.
Settings
• A settings window (/azf menu) with four switches for every element: Always shown, In combat, Standing still and Moving.
• Separate rules for individual frames from other addons, under Frames by addon.
• Sliders for faded opacity, fade-in and fade-out time, and how long elements stay up.
• Reset a single row, a section, or everything.
• A minimap button opens the settings window. Turn it off under General if you don't want it.
Keys and commands
• Toggle fade mode: switches fading off and on.
• Hide everything / restore: hides the whole UI, the minimap included, until you press it again.
• Toggle element fade and Element fade settings: point at any element, even a faded one, to toggle its fading or open its settings card.
• The addon doesn't bind any keys for you, so it can't clash with yours.
Extras
• A welcome window on your first login shows the keys and how to use them. /azf welcome brings it back.
• AFK fade: the UI fades after 30 seconds without input and comes back when you move.
• Tooltips for units and world objects show at your cursor instead of the corner.
• /azf report builds a bug report for you to paste.

Based on Conceal by Keirmot (Joao Pires), GPLv3.

addons.description:
Titan Reputation is a reputation plugin for Titan Panel. It allows you to more easily monitor and track your faction
standings with any faction you may be farming reputation with.

Features
• Titan Panel: Displays the faction data of a given faction in a customizable button directly on Titan Panel.
Toggle the Blizzard Character Reputation Page. Auto-change display of the most recently changed faction.
• Tooltip information: Quickly verify standings with factions using the customizable tooltip to display the
factions you care about by simply mousing over the button.
• Session monitoring: Toggle session data summary, which displays the total gained reputation since your last
login/reload as well as a Reputation breakdown (per hour / per min).
• Customization Options: Customize the appearance of the button and tooltip to fit your needs.
• Reputation Color Highlighting: Color Coding based on faction standings, built-in color scheme, armory color
scheme, or a generic basic colors solution.
• Achievement style announcements: Upon a faction standing change, display a achievements style message with
the faction name and the new standing level. This makes those reputation grinds a bit more eventful and can be
toggled on/off for those minimalists out there.
• MikScrollingBattleText: Mik's Scrolling Battle Text support for faction standing change announcement.
• Blizzard Experience Bar Support: The button follows the faction set to "Show as Experience Bar" in the Blizzard
Reputation Pane and switches whenever you pick another one there. While a faction is shown as experience bar,
"Auto Show Changed" is paused.
• Blizzard Inactive Faction Support: If you wish to omit a faction from the tooltip entirely. Simply visit the
Blizzard Reputation Pane and set the faction to be "Move to Inactive". The tooltip's behavior will not process
any faction with this flag enabled.

> Note: When using the Blizzard Reputation Pane, you should be aware that collapsing groups in this pane
> affects the ability of the plugin to gather data from the factions in the collapsed group.
