ForeverXP Bar — v0.8.0Foreverxpbar is now live in Wow Retail and TBC Anniverssary✨ Introducing Forever Challenge XP — An Optional Addon!
With v0.8.0, we're making ForeverXP Bar more flexible than ever!

Forever Challenge XP is now a separate, optional companion addon, included with ForeverXP Bar.

Want a clean, minimalist XP bar? Keep Challenge Mode disabled. Want to compete with friends, track leveling records, and celebrate your progress? Enable Forever Challenge XP whenever you like!
🧩 How It Works
• ForeverXP Bar works independently, providing the XP bar, leveling statistics, visual customization, and essential features.
• Forever Challenge XP adds Challenge Mode, races, leaderboards, level-up cards, and leveling records.
• Enable or disable Forever Challenge XP directly from WoW's AddOns list.
• Clicking the inactive Challenge tab lets you enable the companion addon with a confirmation and automatic UI reload.
• Use Turn Off Challenge in the Challenge settings to disable the companion addon and reload.
• Your existing settings, races, and records are preserved when switching between enabled and disabled states.

Both addons are included in the same download. No additional installation is required!
🏆 What's Included in Forever Challenge XP?Challenges & Races
• Create leveling challenges with target levels and deadlines.
• Create or join races using shareable codes.
• Discover races hosted by guild members.
• Compare progress through the Race Panel and Global Race leaderboard.
• Automatic guild progress sharing while Challenge Mode is active.
Level-Up Cards & Records
• Celebrate level-ups with customizable cards and Alliance, Horde, Classic, and Golden themes.
• Customize card appearance and display duration.
• Track leveling time with the Played / Record panel.
• Display the Challenge Meter alongside your XP bar.
⚙️ Interface & Quality-of-Life Improvements
• Added addon icons for both ForeverXP Bar and Forever Challenge XP in WoW's AddOns list.
• Added settings access through Game Menu → Options → AddOns.
• Improved Challenge settings layout with a dedicated Card / Record Settings button.
• Card / Record Settings can now be opened and closed using the same button.
• Added a compact Turn Off Challenge button in the bottom-right corner of the settings window.
• Redesigned the What's New panel to explain the optional addon system and its features.
• Removed the experimental RXP target marker for a cleaner, more reliable interface.
🔔 Buff Expiration Warnings
• Added a Preview button for buff expiration warnings.
• Preview now displays a temporary on-screen warning without changing your settings.
• Real tracked buff expiration warnings use the same banner when the configured warning threshold is reached.
• Improved warning positioning and automatic dismissal.
• Fixed the Preview button accidentally enabling or disabling the warning checkbox.
🛠️ Fixes & Stability
• Fixed startup and initialization issues introduced during the v0.8.0 transition.
• Fixed settings panels failing to open or reopen.
• Improved optional addon activation and deactivation.
• Fixed overlapping controls and spacing issues in Challenge and Leveling settings.
• Preserved existing SavedVariables and profile preferences.

Thank you for your feedback and support! ❤️

ForeverXP Bar continues to focus on a clean, customizable leveling experience, while Forever Challenge XP gives you the freedom to add competitive and advanced features whenever you want them.
addons.description:
A clean, customizable XP bar for World of Warcraft (WoW Forever / Classic clients), with leveling stats, a per-character level record, and campfire / rested buff icons.

Current version: 0.6.4
Folder / addon ID: ForeverXPBar
Commands: /fxpb or /foreverxpbar

> This addon was renamed from "ForeverXP" so it can be installed next to another addon with the same name without overwriting it.

FeaturesThe bar
• "Aurora" design: teal-to-violet gradient fill, an amber segment for quest XP, and a translucent rested overlay.
• Smooth fill animation, an optional spark at the end of the fill, optional tick marks (25 / 50 / 75 % or every 10 %).
• Three textures: flat, striped, glossy. Optional border and class color.
• Level-up flash and an optional level-up sound.
• Fade or hide in combat, or show only on mouseover.
• Can hide the default Blizzard XP bar (on by default).
• Width and height are adjustable (width 60-3000, height 8-60).
Text
Every text element can be shown or hidden, and resized independently (Adjust tab).

| Position | Left | Center | Right |
|---|---|---|---|
| Above the bar | Time this level | | Time this session |
| On the bar | Level | XP / Max XP | Percent (and percent with quests) |
| Under the bar | XP per hour + next-level ETA + kills / quests to level | | Completed quests % and rested XP % |
Leveling info
• Rolling XP/hour over a window you choose (5-30 minutes).
• Kills to level and quests to level.
• Hover tooltip on the bar.
• Session summary (/fxpb summary, or automatically when you log out).
Level record
A transparent, draggable, resizable panel with a timer that starts at level 1 and records the cumulative time at which each level was reached. Levels are compared with your fastest other character that also started at level 1 (green = faster, red = slower). Data is kept across characters. You can pause and resume the timer.
Camp / rested buff icons
Small icons under the bar showing what you are currently getting from:
• the campfire buff Camp Benefits (one icon per benefit it lists: experience, stamina, critical strike...)
• the sleeping-bag buff Well Rested (the value follows the number of stacks)

Every other buff (elixirs, food, priest or paladin buffs...) is ignored. Hover an icon for the bonus and the time left. Drag the row to move it while the bar is unlocked.

0.7.1Level card and race panel

The "RACE TO LEVEL" title is smaller and starts above the player names. "N players" lines up with the level column. Bars start further right so the artwork shows around them.
• Alliance: bars use the same layout as Horde. The level number in the title is bold and larger. Font and colours unchanged.
• Classic (new): minimalist card using the stock tooltip panel, Friz Quadrata text, a shorter layout, no ornaments, no animation glow.
• Gold is unchanged.
• The card theme now defaults to Auto (by faction). Choose a theme with four buttons: Alliance, Horde, Classic, Golden (the selected one is highlighted). /fxpb card theme auto returns to automatic.
Race: class icons and colours
• Each racer's class icon is shown in the race list on every theme.
• Class colours are used on Gold and Classic (Alliance and Horde keep their own bar colours). The standalone race panel also uses class colours.
• The class is sent in a separate small message (C;CODE;CLASS), so older versions ignore it. Racers on older versions show without an icon.
• Always on; there is no option to disable it.
Settings and panels
• Hybrid entrance + golden shimmer is always on; the option was removed.
• Auto-send to party / guild moved to the Challenge tab under Show race panel. Both are off by default.
• Show the card when I gain a level moved to the Challenge tab, under the theme buttons.
• Card stays for can now be set up to 30 seconds (was 20).
• Preview shows a 20-player race (8 visible, scroll for the rest).
• Main window: Options, Leveling, Challenge and Profiles share one row of equal buttons, placed higher to give pages more room. The selected button turns blue with white text. Info is now a small "i" button after the version number in the title bar.
Slash commands
• /fxpb card reset: reset the card position.
• /fxpb card theme gold | alliance | horde | classic | auto.

[0.7.0] — Current development buildAdded — Challenge & race system
• Setup your challenge: combined challenge-goal setup and race management into one streamlined section.
• Level goals: choose a target level to reach. A race created with a blank target-level field defaults to level 60. The chosen target must still be above the host's current level.
• Optional calendar deadline: set a number of Days and a Time (HH:MM). Deadlines use real calendar time rather than time spent playing. Leave both blank for a level-only race; specifying Days also requires a time.
• Create applies the goal automatically: no separate Set challenge goal button is needed. Create validates the inputs, creates the race, and establishes its goal.
• Shareable race codes: host a race with a name and share the generated code with other players.
• Join by code: enter a race code or select a discovered guild race. The join field displays “Insert the code” only while empty.
• Host-defined shared objective: race participants use the host's target level and optional deadline in their challenge display rather than substituting a local personal goal.
• Automatic goal retrieval: players joining a race request the host's requirements; available guild and peer messages can supply the goal.
• Separate progress baselines: each participant's race progress begins when they join, while the race target and deadline are shared.
• Guild race discovery: use Discover guild races to look for races advertised by online guild members running the addon. Discovered race buttons use compact names, distinguish duplicates, and can be dismissed locally.
• Race controls: Create, Join, Leave race, Discover guild races, Clear, Share progress with my guild, and Show race panel.
• Clear action: resets the local challenge setup, active race state, discovered races, and input fields without resetting unrelated addon settings.
• Race progress panel: displays participating players and their progress toward the shared race target, including the race's target level.
• Resizable race panel: drag the three-line handle at the bottom right to adjust width and height. The addon remembers the chosen dimensions and fits visible player rows to the available space.
• Challenge status: shows progress, estimated pacing, remaining deadline time when relevant, and completion/failure information.
• Vertical challenge bar: displayed alongside the activity meter when a challenge is active; its goal label is placed below the bar.
Added — Activity, leveling & alerts
• Activity meter: a vertical bar estimates recent active leveling versus inactivity, with a color progression from green (more active) through yellow toward red (less active/AFK).
• Activity breakdown: tracks time associated with activity, travel, idle time, resting in town, flight, and death for leveling insights and tooltips.
• Rest alerts: optional visual warnings for full rested XP and logging out outside a resting area.
• Rested XP information: shows available rested XP and a rough estimate of the time it could save at the current leveling rate.
• RXP target marker: optionally marks XP targets inferred from RestedXP guide steps on the XP bar, when compatible information is available.
• Level-up card: configurable on-screen level-up announcement with an adjustable display duration, preview and last-card actions.
• Card sharing/tests: support for manually sending level-card messages to supported chat channels, optional automatic party/guild announcements on level-up, and a Test to Say action.
• Visual alert previews: dedicated preview/test controls for level-card and warning displays.
Changed — Challenge interface
• Reorganized the goal and race interface under Setup your challenge, replacing the separate Challenge with friends section.
• Removed the dedicated Set challenge goal button; creating a race now starts the configured goal as part of the same action.
• Removed “from now” from the Days field label.…

0.6.4 - 2026-10-07Changed
• Camp / rested buff icons now only show the campfire and the sleeping bag. Only the campfire buff Camp Benefits (one icon per benefit it lists: experience, stamina, critical strike...) and Well Rested are read. Elixirs, food and other players' buffs (priest, paladin...) are ignored.
• The old detection ("any new buff that appears near a campfire counts as a camp buff") is gone. It was the reason an elixir drunk next to a fire showed up as a campfire buff.
• ForeverXPBarCampData.lua has new fields: campIds, campNames, restedIds. known and ignore still work.
• The text of the Camp Benefits buff is read again every time instead of being cached, because the list of benefits changes while the spell ID stays the same.
• Well Rested now reads the buff's own tooltip first, so the value follows the stacks (x3 shows 3 %, not 1 %).
• Settings panel reorganized:
• Bar Text and Bar are merged into one sub-tab, Text & Bar (Bar Text first, Bar below).
• The camp buff icon settings (show, icon size, reset position) moved from Adjust > Bar to Options > Leveling.
• Tab order is now Options, Adjust, Colors, Info.
• The panel is 50 px taller so the merged tab fits.
• New installs: the spark at the end of the fill is now off by default. Tick marks stay off by default. Existing saved settings are not changed.
Removed
• The option Also buffs from other sources (priest, paladin, food...), the command /fxpb camp other on|off, and its line in the help.
Fixed
• Dragging the camp icon row could make it jump, drift down, or end up outside where you dropped it. The row now follows the cursor directly and no longer reacts to refreshes during the drag. The screen-edge clamp was removed (use /fxpb camp reset if the row ends up off-screen).

ForeverXP Bar 0.6.3Leveling info
• Kills / quests to level. New text under the bar, after the Next LVL ETA, e.g. ~163 kills • ~15 quests.
• Kills = XP left ÷ the XP of your last kill (rested bonus included).
• Quests = XP left ÷ the average of your last 10 quest rewards.
• Each half appears once it has data. Show or hide it in Options > Bar Text; move it and resize it like the other texts.
• Rolling XP/hr. XP/hr and the Next LVL ETA now use the last 15 minutes of online time (adjustable 5–30 min) instead of the whole level, so time spent idle in town no longer drags the number down. Offline time never counts. With less than a minute of data, or no XP in the window, it falls back to the level average. Can be switched off in Options > Leveling.
• Hover tooltip on the bar. Exact XP, remaining, rested, quest XP ready to turn in, kills / quests to level, XP/hr (rolling and level average), ETA, time this level and this session's XP. Refreshes live. Can be turned off.
• Session summary. /fxpb summary prints time played, XP gained (and XP/hr), levels gained, kills and quests turned in. Also printed when you start logging out or quitting (can be turned off). The session restarts on a fresh login and survives /reload.
Bar visuals (Options > Visuals)
• Smooth fill animation and a spark at the end of the fill (both on by default, both optional).
• Tick marks at 25 / 50 / 75 % or every 10 % (off by default).
• Bar texture: Flat (as before), Striped or Glossy.
• Level-up flash and level-up sound (both off by default; the game already plays its own fanfare).
• Minimal UI: in combat the bar can fade or hide, and/or be shown only on mouseover. Mouseover and the settings panel always show it.
Level-up sounds
• Pick the sound from a drop-down in Options > Visuals, with a Test button.
• The list mixes Blizzard sounds and your own .ogg files from the Sound folder. An entry can also play both together (a mix).
• Add your own sounds by listing them in ForeverXPBarSounds.lua (WoW addons cannot read a folder's contents):
{ name = "My level-up", file = "levelup.ogg" }
• New .ogg files need a full game restart to be found.
Record panel
• Resizable: drag the three-line grip in the bottom-right corner. Size and position are remembered (the grip is hidden while the bar is locked).
• Default position: middle of the right edge. Once you move it, it stays where you leave it. /fxpb record resetpos restores the default.
• Buttons: Hide at the bottom-left, Pause / Resume at the bottom-right. Bring the panel back with Options > Record > Show Record Panel or /fxpb record show.
• Cleaner layout: title, big timer and the "from lvl X - no comparison" note each have their own line, with separators and a right-aligned comparison column, so nothing overlaps the buttons.
• The panel still records the total time at which you reached each level (from level 1), compares it with your fastest other character (green = faster, red = slower), and keeps running when hidden.
Options and minimap
• New General row at the top of Options: Show Bar and Show Minimap Icon.
• Show Minimap Icon asks to reload the UI when changed, and the icon is hidden much more firmly (it no longer comes back on its own).
• /fxpb minimap on | off | toggle.
New commands
/fxpb summary | kills | rolling | tooltip | logoutsummary | smooth | spark | flash | sound | mouseover on/off
/fxpb window · /fxpb ticks off|25|10 · /fxpb texture flat|striped|glossy
/fxpb combat off|fade|hide · /fxpb sound list|test| · /fxpb testlevelup
/fxpb record resetpos
Compatibility
• Position, size, colors and text options are kept. New settings start at the defaults above (everything optional is off).
• New settings are also saved in the extra CVar / macro layers, like the existing ones.
• Existing characters start collecting kill / quest / rolling data from the first login after the update.
Upgrading…

addons.changelog:
Zbuilds
Builds are refreshed from the sites every day; a new version is published whenever any of them changes.
Game build 1.60.1.70374 — new talent trees
• The talent trees of every class changed with this beta build: builds come from the sites' new trees.
• Builds saved from the old trees are no longer offered (their points would land on other talents). Fewer builds for now; they come back as each site updates its guides.
v0.10.0 — Two more build sites
• RankedBoost: its builds for every class (DPS, healing, tanking, PvP and leveling).
• WoW Forever Talent (wowforevertalent.com): its own level 10–20 plans, with their point order. The guides it copies from other sites are left out, so a build is not counted twice.
• Both get their own source filter; a build that another site also recommends is shown once, with "also recommended by".
• The build bar on the talent window no longer shows on the spellbook tab.
v0.9.0 — Options, Train all and smarter reminders⚙️ Options
• New Options tab (also /zb options): turn the banner and its sound on or off, choose what it shows (next talent, Legacy challenges), the trainer list in the chat, the minimap button, and how long the banner stays (4, 6, 10 or 15 s).
• Preview buttons for the level-up and the Legacy banners.
🎉 Banners
• The level-up banner now also shows the next talent of your build.
• A banner when you complete a Legacy challenge, with the perk your plan wants next.
📜 Trainer
• Train all button on the trainer window: learns everything you can in one click; Shift-click learns only what is on your action bars.
• Spells you know but do not have on your action bars are shown in grey as optional, with what the rest costs.
• Next 5 levels: how much gold the coming levels will ask for.
• Hunter pets and warlock demons: their abilities are no longer listed as yours; you get the upgrades your pet or demon can learn instead. Rogue poisons are listed once you have their first rank.
Behind the scenes
• Every release, daily ones included, is now tested before it is published.
• If Wowhead fails, the trainer prices of the last good update are kept.
v0.8.0 — Legacy, challenges and trainer
Zbuilds becomes a progression addon: besides talent builds, it now plans your Legacy points, tracks the Legacy challenges and reminds you of your trainer.
🏛️ Legacy planner
• New Legacy tab next to Talents.
• The three Legacy trees (Professions, Adventure, Resourcefulness) with your learned ranks, read live from the game.
• Points available, spent and earned on the account (out of 81, like the game's window).
• Plans by goal from WoW Forever Builds: Leveling alts, Professions and gold, Travel camping and upkeep, Dying and recovering, Reputation and PvP.
• Each plan is drawn over the trees with its point order and the next perk to take, respecting every unlock requirement.
• Reminder that Legacy points cannot be refunded.
🏆 Legacy challenges
• All 66 challenges, done and pending, with progress bars (levels, professions, honor, reputations, raids…).
• Sorted by ease: what you are closest to comes first.
• Hide done to see only what is left.
• Click a challenge to open it in the game's Legacy Challenges window.
📜 Trainer reminder
• When you level up, an animated banner in the middle of the screen, like the game's own: the new spells and ranks your trainer has for you, their icons and tooltips, and the total cost.
• Says whether your gold is enough or how much you are short.
• Ranks the trainer does not sell are named apart, with where they come from (quest, drop, vendor).
• Prices from Wowhead, replaced by the real prices (reputation discount included) the first time you open your trainer.
• /zb trainer shows the list any time; /zb trainertest previews the banner.
Other
• Everything translated into the 11 languages.
addons.description:
Addon de WoW Forever que reúne builds de talentos de varias webs y te deja verlas, compararlas y aprenderlas en el juego.
• Fuentes: builds populares de Talents Forever (datos CC BY 4.0) y las guías de Icy Veins, Warcraft Tavern, Method, WoW Forever Builds, RankedBoost y WoW Forever Talent (solo sus planes propios), más las guías extra de tools/links.txt.
• Siempre válidas: cada build se traduce al árbol actual del juego por el nombre de sus talentos, y se descarta si usa un talento que ya no existe o no se puede aprender (por ejemplo, si un talento ha cambiado de fila).
• Pestañas por especialización: se abre en la tuya. Puedes filtrar por tipo (Leveo, PvE, PvP), por web y con un buscador.
• Árboles: muestran los rangos de la build y, con el color del borde, lo que ya tienes aprendido. Incluyen las flechas de requisitos.
• Orden de puntos: una línea de tiempo con los 51 puntos en orden y su nivel; pulsa uno para ver la build tal como queda en ese nivel.
• Comparar: clic derecho en otra build, o "Comparar con mis talentos". Cada talento muestra los rangos de A y B, y debajo aparece la lista de diferencias.
• Aprender puntos libres: gasta tus puntos siguiendo el orden de la build (fuera de combate).
• + Importar enlace: pega un enlace de build de talentsforever.com, Icy Veins, Warcraft Tavern o wowforeverbuilds.com. Funciona sin conexión y se guarda en tu cuenta.
• Recomendaciones: las builds iguales de varias webs se juntan en una ("también la recomiendan: …") y salen primero.
• Builds de la beta: marcadas, y se pueden ocultar con el filtro "Beta".
• Nombres y descripciones en tu idioma para los talentos de todas las clases.
• En la ventana de talentos del juego: una barra en la franja dorada con el selector de build, la predicción del siguiente punto ("disponible ya" o "nivel 31", más los dos siguientes), el brillo numerado sobre el árbol del juego y "Aprender N puntos".
• Loadouts: guarda builds como loadout, ponles nombre y rota entre ellos con las flechas o la rueda en la ventana de talentos (clic derecho en el selector para renombrar). Como en Classic, para cambiar de build hay que olvidar los talentos en el instructor; después, un clic la aplica entera.
• Legacy: pestaña con los tres árboles de Legacy (Profesiones, Aventura, Recursos), tus rangos y puntos (disponibles, gastados y conseguidos sobre 81), y planes por objetivo de WoW Forever Builds con su orden de puntos.
• Desafíos de Legacy: los 66 desafíos, hechos y pendientes, con su progreso y ordenados por facilidad. Un clic abre el desafío en la ventana Legacy Challenges del juego.
• Recordatorio del instructor: al subir de nivel, un banner en el centro de la pantalla con los hechizos y rangos nuevos que puedes aprender, el siguiente talento de tu build, el coste total y si te llega el oro, y lo que costarán los próximos 5 niveles. Los hechizos que no tienes en tus barras salen en gris como opcionales. Las mejoras para tu mascota o tu demonio van aparte. Los precios salen de Wowhead y se cambian por los reales al abrir tu instructor.
• Entrenar todo: botón en la ventana del instructor que aprende de un clic todo lo que puedes (Mayús+clic: solo lo de tus barras).
• Banner de Legacy: al completar un desafío, con el siguiente perk de tu plan.
• Opciones: pestaña para activar o quitar el banner, su sonido y su contenido, la lista en el chat, el botón del minimapa y la duración del banner.
• Accesos: botón en el minimapa (/zb minimap lo oculta) y menú de addons del juego.

Comandos: /zb abre la ventana · /zb minimap oculta o muestra el botón del minimapa · /zb trainer lista lo que puedes aprender en tu instructor · /zb trainertest muestra el banner del instructor · /zb options abre las opciones · /zb diag comprueba qué permite este cliente

Idiomas: inglés, español, alemán, francés, portugués, italiano, ruso, coreano y chino (simplificado y tradicional). Se elige el del juego automáticamente.
Instalación…

addons.description:
Unit frames for World of Warcraft: Forever: player, pet, target, focus, target of target, party, party pets and raid. F-Perl keeps the look of the classic X-Perl unit frames, rebuilt for the Forever client. Three optional raid tools come with it: Raid Admin, Raid Helper and Raid Monitor.
What F-Perl does differently
• Auras are drawn by the game's own aura display, so buffs and debuffs keep showing in content where the game hides aura details from addons.
• Light on the game: frames update when the game reports a change, not by checking on a timer, and no setting or event redraws every frame when only one part changed.
• A new settings system, built into the game's settings panel: every option in one place, one page per frame group, and changes take effect at once (only switching the Player, Pet or Target frame on or off needs /reload).
• Layouts: named sets of positions and settings, shared by all your characters, switched in the options or with /fperl layout .
• A new unlock mode: unlocking hides the options and shows a small toolbar with an alignment grid and snapping, and a right-click on any frame opens a menu of its common settings. Changing a frame's scale keeps it where it is.
• Automatic range fading: F-Perl picks your longest-range spells from your spellbook, so out-of-range units fade without any setup for your class.

addons.changelog:
Changelogv1.11.3 (2026-10-23)Fixed
• A macro like /cast !Stealth was saved as a spell called "!Stealth", so its button stayed empty on a new
character. A "!" in front (it keeps Stealth, an aura or a stance from toggling off) now keeps it a macro. A plan
saved before puts the macro back on that button when applied.
v1.11.2 (2026-10-23)Fixed
• Apply from the window could freeze the game for a moment when it changed many keybindings: the window redrew
itself once for every key. It now redraws once.
• Export and Export all took noticeably long with several plans. They use a faster compression setting now (the text
is a little longer; Import reads both).
• After the Import window had been open, Export showed Import's summary and its "macros that run code" checkbox under
the text. It shows the character count again.
v1.11.1 (2026-10-21)Fixed
• A button BarPlan couldn't read when a plan was saved was left out of the plan, so Apply cleared it and put
nothing back. Such a button is now kept in the plan as "keep as it is", and Apply leaves it alone.
New
• /barplan debug [from-to] (default 1-12) lists what BarPlan sees on those buttons and what the plan has there,
for bug reports.
v1.11.0 (2026-10-21)New
• The plan list in the window shows the plans of every class (yours first, each with its class), so you can
export, delete or choose the plan offered to new characters of any class from any character. Apply stays for
plans of your own class. /barplan export finds a plan of another class by its name too.
• Export all (in the window, or /barplan exportall): every plan of every class in one text. Import adds them
all back.
• Import no longer replaces a plan by default: a name you already have gets a number ("Paladin (2)"). The window
says for each plan what will happen; for a single plan you can still type an existing name to replace it.
• Macros that run code are still left out of an imported plan by default; a checkbox in the import window (shown
when the text has such macros, off each time) imports them too, at your own discretion.
v1.10.1 (2026-10-21)Fixed
• The reload question after Apply could sit behind or overlap other windows. It now stays in front of everything,
in the middle of the screen.
v1.10.0 (2026-10-20)New
• Share a plan as a text string: Export in the window (or /barplan export [name]) shows it to copy; Import
(/barplan import) adds a plan from one to its class, on any character or account. Macros that run code
(/run, /script, /console, /click ...) are left out of an imported plan.
v1.9.1 (2026-10-20)Fixed
• A spell you learn was left where the game put it, on the first empty button: on a button the plan keeps for a
spell you haven't learned yet (which then never went there), or on one the plan keeps empty. A spell the game
places as you learn it now goes off any button the plan doesn't have it on, so the plan's buttons stay free.
v1.9.0 (2026-10-19)New
• Edit Mode layout: a plan keeps the Blizzard Edit Mode layout its character uses. Applying it adds the layout
(replacing an older one of the same name), makes it the new character's and offers a reload to set it up.
Its own On/Off switch in the window, /barplan editmode on|off. Save a plan again to add its layout.
• The reload question after Apply covers addons and the layout together.
v1.8.0 (2026-10-19)New
• A plan saved on a character using the account-wide keybindings now keeps those keys too. Applying it sets the
account-wide keys to the plan's, so a new account or a fresh WoW folder gets your keys as well (before, it only
switched the character to the account-wide keys, whatever they were). Save such a plan again to add its keys.
v1.7.0 (2026-10-19)
First release on CurseForge.
New
• A macro that only casts one spell (#showtooltip X / /cast X) is saved in a plan as that spell. Keep such
placeholders on the character you save from (for spells it can't learn yet): new characters get the plain
spell on that button when they learn it, and no macro.…

addons.author: Ghaan
addons.changelog:
Provisionsv1.6
• Works on game clients in every language. Provisions now comes with a table of the game's food, drink, potions, bandages and healthstones (read from the game itself), so it no longer needs English tooltip text. An item that isn't in the table is still read from its tooltip, which only works on an English client.
• Right after logging in, the macros and the bar are ready at once instead of after the tooltips have loaded.
v1.5.3
• Fixed: logging in or reloading during a fight with the clickable bar on gave "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" and a bar that didn't work until the fight ended. The bar now appears once the fight is over.
• Fixed: after a fresh login, item or spell data loading anywhere in the game (tooltips, vendors, the auction house, other addons) could make Provisions re-check your bags up to twice a second for the rest of the session. It now only re-checks when the item it's waiting for loads.
• Items Provisions has given up waiting for no longer ask the game for their data again on every bag check (most noticeable on non-English game clients).
v1.5.2
• Fixed: the bar and macros went empty after a reload on a flight path (or while stunned, feared etc.). They now keep their items, and refresh when you land.
• Items you could use once stay on the bar for the session, so a temporary "can't use that now" from the game no longer empties it.
v1.5.1
• Fixed: food (or other items) sometimes missing from the bar and macros after logging in or switching characters, until your bags changed. Items whose tooltip text loads late are now picked up as soon as it arrives.
• Fixed: the bar and macros went empty while you were dead. They now keep showing what you'll use once you're back.
• New: /prov debug lists the consumables in your bags and how Provisions sees them.
• The first-login hint now points to the settings window (/prov, Item order tab) for dragging the buttons onto your bars.
v1.5
• Options and the item bar (position, size, lock, click behaviour) are now shared by all your characters.
• Item order, which items the bar shows and right-click picks stay per character.
• /prov reset resets the shared settings plus this character's own.
addons.description:
One button to eat, drink, potion or bandage, always with the best item in your bags.

A WoW Forever addon.

⬇️ Download the latest version · What's new

Provisions keeps a few general macros pointed at the right consumable. When you loot new food, level up or run out of a stack, the buttons update themselves. Put them on your bars once and never think about it again.

Any game language: Provisions knows the game's food, drink, potions, bandages and healthstones by their item ID, so it works whatever language your game is in. (An item added to the game later is only recognized on an English client, until Provisions' table has it.)

addons.changelog:
Added
• Buff & Run: a middle click on Arcane Intellect buffs your target and then targets the next
friendly player, one click per player. It casts Arcane Intellect only, never Brilliance, in the
rank the player's level accepts, and passes anyone who is no mana user or already has it. It
does nothing in combat or during the global cooldown, and passes players flagged for PvP unless
"Allow PvP buffing" is on or you are flagged yourself without the 5-minute timer - by /pvp,
in a battleground, an arena or a PvP zone. Both switches are on the General tab; Buff & Run is
on by default.
It has its own key binding.
• Arcane Intellect and the armor are renewed before they run out: on the Tracking tab you set how
many minutes before (Intellect 0-15, default 5; armor 0-5, default 3). From then on the button
glows, counts the buff as needed, and its click - and "Cast next buff" - casts it again; members
who have no Intellect at all come first. Buff & Run follows the same rule.
• A new bug report: a short form - what happened, where (a list of the addon's parts), details -
and everything else taken from the game, so a bug can be fixed without asking you back. It
holds this session's errors with how long ago they came and whether in combat, the addon's
last 50 actions, the state of its buttons and your loaded addons. It never holds chat,
positions or the date, and filters out the names the game knows, GUIDs, BattleTags, e-mail
addresses and file paths; a name the game does not know can remain, so check "Show content"
before you send it. The window lists what it holds and says that an issue is public and the
code is not encrypted. The report is one code, already selected; its link opens a GitHub form
with one field for it, and "Show content" shows what the code holds.
• "Window background" beside Scale on the General tab sets the background of the settings and
bug report windows from invisible (0 %) to solid (100 %); 60 % is the look they always had.
Frame, texts and controls stay as they are.
• "Show anchor" on the General tab keeps the bar's handle - move, lock, settings - visible. It is
on by default, also when you update; switched off, the handle shows only while the mouse is
over it, as before.
• The flyouts of Armor, Teleport and Portal open in a direction you choose on the General tab -
automatic by screen half as before, up or down for a horizontal bar, right or left for a
vertical one - and close by themselves 1 to 5 seconds (3 by default) after the mouse has left
them, also in combat.
• Three keys under Options > Key Bindings > SimpleConjureBar. "Cast next buff" casts, one press
at a time, what the first highlighted button of the bar would fix: your armor, Arcane Intellect
on the next member, a mana gem conjured. In combat it keeps what it held when the fight
started - your armor, if nothing was highlighted then - and never casts Arcane Intellect, as the
button does not. "Buff & Run" is the Arcane Intellect button's middle click, also with the
button hidden. "Open Settings" opens or closes the settings window.
Changed
• Every button's tooltip names its clicks in one order - left, middle, right - and the left
click is named everywhere: "Cast Armor", "Use Water", "Use Food", "Use" and the mana gem's
name (or the conjure spell while you carry none), "Teleport", "Create Portal". The middle
click of water and food reads "Trade Food & Water", the right click of the flyouts "Choose
Armor" and "Choose Destination".
• The tooltip of the minimap button and of the AddOn menu entry says "Lock bar" and "Unlock bar"
for the right click, and changes as soon as you click, without moving the mouse away.
• /scb debug prints the state part of a bug report: every button, flyout entry and key with its
click, the items the addon counts, your group by class and your buffs with minutes left.
• The bug report no longer prints the date and clock, your faction or your exact level (a range
instead), and no settings the addon does not know.…

addons.author: ZulshiBLN
addons.changelog:
Added
• The addon loads for paladins on WoW Forever and says so with its version at login, in the
client's language. Every other class loads nothing.
• A movable bar with an aura, a Righteous Fury, a blessing and a Salvation button. Each is
highlighted with the modern client's glow while it has something to cast.
• The blessing button blesses your group without any assignment: every member gets the
first blessing on his class's priority list that no other paladin has given in
Greater form or an equal or higher rank. Greater Blessings where they are stronger; between
equals only in a raid, from three members of a class in range, while you carry a Symbol of
Kings.
• The Salvation button gives Salvation to every member who is not a tank, Revoke to a tank
carrying it, and in a raid Mass Salvation to a class with enough members lacking it.
• Low-level members get the highest rank that reaches them; nothing is offered that the game
would refuse with "Target is too low level".
• Both buttons show how many casts are left and name the next one in their tooltip, with the
class it reaches for a Greater Blessing or Mass Salvation. A right click on the blessing
button opens the Priorities tab. In combat they keep the cast that was first when the
fight started; one that must wait for the end of combat shows no highlight, and the
tooltip says so. The same while the game hides buffs out of combat, as it sometimes does
in instances and PvP.
• A Priorities tab: early renewal, 5 minutes before a blessing or Salvation of yours runs out
by default, and 3 minutes before your Righteous Fury, for a tank; the aura list; the
priority list of each class, under its class colour, reordered by drag and drop, with
blessings switched off per class and "Enable all" to switch them on again; and the overview. Each class has its own default list; Warriors and
Rogues never get Wisdom.
• A change of a list is cast at once, replacing your blessing of another kind.
• Buff & Run: a middle click on the blessing button blesses the target as his class's list
wants and then targets the next friendly player, one click per player. It passes players
flagged for PvP unless "Allow PvP blessing" is on.
• Key bindings in a section of their own, SmartBlessingBar: "Cast next buff" casts what the
aura, Righteous Fury, blessing and Salvation buttons want, one per press; "Buff & Run"; "Set
priorities" opens the Priorities tab.
• Righteous Fury is only highlighted while the game reports you as tank (a group's role
check); otherwise its button is greyed.
• The overview, on the Priorities tab: every group member in two columns, sorted by class and
named in its colour, a tank's or healer's role icon, a paladin's aura, the blessings and
Salvation he carries, yours glowing, the one you would give next faint. A middle click on
the minimap button opens it.
• The aura button casts the first aura of your list that no other paladin of your group runs,
so paladins need not agree who runs which.
• A settings window, opened with /sbb, a middle click on the handle, the minimap button, the
AddOn menu or the game's Options. General: language, hide in combat, hide the minimap button,
scale, border, background color, orientation and growth direction, demo mode, Buff & Run
with Allow PvP blessing, Report bug, Reload UI. Tracking: show each of the four buttons,
their highlight's color and speed, and the color of the blessing and Salvation buttons'
count.
Supplies: the Symbol of Kings warning threshold and colors, and the auto-buy. Order: the
order of the four buttons. Priorities: see above. Macros: prepared for a later version.
• The blessing button shows your Symbols of Kings once you know a Greater Blessing, colored
when they run low; at a vendor they are bought automatically up to a target, above a gold
reserve.
• A minimap button, an AddOn menu entry and an entry in the game's Options.
• A bug report to copy into a GitHub issue, without character names or realm.…

Exceptions for single characters come later.

equals only in a raid, from three members of a class in range, while you carry a Symbol of
Kings.
• The Salvation button gives Salvation to every member who is not a tank, Revoke to a tank
carrying it, and in a raid Mass Salvation to a class with enough members lacking it.
• Low-level members get the highest rank that reaches them; nothing is offered that the game
would refuse with "Target is too low level".
• Both buttons show how many casts are left and name the next one in their tooltip, with the
class it reaches for a Greater Blessing or Mass Salvation. A right click on the blessing
button opens the Priorities tab. In combat they keep the cast that was first when the
fight started; one that must wait for the end of combat shows no highlight, and the
tooltip says so. The same while the game hides buffs out of combat, as it sometimes does
in instances and PvP.
• A Priorities tab: early renewal, 5 minutes before a blessing or Salvation of yours runs out
by default, and 3 minutes before your Righteous Fury, for a tank; the aura list; the
priority list of each class, under its class colour, reordered by drag and drop, with
blessings switched off per class and "Enable all" to switch them on again; and the overview. Each class has its own default list; Warriors and
Rogues never get Wisdom.
• A change of a list is cast at once, replacing your blessing of another kind.
• Buff & Run: a middle click on the blessing button blesses the target as his class's list
wants and then targets the next friendly player, one click per player. It passes players
flagged for PvP unless "Allow PvP blessing" is on.
• Key bindings in a section of their own, SmartBlessingBar: "Cast next buff" casts what the
aura, Righteous Fury, blessing and Salvation buttons want, one per press; "Buff & Run"; "Set
priorities" opens the Priorities tab.
• Righteous Fury is only highlighted while the game reports you as tank (a group's role
check); otherwise its button is greyed.
• The overview, on the Priorities tab: every group member in two columns, sorted by class and
named in its colour, a tank's or healer's role icon, a paladin's aura, the blessings and
Salvation he carries, yours glowing, the one you would give next faint. A middle click on
the minimap button opens it.
• The aura button casts the first aura of your list that no other paladin of your group runs,
so paladins need not agree who runs which.
• A settings window, opened with /sbb, a middle click on the handle, the minimap button, the
AddOn menu or the game's Options. General: language, hide in combat, hide the minimap button,
scale, border, background color, orientation and growth direction, demo mode, Buff & Run
with Allow PvP blessing, Report bug, Reload UI. Tracking: show each of the four buttons,
their highlight's color and speed, and the color of the blessing and Salvation buttons'
count.
Supplies: the Symbol of Kings warning threshold and colors, and the auto-buy. Order: the
order of the four buttons. Priorities: see above. Macros: prepared for a later version.
• The blessing button shows your Symbols of Kings once you know a Greater Blessing, colored
when they run low; at a vendor they are bought automatically up to a target, above a gold
reserve.
• A minimap button, an AddOn menu entry and an entry in the game's Options.
• A bug report to copy into a GitHub issue, without character names or realm.…

addons.summary: A modern blessing manager for paladins in WoW Forever
